ly for the currently READY, explicitly
// selected Execution Node; secret bytes remain in the dedicated delivery flow.
func (a *App) ListPendingSecretOutputs(cursor *string) SecretOutputPackagesOperation {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	if a.current.Status != "OPEN" || a.current.Project == nil {
		a.editMu.Unlock()
		return SecretOutputPackagesOperation{Status: "UNAVAILABLE", Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: "PROJECT_NOT_OPEN", Message: projectErrorMessage("PROJECT_NOT_OPEN")}}
	}
	binding, err := a.resolveSelectedExecutionNodeBindingLocked()
	if err != nil || a.execution.context.Status != "READY" {
		a.editMu.Unlock()
		return SecretOutputPackagesOperation{Status: "UNAVAILABLE", Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: "EXECUTION_NODE_NOT_READY", Message: projectErrorMessage("EXECUTION_NODE_NOT_READY")}}
	}
	client, ok := binding.reader.transport.(interface {
		GetSecretOutputCapabilities(context.Context, executionnode.Node, string, string) (executionnode.SecretOutputCapabilities, error)
		ListPendingSecretOutputs(context.Context, executionnode.Node, string, string, int, *string) (executionnode.SecretOutputList, error)
	})
	if !ok {
		a.editMu.Unlock()
		return SecretOutputPackagesOperation{Status: "UNAVAILABLE", Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: "SECRET_OUTPUT_UNSUPPORTED", Message: "The selected Execution Node does not support protected output delivery."}}
	}
	runtimeBinding, valid := installationRuntimeBinding(binding.reader.runtimeRelease)
	if !valid {
		a.editMu.Unlock()
		return SecretOutputPackagesOperation{Status: "UNAVAILABLE", Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: "EXECUTION_NODE_NOT_READY", Message: projectErrorMessage("EXECUTION_NODE_NOT_READY")}}
	}
	projectID, node, runtimeDigest := a.current.Project.ID, binding.node, runtimeBinding.BundleDigest
	generation, root := a.installationGeneration, a.current.Root
	ctx, cancel := a.operationContext(30 * time.Second)
	a.editMu.Unlock()
	defer cancel()
	if _, err := client.GetSecretOutputCapabilities(ctx, node, runtimeDigest, projectID); err != nil {
		return SecretOutputPackagesOperation{Status: "UNAVAILABLE", Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: "SECRET_OUTPUT_UNAVAILABLE", Message: "Secret output delivery is not available from the selected Execution Node."}}
	}
	listed, err := client.ListPendingSecretOutputs(ctx, node, runtimeDigest, projectID, 32, cursor)
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, executionnode.ErrSecretOutputRecoveryRequired) {
			return SecretOutputPackagesOperation{Status: "UNAVAILABLE", Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: "OUTPUT_RECOVERY_REQUIRED", Message: "Незавершённые выходные файлы сервиса сохранены на Execution Node. Требуется восстановление; частичные данные не удалены."}}
		}
		return SecretOutputPackagesOperation{Status: "UNAVAILABLE", Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: "SECRET_OUTPUT_UNAVAILABLE", Message: "Pending secret outputs could not be safely listed."}}
	}
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	currentBinding, bindingErr := a.resolveSelectedExecutionNodeBindingLocked()
	if a.installationGeneration != generation || a.current.Status != "OPEN" || a.current.Root != root || a.current.Project == nil || a.current.Project.ID != projectID || a.execution.context.Status != "READY" || bindingErr != nil || currentBinding != binding || currentBinding.node != node {
		return SecretOutputPackagesOperation{Status: "UNAVAILABLE", Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: "PROJECT_CHANGED", Message: projectErrorMessage("PROJECT_CHANGED")}}
	}
	currentRuntime, runtimeValid := installationRuntimeBinding(currentBinding.reader.runtimeRelease)
	if !runtimeValid || currentRuntime != runtimeBinding {
		return SecretOutputPackagesOperation{Status: "UNAVAILABLE", Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: "PROJECT_CHANGED", Message: projectErrorMessage("PROJECT_CHANGED")}}
	}
	// A delivered/cleanup-pending remote package may no longer be listable.
	for index := range listed.Packages {
		item := &listed.Packages[index]
		_, encrypted, readErr := installer.ReadSecretOutputFiles(root, projectID, item.DeploymentID, item.PackageID, item.SourceRunID, item.Generation, item.RuntimeDigest)
		for _, data := range encrypted {
			clear(data)
		}
		if readErr == nil {
			item.State = "LOCAL_DELIVERED"
		}
	}
	// Recover its identity from the bound local receipt at known managed paths.
	if cursor == nil && a.current.Managed != nil {
		seen := map[string]bool{}
		for _, item := range listed.Packages {
			seen[item.PackageID] = true
		}
		for deployment := range a.current.Managed.Deployments {
			receipt, encrypted, readErr := installer.ReadSecretOutputReceipt(root, projectID, deployment, runtimeDigest)
			for _, data := range encrypted {
				clear(data)
			}
			if readErr != nil || seen[receipt.PackageID] {
				continue
			}
			listed.Packages = append(listed.Packages, executionnode.SecretOutputPackage{Protocol: "SecretOutputDelivery/v1alpha1", PackageID: receipt.PackageID, ProjectID: receipt.ProjectID, DeploymentID: receipt.DeploymentID, SourceRunID: receipt.SourceRunID, RuntimeDigest: receipt.RuntimeDigest, Generation: receipt.Generation, State: "LOCAL_DELIVERED", Entries: []string{"admin-token", "unseal-shares"}})
			if len(listed.Packages) >= 96 {
				break
			}
		}
	}
	return SecretOutputPackagesOperation{Status: "READY", Packages: listed.Packages, NextCursor: listed.NextCursor}
}

func (a *App) getRuntimeSecretDescriptorsLocked(clearAttached bool) RuntimeSecretDescriptorOperation {
	if a.current.Status != "OPEN" || a.current.Project == nil || a.current.Root == "" || a.execution.context.Status != "READY" {
		return RuntimeSecretDescriptorOperation{Status: "UNAVAILABLE", Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: "EXECUTION_NODE_READY_REQUIRED", Message: projectErrorMessage("EXECUTION_NODE_READY_REQUIRED")}}
	}
	binding, err := a.resolveSelectedExecutionNodeBindingLocked()
	if err != nil {
		return RuntimeSecretDescriptorOperation{Status: "UNAVAILABLE", Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: projectErrorCode(err), Message: projectErrorMessage(projectErrorCode(err))}}
	}
	transport, ok := binding.reader.transport.(interface {
		BuildRuntimeSecretDescriptors(context.Context, executionnode.Node, string, map[string]any, executionnode.RuntimeSecretDescriptorRequest) (executionnode.RuntimeSecretDescriptorResult, error)
	})
	if !ok {
		return RuntimeSecretDescriptorOperation{Status: "UNAVAILABLE", Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: "RUNTIME_SECRET_DESCRIPTORS_UNSUPPORTED", Message: "Execution Node does not support service secret descriptors."}}
	}
	revision, err := installer.ProjectRevision(a.current.Root)
	if err != nil {
		return RuntimeSecretDescriptorOperation{Status: "UNAVAILABLE", Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: "PROJECT_REVISION_UNAVAILABLE", Message: projectErrorMessage("PROJECT_REVISION_UNAVAILABLE")}}
	}
	requestID, err := executionnode.NewRequestID()
	if err != nil {
		return RuntimeSecretDescriptorOperation{Status: "UNAVAILABLE", Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: "RUNTIME_SECRET_DESCRIPTORS_UNAVAILABLE", Message: "Could not create a bounded secret descriptor request."}}
	}
	ctx, cancel := a.operationContext(2 * time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	result, err := transport.BuildRuntimeSecretDescriptors(ctx, binding.node, a.current.Root, binding.reader.runtimeRelease, executionnode.RuntimeSecretDescriptorRequest{RequestID: requestID, ProjectIdentity: a.current.Project.ID, ProjectRevision: revision, ArtifactLockDigest: a.current.Project.Source.BundleDigest, CatalogLockDigest: a.current.Project.Source.CatalogDigest})
	if err != nil {
		return RuntimeSecretDescriptorOperation{Status: "UNAVAILABLE", Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: "RUNTIME_SECRET_DESCRIPTORS_UNAVAILABLE", Message: "Core could not safely build service secret descriptors.", DiagnosticCodes: runtimeSecretDescriptorDiagnosticCodes(err)}}
	}
	if result.ProjectRevision != revision {
		return RuntimeSecretDescriptorOperation{Status: "UNAVAILABLE", Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: "RUNTIME_SECRET_DESCRIPTORS_UNAVAILABLE", Message: "Core returned descriptors for a different saved project revision.", DiagnosticCodes: []string{"PROJECT_SNAPSHOT_REVISION_MISMATCH"}}}
	}
	if !runtimeEvidenceMatchesExpected(result.Runtime, binding.reader.runtimeRelease) {
		return RuntimeSecretDescriptorOperation{Status: "UNAVAILABLE", Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: "RUNTIME_SECRET_DESCRIPTORS_UNAVAILABLE", Message: "Core returned descriptors without matching runtime identity.", DiagnosticCodes: []string{"EXECUTION_RUNTIME_IDENTITY_MISMATCH"}}}
	}
	view := RuntimeSecretDescriptorOperation{Status: "READY", ProjectRevision: result.ProjectRevision, DescriptorSetFingerprint: result.DescriptorSetFingerprint}
	for _, item := range result.Descriptors {
		if !validRuntimeSecretDescriptor(item) {
			return RuntimeSecretDescriptorOperation{Status: "UNAVAILABLE", Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: "RUNTIME_SECRET_DESCRIPTORS_UNAVAILABLE", Message: "Core returned an unsafe service secret descriptor."}}
		}
		view.Descriptors = append(view.Descriptors, RuntimeSecretDescriptorView{RequirementRef: item.RequirementRef, Purpose: item.Purpose, ServiceDeployment: item.ServiceDeployment, DisplayLabel: item.DisplayLabel, RequiredWhen: item.RequiredWhen, Operations: append([]string(nil), item.Operations...), Hosts: append([]string(nil), item.Hosts...)})
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, item := range view.Descriptors {
		if seen[item.RequirementRef] {
			return RuntimeSecretDescriptorOperation{Status: "UNAVAILABLE", Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: "RUNTIME_SECRET_DESCRIPTORS_UNAVAILABLE"}}
		}
		seen[item.RequirementRef] = true
	}
	sources := map[string]bool{}
	for _, item := range result.ApplicationInputs {
		if !validApplicationSecretDescriptor(item) || seen[item.RequirementRef] || sources[item.SourceRef] {
			return RuntimeSecretDescriptorOperation{Status: "UNAVAILABLE", Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: "RUNTIME_SECRET_DESCRIPTORS_UNAVAILABLE", Message: "Core returned an unsafe application secret descriptor."}}
		}
		seen[item.RequirementRef] = true
		sources[item.SourceRef] = true
		view.ApplicationInputs = append(view.ApplicationInputs, item)
	}
	// A fresh Core descriptor set invalidates values already attached to a
	// target credential, but retains local pending values long enough to prove
	// they match this exact set below.
	a.runtimeSecretEvidence = nil
	if credentialBinding, bindingErr := a.credentialBindingLocked(); clearAttached && bindingErr == nil {
		a.secrets.ClearAttachedRuntimeSecretValues(credentialBinding)
	}
	a.runtimeSecretEvidence = &runtimeSecretDescriptorEvidence{projectID: a.current.Project.ID, projectRevision: revision, nodeID: binding.node.ID, runtime: result.Runtime, fingerprint: result.DescriptorSetFingerprint, descriptors: append([]RuntimeSecretDescriptorView(nil), view.Descriptors...)}
	a.runtimeSecretEvidence.applicationInputs = append([]executionnode.ApplicationSecretDescriptor(nil), view.ApplicationInputs...)
	requirements := make([]string, 0, len(view.Descriptors))
	typedRequirements := make([]runtimesecret.RuntimeSecretInput, 0, len(view.Descriptors))
	for _, descriptor := range view.Descriptors {
		if descriptor.Purpose == "SERVICE_PASSWORD" {
			requirements = append(requirements, descriptor.RequirementRef)
			pending, pendingErr := a.pendingRuntimeSecretDescriptorsLocked(descriptor.ServiceDeployment)
			if pendingErr == nil && len(pending) == 1 && pending[0].DeploymentBound {
				typedRequirements = append(typedRequirements, runtimesecret.RuntimeSecretInput{RequirementRef: descriptor.RequirementRef, Purpose: descriptor.Purpose, ServiceDeployment: descriptor.ServiceDeployment, Operations: append([]string(nil), descriptor.Operations...)})
			}
		}
		if descriptor.Purpose == secretfiles.PurposeAdminToken || descriptor.Purpose == secretfiles.PurposeUnsealShares {
			typedRequirements = append(typedRequirements, runtimesecret.RuntimeSecretInput{RequirementRef: descriptor.RequirementRef, Purpose: descriptor.Purpose, ServiceDeployment: descriptor.ServiceDeployment, Operations: append([]string(nil), descriptor.Operations...)})
		}
	}
	applicationTokens := []runtimesecret.RuntimeSecretInput{}
	for _, item := range view.ApplicationInputs {
		requirements = append(requirements, item.RequirementRef)
		if item.Purpose == "APPLICATION_VAULT_ADMIN_TOKEN" && item.ProviderDeployment != nil {
			applicationTokens = append(applicationTokens, runtimesecret.RuntimeSecretInput{RequirementRef: item.RequirementRef, Purpose: item.Purpose, ServiceDeployment: *item.ProviderDeployment})
		}
	}
	if credentialBinding, bindingErr := a.credentialBindingLocked(); bindingErr == nil {
		if err := a.secrets.PromotePendingRuntimeSecretValues(credentialBinding, requirements); err != nil {
			a.runtimeSecretEvidence = nil
			return RuntimeSecretDescriptorOperation{Status: "UNAVAILABLE", Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: projectErrorCode(err), Message: projectErrorMessage(projectErrorCode(err))}}
		}
		if err := a.secrets.BindPendingServiceSecretInputs(credentialBinding, typedRequirements, applicationTokens...); err != nil {
			a.runtimeSecretEvidence = nil
			return RuntimeSecretDescriptorOperation{Status: "UNAVAILABLE", Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: projectErrorCode(err), Message: projectErrorMessage(projectErrorCode(err))}}
		}
	}
	return view
}

// runtimeSecretDescriptorDiagnosticCodes returns only bounded machine tokens
// from the fixed Execution Node protocol. It deliberately excludes diagnostic
// messages, command output, paths and all user/project data.
func runtimeSecretDescriptorDiagnosticCodes(err error) []string {
	var executionErr *executionnode.ExecutionError
	if !errors.As(err, &executionErr) || executionErr == nil {
		return nil
	}
	var result []string
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, 4)
	appendCode := func(code string) {
		if len(result) >= 8 || len(code) > 80 || !verificationErrorCodePattern.MatchString(code) {
			return
		}
		if _, exists := seen[code]; exists {
			return
		}
		seen[code] = struct{}{}
		result = append(result, code)
	}
	appendCode(executionErr.Code)
	for _, finding := range executionErr.Findings {
		appendCode(finding.Code)
	}
	return result
}

func typedRuntimeSecretRequirements(plan executionnode.DeploymentPlan) []executionnode.RuntimeSecretInputRequirement {
	result := make([]executionnode.RuntimeSecretInputRequirement, 0)
	for _, requirement := range plan.RequiredCredentials {
		if requirement.Purpose == secretfiles.PurposeAdminToken || requirement.Purpose == secretfiles.PurposeUnsealShares {
			result = append(result, executionnode.RuntimeSecretInputRequirement{RequirementRef: requirement.RequirementRef, Purpose: requirement.Purpose})
		}
	}
	sort.Slice(result, func(i, j int) bool { return result[i].RequirementRef < result[j].RequirementRef })
	return result
}

func runtimeDescriptorsMatchPlan(descriptors []RuntimeSecretDescriptorView, requirements []executionnode.RuntimeSecretInputRequirement, mode executionnode.ExecutionMode) bool {
	actual := make([]executionnode.RuntimeSecretInputRequirement, 0)
	for _, descriptor := range descriptors {
		if (mode == executionnode.ApplicationLibrariesOnly || mode == executionnode.InfrastructureVerifyOnly) && !slices.Contains(descriptor.Operations, "SERVICE_VERIFY") {
			continue
		}
		if descriptor.Purpose == secretfiles.PurposeAdminToken || descriptor.Purpose == secretfiles.PurposeUnsealShares {
			actual = append(actual, executionnode.RuntimeSecretInputRequirement{RequirementRef: descriptor.RequirementRef, Purpose: descriptor.Purpose})
		}
	}
	sort.Slice(actual, func(i, j int) bool { return actual[i].RequirementRef < actual[j].RequirementRef })
	if len(actual) != len(requirements) {
		return false
	}
	for i := range actual {
		if actual[i] != requirements[i] {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func validRuntimeSecretDescriptor(item executionnode.RuntimeSecretDescriptor) bool {
	if !runtimeSecretDescriptorRequirement.MatchString(item.RequirementRef) || item.DisplayLabel == "" || len([]byte(item.DisplayLabel)) > 160 || len(item.Hosts) == 0 || len(item.Hosts) > 256 {
		return false
	}
	seenHosts := make(map[string]struct{}, len(item.Hosts))
	for _, host := range item.Hosts {
		if host == "" {
			return false
		}
		if _, duplicate := seenHosts[host]; duplicate {
			return false
		}
		seenHosts[host] = struct{}{}
	}
	if item.Purpose == "PKI_STORE_PASSWORD" {
		return item.RequirementRef == "pki-store-password" && item.ServiceDeployment == "" && item.RequiredWhen == "ALWAYS" && len(item.Operations) == 2 && item.Operations[0] == "SERVICE_APPLY" && item.Operations[1] == "SERVICE_VERIFY"
	}
	if item.Purpose == "SERVICE_PASSWORD" {
		return item.ServiceDeployment != "" && item.RequiredWhen == "ALWAYS" && len(item.Operations) == 2 && item.Operations[0] == "SERVICE_APPLY" && item.Operations[1] == "SERVICE_VERIFY"
	}
	if item.Purpose == secretfiles.PurposeAdminToken {
		return item.ServiceDeployment != "" && item.RequiredWhen == "INITIALIZED" && len(item.Operations) == 2 && item.Operations[0] == "SERVICE_APPLY" && item.Operations[1] == "SERVICE_VERIFY"
	}
	if item.Purpose == secretfiles.PurposeUnsealShares {
		return item.ServiceDeployment != "" && item.RequiredWhen == "SEALED" && len(item.Operations) == 1 && item.Operations[0] == "SERVICE_APPLY"
	}
	return false
}

func (a *App) ClearSessionCredential() (runtimesecret.Status, error) {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	if a.startInFlight || a.installationRuns.hasActiveRun() || a.secrets.HasAnyRunExecutionIdentityHold() {
		return runtimesecret.Status{}, errors.New("INSTALLATION_RUN_ACTIVE")
	}
	_, err := a.credentialBindingLocked()
	if err != nil {
		return runtimesecret.Status{}, err
	}
	a.secrets.Clear()
	a.pendingHostKey = nil
	a.invalidateDynamicBindingLocked()
	a.runtimeSecretEvidence = nil
	return runtimesecret.Status{Status: runtimesecret.StatusMissing, SudoPasswordStatus: runtimesecret.SudoNotProvided, PKIStorePasswordStatus: runtimesecret.PKIStorePasswordMissing}, nil
}

// GetExecutionNodeContext exposes only app-memory, non-secret selection state.
func (a *App) GetExecutionNodeContext() (ExecutionNodeContext, error) {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	a.reconcileEditSessionLocked()
	if a.current.Status != "OPEN" || a.current.Project == nil {
		return ExecutionNodeContext{}, errors.New("PROJECT_NOT_OPEN")
	}
	// A draft cannot authorize execution, but merely rendering its node panel
	// must not revoke verification evidence for the still-saved revision.
	if a.activeSession == "" && a.binding != nil && a.binding.dynamic {
		_, _ = a.resolveSelectedExecutionNodeBindingLocked()
	}
	context := a.execution.context
	// Revalidating a dynamic binding while a draft is open may revoke the
	// verification of the still-saved revision. The draft is not executable.
	if a.activeSession == "" && context.Status == "READY" {
		if binding, err := a.resolveSelectedExecutionNodeBindingLocked(); err == nil {
			if digest, ok := binding.reader.runtimeRelease["bundleDigest"].(string); ok {
				context.RuntimeDigest = digest
			}
		}
	}
	return context, nil
}

// SelectExecutionNode changes only the current safe project-server selection.
func (a *App) SelectExecutionNode(hostID string) (ExecutionNodeContext, error) {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	a.reconcileEditSessionLocked()
	if a.current.Status != "OPEN" || a.current.Project == nil {
		return ExecutionNodeContext{}, errors.New("PROJECT_NOT_OPEN")
	}
	if a.recoveredRunActiveLocked() && hostID != a.recoveredRun.NodeID {
		return ExecutionNodeContext{}, errors.New("INSTALLATION_RUN_ACTIVE")
	}
	before := a.execution.context
	if err := a.execution.selectProjectServer(hostID); err != nil {
		return ExecutionNodeContext{}, err
	}
	if !sameExecutionNodeTarget(before, a.execution.context) {
		a.pendingHostKey = nil
		a.invalidateDynamicBindingLocked()
		a.clearRuntimeSecretDescriptorEvidenceLocked()
		a.current.Snapshot = nil
		a.current.Verification = notVerified()
		a.installationPlanID = ""
		a.installationGeneration++
		a.clearInstallationRunsLocked()
	}
	a.continuation = nil
	return a.execution.context, nil
}

func sameExecutionNodeTarget(left, right ExecutionNodeContext) bool {
	return left.SelectionKind == right.SelectionKind && left.SelectedHostID == right.SelectedHostID
}

func (a *App) credentialBindingLocked() (runtimesecret.Binding, error) {
	if a.current.Status != "OPEN" || a.current.Project == nil || a.current.Root == "" || a.current.Project.ID == "" {
		return runtimesecret.Binding{}, errors.New("PROJECT_NOT_OPEN")
	}
	return runtimesecret.Binding{Root: a.current.Root, ID: a.current.Project.ID}, nil
}

func (a *App) clearCredentialForReplacementLocked(root string, project *projectlifecycle.Project) {
	a.clearRuntimeSecretDescriptorEvidenceLocked()
	if a.current.Status != "OPEN" || a.current.Project == nil || project == nil || a.current.Root != root || a.current.Project.ID != project.ID {
		a.secrets.Clear()
	}
}

func (a *App) clearRuntimeSecretDescriptorEvidenceLocked() {
	a.runtimeSecretEvidence = nil
	if binding, err := a.credentialBindingLocked(); err == nil {
		a.secrets.ClearRuntimeSecretValues(binding)
	}
}

type EditOperationResult struct {
	Status      string                      `json:"status"`
	Session     *installer.EditSession      `json:"session,omitempty"`
	Plan        *installer.EditPlan         `json:"plan,omitempty"`
	Commit      *installer.EditCommitResult `json:"commit,omitempty"`
	Diagnostics []ApplicationDiagnostic     `json:"diagnostics,omitempty"`
	Error       *ProjectOpenError           `json:"error,omitempty"`
}

// StructuralEditOperationResult is the additive local Save contract. Legacy
// EditOperationResult remains published for previous Wails consumers.
type StructuralEditOperationResult struct {
	Status      string                          `json:"status"`
	Session     *installer.EditSession          `json:"session,omitempty"`
	Plan        *installer.StructuralEditPlan   `json:"plan,omitempty"`
	Commit      *installer.StructuralSaveResult `json:"commit,omitempty"`
	Current     *ProjectOpenResult              `json:"current,omitempty"`
	Diagnostics []ApplicationDiagnostic         `json:"diagnostics,omitempty"`
	Error       *ProjectOpenError               `json:"error,omitempty"`
}

type ProjectExportOperationResult struct {
	Status string                         `json:"status"`
	Plan   *installer.ProjectExportPlan   `json:"plan,omitempty"`
	Result *installer.ProjectExportResult `json:"result,omitempty"`
	Error  *ProjectOpenError              `json:"error,omitempty"`
}

func (a *App) projectExportFailure(err error) ProjectExportOperationResult {
	code := projectErrorCode(err)
	return ProjectExportOperationResult{Status: "BLOCKED", Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: code, Message: projectErrorMessage(code)}}
}

// PlanProjectExport creates one bounded in-memory export capability. It does
// not write the project, call Core, contact an Execution Node, or expose file
// contents to Wails.
func (a *App) PlanProjectExport(destinationParent, directoryName string) ProjectExportOperationResult {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	a.reconcileEditSessionLocked()
	if a.activeSession != "" {
		return a.projectExportFailure(errors.New("EDIT_SESSION_ACTIVE"))
	}
	if a.current.Status != "OPEN" || a.current.Project == nil {
		return a.projectExportFailure(errors.New("PROJECT_NOT_OPEN"))
	}
	if a.current.Classification != projectlifecycle.ClassificationEmpty && a.current.Classification != projectlifecycle.ClassificationManaged {
		return a.projectExportFailure(errors.New("EXPORT_NOT_AVAILABLE"))
	}
	if a.current.Classification == projectlifecycle.ClassificationManaged && a.current.Managed == nil {
		return a.projectExportFailure(errors.New("LOCAL_PROJECT_REFRESH_REQUIRED"))
	}
	a.clearProjectExportLocked()
	capability, plan, err := installer.PlanProjectExport(a.current.Root, destinationParent, directoryName)
	if err != nil {
		return a.projectExportFailure(err)
	}
	a.export = capability
	return ProjectExportOperationResult{Status: "READY", Plan: &plan}
}

// CommitProjectExport publishes only the manifest bound to the active preview.
// It is synchronous by owner decision: no user-facing interruption path exists.
func (a *App) CommitProjectExport(planDigest string) ProjectExportOperationResult {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	if a.export == nil {
		return a.projectExportFailure(errors.New("EXPORT_PLAN_STALE"))
	}
	capability := a.export
	a.export = nil
	result := capability.Commit(planDigest)
	if result.Status != "EXPORTED" {
		return a.projectExportFailure(errors.New(result.ErrorCode))
	}
	return ProjectExportOperationResult{Status: "EXPORTED", Result: &result}
}

func (a *App) clearProjectExportLocked() {
	if a.export != nil {
		a.export.Close()
		a.export = nil
	}
}

func (a *App) editFailure(err error) EditOperationResult {
	code := projectErrorCode(err)
	return EditOperationResult{Status: "BLOCKED", Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: code, Message: projectErrorMessage(code)}}
}

func (a *App) structuralEditFailure(err error) StructuralEditOperationResult {
	code := projectErrorCode(err)
	return StructuralEditOperationResult{Status: "BLOCKED", Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: code, Message: projectErrorMessage(code)}}
}

func (a *App) StartEditSession() EditOperationResult {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	a.reconcileEditSessionLocked()
	if a.current.Status != "OPEN" || a.current.Project == nil {
		return a.editFailure(errors.New("PROJECT_NOT_OPEN"))
	}
	if a.current.Classification == projectlifecycle.ClassificationManaged && a.current.Managed == nil {
		return a.editFailure(errors.New("LOCAL_PROJECT_REFRESH_REQUIRED"))
	}
	a.clearProjectExportLocked()
	revision := ""
	if a.current.Snapshot != nil {
		revision = a.current.Snapshot.ProjectRevision
	} else {
		var err error
		revision, err = installer.ProjectRevision(a.current.Root)
		if err != nil {
			return a.editFailure(err)
		}
	}
	typeIDs := make([]string, 0, len(a.config.ServerTypes))
	if a.configErr == nil {
		for _, serverType := range a.config.ServerTypes {
			typeIDs = append(typeIDs, serverType.ID)
		}
	}
	a.editor = installer.NewBackend(nil, installer.WithServerTypes(typeIDs), installer.WithProjectCatalogResolver(a.lifecycle.ResolveProjectCatalog))
	session, err := a.sessions.Start(a.current.Project.ID, a.current.Root, a.current.Classification, revision)
	if err != nil {
		return a.editFailure(err)
	}
	a.activeSession = session.SessionID
	return EditOperationResult{Status: "EDITING", Session: &session}
}

func (a *App) AppendEditCommand(sessionID string, command installer.EditCommand) EditOperationResult {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	a.reconcileEditSessionLocked()
	if sessionID == "" || sessionID != a.activeSession {
		return a.editFailure(errors.New("EDIT_SESSION_EXPIRED"))
	}
	switch command.Operation {
	case "SetProjectSetting", "CreateServer", "UpdateServer", "DeleteServer",
		"CreateServiceDeployment", "DeleteServiceDeployment",
		"ReconcileDeploymentPlacement", "ReconcileHostScopedDeploymentPlacement",
		"CreateEndpointGroup", "UpdateEndpointGroup", "DeleteEndpointGroup",
		"SetServiceEndpointGroup", "ClearServiceEndpointGroup",
		"ReconcileEndpointProvider", "ClearEndpointProvider",
		"CreateCertificateAuthority", "UpdateCertificateAuthority", "DeleteCertificateAuthority",
		"CreateCertificateProfile", "UpdateCertificateProfile", "DeleteCertificateProfile",
		"CreateTLSProfile", "UpdateTLSProfile", "DeleteTLSProfile",
		"CreateCertificateScope", "UpdateCertificateScope", "DeleteCertificateScope":
	case "CreateApplicationLibraryDeployment", "UpdateApplicationLibraryDeployment", "DeleteApplicationLibraryDeployment",
		"SetApplicationLibrarySlot", "RemoveApplicationLibrarySlot", "SetApplicationLibraryPlacement", "RemoveApplicationLibraryPlacement",
		"SetApplicationLibraryOverride", "RemoveApplicationLibraryOverride":
	case "SetServiceConfigurationValue", "RemoveServiceConfigurationOverride":
	default:
		return a.editFailure(errors.New("EDIT_OPERATION_NOT_AVAILABLE"))
	}
	session, err := a.sessions.Append(sessionID, command, a.editor)
	if err != nil {
		return a.editFailure(err)
	}
	a.execution.applyCommand(command.HostID, command.Operation, command.Address)
	result := EditOperationResult{Status: "EDITING", Session: &session}
	if command.ServerType != "" && a.configErr == nil && !a.config.HasServerType(command.ServerType) {
		result.Diagnostics = []ApplicationDiagnostic{{Code: "UNKNOWN_CONFIGURED_SERVER_TYPE", Severity: "WARNING", HostID: command.HostID, SafeMessage: "Server type is not present in the current application configuration"}}
	}
	return result
}

// AmendServiceConfigurationDraft replaces or withdraws one acknowledged
// setting command in the current unsaved session. It cannot edit other intents.
func (a *App) AmendServiceConfigurationDraft(sessionID string, index int, expected installer.EditCommand, replacement *installer.EditCommand) EditOperationResult {
	return a.amendDraft(sessionID, index, expected, replacement, false)
}

func (a *App) AmendApplicationLibraryDraft(sessionID string, index int, expected installer.EditCommand, replacement *installer.EditCommand) EditOperationResult {
	return a.amendDraft(sessionID, index, expected, replacement, true)
}

func (a *App) amendDraft(sessionID string, index int, expected installer.EditCommand, replacement *installer.EditCommand, application bool) EditOperationResult {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	a.reconcileEditSessionLocked()
	if sessionID == "" || sessionID != a.activeSession {
		return a.editFailure(errors.New("EDIT_SESSION_EXPIRED"))
	}
	amend := a.sessions.AmendConfiguration
	if application {
		amend = a.sessions.AmendApplication
	}
	session, err := amend(sessionID, index, expected, replacement, a.editor)
	if err != nil {
		return a.editFailure(err)
	}
	if session.CommandCount == 0 {
		if !a.sessions.Discard(sessionID, a.editor) {
			return a.editFailure(errors.New("EDIT_SESSION_EXPIRED"))
		}
		a.activeSession, a.editor = "", nil
		a.execution.discardDraft(currentProjectHosts(a.current))
		return EditOperationResult{Status: "DISCARDED"}
	}
	return EditOperationResult{Status: "EDITING", Session: &session}
}

// ReviewEditSession is retained only as a shape-compatible legacy endpoint.
func (a *App) ReviewEditSession(string) EditOperationResult {
	return a.editFailure(errors.New("EDIT_CONTRACT_SUPERSEDED"))
}

func (a *App) ReviewStructuralEditSession(sessionID string) StructuralEditOperationResult {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	a.reconcileEditSessionLocked()
	if a.editor == nil || sessionID == "" || sessionID != a.activeSession {
		return a.structuralEditFailure(errors.New("EDIT_SESSION_EXPIRED"))
	}
	ctx, cancel := a.operationContext(2 * time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	plan, err := a.sessions.ReviewStructural(ctx, a.editor, sessionID)
	if err != nil {
		return a.structuralEditFailure(err)
	}
	return StructuralEditOperationResult{Status: plan.Status, Plan: plan}
}

// CommitEditPlan is retained only as a shape-compatible legacy endpoint.
func (a *App) CommitEditPlan(string, string) EditOperationResult {
	return a.editFailure(errors.New("EDIT_CONTRACT_SUPERSEDED"))
}

func (a *App) CommitStructuralEditPlan(sessionID, planID string) StructuralEditOperationResult {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	a.reconcileEditSessionLocked()
	if a.editor == nil || sessionID == "" || sessionID != a.activeSession {
		return a.structuralEditFailure(errors.New("EDIT_SESSION_EXPIRED"))
	}
	if _, err := a.sessions.BeginCommit(sessionID, planID); err != nil {
		return a.structuralEditFailure(err)
	}
	ctx, cancel := a.operationContext(2 * time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	result := a.editor.CommitStructuralSave(ctx, planID)
	if result.Status == "COMMITTED" && result.Managed != nil && a.current.Catalog != nil && a.current.Catalog.Status == "READY" {
		if enriched, readErr := installer.ReadManagedProjectViewWithCatalog(a.current.Root, a.current.Catalog); readErr == nil && enriched.ProjectRevision == result.NewProjectRevision {
			result.Managed = enriched
		}
	}
	if result.Status == "COMMITTED" || result.Status == "COMMITTED_REFRESH_FAILED" {
		a.pendingTargetHostKey = nil
		clear(a.approvedTargetHostKeys)
		previousVerification := a.current.Verification
		a.clearRuntimeSecretDescriptorEvidenceLocked()
		if !a.sessions.FinishCommit(sessionID, planID, true) {
			return a.structuralEditFailure(errors.New("EDIT_SESSION_EXPIRED"))
		}
		a.activeSession = ""
		a.editor = nil
		a.current.Snapshot = nil
		a.current.Classification = projectlifecycle.ClassificationManaged
		if result.Status == "COMMITTED" && result.Managed != nil && result.Managed.ProjectRevision == result.NewProjectRevision {
			a.current.Managed = result.Managed
			managed := result.Managed
			a.current.Counts.Servers = len(managed.Servers)
			a.current.Diagnostics = a.managedServerTypeDiagnostics(managed)
			a.refreshExecutionAfterSaveLocked(a.current.Root, a.current.Project, managedSnapshotHosts(managed))
		} else {
			a.pendingHostKey = nil
			a.invalidateDynamicBindingLocked()
			a.current.Managed = nil
			a.current.Snapshot = nil
			a.current.Counts.Servers = 0
			a.current.Diagnostics = nil
			a.execution.bind(a.current.Root, a.current.Project.ID, nil)
		}
		a.continuation = nil
		a.current.Verification = verificationAfterSave(previousVerification)
	}
	if result.Status != "COMMITTED" && result.Status != "COMMITTED_REFRESH_FAILED" {
		a.sessions.FinishCommit(sessionID, planID, false)
	}
	response := StructuralEditOperationResult{Status: result.Status, Commit: &result}
	if result.Status == "COMMITTED" || result.Status == "COMMITTED_REFRESH_FAILED" {
		current := a.current
		response.Current = &current
	}
	return response
}

func (a *App) DiscardEditSession(sessionID string) EditOperationResult {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	wasActive := sessionID != "" && sessionID == a.activeSession
	a.reconcileEditSessionLocked()
	if wasActive && a.activeSession == "" {
		return EditOperationResult{Status: "DISCARDED"}
	}
	if a.editor == nil || !a.sessions.Discard(sessionID, a.editor) {
		return a.editFailure(errors.New("EDIT_SESSION_EXPIRED"))
	}
	a.activeSession, a.editor = "", nil
	a.execution.discardDraft(currentProjectHosts(a.current))
	return EditOperationResult{Status: "DISCARDED"}
}

func (a *App) reconcileEditSessionLocked() {
	if a.activeSession != "" && !a.sessions.Active(a.activeSession) {
		a.activeSession, a.editor = "", nil
		a.execution.discardDraft(currentProjectHosts(a.current))
	}
}

func snapshotHosts(snapshot *coreadapter.Snapshot) map[string]map[string]any {
	if snapshot == nil {
		return nil
	}
	return snapshot.Hosts
}

func currentProjectHosts(current ProjectOpenResult) map[string]map[string]any {
	if current.Managed != nil {
		return managedSnapshotHosts(current.Managed)
	}
	return snapshotHosts(current.Snapshot)
}

func managedSnapshotHosts(view *installer.ManagedProjectView) map[string]map[string]any {
	if view == nil {
		return nil
	}
	hosts := make(map[string]map[string]any, len(view.Servers))
	for id, server := range view.Servers {
		hosts[id] = map[string]any{"ansibleHost": server.Address, "type": server.Type, "desiredHostname": server.DesiredHostname}
		if server.SSHPort != nil {
			hosts[id]["ansiblePort"] = *server.SSHPort
		}
	}
	return hosts
}

// Saving desired state invalidates plans, not an unchanged prepared transport.
// Connection authority is still checked by the normal credential/pin guards.
func (a *App) refreshExecutionAfterSaveLocked(root string, project *projectlifecycle.Project, hosts map[string]map[string]any) {
	if project != nil && a.binding != nil && a.binding.dynamic &&
		a.execution.root == root && a.execution.projectID == project.ID &&
		a.execution.context.SelectionKind == "PROJECT_SERVER" {
		id, address, port, err := a.selectedSavedExecutionServerLocked()
		runtime, valid := installationRuntimeBinding(a.binding.reader.runtimeRelease)
		if err == nil && id == a.binding.node.ID && address == a.binding.node.Address && port == a.binding.node.Port &&
			valid && runtime.BundleDigest == project.Source.BundleDigest && runtime.CatalogDigest == project.Source.CatalogDigest {
			a.pendingHostKey = nil
			a.execution.replaceSnapshotHosts(hosts)
			if candidate, ok := a.execution.candidates[id]; ok {
				a.execution.context.SafeLabel = candidate.label
			}
			a.clearRuntimeSecretDescriptorEvidenceLocked()
			a.installationGeneration++
			a.continuation = nil
			a.installationPlanID = ""
			a.clearInstallationRunsLocked()
			return
		}
	}
	a.bindExecutionLocked(root, project, hosts)
}

func (a *App) bindExecutionLocked(root string, project *projectlifecycle.Project, hosts map[string]map[string]any) {
	a.pendingHostKey = nil
	a.pendingTargetHostKey = nil
	clear(a.approvedTargetHostKeys)
	a.invalidateDynamicBindingLocked()
	a.clearRuntimeSecretDescriptorEvidenceLocked()
	a.installationGeneration++
	a.continuation = nil
	a.installationPlanID = ""
	a.clearInstallationRunsLocked()
	if project == nil || project.ID == "" {
		a.execution.clear()
		return
	}
	a.execution.bind(root, project.ID, hosts)
}

func (a *App) operationContext(timeout time.Duration) (context.Context, context.CancelFunc) {
	base := a.ctx
	if base == nil {
		base = context.Background()
	}
	return context.WithTimeout(base, timeout)
}

func (a *App) CurrentProject() ProjectOpenResult {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	return a.current
}

// GetServiceConfigurationPreview obtains a read-only Core projection for the
// exact saved revision. It neither changes Verify state nor creates a plan.
func (a *App) GetServiceConfigurationPreview() (executionnode.ServiceConfigurationPreview, error) {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	// A draft is not a change of SSH identity. Do not send this read-only
	// request through transport revalidation while the saved binding is gated
	// by an edit session; that would invalidate an otherwise trusted binding.
	if a.activeSession != "" {
		a.editMu.Unlock()
		return executionnode.ServiceConfigurationPreview{}, errors.New("SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_PREVIEW_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	if a.current.Status != "OPEN" || a.current.Managed == nil || a.current.Catalog == nil || a.current.Catalog.Status != "READY" || a.execution.context.Status != "READY" {
		a.editMu.Unlock()
		return executionnode.ServiceConfigurationPreview{}, errors.New("SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_PREVIEW_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	binding, err := a.resolveSelectedExecutionNodeBindingLocked()
	if err != nil {
		a.editMu.Unlock()
		return executionnode.ServiceConfigurationPreview{}, err
	}
	transport, ok := binding.reader.transport.(interface {
		BuildServiceConfigurationPreview(context.Context, executionnode.Node, string, map[string]any) (executionnode.ServiceConfigurationPreview, error)
	})
	if !ok {
		a.editMu.Unlock()
		return executionnode.ServiceConfigurationPreview{}, errors.New("SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_PREVIEW_UNSUPPORTED")
	}
	root := a.current.Root
	revision, err := installer.ProjectRevision(root)
	if err != nil || revision != a.current.Managed.ProjectRevision {
		a.editMu.Unlock()
		return executionnode.ServiceConfigurationPreview{}, errors.New("PROJECT_REVISION_CHANGED")
	}
	a.editMu.Unlock()
	ctx, cancel := a.operationContext(90 * time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	preview, err := transport.BuildServiceConfigurationPreview(ctx, binding.node, root, binding.reader.runtimeRelease)
	if err != nil {
		return executionnode.ServiceConfigurationPreview{}, err
	}
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	after, err := installer.ProjectRevision(root)
	if err != nil || a.current.Status != "OPEN" || a.current.Root != root || a.current.Managed == nil || a.current.Catalog == nil || a.current.Catalog.Status != "READY" || a.current.Managed.ProjectRevision != revision || after != revision || preview.ProjectRevision != revision || !runtimeEvidenceMatchesExpected(preview.Runtime, binding.reader.runtimeRelease) || a.revalidateBindingBeforePublicationLocked(binding) != nil {
		return executionnode.ServiceConfigurationPreview{}, errors.New("SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_PREVIEW_STALE")
	}
	for deploymentID, scoped := range preview.Services {
		deployment, present := a.current.Managed.Deployments[deploymentID]
		if !present {
			return executionnode.ServiceConfigurationPreview{}, errors.New("SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_PREVIEW_RESPONSE_INVALID")
		}
		var service *projectlifecycle.ProjectCatalogService
		for index := range a.current.Catalog.Services {
			if a.current.Catalog.Services[index].ID == deployment.ServiceType {
				service = &a.current.Catalog.Services[index]
				break
			}
		}
		if service == nil {
			return executionnode.ServiceConfigurationPreview{}, errors.New("SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_PREVIEW_RESPONSE_INVALID")
		}
		filter := func(values map[string]executionnode.ServiceConfigurationValue) {
			for settingID, item := range values {
				var descriptor *projectlifecycle.ProjectCatalogSetting
				for index := range service.ConfigurationSettings {
					if service.ConfigurationSettings[index].ID == settingID {
						descriptor = &service.ConfigurationSettings[index]
						break
					}
				}
				if descriptor == nil || descriptor.Kind != "MANAGED" || descriptor.EditorShape == "UNSUPPORTED" || descriptor.EditorShape == "RUNTIME_SECRET_REFERENCE_OBJECT" {
					delete(values, settingID)
					continue
				}
				if item.State != "RESOLVED" || !projectlifecycle.SafePresentationValue(*descriptor, item.Value) {
					item.Value = nil
					values[settingID] = item
				}
			}
		}
		filter(scoped.Configuration)
		for memberID, values := range scoped.Members {
			found := false
			for _, placement := range a.current.Managed.MemberPlacements {
				if placement.DeploymentID == deploymentID && placement.MemberID == memberID {
					found = true
					break
				}
			}
			if !found {
				return executionnode.ServiceConfigurationPreview{}, errors.New("SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_PREVIEW_RESPONSE_INVALID")
			}
			filter(values)
		}
	}
	preview.RuntimeDigest = preview.Runtime.BundleDigest
	return preview, nil
}

func (a *App) failure(code string) ProjectOpenResult {
	return ProjectOpenResult{Status: "ERROR", Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: code, Message: projectErrorMessage(code)}}
}

func projectErrorCode(err error) string {
	var executionError *executionnode.ExecutionError
	if errors.As(err, &executionError) && executionError.Code != "" {
		return executionError.Code
	}
	if err == nil || err.Error() == "" {
		return "PROJECT_OPEN_FAILED"
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), "EXECUTION_NODE_TRANSPORT_FAILED") {
		return "EXECUTION_NODE_UNAVAILABLE"
	}
	return err.Error()
}

package desktop

import (

type LaunchSettings struct {
	Address, User, Identity, KnownHosts, Fingerprint string
	Port                                             uint
	Bundle                                           string
}

type desktopIdentity struct{ path string }

func (i desktopIdentity) IdentityFile(string) (string, error) {
	if i.path == "" {
		return "", errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_NOT_CONFIGURED")
	}
	return i.path, nil
}

func newConfiguredApp(settings LaunchSettings, dialogs DialogProvider, events ApplicationEventPublisher) (*App, error) {
	bundleRoot := resolveBundleRoot(settings.Bundle)
	var reader interface {
		BuildSnapshot(context.Context, string) (*coreadapter.Snapshot, error)
	} = unavailableProjectReader{}
	appOptions := []AppOption{WithDialogProvider(dialogs), WithApplicationEventPublisher(events), WithAvailableExecutionBundle(bundleRoot)}
	if executable, err := os.Executable(); err == nil {
		appOptions = append(appOptions, WithBundleCacheRoot(bundleCacheDirectory(executable)))
	}
	sources := map[string]string{}
	if bundleRoot != "" {
		if _, err := executionbundle.ValidateRoot(bundleRoot); err == nil {
			sources[projectlifecycle.DefaultCompatibilitySourceID] = bundleRoot
		}
	}
	configuredNode := settings.Address != "" && settings.User != "" && settings.Identity != "" && settings.KnownHosts != "" && settings.Fingerprint != "" && bundleRoot != "" && settings.Port > 0 && settings.Port <= 65535
	if configuredNode {
		if verified, err := executionbundle.ValidateRoot(bundleRoot); err == nil {
			node := executionnode.Node{ID: "desktop-" + settings.Address, Address: settings.Address, User: settings.User, Port: uint16(settings.Port), CredentialRef: "runtime:ssh", HostKey: executionnode.HostKeyPolicy{State: "TRUSTED", KnownHosts: settings.KnownHosts, Fingerprint: settings.Fingerprint}}
			release := map[string]any{"bundleDigest": verified.Digest, "coreVersion": verified.Manifest.CoreVersion, "catalogDigest": verified.Manifest.CatalogDigest, "planningProtocol": executionbundle.ProtocolVersion}
			transport := executionnode.OpenSSHTransport{Identity: desktopIdentity{settings.Identity}}
			projectReadBinding := projectReader{transport: transport, node: node, runtimeRelease: release}
			planService := executionnode.NewExecutionService(transport, transport)
			reader = projectReadBinding
			appOptions = append(appOptions, WithTrustedExecutionNodeBinding(executionNodeBinding{node: node, reader: projectReadBinding, service: executionnode.NewService(transport), plans: planService, bundleRoot: bundleRoot}))
		}
		appOptions = append(appOptions, WithExplicitExecutionNode("desktop-"+settings.Address, settings.Address))
	}
	applicationConfig, applicationConfigErr := loadApplicationConfig()
	appOptions = append(appOptions, WithApplicationConfig(applicationConfig, applicationConfigErr))
	app := NewApp(reader, projectlifecycle.NewService(sources), appOptions...)
	if err := configureQASecretFileSelection(app); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return app, nil
}

func loadApplicationConfig() (appconfig.Config, error) {
	workingDirectory, _ := os.Getwd()
	executable, _ := os.Executable()
	path, err := appconfig.ResolveDevelopmentPath(workingDirectory, executable)
	if err != nil {
		return appconfig.Config{}, err
	}
	return appconfig.Load(path)
}

func resolveBundleRoot(explicit string) string {
	if explicit != "" {
		return explicit
	}
	executable, err := os.Executable()
	if err != nil {
		return ""
	}
	cacheRoot := bundleCacheDirectory(executable)
	if found := verifiedBundleInCache(cacheRoot); found != "" {
		return found
	}
	return verifiedBundleInCache(filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(cacheRoot), "bundle"))
}

func verifiedBundleInCache(cacheRoot string) string {
	entries, err := os.ReadDir(cacheRoot)
	if err != nil {
		return ""
	}
	var found string
	for _, entry := range entries {
		if !entry.IsDir() {
			continue
		}
		candidate := filepath.Join(cacheRoot, entry.Name())
		if _, err := executionbundle.ValidateRoot(candidate); err != nil {
			continue
		}
		if found != "" {
			return ""
		}
		found = candidate
	}
	return found
}

func bundleCacheDirectory(executable string) string {
	return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(executable), "..", "..", "cache"))
}

package desktop

	"platform-installer/internal/executionnode"

// Called within synchronous Create Plan, while editMu protects the session.
func (a *App) imagePreparationCredentialsLocked(scope executionnode.ImagePreparationScope) (executionnode.ImagePreparationCredentials, error) {
	result := executionnode.ImagePreparationCredentials{}
	approvals, err := a.approvedTargetKeysForHostsLocked(scope.ProjectIdentity, scope.ProjectRevision, scope.TargetIDs())
	if err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	result.Approvals = approvals
	if len(scope.Requirements) > 0 {
		evidence := a.runtimeSecretEvidence
		if evidence == nil || evidence.projectID != scope.ProjectIdentity || evidence.projectRevision != scope.ProjectRevision || a.binding == nil || evidence.nodeID != a.binding.node.ID || !runtimeEvidenceMatchesExpected(evidence.runtime, a.binding.reader.runtimeRelease) {
			return result, errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_DESCRIPTORS_STALE")
		}
		for _, requirement := range scope.Requirements {
			found := false
			for _, item := range evidence.applicationInputs {
				if item.RequirementRef == requirement.RequirementRef && item.Purpose == requirement.Purpose && strings.HasPrefix(item.Purpose, "APPLICATION_REGISTRY_") && slices.Equal(item.Hosts, requirement.Hosts) && slices.Equal(item.ApplicationLibraries, requirement.ApplicationLibraries) {
					found = true
					break
				}
			}
			if !found {
				return result, errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_DESCRIPTORS_STALE")
			}
		}
	}
	binding, err := a.credentialBindingLocked()
	if err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	if len(scope.Requirements) > 0 {
		// The form saves pending values. Authorize promotion against the current
		// Core descriptor evidence before constructing the metadata-only payload.
		requirements := make([]string, 0)
		for _, item := range a.runtimeSecretEvidence.descriptors {
			if item.Purpose == "SERVICE_PASSWORD" {
				requirements = append(requirements, item.RequirementRef)
			}
		}
		for _, item := range a.runtimeSecretEvidence.applicationInputs {
			requirements = append(requirements, item.RequirementRef)
		}
		if err := a.secrets.PromotePendingRuntimeSecretValues(binding, requirements); err != nil {
			return result, err
		}
	}
	err = a.secrets.WithTargetCredential(binding, func(credential runtimesecret.TargetCredential) error {
		payload := executionnode.TargetCredentialLeasePayload{Username: credential.Username, SudoPassword: string(credential.SudoSecret), RuntimeSecretValues: map[string]string{}}
		if credential.SSHMode == runtimesecret.SSHPassword {
			payload.Password = string(credential.SSHSecret)
		} else {
			payload.PrivateKey = string(credential.SSHSecret)
		}
		for _, requirement := range scope.Requirements {
			value, ok := credential.RuntimeSecretValues[requirement.RequirementRef]
			if !ok || len(value) == 0 {
				return errors.New("APPLICATION_REGISTRY_RUNTIME_SECRET_REQUIRED")
			}
			payload.RuntimeSecretValues[requirement.RequirementRef] = string(value)
		}
		result.Payload = payload
		return nil
	})
	return result, err
}

	if a.ctx == nil {
		return ""
	}
	root, err := a.openDirectory(a.ctx, DialogOptions{Title: "Выбрать пакет приложения или библиотеки"})

// Only plans a data-only package through the existing active edit session.
// CommitStructuralEditPlan handles revision, transaction, recovery and refresh.
func (a *App) ReviewApplicationPackageImport(sessionID, source, kind, name, version, digest string) StructuralEditOperationResult {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	a.reconcileEditSessionLocked()
	if sessionID == "" || sessionID != a.activeSession || a.editor == nil {
		return a.structuralEditFailure(errors.New("EDIT_SESSION_EXPIRED"))
	}
	ctx, cancel := a.operationContext(2 * time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	plan, err := a.sessions.ReviewApplicationPackageImport(ctx, a.editor, sessionID, source, kind, name, version, digest)
	if err != nil {
		return a.structuralEditFailure(err)
	}
	return StructuralEditOperationResult{Status: plan.Status, Plan: plan}
}

@@PORTABLE {"path":"internal/desktop/application_secret_descriptors.go","mode":420,"size":1988,"sha256":"939680d7f0e85cbaa74ce771fe6e5370aba0c2bab24188a0f5f1e5869af72c1d","index":0,"count":1,"encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":1988}
package desktop

import (
	"platform-installer/internal/executionnode"
	"regexp"
	"slices"
)

var applicationSecretRequirement = regexp.MustCompile(`^application-secret-[a-f0-9]{32}$`)
var applicationSecretID = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:[-_.][a-z0-9]+)*$`)
var applicationSecretHost = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,62}$`)

func validApplicationSecretDescriptor(item executionnode.ApplicationSecretDescriptor) bool {
	if !applicationSecretRequirement.MatchString(item.RequirementRef) || !applicationSecretID.MatchString(item.SourceRef) || item.DisplayLabel == "" || len([]byte(item.DisplayLabel)) > 256 ||
		!validApplicationSecretOperations(item.Operations) {
		return false
	}
	if item.Purpose == "APPLICATION_SECRET" || item.Purpose == "APPLICATION_REGISTRY_USERNAME" || item.Purpose == "APPLICATION_REGISTRY_PASSWORD" {
		if item.ProviderDeployment != nil {
			return false
		}
	} else if item.Purpose == "APPLICATION_VAULT_ADMIN_TOKEN" {
		if item.ProviderDeployment == nil || !applicationSecretID.MatchString(*item.ProviderDeployment) || item.SourceRef != "vault-admin-token-"+*item.ProviderDeployment {
			return false
		}
	} else {
		return false
	}
	for _, group := range []struct {
		values  []string
		pattern *regexp.Regexp
	}{{item.Hosts, applicationSecretHost}, {item.ApplicationLibraries, applicationSecretID}} {
		if len(group.values) == 0 || len(group.values) > 256 {
			return false
		}
		prior := ""
		for _, value := range group.values {
			if !group.pattern.MatchString(value) || value <= prior {
				return false
			}
			prior = value
		}
	}
	return true
}

func validApplicationSecretOperations(operations []string) bool {
	allowed := []string{"APPLICATION_LIBRARIES_APPLY", "APPLICATION_LIBRARIES_VERIFY", "APPLICATION_LIBRARIES_POST_INSTALL"}
	var ordered []string
	for _, op := range allowed {
		if slices.Contains(operations, op) {
			ordered = append(ordered, op)
		}
	}
	return len(operations) > 0 && slices.Equal(operations, ordered)
}

	filter := "All files|*.*"
	if len(filters) > 0 {
		filter = strings.Join(filters, "|")
	}
	script := "Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms; $d=New-Object System.Windows.Forms.OpenFileDialog; $d.Title='" + escapePowerShell(options.Title) + "'; $d.Filter='" + filter + "'; if($d.ShowDialog() -eq [System.Windows.Forms.DialogResult]::OK){[Console]::Out.Write([Convert]::ToBase64String([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($d.FileName)))}"
	return runNativePicker(ctx, script)
}

func escapePowerShell(value string) string { return strings.ReplaceAll(value, "'", "''") }

func runNativePicker(ctx context.Context, script string) (string, error) {
	encoded := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(utf16LE(script))
	command := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "powershell.exe", "-NoLogo", "-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive", "-STA", "-EncodedCommand", encoded)
	command.SysProcAttr = &syscall.SysProcAttr{HideWindow: true}
	output, err := command.Output()
	if err != nil {
		if ctx.Err() != nil {
			return "", ctx.Err()
		}
		return "", errors.New("NATIVE_DIALOG_FAILED")
	}
	decoded, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(string(output))
	if err != nil || !utf8.Valid(decoded) {
		return "", errors.New("NATIVE_DIALOG_OUTPUT_INVALID")
	}
	return string(decoded), nil
}

func utf16LE(value string) []byte {
	codes := utf16.Encode([]rune(value))
	bytes := make([]byte, len(codes)*2)
	for i, code := range codes {
		bytes[i*2], bytes[i*2+1] = byte(code), byte(code>>8)
	}
	return bytes
}

package desktop

func RunBrowserLinux(static fs.FS) {
	if sshpassword.Dispatch() {
		return
	}
	address := flag.String("execution-node-address", "", "READY Execution Node address")
	user := flag.String("execution-node-user", "", "Execution Node SSH user")
	identity := flag.String("execution-node-identity", "", "runtime-only SSH identity path")
	knownHosts := flag.String("execution-node-known-hosts", "", "trusted known_hosts path")
	fingerprint := flag.String("execution-node-fingerprint", "", "operator-approved host fingerprint")
	port := flag.Uint("execution-node-port", 22, "Execution Node SSH port")
	bundle := flag.String("execution-bundle", "", "verified local runtime bundle root")
	listenAddress := flag.String("browser-listen", "127.0.0.1:8765", "browser HTTP listener address; dev only, restrict access to the browser workstation and localhost")
	publicHost := flag.String("browser-host", "127.0.0.1:8765", "Host:port used by the browser; must match the browser URL exactly")
	allowInsecureDevHTTP := flag.Bool("browser-allow-insecure-dev-http", false, "explicitly allow remote HTTP for development only; credentials and secret uploads are not protected in transit")
	flag.Parse()
	if !*allowInsecureDevHTTP {
		_, _ = os.Stderr.WriteString("BROWSER_REMOTE_HTTP_REQUIRES_DEV_OPT_IN\n")
		return
	}
	if !validBrowserAuthority(*publicHost) || !browserListenerMatchesHost(*listenAddress, *publicHost) {
		_, _ = os.Stderr.WriteString("BROWSER_HOST_CONFIGURATION_INVALID\n")
		return
	}

	events := newBrowserEventHub()
	app, err := newConfiguredApp(LaunchSettings{Address: *address, User: *user, Identity: *identity, KnownHosts: *knownHosts, Fingerprint: *fingerprint, Port: *port, Bundle: *bundle}, newBrowserDialogProvider(), events)
	if err != nil {
		_, _ = os.Stderr.WriteString("BROWSER_APPLICATION_START_FAILED\n")
		return
	}
	webRoot, err := fs.Sub(static, "frontend/dist")
	if err != nil {
		_, _ = os.Stderr.WriteString("BROWSER_ASSETS_UNAVAILABLE\n")
		return
	}
	ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM)
	defer stop()
	if err := runRemoteBrowserHost(ctx, app, webRoot, events, *listenAddress, *publicHost); err != nil {
		_, _ = os.Stderr.WriteString("BROWSER_HOST_FAILED\n")
	}
}

func browserListenerMatchesHost(listenAddress, publicHost string) bool {
	_, listenPort, listenErr := net.SplitHostPort(listenAddress)
	_, publicPort, publicErr := net.SplitHostPort(publicHost)
	return listenErr == nil && publicErr == nil && listenPort != "0" && listenPort == publicPort
}

func validBrowserAuthority(value string) bool {
	host, portText, err := net.SplitHostPort(value)
	if err != nil || host == "" {
		return false
	}
	port, err := strconv.Atoi(portText)
	if err != nil || port <= 0 || port > 65535 {
		return false
	}
	if net.ParseIP(host) != nil {
		return true
	}
	if len(host) > 253 || host == "localhost." {
		return false
	}
	for _, label := range strings.Split(host, ".") {
		if len(label) == 0 || len(label) > 63 || label[0] == '-' || label[len(label)-1] == '-' {
			return false
		}
		for _, r := range label {
			if !(r >= 'a' && r <= 'z' || r >= 'A' && r <= 'Z' || r >= '0' && r <= '9' || r == '-') {
				return false
			}
		}
	}
	return true
}

@@PORTABLE {"path":"internal/desktop/browser_host.go","mode":420,"size":17892,"sha256":"6d95fd4cb89bae98ec7572504d5c3107bdf0e438ad4a0c397828f68df1feec5a","index":0,"count":1,"encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":17892}
//go:build browser

package desktop

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"crypto/rand"
	"crypto/subtle"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"io/fs"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"
)

const (
	browserCookieName = "platform-installer-local"
	browserIdleLimit  = 15 * time.Minute
	browserMaxRequest = 4 << 20
	browserMaxCalls   = 32
)

type browserHost struct {
	app            *App
	static         fs.FS
	operations     map[string]browserOperation
	hub            *browserEventHub
	listener       net.Listener
	server         *http.Server
	authority      string
	origin         string
	allowedHosts   map[string]struct{}
	allowedOrigins map[string]struct{}
	bootstrap      [32]byte
	session        [32]byte
	mu             sync.Mutex
	bootstrapped   bool
	leaseID        string
	lastActive     time.Time
	activeCalls    int
	exitPending    bool
	stopping       bool
	localOnly      bool
	ctx            context.Context
	cancel         context.CancelFunc
}

func newBrowserHost(app *App, static fs.FS, hub *browserEventHub) (*browserHost, error) {
	if hub == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("BROWSER_EVENT_CHANNEL_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	host := &browserHost{app: app, static: static, operations: browserOperations(), hub: hub, lastActive: time.Now()}
	if _, err := rand.Read(host.bootstrap[:]); err != nil {
		return nil, errors.New("BROWSER_BOOTSTRAP_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	if _, err := rand.Read(host.session[:]); err != nil {
		return nil, errors.New("BROWSER_SESSION_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	return host, nil
}

func runBrowserHost(parent context.Context, app *App, static fs.FS, hub *browserEventHub) error {
	return runConfiguredBrowserHost(parent, app, static, hub, "127.0.0.1:0", "", true, true)
}

func runRemoteBrowserHost(parent context.Context, app *App, static fs.FS, hub *browserEventHub, listenAddress, expectedHost string) error {
	if listenAddress == "" || expectedHost == "" {
		return errors.New("BROWSER_LISTENER_CONFIGURATION_INVALID")
	}
	return runConfiguredBrowserHost(parent, app, static, hub, listenAddress, expectedHost, false, false)
}

func runConfiguredBrowserHost(parent context.Context, app *App, static fs.FS, hub *browserEventHub, listenAddress, expectedHost string, localOnly, launchLocalBrowser bool) error {
	host, err := newBrowserHost(app, static, hub)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	host.listener, err = net.Listen("tcp", listenAddress)
	if err != nil {
		return errors.New("BROWSER_LISTENER_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	host.localOnly = localOnly
	if localOnly {
		host.authority = host.listener.Addr().String()
		host.setAuthorities(host.authority, false)
	} else {
		host.authority = expectedHost
		host.setAuthorities(expectedHost, true)
	}
	host.server = &http.Server{Handler: host, ReadHeaderTimeout: 5 * time.Second, IdleTimeout: 90 * time.Second}
	host.ctx, host.cancel = context.WithCancel(parent)
	app.startup(host.ctx)
	serveResult := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { serveResult <- host.server.Serve(host.listener) }()
	go host.monitor()
	if launchLocalBrowser {
		launchURL := host.origin + "/?mode=browser#bootstrap=" + hex.EncodeToString(host.bootstrap[:])
		if err := openBrowser(launchURL); err != nil {
			host.cancel()
			_ = host.server.Close()
			app.shutdown(context.Background())
			return err
		}
	} else {
		_, _ = fmt.Fprintf(os.Stdout, "Browser UI: %s\n", host.origin)
	}
	select {
	case <-host.ctx.Done():
	case err := <-serveResult:
		if !errors.Is(err, http.ErrServerClosed) {
			host.cancel()
			app.shutdown(context.Background())
			return errors.New("BROWSER_SERVER_FAILED")
		}
	}
	shutdownCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	_ = host.server.Shutdown(shutdownCtx)
	app.shutdown(context.Background())
	return nil
}

func (h *browserHost) setAuthorities(primary string, includeLocalhost bool) {
	h.origin = "http://" + primary
	h.allowedHosts = map[string]struct{}{primary: {}}
	h.allowedOrigins = map[string]struct{}{h.origin: {}}
	if !includeLocalhost {
		return
	}
	_, port, err := net.SplitHostPort(primary)
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	for _, host := range []string{"localhost", "127.0.0.1", "[::1]"} {
		authority := net.JoinHostPort(strings.Trim(host, "[]"), port)
		h.allowedHosts[authority] = struct{}{}
		h.allowedOrigins["http://"+authority] = struct{}{}
	}
}

func (h *browserHost) monitor() {
	ticker := time.NewTicker(15 * time.Second)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for {
		select {
		case <-h.ctx.Done():
			return
		case now := <-ticker.C:
			h.mu.Lock()
			shouldExit := (h.exitPending || now.Sub(h.lastActive) >= browserIdleLimit) && h.activeCalls == 0 && !h.stopping
			h.mu.Unlock()
			if !shouldExit || h.hasActiveRun() {
				continue
			}
			h.mu.Lock()
			shouldStop := !h.stopping && h.activeCalls == 0 && (h.exitPending || now.Sub(h.lastActive) >= browserIdleLimit)
			if shouldStop {
				h.stopping = true
			}
			h.mu.Unlock()
			if !shouldStop {
				continue
			}
			if h.hasActiveRun() {
				h.mu.Lock()
				h.stopping = false
				if !h.exitPending {
					h.lastActive = time.Now()
				}
				h.mu.Unlock()
				continue
			}
			h.mu.Lock()
			shouldCancel := h.stopping && h.activeCalls == 0
			if !shouldCancel {
				h.stopping = false
			}
			h.mu.Unlock()
			if !shouldCancel {
				continue
			}
			h.cancel()
			return
		}
	}
}

func (h *browserHost) hasActiveRun() bool {
	h.app.editMu.Lock()
	defer h.app.editMu.Unlock()
	if h.app.startInFlight || h.app.startOutcomeUnknown {
		return true
	}
	if h.app.current.Status != "OPEN" || h.app.current.Project == nil {
		return len(h.app.installationRuns.runIDs()) > 0
	}
	return !h.app.knownRunsTerminalLocked()
}

func (h *browserHost) ServeHTTP(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	w.Header().Set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
	w.Header().Set("Referrer-Policy", "no-referrer")
	w.Header().Set("X-Frame-Options", "DENY")
	w.Header().Set("Content-Security-Policy", "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'")
	if !h.requestAllowed(r) {
		http.NotFound(w, r)
		return
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/api/") {
		h.serveAPI(w, r)
		return
	}
	h.serveStatic(w, r)
}

func (h *browserHost) requestAllowed(r *http.Request) bool {
	if _, ok := h.allowedHosts[r.Host]; !ok {
		return false
	}
	if !h.localOnly {
		return true
	}
	host, _, err := net.SplitHostPort(r.RemoteAddr)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	ip := net.ParseIP(host)
	return ip != nil && ip.IsLoopback()
}

func (h *browserHost) serveAPI(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	origin := r.Header.Get("Origin")
	_, originAllowed := h.allowedOrigins[origin]
	if !originAllowed && !(origin == "" && r.Method == http.MethodGet && r.URL.Path == "/api/events" && r.Header.Get("Sec-Fetch-Site") == "same-origin") {
		http.Error(w, "origin rejected", http.StatusForbidden)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	switch r.URL.Path {
	case "/api/bootstrap":
		if !h.localOnly {
			http.NotFound(w, r)
			return
		}
		h.handleBootstrap(w, r)
	case "/api/lease/acquire":
		h.handleLease(w, r)
	case "/api/events":
		h.handleEvents(w, r)
	case "/api/heartbeat":
		h.handleHeartbeat(w, r)
	case "/api/exit":
		h.handleExit(w, r)
	default:
		if strings.HasPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/api/call/") {
			h.handleCall(w, r)
			return
		}
		http.NotFound(w, r)
	}
}

func (h *browserHost) handleBootstrap(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		http.Error(w, "method rejected", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
		return
	}
	var request struct {
		Token string `json:"token"`
	}
	if err := decodeBrowserJSON(w, r, &request, 2048); err != nil {
		writeBrowserError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, err)
		return
	}
	supplied, err := hex.DecodeString(request.Token)
	if err != nil || len(supplied) != len(h.bootstrap) {
		http.Error(w, "bootstrap rejected", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	if h.bootstrapped || subtle.ConstantTimeCompare(supplied, h.bootstrap[:]) != 1 {
		http.Error(w, "bootstrap rejected", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	h.bootstrapped = true
	h.lastActive = time.Now()
	http.SetCookie(w, &http.Cookie{Name: browserCookieName, Value: hex.EncodeToString(h.session[:]), Path: "/", HttpOnly: true, SameSite: http.SameSiteStrictMode})
	writeBrowserJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"status": "READY"})
}

func (h *browserHost) handleLease(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		http.Error(w, "method rejected", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
		return
	}
	if !h.validSession(r) {
		http.Error(w, "session rejected", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	var request struct {
		LeaseID string `json:"leaseId"`
	}
	if err := decodeBrowserJSON(w, r, &request, 1024); err != nil || !validBrowserLeaseID(request.LeaseID) {
		writeBrowserError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, errors.New("BROWSER_LEASE_INVALID"))
		return
	}
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	if h.stopping {
		http.Error(w, "browser host is shutting down", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	if h.leaseID != "" && subtle.ConstantTimeCompare([]byte(h.leaseID), []byte(request.LeaseID)) != 1 {
		http.Error(w, "another browser tab is active", http.StatusConflict)
		return
	}
	h.leaseID = request.LeaseID
	h.lastActive = time.Now()
	writeBrowserJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"status": "ACTIVE"})
}

func validBrowserLeaseID(value string) bool {
	if len(value) < 32 || len(value) > 128 {
		return false
	}
	for _, r := range value {
		if !(r >= 'a' && r <= 'z' || r >= 'A' && r <= 'Z' || r >= '0' && r <= '9' || r == '-' || r == '_') {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func (h *browserHost) validSession(r *http.Request) bool {
	if !h.localOnly {
		return true
	}
	cookie, err := r.Cookie(browserCookieName)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	supplied, err := hex.DecodeString(cookie.Value)
	return err == nil && len(supplied) == len(h.session) && subtle.ConstantTimeCompare(supplied, h.session[:]) == 1
}

func (h *browserHost) authorized(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) bool {
	return h.authorizeRequest(w, r, false)
}

func (h *browserHost) authorizeCall(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) bool {
	return h.authorizeRequest(w, r, true)
}

func (h *browserHost) authorizeRequest(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, countCall bool) bool {
	if !h.validSession(r) {
		http.Error(w, "session rejected", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return false
	}
	h.mu.Lock()
	if h.stopping {
		h.mu.Unlock()
		http.Error(w, "browser host is shutting down", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return false
	}
	lease := h.leaseID
	if lease == "" || subtle.ConstantTimeCompare([]byte(lease), []byte(r.Header.Get("X-Platform-UI-Lease"))) != 1 {
		h.mu.Unlock()
		http.Error(w, "tab lease rejected", http.StatusForbidden)
		return false
	}
	if countCall && h.activeCalls >= browserMaxCalls {
		h.mu.Unlock()
		http.Error(w, "application busy", http.StatusTooManyRequests)
		return false
	}
	h.lastActive = time.Now()
	if countCall {
		h.activeCalls++
	}
	h.mu.Unlock()
	return true
}

func (h *browserHost) finishCall() {
	h.mu.Lock()
	h.activeCalls--
	h.mu.Unlock()
}

func (h *browserHost) handleCall(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		http.Error(w, "method rejected", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
		return
	}
	if !h.authorizeCall(w, r) {
		return
	}
	defer h.finishCall()
	if r.Header.Get("Content-Type") != "application/json" {
		http.Error(w, "content type rejected", http.StatusUnsupportedMediaType)
		return
	}
	operationName := strings.TrimPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/api/call/")
	operation, ok := h.operations[operationName]
	if !ok || strings.Contains(operationName, "/") {
		http.NotFound(w, r)
		return
	}
	body, err := io.ReadAll(http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, browserMaxRequest))
	if err != nil {
		writeBrowserError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, errors.New("REQUEST_BODY_INVALID"))
		return
	}
	defer clear(body)
	result, err := operation(h.app, body)
	if err != nil {
		writeBrowserError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, err)
		return
	}
	writeBrowserJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"result": result})
}

func (h *browserHost) handleHeartbeat(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		http.Error(w, "method rejected", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
		return
	}
	if !h.authorized(w, r) {
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}

func (h *browserHost) handleExit(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		http.Error(w, "method rejected", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
		return
	}
	if !h.authorized(w, r) {
		return
	}
	h.mu.Lock()
	h.exitPending = true
	h.mu.Unlock()
	status := "EXITING"
	if h.hasActiveRun() {
		status = "EXIT_AFTER_RUN"
	}
	writeBrowserJSON(w, http.StatusAccepted, map[string]string{"status": status})
}

func (h *browserHost) serveStatic(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodGet && r.Method != http.MethodHead {
		http.Error(w, "method rejected", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
		return
	}
	path := strings.TrimPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/")
	if path == "" || path == "index.html" {
		path = "browser.html"
	}
	if path == "browser.html" {
		data, err := fs.ReadFile(h.static, path)
		if err != nil {
			http.NotFound(w, r)
			return
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
		w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
		if !h.localOnly {
			data = bytes.Replace(data, []byte(`<script src="/browser-bootstrap.js"></script>`), []byte(`<script src="/browser-mode.js"></script><script src="/browser-bootstrap.js"></script>`), 1)
		}
		_, _ = w.Write(data)
		return
	}
	if path == "browser-mode.js" && !h.localOnly {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/javascript; charset=utf-8")
		w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
		_, _ = io.WriteString(w, `window.__PI_BROWSER_REMOTE__ = true;`)
		return
	}
	if !fs.ValidPath(path) {
		http.NotFound(w, r)
		return
	}
	fileServer := http.FileServer(http.FS(h.static))
	cloned := r.Clone(r.Context())
	cloned.URL.Path = "/" + path
	fileServer.ServeHTTP(w, cloned)
}

func (h *browserHost) handleEvents(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodGet {
		http.Error(w, "method rejected", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
		return
	}
	if !h.authorized(w, r) {
		return
	}
	flusher, ok := w.(http.Flusher)
	if !ok {
		http.Error(w, "stream unavailable", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	after, _ := strconv.ParseUint(r.Header.Get("Last-Event-ID"), 10, 64)
	backlog, events, remove, gap := h.hub.subscribe(after)
	defer remove()
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	w.Header().Set("Connection", "keep-alive")
	w.Header().Set("X-Accel-Buffering", "no")
	if gap {
		frame, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"name": installationEventName, "payload": InstallationSubscriptionEvent{ErrorCode: "OBSERVER_HISTORY_GAP"}})
		_, _ = fmt.Fprintf(w, "data: %s\n\n", frame)
	}
	for _, item := range backlog {
		if !writeBrowserSSE(w, item) {
			return
		}
	}
	flusher.Flush()
	heartbeat := time.NewTicker(20 * time.Second)
	defer heartbeat.Stop()
	for {
		select {
		case <-r.Context().Done():
			return
		case item, open := <-events:
			if !open {
				return
			}
			if !writeBrowserSSE(w, item) {
				return
			}
			flusher.Flush()
		case <-heartbeat.C:
			if _, err := io.WriteString(w, ": ping\n\n"); err != nil {
				return
			}
			flusher.Flush()
		}
	}
}

func writeBrowserSSE(w io.Writer, event browserEvent) bool {
	_, err := fmt.Fprintf(w, "id: %d\ndata: %s\n\n", event.ID, event.Data)
	return err == nil
}

func decodeBrowserJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, target any, limit int64) error {
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, limit))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(target); err != nil {
		return errors.New("REQUEST_BODY_INVALID")
	}
	var trailing any
	if err := decoder.Decode(&trailing); err != io.EOF {
		return errors.New("REQUEST_BODY_INVALID")
	}
	return nil
}

func writeBrowserJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, payload any) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(payload)
}

type browserEvent struct {
	ID   uint64
	Data []byte
}

type browserEventHub struct {
	mu          sync.Mutex
	nextID      uint64
	history     []browserEvent
	subscribers map[uint64]chan browserEvent
	nextSubID   uint64
}

func newBrowserEventHub() *browserEventHub {
	return &browserEventHub{subscribers: map[uint64]chan browserEvent{}}
}

func (h *browserEventHub) Publish(ctx context.Context, name string, payload any) {
	if ctx != nil && ctx.Err() != nil {
		return
	}
	data, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"name": name, "payload": payload})
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	h.mu.Lock()
	h.nextID++
	event := browserEvent{ID: h.nextID, Data: data}
	h.history = append(h.history, event)
	if len(h.history) > 4096 {
		h.history = append([]browserEvent(nil), h.history[len(h.history)-4096:]...)
	}
	for id, channel := range h.subscribers {
		select {
		case channel <- event:
		default:
			delete(h.subscribers, id)
			close(channel)
		}
	}
	h.mu.Unlock()
}

func (h *browserEventHub) subscribe(after uint64) ([]browserEvent, <-chan browserEvent, func(), bool) {
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	gap := len(h.history) > 0 && after+1 < h.history[0].ID
	backlog := make([]browserEvent, 0, len(h.history))
	for _, event := range h.history {
		if event.ID > after {
			backlog = append(backlog, event)
		}
	}
	h.nextSubID++
	id := h.nextSubID
	channel := make(chan browserEvent, 256)
	h.subscribers[id] = channel
	remove := func() {
		h.mu.Lock()
		if current, ok := h.subscribers[id]; ok {
			delete(h.subscribers, id)
			close(current)
		}
		h.mu.Unlock()
	}
	return backlog, channel, remove, gap
}

import (
	"errors"

func openBrowser(address string) error {
	command := exec.Command("rundll32.exe", "url.dll,FileProtocolHandler", address)
	command.SysProcAttr = &syscall.SysProcAttr{HideWindow: true}
	if err := command.Start(); err != nil {
		return errors.New("BROWSER_LAUNCH_FAILED")
	}
	_ = command.Process.Release()
	return nil
}

type browserOperation func(*App, []byte) (any, error)

func noBrowserArgs[R any](fn func(*App) R) browserOperation {
	return func(app *App, body []byte) (any, error) {
		if err := decodeBrowserArgs(body); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return fn(app), nil
	}
}

func noBrowserArgsError[R any](fn func(*App) (R, error)) browserOperation {
	return func(app *App, body []byte) (any, error) {
		if err := decodeBrowserArgs(body); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return fn(app)
	}
}

func oneBrowserArg[A, R any](fn func(*App, A) R) browserOperation {
	return func(app *App, body []byte) (any, error) {
		var arg A
		if err := decodeBrowserArgs(body, &arg); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return fn(app, arg), nil
	}
}

func oneBrowserArgError[A, R any](fn func(*App, A) (R, error)) browserOperation {
	return func(app *App, body []byte) (any, error) {
		var arg A
		if err := decodeBrowserArgs(body, &arg); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return fn(app, arg)
	}
}

func twoBrowserArgs[A, B, R any](fn func(*App, A, B) R) browserOperation {
	return func(app *App, body []byte) (any, error) {
		var first A
		var second B
		if err := decodeBrowserArgs(body, &first, &second); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return fn(app, first, second), nil
	}
}

func twoBrowserArgsError[A, B, R any](fn func(*App, A, B) (R, error)) browserOperation {
	return func(app *App, body []byte) (any, error) {
		var first A
		var second B
		if err := decodeBrowserArgs(body, &first, &second); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return fn(app, first, second)
	}
}

func oneBrowserError[A any](fn func(*App, A) error) browserOperation {
	return func(app *App, body []byte) (any, error) {
		var arg A
		if err := decodeBrowserArgs(body, &arg); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return struct{}{}, fn(app, arg)
	}
}

func decodeBrowserArgs(body []byte, outputs ...any) error {
	var args []json.RawMessage
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(body))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(&args); err != nil {
		return errors.New("REQUEST_ARGUMENTS_INVALID")
	}
	var trailing any
	if err := decoder.Decode(&trailing); err != io.EOF || len(args) != len(outputs) {
		return errors.New("REQUEST_ARGUMENTS_INVALID")
	}
	for i, raw := range args {
		argDecoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
		argDecoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
		if err := argDecoder.Decode(outputs[i]); err != nil {
			return errors.New("REQUEST_ARGUMENTS_INVALID")
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func browserAmendConfiguration(application bool) browserOperation {
	type args struct {
		SessionID   string
		Index       int
		Expected    installer.EditCommand
		Replacement *installer.EditCommand `json:"replacement"`
	}
	return func(app *App, body []byte) (any, error) {
		var input args
		if err := decodeBrowserArgs(body, &input.SessionID, &input.Index, &input.Expected, &input.Replacement); err != nil {
			return nil, errors.New("REQUEST_ARGUMENTS_INVALID")
		}
		if application {
			return app.AmendApplicationLibraryDraft(input.SessionID, input.Index, input.Expected, input.Replacement), nil
		}
		return app.AmendServiceConfigurationDraft(input.SessionID, input.Index, input.Expected, input.Replacement), nil
	}
}

func writeBrowserError(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, err error) {
	code := projectErrorCode(err)
	if code == "" {
		code = "BROWSER_API_REQUEST_FAILED"
	}
	message := projectErrorMessage(code)
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]browserAPIError{"error": {Code: code, Message: message}})
}
