@@PORTABLE {"path":"internal/desktop/endpoint_preview.go","mode":420,"size":10258,"sha256":"78234d40fa430b7a410785f889ec8ff0dd4fb6c0b81b323c70589552062139d7","index":0,"count":1,"encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":10258}
package desktop

import (
	"net"
	"regexp"
	"sort"
	"strings"

	"platform-installer/internal/coreadapter"
)

const (
	maxEndpointPreviewSourceItems      = 4096
	maxEndpointPreviewEndpoints        = 64
	maxEndpointPreviewProviders        = 64
	maxEndpointPreviewAddresses        = 64
	maxEndpointPreviewIdentifierLength = 128
	maxEndpointPreviewFQDNLength       = 253
	maxEndpointPreviewInterfaceLength  = 128
)

var (
	endpointPreviewIdentifier = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:[-_.][a-z0-9]+)*$`)
	endpointPreviewInterface  = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]+$`)
)

// EndpointPreview is a bounded, presentation-only view of accepted Core
// evidence. It is not desired state and cannot be supplied to Save.
type EndpointPreview struct {
	Status            string                    `json:"status"`
	Endpoints         []EndpointPreviewEndpoint `json:"endpoints,omitempty"`
	Providers         []EndpointPreviewProvider `json:"providers,omitempty"`
	Findings          []VerificationFinding     `json:"findings,omitempty"`
	FindingsTruncated bool                      `json:"findingsTruncated,omitempty"`
	Truncated         bool                      `json:"truncated,omitempty"`
	Error             *ProjectOpenError         `json:"error,omitempty"`
}

type EndpointPreviewEndpoint struct {
	DeploymentID string `json:"deploymentId"`
	FQDN         string `json:"fqdn"`
}

type EndpointPreviewProvider struct {
	EndpointGroupID      string                          `json:"endpointGroupId"`
	ProviderDeploymentID string                          `json:"providerDeploymentId"`
	EndpointGroupRef     string                          `json:"endpointGroupRef"`
	VirtualRouterID      int                             `json:"virtualRouterId"`
	VirtualAddresses     []EndpointPreviewVirtualAddress `json:"virtualAddresses"`
}

type EndpointPreviewVirtualAddress struct {
	Address   string `json:"address"`
	Interface string `json:"interface"`
}

// GetEndpointPreview exposes only the small safe endpoint/provider projection
// required by UI-01F5. Core snapshot maps never cross this Wails boundary.
func (a *App) GetEndpointPreview() EndpointPreview {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	a.reconcileEditSessionLocked()
	return a.endpointPreviewLocked()
}

func (a *App) endpointPreviewLocked() EndpointPreview {
	verification := a.current.Verification
	if a.current.Status != "OPEN" || a.current.Project == nil {
		return endpointPreviewUnavailable("PROJECT_NOT_OPEN")
	}
	if a.activeSession != "" {
		return EndpointPreview{Status: "STALE"}
	}
	if verification.Status == "INVALID" {
		return EndpointPreview{Status: "INVALID", Findings: append([]VerificationFinding(nil), verification.Findings...), FindingsTruncated: verification.FindingsTruncated}
	}
	if verification.Status == "STALE" {
		return EndpointPreview{Status: "STALE"}
	}
	if verification.Status != "VERIFIED" {
		if verification.Status == "UNVERIFIED" || verification.Status == "" {
			return EndpointPreview{Status: "NOT_VERIFIED"}
		}
		return EndpointPreview{Status: "UNAVAILABLE", Error: verification.Error}
	}
	if a.current.Managed == nil || a.current.Snapshot == nil ||
		verification.ProjectIdentity != a.current.Project.ID ||
		verification.ProjectRevision == "" ||
		verification.ProjectRevision != a.current.Managed.ProjectRevision ||
		verification.ProjectRevision != a.current.Snapshot.ProjectRevision ||
		verification.ExecutionNodeID == "" || verification.Runtime == nil {
		return EndpointPreview{Status: "STALE"}
	}
	if a.binding == nil || a.binding.node.ID == "" ||
		a.execution.context.SelectionKind != "EXPLICIT_EXTERNAL" ||
		a.execution.external == nil || a.execution.external.hostID != a.binding.node.ID ||
		verification.ExecutionNodeID != a.binding.node.ID {
		return EndpointPreview{Status: "STALE"}
	}
	if a.current.Snapshot.Status != "PASS" || a.current.Snapshot.Partial {
		return endpointPreviewUnavailable("ENDPOINT_PREVIEW_SNAPSHOT_INVALID")
	}
	preview, err := buildEndpointPreview(a.current.Snapshot)
	if err != nil {
		return endpointPreviewUnavailable("ENDPOINT_PREVIEW_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	return preview
}

func endpointPreviewUnavailable(code string) EndpointPreview {
	return EndpointPreview{Status: "UNAVAILABLE", Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: code, Message: "Не удалось безопасно подготовить read-only представление точек входа."}}
}

func buildEndpointPreview(snapshot *coreadapter.Snapshot) (EndpointPreview, error) {
	if snapshot == nil {
		return EndpointPreview{}, errEndpointPreview
	}
	endpointRoot, ok := object(snapshot.Endpoints["deployments"])
	if !ok || len(endpointRoot) > maxEndpointPreviewSourceItems || len(snapshot.ServiceDeployments) > maxEndpointPreviewSourceItems {
		return EndpointPreview{}, errEndpointPreview
	}
	integrationRoot, ok := object(snapshot.Integrations["addressProvidersByEndpointGroup"])
	if !ok || len(integrationRoot) > maxEndpointPreviewSourceItems {
		return EndpointPreview{}, errEndpointPreview
	}
	preview := EndpointPreview{Status: "CURRENT"}
	endpointIDs := sortedKeys(endpointRoot)
	if len(endpointIDs) > maxEndpointPreviewEndpoints {
		preview.Truncated = true
		endpointIDs = endpointIDs[:maxEndpointPreviewEndpoints]
	}
	for _, deploymentID := range endpointIDs {
		if !validPreviewIdentifier(deploymentID) {
			return EndpointPreview{}, errEndpointPreview
		}
		record, ok := object(endpointRoot[deploymentID])
		fqdn, valid := requiredString(record, "fqdn", maxEndpointPreviewFQDNLength)
		if !ok || !valid || !validPreviewFQDN(fqdn) {
			return EndpointPreview{}, errEndpointPreview
		}
		preview.Endpoints = append(preview.Endpoints, EndpointPreviewEndpoint{DeploymentID: deploymentID, FQDN: fqdn})
	}
	for _, groupID := range sortedKeys(integrationRoot) {
		if !validPreviewIdentifier(groupID) {
			return EndpointPreview{}, errEndpointPreview
		}
		items, ok := array(integrationRoot[groupID])
		if !ok || len(items) > maxEndpointPreviewSourceItems {
			return EndpointPreview{}, errEndpointPreview
		}
		for _, item := range items {
			provider, ok := object(item)
			deploymentID, valid := requiredString(provider, "deploymentId", maxEndpointPreviewIdentifierLength)
			if !ok || !valid || !validPreviewIdentifier(deploymentID) {
				return EndpointPreview{}, errEndpointPreview
			}
			deployment, present := snapshot.ServiceDeployments[deploymentID]
			endpointGroupRef, valid := requiredString(deployment, "endpointGroupRef", maxEndpointPreviewIdentifierLength)
			virtualRouterID, validRouter := previewRouterID(deployment["virtualRouterId"])
			addresses, validAddresses := previewAddresses(provider["virtualAddresses"])
			deploymentAddresses, deploymentAddressesValid := previewAddresses(deployment["virtualAddresses"])
			if !present || !valid || !validPreviewIdentifier(endpointGroupRef) || endpointGroupRef != groupID || !validRouter || !validAddresses || !deploymentAddressesValid || !sameAddresses(addresses, deploymentAddresses) {
				return EndpointPreview{}, errEndpointPreview
			}
			if len(preview.Providers) >= maxEndpointPreviewProviders {
				preview.Truncated = true
				continue
			}
			if len(addresses) > maxEndpointPreviewAddresses {
				preview.Truncated = true
				addresses = addresses[:maxEndpointPreviewAddresses]
			}
			preview.Providers = append(preview.Providers, EndpointPreviewProvider{EndpointGroupID: groupID, ProviderDeploymentID: deploymentID, EndpointGroupRef: endpointGroupRef, VirtualRouterID: virtualRouterID, VirtualAddresses: addresses})
		}
	}
	sort.Slice(preview.Providers, func(i, j int) bool {
		if preview.Providers[i].EndpointGroupID == preview.Providers[j].EndpointGroupID {
			return preview.Providers[i].ProviderDeploymentID < preview.Providers[j].ProviderDeploymentID
		}
		return preview.Providers[i].EndpointGroupID < preview.Providers[j].EndpointGroupID
	})
	return preview, nil
}

var errEndpointPreview = &endpointPreviewError{}

type endpointPreviewError struct{}

func (*endpointPreviewError) Error() string { return "endpoint preview invalid" }

func object(value any) (map[string]any, bool) {
	result, ok := value.(map[string]any)
	return result, ok
}
func array(value any) ([]any, bool) { result, ok := value.([]any); return result, ok }
func sortedKeys(values map[string]any) []string {
	keys := make([]string, 0, len(values))
	for key := range values {
		keys = append(keys, key)
	}
	sort.Strings(keys)
	return keys
}
func requiredString(values map[string]any, key string, limit int) (string, bool) {
	value, ok := values[key].(string)
	return value, ok && value != "" && len(value) <= limit
}
func validPreviewIdentifier(value string) bool {
	return len(value) <= maxEndpointPreviewIdentifierLength && endpointPreviewIdentifier.MatchString(value)
}
func validPreviewFQDN(value string) bool {
	return len(value) <= maxEndpointPreviewFQDNLength && strings.Contains(value, ".") && !strings.HasPrefix(value, ".") && !strings.HasSuffix(value, ".")
}
func previewRouterID(value any) (int, bool) {
	switch item := value.(type) {
	case float64:
		if item == float64(int(item)) && item >= 1 && item <= 255 {
			return int(item), true
		}
	case int:
		if item >= 1 && item <= 255 {
			return item, true
		}
	case int64:
		if item >= 1 && item <= 255 {
			return int(item), true
		}
	}
	return 0, false
}
func previewAddresses(value any) ([]EndpointPreviewVirtualAddress, bool) {
	items, ok := array(value)
	if !ok || len(items) > maxEndpointPreviewSourceItems {
		return nil, false
	}
	result := make([]EndpointPreviewVirtualAddress, 0, len(items))
	for _, item := range items {
		object, ok := object(item)
		address, addressOK := requiredString(object, "address", 45)
		iface, interfaceOK := requiredString(object, "interface", maxEndpointPreviewInterfaceLength)
		ip := net.ParseIP(address)
		if !ok || !addressOK || !interfaceOK || ip == nil || ip.To4() == nil || !endpointPreviewInterface.MatchString(iface) {
			return nil, false
		}
		result = append(result, EndpointPreviewVirtualAddress{Address: address, Interface: iface})
	}
	return result, true
}
func sameAddresses(left, right []EndpointPreviewVirtualAddress) bool {
	if len(left) != len(right) {
		return false
	}
	for index := range left {
		if left[index] != right[index] {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

package desktop

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"syscall"
	"unsafe"

	"golang.org/x/sys/windows"
)

var bindingConvertSD = syscall.NewLazyDLL("advapi32.dll").NewProc("ConvertStringSecurityDescriptorToSecurityDescriptorW")
var bindingSetFileSecurity = syscall.NewLazyDLL("advapi32.dll").NewProc("SetFileSecurityW")

const bindingProtectedDACL = 0x80000004

func hardenBindingPath(file *os.File) error {
	token, err := syscall.OpenCurrentProcessToken()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer token.Close()
	user, err := token.GetTokenUser()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	sid, err := user.User.Sid.String()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	sddl, err := syscall.UTF16PtrFromString("D:P(A;;FA;;;" + sid + ")(A;;FA;;;SY)(A;;FA;;;BA)")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var descriptor uintptr
	var size uint32
	result, _, callErr := bindingConvertSD.Call(uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(sddl)), 1, uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&descriptor)), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&size)))
	if result == 0 || descriptor == 0 {
		return callErr
	}
	defer syscall.LocalFree(syscall.Handle(descriptor))
	path, err := syscall.UTF16PtrFromString(file.Name())
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	result, _, callErr = bindingSetFileSecurity.Call(uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(path)), bindingProtectedDACL, descriptor)
	if result == 0 {
		return callErr
	}
	opened, err := file.Stat()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	linked, err := os.Lstat(file.Name())
	if err != nil || !os.SameFile(opened, linked) || linked.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_BINDING_INVALID")
	}
	return nil
}

// holdVerifiedBindingFile locks every pathname component against rename and
// the exact opened file against write/delete for the lifetime of ssh/scp.
// This narrow guard is only for the V02 Windows UI transport.
func holdVerifiedBindingFile(path string, identity os.FileInfo, digest [sha256.Size]byte, maxBytes int64) (func(), error) {
	if !filepath.IsAbs(path) || identity == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_BINDING_INVALID")
	}
	clean := filepath.Clean(path)
	volume := filepath.VolumeName(clean)
	if volume == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_BINDING_INVALID")
	}
	current := volume + string(filepath.Separator)
	relative := strings.TrimPrefix(clean, current)
	if relative == clean || relative == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_BINDING_INVALID")
	}
	var held []*os.File
	closeHeld := func() {
		for i := len(held) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
			_ = held[i].Close()
		}
	}
	parts := strings.Split(relative, string(filepath.Separator))
	for i := 0; i < len(parts); i++ {
		if i != 0 {
			current = filepath.Join(current, parts[i-1])
		}
		directory, err := openBindingComponent(current, true)
		if err != nil {
			closeHeld()
			return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_BINDING_INVALID")
		}
		held = append(held, directory)
	}
	file, err := openBindingComponent(clean, false)
	if err != nil {
		closeHeld()
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_BINDING_INVALID")
	}
	held = append(held, file)
	info, err := file.Stat()
	if err != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() || !os.SameFile(info, identity) || info.Size() < 1 || info.Size() > maxBytes {
		closeHeld()
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_BINDING_INVALID")
	}
	bytes, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, maxBytes+1))
	if err != nil || int64(len(bytes)) != info.Size() || sha256.Sum256(bytes) != digest {
		closeHeld()
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_BINDING_INVALID")
	}
	return closeHeld, nil
}

func openBindingComponent(path string, directory bool) (*os.File, error) {
	pointer, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	access := uint32(windows.GENERIC_READ)
	flags := uint32(windows.FILE_FLAG_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT)
	share := uint32(windows.FILE_SHARE_READ)
	if directory {
		access = windows.FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES
		flags |= windows.FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS
		share |= windows.FILE_SHARE_WRITE
	}
	handle, err := windows.CreateFile(pointer, access, share, nil, windows.OPEN_EXISTING, flags, 0)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var info windows.ByHandleFileInformation
	if windows.GetFileInformationByHandle(handle, &info) != nil || info.FileAttributes&windows.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT != 0 || (info.FileAttributes&windows.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY != 0) != directory {
		_ = windows.CloseHandle(handle)
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_BINDING_INVALID")
	}
	return os.NewFile(uintptr(handle), "binding-component"), nil
}

// Delete by the opened object, never by a pathname observed earlier. If a
// lease or an unrelated process still holds either object, retain it safely.
func removeSessionKnownHosts(filePath string, fileInfo os.FileInfo, directory string, directoryInfo os.FileInfo) {
	if fileInfo == nil || directoryInfo == nil || filepath.Dir(filePath) != directory {
		return
	}
	if !markBindingObjectDeleted(filePath, fileInfo, false) {
		return
	}
	_ = markBindingObjectDeleted(directory, directoryInfo, true)
}

func removeSessionDirectory(path string, info os.FileInfo) {
	if info != nil {
		_ = markBindingObjectDeleted(path, info, true)
	}
}

func markBindingObjectDeleted(path string, original os.FileInfo, directory bool) bool {
	pointer, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(path)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	flags := uint32(windows.FILE_FLAG_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT)
	if directory {
		flags |= windows.FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS
	}
	handle, err := windows.CreateFile(pointer, windows.DELETE|windows.FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES, windows.FILE_SHARE_READ|windows.FILE_SHARE_WRITE|windows.FILE_SHARE_DELETE, nil, windows.OPEN_EXISTING, flags, 0)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	file := os.NewFile(uintptr(handle), "session-host-key-cleanup")
	if file == nil {
		_ = windows.CloseHandle(handle)
		return false
	}
	defer file.Close()
	info, err := file.Stat()
	if err != nil || !os.SameFile(info, original) || info.IsDir() != directory {
		return false
	}
	var attributes windows.ByHandleFileInformation
	if windows.GetFileInformationByHandle(handle, &attributes) != nil || attributes.FileAttributes&windows.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT != 0 {
		return false
	}
	deleteFlag := []byte{1}
	return windows.SetFileInformationByHandle(handle, windows.FileDispositionInfo, &deleteFlag[0], uint32(len(deleteFlag))) == nil
}

package desktop

import (
	"errors"
	"os"
	"runtime"
	"sort"
	"strings"

const (
	executionNodeNotConfigured = "NOT_CONFIGURED"
	executionNodeNotPrepared   = "NOT_PREPARED"

var errExecutionNodeSelectionInvalid = errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_SELECTION_INVALID")

// probeLocalExecutionNodeCandidate is intentionally fail-closed. Platform
// Installer currently ships no local Execution Node adapter, therefore no
// Linux host is offered merely because it looks compatible. When such an
// adapter is implemented, this fixed seam is the only place that may turn the
// bounded local OS/architecture observations into a selectable candidate.
func probeLocalExecutionNodeCandidate() *executionNodeCandidate {
	if runtime.GOOS != "linux" || runtime.GOARCH != "amd64" {
		return nil
	}
	content, err := os.ReadFile("/etc/os-release")
	if err != nil || !supportedLocalExecutionNodeOS(string(content)) {
		return nil
	}
	// No supported local adapter is implemented in this release.
	return nil
}

func supportedLocalExecutionNodeOS(content string) bool {
	for _, line := range strings.Split(content, "\n") {
		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "ID=") && strings.Trim(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "ID="), "\"") == "redos" {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

// ExecutionNodeContext is safe, application-only selection state. It is never
// a portable-project field and deliberately cannot represent READY.
type ExecutionNodeContext struct {
	Status          string `json:"status"`
	SelectionKind   string `json:"selectionKind"`
	SelectionSource string `json:"selectionSource"`
	SelectedHostID  string `json:"selectedHostId,omitempty"`
	RuntimeDigest   string `json:"runtimeDigest,omitempty"`
	SafeLabel       string `json:"safeLabel,omitempty"`
	Locked          bool   `json:"locked"`
}

type executionNodeCandidate struct {
	hostID string
	label  string
}

type executionNodeContextStore struct {
	root, projectID string
	external        *executionNodeCandidate
	local           *executionNodeCandidate
	candidates      map[string]executionNodeCandidate
	context         ExecutionNodeContext
}

func newExecutionNodeContextStore(external, local *executionNodeCandidate) *executionNodeContextStore {
	return &executionNodeContextStore{external: external, local: local, candidates: map[string]executionNodeCandidate{}, context: emptyExecutionNodeContext()}
}

func emptyExecutionNodeContext() ExecutionNodeContext {
	return ExecutionNodeContext{Status: executionNodeNotConfigured, SelectionKind: "NONE", SelectionSource: "NONE"}
}

func (s *executionNodeContextStore) bind(root, projectID string, hosts map[string]map[string]any) {
	s.root, s.projectID = root, projectID
	s.replaceSnapshotHosts(hosts)
	s.context = emptyExecutionNodeContext()
	s.selectInitial()
}

func (s *executionNodeContextStore) clear() {
	s.root, s.projectID = "", ""
	s.candidates = map[string]executionNodeCandidate{}
	s.context = emptyExecutionNodeContext()
}

func (s *executionNodeContextStore) setStatus(status string) {
	if status == "" || s.context.SelectionKind == "NONE" {
		return
	}
	s.context.Status = status
}

func (s *executionNodeContextStore) replaceSnapshotHosts(hosts map[string]map[string]any) {
	s.candidates = map[string]executionNodeCandidate{}
	for hostID, host := range hosts {
		if candidate, ok := candidateFromHost(hostID, host); ok {
			s.candidates[hostID] = candidate
		}
	}
}

func candidateFromHost(hostID string, host map[string]any) (executionNodeCandidate, bool) {
	address, _ := host["ansibleHost"].(string)
	if hostID == "" || address == "" {
		return executionNodeCandidate{}, false
	}
	return executionNodeCandidate{hostID: hostID, label: hostID + " · " + address}, true
}

func (s *executionNodeContextStore) applyCommand(commandHostID, operation, address string) {
	if s.root == "" || commandHostID == "" {
		return
	}
	switch operation {
	case "CreateServer":
		if address != "" {
			s.candidates[commandHostID] = executionNodeCandidate{hostID: commandHostID, label: commandHostID + " · " + address}
			if !s.context.Locked && s.context.Status == executionNodeNotConfigured {
				s.selectInitial()
			}
		}
	case "UpdateServer":
		if candidate, ok := s.candidates[commandHostID]; ok && address != "" {
			candidate.label = commandHostID + " · " + address
			s.candidates[commandHostID] = candidate
			if s.context.SelectionKind == "PROJECT_SERVER" && s.context.SelectedHostID == commandHostID {
				s.context.SafeLabel = candidate.label
			}
		}
	case "DeleteServer":
		delete(s.candidates, commandHostID)
		if s.context.SelectionKind == "PROJECT_SERVER" && s.context.SelectedHostID == commandHostID {
			s.context = emptyExecutionNodeContext()
		}
	}
}

func (s *executionNodeContextStore) discardDraft(hosts map[string]map[string]any) {
	selected := s.context
	s.replaceSnapshotHosts(hosts)
	if selected.SelectionKind == "PROJECT_SERVER" {
		if candidate, ok := s.candidates[selected.SelectedHostID]; ok {
			s.context.SafeLabel = candidate.label
			return
		}
		s.context = emptyExecutionNodeContext()
	}
}

func (s *executionNodeContextStore) selectInitial() {
	if s.external != nil {
		s.context = ExecutionNodeContext{Status: executionNodeNotPrepared, SelectionKind: "EXPLICIT_EXTERNAL", SelectionSource: "EXPLICIT", SafeLabel: s.external.label, Locked: true}
		return
	}
	if s.local != nil {
		s.context = ExecutionNodeContext{Status: executionNodeNotPrepared, SelectionKind: "LOCAL_LINUX", SelectionSource: "AUTO_LOCAL_LINUX", SafeLabel: s.local.label, Locked: true}
		return
	}
	ids := make([]string, 0, len(s.candidates))
	for hostID := range s.candidates {
		ids = append(ids, hostID)
	}
	if len(ids) == 0 {
		return
	}
	sort.Strings(ids)
	candidate := s.candidates[ids[0]]
	s.context = ExecutionNodeContext{Status: executionNodeNotPrepared, SelectionKind: "PROJECT_SERVER", SelectionSource: "AUTO_FIRST_ELIGIBLE", SelectedHostID: candidate.hostID, SafeLabel: candidate.label, Locked: true}
}

func (s *executionNodeContextStore) selectProjectServer(hostID string) error {
	candidate, ok := s.candidates[hostID]
	if !ok {
		return errExecutionNodeSelectionInvalid
	}
	s.context = ExecutionNodeContext{Status: executionNodeNotPrepared, SelectionKind: "PROJECT_SERVER", SelectionSource: "EXPLICIT", SelectedHostID: candidate.hostID, SafeLabel: candidate.label, Locked: true}
	return nil
}

package desktop

// executionNodeLifecycle is the existing narrow execution-node lifecycle. The
// application keeps its trusted binding private; Wails receives only the safe
// result types below.
type executionNodeLifecycle interface {
	InspectExecutionNode(context.Context, executionnode.Node) (executionnode.Inspection, error)
	PlanExecutionNodePreparation(context.Context, executionnode.Node, string) (executionnode.Plan, error)
	Prepare(context.Context, executionnode.Node, string, string) (executionnode.Result, error)
}

type executionNodeBinding struct {
	node                 executionnode.Node
	reader               projectReader
	service              executionNodeLifecycle
	plans                *executionnode.ExecutionService
	bundleRoot           string
	dynamic              bool
	credentialGeneration uint64
	hostKeyPin           *approvedExecutionHostKey
	commandGuard         func() (func(), error)
}

// ExecutionNodeReadiness contains no connection, host-key, credential, or
// runtime-path material. It is the only readiness state exposed to Wails.
type ExecutionNodeReadiness struct {
	Status    string                     `json:"status"`
	NodeID    string                     `json:"nodeId,omitempty"`
	SafeLabel string                     `json:"safeLabel,omitempty"`
	CheckedAt string                     `json:"checkedAt,omitempty"`
	Findings  []ExecutionNodeSafeFinding `json:"findings,omitempty"`
	Error     *ProjectOpenError          `json:"error,omitempty"`
}

// ExecutionNodePreparation is a bounded, in-memory confirmation request. Its
// plan is owned and verified by executionnode.Service; the UI may return only
// PlanID to confirm it.
type ExecutionNodePreparation struct {
	Status       string                     `json:"status"`
	PlanID       string                     `json:"planId,omitempty"`
	ExpiresAt    string                     `json:"expiresAt,omitempty"`
	Steps        []ExecutionNodeSafeStep    `json:"steps,omitempty"`
	Findings     []ExecutionNodeSafeFinding `json:"findings,omitempty"`
	Error        *ProjectOpenError          `json:"error,omitempty"`
	Verification *ProjectVerification       `json:"verification,omitempty"`
}

type ExecutionNodeSafeFinding struct {
	Code        string `json:"code"`
	SafeMessage string `json:"safeMessage"`
}

type ExecutionNodeSafeStep struct {
	ID      string `json:"id"`
	Action  string `json:"action"`
	Mutates bool   `json:"mutates"`
}

func safeNodeFindings(findings []executionnode.Finding) []ExecutionNodeSafeFinding {
	const maxFindings = 64
	if len(findings) > maxFindings {
		findings = findings[:maxFindings]
	}
	result := make([]ExecutionNodeSafeFinding, 0, len(findings))
	for _, finding := range findings {
		if finding.Code == "EXECUTION_NODE_ELEVATION_REQUIRED" {
			finding.SafeMessage = "Подключение по SSH выполнено, но права sudo не подтверждены. На странице «Серверы» включите «Требуется пароль sudo», введите пароль и сохраните данные в сеансе. Затем повторите проверку сервера."
		}
		if finding.Code == "" || finding.SafeMessage == "" || len(finding.Code) > 128 || len(finding.SafeMessage) > 512 {
			continue
		}
		result = append(result, ExecutionNodeSafeFinding{Code: finding.Code, SafeMessage: finding.SafeMessage})
	}
	return result
}

func safeNodeSteps(steps []executionnode.Step) []ExecutionNodeSafeStep {
	const maxSteps = 16
	if len(steps) > maxSteps {
		steps = steps[:maxSteps]
	}
	result := make([]ExecutionNodeSafeStep, 0, len(steps))
	for _, step := range steps {
		if step.ID == "" || step.Action == "" || len(step.ID) > 128 || len(step.Action) > 128 {
			continue
		}
		result = append(result, ExecutionNodeSafeStep{ID: step.ID, Action: step.Action, Mutates: step.Mutates})
	}
	return result
}

type verificationContinuation struct {
	root, projectID, revision, bindingID, planID, planDigest string
	expiresAt                                                time.Time
}

func (a *App) resolveSelectedExecutionNodeBindingLocked(scope ...sshpassword.Scope) (*executionNodeBinding, error) {
	binding, err := a.resolveTrustedExecutionConnectionLocked(scope...)
	if err != nil || binding.bundleRoot == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("BINDING_REQUIRED")
	}
	if binding.dynamic {
		verified, err := a.verifySelectedBundleLocked()
		if err != nil || verified.Digest != binding.reader.runtimeRelease["bundleDigest"] {
			return nil, errors.New("BINDING_REQUIRED")
		}
	}
	return binding, nil
}

// Trusted connection is transport authority only. It can inspect a node or
// resolve an already-known run, but cannot authorize Core/plan/Start without
// resolveSelectedExecutionNodeBindingLocked's runtime release check.
func (a *App) resolveTrustedExecutionConnectionLocked(scope ...sshpassword.Scope) (*executionNodeBinding, error) {
	if a.binding == nil || a.binding.service == nil || a.binding.reader.transport == nil || a.binding.node.ID == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("BINDING_REQUIRED")
	}
	if a.binding.dynamic {
		id, address, port, err := a.selectedSavedExecutionServerLocked()
		if err != nil || id != a.binding.node.ID || address != a.binding.node.Address || port != a.binding.node.Port {
			a.invalidateDynamicBindingLocked()
			return nil, errors.New("BINDING_REQUIRED")
		}
		credentialBinding, err := a.credentialBindingLocked()
		if err != nil {
			a.invalidateDynamicBindingLocked()
			return nil, errors.New("BINDING_REQUIRED")
		}
		identity, err := a.secrets.CurrentExecutionIdentity(credentialBinding)
		if len(scope) == 1 {
			identity, err = a.secrets.CurrentExecutionIdentityForOperation(credentialBinding, scope[0].PlanID, scope[0].RunID)
		}
		if err != nil || identity.Generation != a.binding.credentialGeneration || identity.Username != a.binding.node.User {
			if !a.secrets.HasRunExecutionIdentityHold(credentialBinding) {
				a.invalidateDynamicBindingLocked()
			}
			return nil, errors.New("BINDING_REQUIRED")
		}
		if a.binding.hostKeyPin == nil {
			a.invalidateDynamicBindingLocked()
			return nil, errors.New("BINDING_REQUIRED")
		}
		if a.binding.commandGuard == nil {
			a.invalidateDynamicBindingLocked()
			return nil, errors.New("BINDING_REQUIRED")
		}
		var release func()
		var guardErr error
		if transport, ok := a.binding.reader.transport.(executionnode.OpenSSHTransport); ok && transport.ContextCommandGuard != nil && len(scope) == 1 {
			release, guardErr = transport.ContextCommandGuard(sshpassword.WithScope(context.Background(), scope[0]))
		} else {
			release, guardErr = a.binding.commandGuard()
		}
		if guardErr != nil {
			a.invalidateDynamicBindingLocked()
			return nil, errors.New("BINDING_REQUIRED")
		}
		release()
		return a.binding, nil
	}
	if a.execution.context.SelectionKind != "EXPLICIT_EXTERNAL" || a.execution.external == nil || a.execution.external.hostID != a.binding.node.ID {
		return nil, errors.New("BINDING_REQUIRED")
	}
	return a.binding, nil
}

// A long remote call may outlive its session credential. Never publish its
// result unless the same private binding is still current after the call.
func (a *App) revalidateBindingBeforePublicationLocked(binding *executionNodeBinding) error {
	if !binding.dynamic {
		return nil
	}
	current, err := a.resolveSelectedExecutionNodeBindingLocked()
	if err != nil || current != binding {
		credentialBinding, credentialErr := a.credentialBindingLocked()
		if a.binding != binding || credentialErr != nil || !a.secrets.HasRunExecutionIdentityHold(credentialBinding) {
			a.invalidateDynamicBindingLocked()
		}
		return errors.New("BINDING_REQUIRED")
	}
	return nil
}

func (a *App) revalidateTrustedConnectionLocked(binding *executionNodeBinding) error {
	if !binding.dynamic {
		return nil
	}
	current, err := a.resolveTrustedExecutionConnectionLocked()
	if err != nil || current != binding {
		return errors.New("BINDING_REQUIRED")
	}
	return nil
}

func readinessFromInspection(binding *executionNodeBinding, label string, inspection executionnode.Inspection) ExecutionNodeReadiness {
	status := string(inspection.State)
	findings := append([]executionnode.Finding(nil), inspection.Findings...)
	if inspection.State == executionnode.Ready {
		expectedDigest, _ := binding.reader.runtimeRelease["bundleDigest"].(string)
		if expectedDigest != "" && inspection.Runtime.BundleDigest != expectedDigest {
			status = string(executionnode.UpdateRequired)
			findings = append(findings, executionnode.Finding{
				Code:        "EXECUTION_NODE_RUNTIME_BUNDLE_MISMATCH",
				SafeMessage: "Активный runtime bundle на узле не совпадает с проверенным bundle проекта; требуется обновление узла.",
			})
		}
	}
	return ExecutionNodeReadiness{Status: status, NodeID: binding.node.ID, SafeLabel: label, CheckedAt: time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339), Findings: safeNodeFindings(findings)}
}

func (a *App) readinessFailureLocked(err error) ExecutionNodeReadiness {
	code := projectErrorCode(err)
	return ExecutionNodeReadiness{Status: code, CheckedAt: time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339), Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: code, Message: projectErrorMessage(code)}}
}

func (a *App) CheckExecutionNode() ExecutionNodeReadiness {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	if a.current.Status != "OPEN" || a.current.Project == nil {
		return a.readinessFailureLocked(errors.New("PROJECT_NOT_OPEN"))
	}
	binding, err := a.resolveTrustedExecutionConnectionLocked()
	if err != nil {
		return a.readinessFailureLocked(err)
	}
	ctx, cancel := a.operationContext(90 * time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	inspection, err := binding.service.InspectExecutionNode(ctx, binding.node)
	if err != nil {
		if binding.dynamic {
			a.invalidateDynamicBindingLocked()
		}
		return a.readinessFailureLocked(err)
	}
	if err := a.revalidateTrustedConnectionLocked(binding); err != nil {
		return a.readinessFailureLocked(err)
	}
	readiness := readinessFromInspection(binding, a.execution.context.SafeLabel, inspection)
	a.execution.setStatus(readiness.Status)
	return readiness
}

func (a *App) PlanExecutionNodePreparation() ExecutionNodePreparation {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	if a.current.Status != "OPEN" || a.current.Project == nil || a.current.Root == "" {
		return preparationFailure(errors.New("PROJECT_NOT_OPEN"))
	}
	binding, err := a.resolveSelectedExecutionNodeBindingLocked()
	if err != nil {
		return preparationFailure(err)
	}
	revision, err := installer.ProjectRevision(a.current.Root)
	if err != nil {
		return preparationFailure(err)
	}
	ctx, cancel := a.operationContext(2 * time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	plan, err := binding.service.PlanExecutionNodePreparation(ctx, binding.node, binding.bundleRoot)
	if err != nil {
		if binding.dynamic {
			a.invalidateDynamicBindingLocked()
		}
		return preparationFailure(err)
	}
	if err := a.revalidateBindingBeforePublicationLocked(binding); err != nil {
		return preparationFailure(err)
	}
	a.execution.setStatus(string(plan.State))
	if plan.State == executionnode.Incompatible || plan.State == executionnode.Broken || plan.State == executionnode.Unreachable || plan.ID == "" || plan.Digest == "" {
		a.continuation = nil
		return ExecutionNodePreparation{Status: string(plan.State), Steps: safeNodeSteps(plan.Steps)}
	}
	a.continuation = &verificationContinuation{root: a.current.Root, projectID: a.current.Project.ID, revision: revision, bindingID: binding.node.ID, planID: plan.ID, planDigest: plan.Digest, expiresAt: plan.ExpiresAt}
	return ExecutionNodePreparation{Status: "CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED", PlanID: plan.ID, ExpiresAt: plan.ExpiresAt.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339), Steps: safeNodeSteps(plan.Steps)}
}

func preparationFailure(err error) ExecutionNodePreparation {
	code := projectErrorCode(err)
	return ExecutionNodePreparation{Status: "BLOCKED", Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: code, Message: projectErrorMessage(code)}}
}

// PrepareExecutionNode continues only the exact preparation plan generated for
// the current saved revision and trusted binding. After a successful Prepare it
// performs a fresh inspection and then Verify; no pre-Prepare runtime evidence
// is retained as final verification proof.
func (a *App) PrepareExecutionNode(planID string) ExecutionNodePreparation {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	continuation := a.continuation
	a.continuation = nil
	if continuation == nil || continuation.planDigest == "" || planID == "" || planID != continuation.planID || !time.Now().Before(continuation.expiresAt) {
		return preparationFailure(errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_PLAN_INVALID"))
	}
	if a.current.Status != "OPEN" || a.current.Project == nil || a.current.Root != continuation.root || a.current.Project.ID != continuation.projectID {
		return preparationFailure(errors.New("PROJECT_REVISION_CHANGED"))
	}
	revision, err := installer.ProjectRevision(a.current.Root)
	if err != nil || revision != continuation.revision {
		if err == nil {
			err = errors.New("PROJECT_REVISION_CHANGED")
		}
		return preparationFailure(err)
	}
	binding, err := a.resolveSelectedExecutionNodeBindingLocked()
	if err != nil || binding.node.ID != continuation.bindingID {
		if err == nil {
			err = errors.New("BINDING_REQUIRED")
		}
		return preparationFailure(err)
	}
	// Bundle transfer and extraction can exceed five minutes for offline images.
	ctx, cancel := a.operationContext(20 * time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	result, err := binding.service.Prepare(ctx, binding.node, binding.bundleRoot, continuation.planID)
	if err != nil {
		if binding.dynamic {
			a.invalidateDynamicBindingLocked()
		}
		return preparationFailure(err)
	}
	if err := a.revalidateBindingBeforePublicationLocked(binding); err != nil {
		return preparationFailure(err)
	}
	a.execution.setStatus(string(result.State))
	if result.State != executionnode.Ready {
		return ExecutionNodePreparation{Status: string(result.State), Findings: safeNodeFindings(result.Findings)}
	}
	inspection, err := binding.service.InspectExecutionNode(ctx, binding.node)
	if err != nil {
		if binding.dynamic {
			a.invalidateDynamicBindingLocked()
		}
		return preparationFailure(err)
	}
	if err := a.revalidateBindingBeforePublicationLocked(binding); err != nil {
		return preparationFailure(err)
	}
	a.execution.setStatus(string(inspection.State))
	if inspection.State != executionnode.Ready {
		return ExecutionNodePreparation{Status: string(inspection.State), Findings: safeNodeFindings(inspection.Findings)}
	}
	verification := a.verifyProjectWithBindingLocked(binding, continuation.revision, false)
	return ExecutionNodePreparation{Status: "PREPARED", Verification: &verification}
}

const maxSessionKnownHostsBytes = 4096

var executionAddressName = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9.-]{0,252}$`)
var executionUsername = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,63}$`)

type HostKeyProbeResult struct {
	Status      string            `json:"status"`
	ProbeID     string            `json:"probeId,omitempty"`
	SafeLabel   string            `json:"safeLabel,omitempty"`
	KeyType     string            `json:"keyType,omitempty"`
	Fingerprint string            `json:"fingerprint,omitempty"`
	Error       *ProjectOpenError `json:"error,omitempty"`
}

type pendingExecutionHostKey struct {
	id, hostID, address, keyType, publicKey, fingerprint string
	port                                                 uint16
	credentialGeneration                                 uint64
	expires                                              time.Time
}

type approvedExecutionHostKey struct {
	knownHosts           string
	fileInfo             os.FileInfo
	directory            string
	directoryInfo        os.FileInfo
	digest               [sha256.Size]byte
	credentialGeneration uint64
}

func hostKeyProbeFailure(code string) HostKeyProbeResult {
	return HostKeyProbeResult{Status: "BLOCKED", Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: code, Message: projectErrorMessage(code)}}
}

// Host-key trust changes replace the transport binding and its pinned
// known_hosts file. Never allow that while a run still relies on its captured
// binding, even if run-monitor bookkeeping is temporarily unavailable.
func (a *App) activeInstallationTrustLocked() bool {
	return a.startInFlight ||
		a.recoveredRunActiveLocked() ||
		(a.installationRuns != nil && a.installationRuns.hasActiveRun()) ||
		(a.secrets != nil && a.secrets.HasAnyRunExecutionIdentityHold())
}

func validExecutionAddress(value string) bool {
	if net.ParseIP(value) != nil {
		return true
	}
	return !strings.Contains(value, "..") && !strings.HasSuffix(value, ".") && executionAddressName.MatchString(value)
}

func (a *App) selectedSavedExecutionServerLocked() (string, string, uint16, error) {
	if a.current.Status != "OPEN" || a.current.Managed == nil || a.activeSession != "" || a.execution.context.SelectionKind != "PROJECT_SERVER" {
		return "", "", 0, errors.New("BINDING_REQUIRED")
	}
	id := a.execution.context.SelectedHostID
	server, ok := a.current.Managed.Servers[id]
	if !ok || !validExecutionAddress(server.Address) {
		return "", "", 0, errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_SELECTION_INVALID")
	}
	port := 22
	if server.SSHPort != nil {
		port = *server.SSHPort
	}
	if port < 1 || port > 65535 {
		return "", "", 0, errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_SELECTION_INVALID")
	}
	return id, server.Address, uint16(port), nil
}

func (a *App) ProbeExecutionNodeHostKey() HostKeyProbeResult {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	if a.activeInstallationTrustLocked() && !a.canRenewRecoveredConnectionLocked() {
		return hostKeyProbeFailure("INSTALLATION_RUN_ACTIVE")
	}
	a.pauseRecoveredObservationLocked()
	a.pendingHostKey = nil
	// A probe does not replace an approved pin. Retain the current binding
	// until the operator approves an actually different connection/key.
	id, address, port, err := a.selectedSavedExecutionServerLocked()
	if err != nil {
		return hostKeyProbeFailure(projectErrorCode(err))
	}
	if a.recoveredRunActiveLocked() && (id != a.recoveredRun.NodeID || address != a.recoveredRun.NodeAddress || port != a.recoveredRun.NodePort) {
		return hostKeyProbeFailure("ORPHAN_RUN_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED")
	}
	binding, err := a.credentialBindingLocked()
	if err != nil {
		return hostKeyProbeFailure(projectErrorCode(err))
	}
	identity, err := a.secrets.CurrentExecutionIdentity(binding)
	if err != nil {
		return hostKeyProbeFailure("SESSION_CREDENTIAL_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	if !executionUsername.MatchString(identity.Username) {
		return hostKeyProbeFailure("EXECUTION_NODE_USER_INVALID")
	}
	ctx, cancel := a.operationContext(9 * time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	keyType, publicKey, fingerprint, err := probeExecutionHostKey(ctx, address, port)
	if err != nil {
		return hostKeyProbeFailure("EXECUTION_NODE_HOST_KEY_PROBE_FAILED")
	}
	if a.recoveredRunActiveLocked() && (identity.Username != a.recoveredRun.NodeUser || fingerprint != a.recoveredRun.HostKeyFingerprint) {
		return hostKeyProbeFailure("ORPHAN_RUN_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED")
	}
	nonce := make([]byte, 16)
	if _, err := rand.Read(nonce); err != nil {
		return hostKeyProbeFailure("EXECUTION_NODE_HOST_KEY_PROBE_FAILED")
	}
	probeID := hex.EncodeToString(nonce)
	a.pendingHostKey = &pendingExecutionHostKey{id: probeID, hostID: id, address: address, port: port, keyType: keyType, publicKey: publicKey, fingerprint: fingerprint, credentialGeneration: identity.Generation, expires: time.Now().Add(2 * time.Minute)}
	return HostKeyProbeResult{Status: "APPROVAL_REQUIRED", ProbeID: probeID, SafeLabel: a.execution.context.SafeLabel, KeyType: keyType, Fingerprint: fingerprint}
}

func (a *App) DeclineExecutionNodeHostKey() HostKeyProbeResult {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	if a.activeInstallationTrustLocked() {
		return hostKeyProbeFailure("INSTALLATION_RUN_ACTIVE")
	}
	a.pendingHostKey = nil
	a.invalidateDynamicBindingLocked()
	return HostKeyProbeResult{Status: "DECLINED"}
}

func (a *App) ApproveExecutionNodeHostKey(probeID string) HostKeyProbeResult {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	if a.activeInstallationTrustLocked() && !a.canRenewRecoveredConnectionLocked() {
		return hostKeyProbeFailure("INSTALLATION_RUN_ACTIVE")
	}
	pending := a.pendingHostKey
	a.pendingHostKey = nil
	if pending == nil || pending.id != probeID || !time.Now().Before(pending.expires) {
		return hostKeyProbeFailure("EXECUTION_NODE_HOST_KEY_APPROVAL_STALE")
	}
	id, address, port, err := a.selectedSavedExecutionServerLocked()
	if err != nil || id != pending.hostID || address != pending.address || port != pending.port {
		return hostKeyProbeFailure("EXECUTION_NODE_HOST_KEY_APPROVAL_STALE")
	}
	credentialBinding, err := a.credentialBindingLocked()
	if err != nil {
		return hostKeyProbeFailure("SESSION_CREDENTIAL_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	identity, err := a.secrets.CurrentExecutionIdentity(credentialBinding)
	if err != nil || identity.Generation != pending.credentialGeneration {
		return hostKeyProbeFailure("SESSION_CREDENTIAL_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	if !executionUsername.MatchString(identity.Username) {
		return hostKeyProbeFailure("EXECUTION_NODE_USER_INVALID")
	}
	if a.recoveredRunActiveLocked() && (id != a.recoveredRun.NodeID || address != a.recoveredRun.NodeAddress || port != a.recoveredRun.NodePort || identity.Username != a.recoveredRun.NodeUser || pending.fingerprint != a.recoveredRun.HostKeyFingerprint) {
		return hostKeyProbeFailure("ORPHAN_RUN_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED")
	}
	verified, bundleErr := a.verifySelectedBundleLocked()
	if previous := a.binding; previous != nil && previous.dynamic &&
		previous.node.ID == id && previous.node.Address == address && previous.node.Port == port &&
		previous.node.User == identity.Username && previous.credentialGeneration == identity.Generation &&
		previous.node.HostKey.Fingerprint == pending.fingerprint {
		sameRuntime := bundleErr == nil && previous.reader.runtimeRelease["bundleDigest"] == verified.Digest
		if bundleErr != nil && previous.bundleRoot == "" && len(previous.reader.runtimeRelease) == 0 {
			sameRuntime = true // Trust may be confirmed before runtime preparation.
		}
		if sameRuntime {
			if current, err := a.resolveTrustedExecutionConnectionLocked(); err == nil && current == previous {
				return HostKeyProbeResult{Status: "APPROVED", SafeLabel: a.execution.context.SafeLabel,
					KeyType: pending.keyType, Fingerprint: pending.fingerprint}
			}
		}
	}
	knownHosts, fileInfo, directory, directoryInfo, digest, err := createSessionKnownHosts(address, port, pending.keyType, pending.publicKey)
	if err != nil {
		return hostKeyProbeFailure("EXECUTION_NODE_BINDING_INVALID")
	}
	if err := verifyIsolatedHostKeyConfiguration(knownHosts, address); err != nil {
		removeSessionKnownHosts(knownHosts, fileInfo, directory, directoryInfo)
		return hostKeyProbeFailure("EXECUTION_NODE_BINDING_INVALID")
	}
	a.invalidateDynamicBindingLocked()
	pin := approvedExecutionHostKey{knownHosts: knownHosts, fileInfo: fileInfo, directory: directory, directoryInfo: directoryInfo, digest: digest, credentialGeneration: identity.Generation}
	transport := a.executionTransport(identity, credentialBinding, knownHosts, pin.fileInfo, pin.digest)
	guard := transport.CommandGuard
	node := executionnode.Node{ID: id, Address: address, Port: port, User: identity.Username, CredentialRef: "runtime:ssh", HostKey: executionnode.HostKeyPolicy{State: "TRUSTED", KnownHosts: knownHosts, Fingerprint: pending.fingerprint}}
	reader := projectReader{transport: transport, node: node}
	binding := &executionNodeBinding{node: node, reader: reader, service: executionnode.NewService(transport), dynamic: true, credentialGeneration: identity.Generation, hostKeyPin: &pin, commandGuard: guard}
	if bundleErr == nil {
		binding.reader.runtimeRelease = map[string]any{"bundleDigest": verified.Digest, "coreVersion": verified.Manifest.CoreVersion, "catalogDigest": verified.Manifest.CatalogDigest, "planningProtocol": executionbundle.ProtocolVersion}
		binding.plans = executionnode.NewExecutionService(transport, transport)
		binding.bundleRoot = a.availableBundleRoot
		a.reader = binding.reader
	} else {
		a.reader = unavailableProjectReader{}
	}
	a.bindDynamicExecutionNode(binding)
	a.execution.setStatus(executionNodeNotPrepared)
	return HostKeyProbeResult{Status: "APPROVED", SafeLabel: a.execution.context.SafeLabel, KeyType: pending.keyType, Fingerprint: pending.fingerprint}
}

// A UI-selected node is bound after NewApp. Its newly created plan service
// must receive the same runtime-only credential lease provider as a startup
// binding before it can accept a credentialed Start.
func (a *App) bindDynamicExecutionNode(binding *executionNodeBinding) {
	a.binding = binding
	a.configureTargetCredentialLease()
	a.configureTargetHostTrust()
}

func (a *App) verifySelectedBundleLocked() (executionbundle.Verified, error) {
	if a.availableBundleRoot == "" || a.current.Project == nil {
		return executionbundle.Verified{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	verified, err := executionbundle.ValidateRoot(a.availableBundleRoot)
	if err != nil || verified.Digest != a.current.Project.Source.BundleDigest || verified.Manifest.CatalogDigest != a.current.Project.Source.CatalogDigest {
		return executionbundle.Verified{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	return verified, nil
}

func (a *App) invalidateDynamicBindingLocked() {
	a.invalidateDynamicBindingRuntimeInputsLocked(false)
}

// SSH credential replacement still revokes node readiness and plans, but the
// project-bound pending inputs can be re-attested without importing them again.
func (a *App) invalidateDynamicBindingRuntimeInputsLocked(retainInputs bool) {
	if a.binding == nil || !a.binding.dynamic {
		return
	}
	pin := a.binding.hostKeyPin
	a.binding = nil
	if pin != nil {
		removeSessionKnownHosts(pin.knownHosts, pin.fileInfo, pin.directory, pin.directoryInfo)
	}
	a.reader = unavailableProjectReader{}
	a.execution.setStatus(executionNodeNotPrepared)
	a.current.Snapshot = nil
	a.current.Verification = notVerified()
	a.continuation = nil
	a.installationPlanID = ""
	a.installationGeneration++
	if retainInputs {
		a.runtimeSecretEvidence = nil
	} else {
		a.clearRuntimeSecretDescriptorEvidenceLocked()
	}
}

func probeExecutionHostKey(ctx context.Context, address string, port uint16) (string, string, string, error) {
	if !validExecutionAddress(address) || port == 0 {
		return "", "", "", errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_HOST_KEY_PROBE_FAILED")
	}
	command := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "ssh-keyscan", "-T", "5", "-p", strconv.Itoa(int(port)), "-t", "ed25519,ecdsa,rsa", address)
	commandwindow.Configure(command)
	var output cappedHostKeyOutput
	command.Stdout = &output
	command.Stderr = nil
	if err := command.Run(); err != nil || output.overflow {
		return "", "", "", errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_HOST_KEY_PROBE_FAILED")
	}
	return parseScannedHostKey(output.Bytes(), address, port)
}

func parseScannedHostKey(output []byte, address string, port uint16) (string, string, string, error) {
	expectedHost := address
	if port != 22 {
		expectedHost = fmt.Sprintf("[%s]:%d", address, port)
	}
	seen := map[string]string{}
	for _, line := range strings.Split(string(output), "\n") {
		fields := strings.Fields(line)
		if len(fields) != 3 || strings.HasPrefix(line, "#") {
			continue
		}
		if fields[0] != expectedHost {
			return "", "", "", errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_HOST_KEY_PROBE_FAILED")
		}
		kind := fields[1]
		if kind != "ssh-ed25519" && kind != "ecdsa-sha2-nistp256" && kind != "ssh-rsa" {
			continue
		}
		decoded, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(fields[2])
		if err != nil || len(decoded) < 32 || len(decoded) > 8192 || len(decoded) < 4 || int(binary.BigEndian.Uint32(decoded[:4])) != len(kind) || len(decoded) < 4+len(kind) || string(decoded[4:4+len(kind)]) != kind {
			return "", "", "", errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_HOST_KEY_PROBE_FAILED")
		}
		if previous, exists := seen[kind]; exists && previous != fields[2] {
			return "", "", "", errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_HOST_KEY_PROBE_FAILED")
		}
		seen[kind] = fields[2]
	}
	for _, kind := range []string{"ssh-ed25519", "ecdsa-sha2-nistp256", "ssh-rsa"} {
		if key, ok := seen[kind]; ok {
			decoded, _ := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(key)
			digest := sha256.Sum256(decoded)
			return kind, key, "SHA256:" + base64.RawStdEncoding.EncodeToString(digest[:]), nil
		}
	}
	return "", "", "", errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_HOST_KEY_PROBE_FAILED")
}

type cappedHostKeyOutput struct {
	bytes.Buffer
	overflow bool
	limit    int
}

func (b *cappedHostKeyOutput) Write(p []byte) (int, error) {
	limit := b.limit
	if limit == 0 {
		limit = 16384
	}
	if b.Len()+len(p) > limit {
		b.overflow = true
		return 0, errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_HOST_KEY_PROBE_FAILED")
	}
	return b.Buffer.Write(p)
}

func createSessionKnownHosts(address string, port uint16, kind, key string) (string, os.FileInfo, string, os.FileInfo, [sha256.Size]byte, error) {
	var empty [sha256.Size]byte
	root, err := os.MkdirTemp("", "platform-installer-v02-")
	if err != nil {
		return "", nil, "", nil, empty, err
	}
	var directoryInfo, fileInfo os.FileInfo
	success := false
	name := filepath.Join(root, "known_hosts")
	defer func() {
		if success || directoryInfo == nil {
			return
		}
		if fileInfo != nil {
			removeSessionKnownHosts(name, fileInfo, root, directoryInfo)
		} else {
			removeSessionDirectory(root, directoryInfo)
		}
	}()
	dir, err := os.Open(root)
	if err != nil {
		return "", nil, "", nil, empty, err
	}
	directoryInfo, err = dir.Stat()
	if err != nil {
		_ = dir.Close()
		return "", nil, "", nil, empty, err
	}
	if err = hardenBindingPath(dir); err != nil {
		_ = dir.Close()
		return "", nil, "", nil, empty, err
	}
	_ = dir.Close()
	file, err := os.OpenFile(name, os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY, 0o600)
	if err != nil {
		return "", nil, "", nil, empty, err
	}
	defer file.Close()
	fileInfo, err = file.Stat()
	if err != nil {
		return "", nil, "", nil, empty, err
	}
	if err = hardenBindingPath(file); err != nil {
		return "", nil, "", nil, empty, err
	}
	host := address
	if port != 22 {
		host = fmt.Sprintf("[%s]:%d", address, port)
	}
	content := []byte(host + " " + kind + " " + key + "\n")
	if len(content) > maxSessionKnownHostsBytes {
		return "", nil, "", nil, empty, errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_BINDING_INVALID")
	}
	if _, err = file.Write(content); err != nil {
		return "", nil, "", nil, empty, err
	}
	if err = file.Sync(); err != nil {
		return "", nil, "", nil, empty, err
	}
	info, err := file.Stat()
	if err != nil {
		return "", nil, "", nil, empty, err
	}
	success = true
	return name, info, root, directoryInfo, sha256.Sum256(content), nil
}

func verifyIsolatedHostKeyConfiguration(knownHosts, address string) error {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	args := []string{"-G", "-F", "none", "-o", "GlobalKnownHostsFile=none", "-o", "KnownHostsCommand=none", "-o", "UpdateHostKeys=no", "-o", "StrictHostKeyChecking=yes", "-o", "UserKnownHostsFile=" + knownHosts, address}
	command := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "ssh", args...)
	commandwindow.Configure(command)
	var output cappedHostKeyOutput
	output.limit = 65536
	command.Stdout = &output
	if err := command.Run(); err != nil || output.overflow {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_BINDING_INVALID")
	}
	settings := map[string]string{}
	for _, line := range strings.Split(output.String(), "\n") {
		parts := strings.SplitN(line, " ", 2)
		if len(parts) == 2 {
			settings[strings.ToLower(parts[0])] = strings.TrimSpace(parts[1])
		}
	}
	if settings["globalknownhostsfile"] != "none" || settings["userknownhostsfile"] != knownHosts || settings["stricthostkeychecking"] != "true" || (settings["knownhostscommand"] != "" && settings["knownhostscommand"] != "none") {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_BINDING_INVALID")
	}
	return nil
}

import (

func sameTransportIdentity(a, b runtimesecret.ExecutionIdentity) bool {
	return a.Mode == b.Mode && a.Generation == b.Generation && a.Username == b.Username && a.Path == b.Path && a.Digest == b.Digest
}

func (a *App) executionTransport(identity runtimesecret.ExecutionIdentity, binding runtimesecret.Binding, known string, file os.FileInfo, digest [sha256.Size]byte) executionnode.OpenSSHTransport {
	guard := func(ctx context.Context) (func(), error) {
		var current runtimesecret.ExecutionIdentity
		var err error
		if identity.Mode == runtimesecret.SSHPassword {
			scope := sshpassword.OperationScope(ctx)
			current, err = a.secrets.CurrentExecutionIdentityForOperation(binding, scope.PlanID, scope.RunID)
		} else {
			current, err = a.secrets.CurrentExecutionIdentity(binding)
		}
		if err != nil || !sameTransportIdentity(current, identity) {
			return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_BINDING_INVALID")
		}
		releaseKey := func() {}
		if identity.Mode != runtimesecret.SSHPassword {
			releaseKey, err = holdVerifiedBindingFile(identity.Path, identity.FileInfo, identity.Digest, 1<<20)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
		}
		releaseHost, err := holdVerifiedBindingFile(known, file, digest, maxSessionKnownHostsBytes)
		if err != nil {
			releaseKey()
			return nil, err
		}
		return func() { releaseHost(); releaseKey() }, nil
	}
	transport := executionnode.OpenSSHTransport{Identity: desktopIdentity{identity.Path}, ContextCommandGuard: guard, IsolatedHostKeyTrust: true}
	transport.CommandGuard = func() (func(), error) { return guard(context.Background()) }
	if identity.Mode == runtimesecret.SSHPassword {
		transport.Password = func(ctx context.Context, use func([]byte) error) error {
			scope := sshpassword.OperationScope(ctx)
			return a.secrets.WithExecutionPassword(binding, identity, scope.PlanID, scope.RunID, use)
		}
	}
	if a.secrets.HasExecutionSudoPassword(binding, identity) {
		transport.SudoPassword = func(ctx context.Context, use func([]byte) error) error {
			scope := sshpassword.OperationScope(ctx)
			return a.secrets.WithExecutionSudoPassword(binding, identity, scope.PlanID, scope.RunID, use)
		}
	}
	return transport
}
