const localRunRecordVersion = 1
const maxLocalRunRecordBytes = 1 << 20

// This is operational start evidence, never desired project state. The
// initial PENDING record is durable before a remote Start can be sent.
type localRunRecord struct {
	Version            int    `json:"version"`
	ProjectRoot        string `json:"projectRoot"`
	ProjectID          string `json:"projectId"`
	ProjectRevision    string `json:"projectRevision"`
	PlanID             string `json:"planId"`
	NodeID             string `json:"nodeId"`
	NodeAddress        string `json:"nodeAddress"`
	NodePort           uint16 `json:"nodePort"`
	NodeUser           string `json:"nodeUser"`
	HostKeyFingerprint string `json:"hostKeyFingerprint"`
	State              string `json:"state"` // PENDING, RUNNING, TERMINAL
	RunID              string `json:"runId,omitempty"`
	TerminalState      string `json:"terminalState,omitempty"`
	// Display evidence only; never used to approve, rebuild or start a plan.
	Plan *InstallationPlanView `json:"plan,omitempty"`
}

func defaultLocalRunRecordRoot() string {
	base, err := os.UserConfigDir()
	if err != nil || base == "" {
		return ""
	}
	return filepath.Join(base, "platform-installer", "run-records")
}

func canonicalRunProjectRoot(root string) (string, error) {
	if root == "" {
		return "", errors.New("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_INVALID")
	}
	absolute, err := filepath.Abs(root)
	if err != nil {
		return "", errors.New("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_INVALID")
	}
	absolute = filepath.Clean(absolute)
	if runtime.GOOS == "windows" {
		absolute = strings.ToLower(absolute)
	}
	return absolute, nil
}

func localRunRecordPath(storeRoot, projectRoot, projectID string) (string, error) {
	if storeRoot == "" || projectID == "" {
		return "", errors.New("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	canonical, err := canonicalRunProjectRoot(projectRoot)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	hash := sha256.Sum256([]byte(canonical + "\x00" + projectID))
	return filepath.Join(storeRoot, hex.EncodeToString(hash[:])+".json"), nil
}

func validLocalRunID(id string) bool {
	if len(id) <= len("installer-") || len(id) > 128 || !strings.HasPrefix(id, "installer-") {
		return false
	}
	for _, ch := range id[len("installer-"):] {
		if ch < '0' || ch > '9' && (ch < 'a' || ch > 'f') {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func validLocalRunRecord(record localRunRecord) bool {
	if record.Plan != nil && (record.Plan.ID != record.PlanID || record.Plan.ProjectRevision != record.ProjectRevision || record.Plan.ExecutionNodeID != record.NodeID) {
		return false
	}
	if record.Version != localRunRecordVersion || record.ProjectRoot == "" || record.ProjectID == "" || record.ProjectRevision == "" || record.PlanID == "" || record.NodeID == "" || record.NodeAddress == "" || record.NodePort == 0 || record.NodeUser == "" || !strings.HasPrefix(record.HostKeyFingerprint, "SHA256:") {
		return false
	}
	switch record.State {
	case "PENDING":
		return record.RunID == "" && record.TerminalState == ""
	case "RUNNING":
		return validLocalRunID(record.RunID) && record.TerminalState == ""
	case "TERMINAL":
		return validLocalRunID(record.RunID) && rebindTerminalRun(record.TerminalState)
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func readLocalRunRecord(storeRoot, projectRoot, projectID string) (*localRunRecord, error) {
	path, err := localRunRecordPath(storeRoot, projectRoot, projectID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := safeLocalRunRecordRoot(storeRoot); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	info, err := os.Lstat(path)
	if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
		return nil, nil
	}
	if err != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Size() < 2 || info.Size() > maxLocalRunRecordBytes {
		return nil, errors.New("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_INVALID")
	}
	content, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil || len(content) > maxLocalRunRecordBytes {
		return nil, errors.New("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_INVALID")
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(content))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	var record localRunRecord
	if err := decoder.Decode(&record); err != nil {
		return nil, errors.New("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_INVALID")
	}
	var extra any
	if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return nil, errors.New("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_INVALID")
	}
	canonical, err := canonicalRunProjectRoot(projectRoot)
	if err != nil || !validLocalRunRecord(record) || record.ProjectRoot != canonical || record.ProjectID != projectID {
		return nil, errors.New("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_INVALID")
	}
	return &record, nil
}

func writeLocalRunRecord(storeRoot string, record localRunRecord) error {
	if !validLocalRunRecord(record) {
		return errors.New("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_INVALID")
	}
	canonical, err := canonicalRunProjectRoot(record.ProjectRoot)
	if err != nil || canonical != record.ProjectRoot {
		return errors.New("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_INVALID")
	}
	path, err := localRunRecordPath(storeRoot, record.ProjectRoot, record.ProjectID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := os.MkdirAll(storeRoot, 0o700); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_UNAVAILABLE: %w", err)
	}
	if err := safeLocalRunRecordRoot(storeRoot); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if info, err := os.Lstat(path); err == nil && !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
		return errors.New("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_INVALID")
	} else if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
		return errors.New("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_INVALID")
	}
	data, err := json.Marshal(record)
	if err != nil || len(data) > maxLocalRunRecordBytes {
		return errors.New("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_INVALID")
	}
	return writeLocalOperationalRecord(storeRoot, path, data)
}

// Shared atomic publication for bounded operational records. Callers validate
// their closed record and derive the path using localRunRecordPath.
func writeLocalOperationalRecord(storeRoot, path string, data []byte) error {
	temp, err := os.CreateTemp(storeRoot, ".run-record-")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer os.Remove(temp.Name())
	if err := temp.Chmod(0o600); err != nil {
		temp.Close()
		return err
	}
	if _, err := temp.Write(data); err != nil {
		temp.Close()
		return err
	}
	if err := temp.Sync(); err != nil {
		temp.Close()
		return err
	}
	if err := temp.Close(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := replaceLocalRunRecord(temp.Name(), path); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return syncLocalRunRecordDir(storeRoot)
}

// restoreLocalRunRecordAfterUnsentStart rolls back only the exact PENDING
// reservation written for a Start request that the trusted lifecycle layer
// proves was never dispatched. A prior terminal record is restored verbatim.
func restoreLocalRunRecordAfterUnsentStart(storeRoot string, pending localRunRecord, previous *localRunRecord) error {
	if pending.State != "PENDING" || pending.RunID != "" || !validLocalRunRecord(pending) {
		return errors.New("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_INVALID")
	}
	current, err := readLocalRunRecord(storeRoot, pending.ProjectRoot, pending.ProjectID)
	currentJSON, currentErr := json.Marshal(current)
	pendingJSON, pendingErr := json.Marshal(pending)
	if err != nil || current == nil || currentErr != nil || pendingErr != nil || !bytes.Equal(currentJSON, pendingJSON) {
		return errors.New("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_CHANGED")
	}
	if previous != nil {
		return writeLocalRunRecord(storeRoot, *previous)
	}
	path, err := localRunRecordPath(storeRoot, pending.ProjectRoot, pending.ProjectID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := safeLocalRunRecordRoot(storeRoot); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	info, err := os.Lstat(path)
	if err != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
		return errors.New("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_INVALID")
	}
	if err := os.Remove(path); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_UNAVAILABLE: %w", err)
	}
	return syncLocalRunRecordDir(storeRoot)
}

func safeLocalRunRecordRoot(root string) error {
	info, err := os.Lstat(root)
	if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
		return nil
	}
	if err != nil || !info.IsDir() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
		return errors.New("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	return nil
}

package desktop

import (
	"os"
	"syscall"
	"unsafe"
)

var localRunMoveFileEx = syscall.NewLazyDLL("kernel32.dll").NewProc("MoveFileExW")

func replaceLocalRunRecord(source, destination string) error {
	from, err := syscall.UTF16PtrFromString(source)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	to, err := syscall.UTF16PtrFromString(destination)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	result, _, callErr := localRunMoveFileEx.Call(uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(from)), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(to)), 0x1|0x8)
	if result == 0 {
		if callErr != nil && callErr != syscall.Errno(0) {
			return callErr
		}
		return os.ErrInvalid
	}
	return nil
}

@@PORTABLE {"path":"internal/desktop/orphan_run_recovery.go","mode":420,"size":12533,"sha256":"10d50fe3009b9ddbad92a96037a2660f4ddf03142ad6e159c53aa641e1216e5c","index":0,"count":1,"encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":12533}
package desktop

import (
	"crypto/rand"
	"encoding/hex"
	"errors"
	"time"

	"platform-installer/internal/executionnode"
	"platform-installer/internal/sshpassword"
)

type orphanRunRecovery struct {
	id          string
	projectRoot string
	projectID   string
	runID       string
	expires     time.Time
}

type OrphanRunRecoveryResult struct {
	Status          string            `json:"status"`
	RecoveryID      string            `json:"recoveryId,omitempty"`
	RunID           string            `json:"runId,omitempty"`
	RunState        string            `json:"runState,omitempty"`
	ProjectRevision string            `json:"projectRevision,omitempty"`
	Error           *ProjectOpenError `json:"error,omitempty"`
}

func orphanRecoveryError(code string) OrphanRunRecoveryResult {
	return OrphanRunRecoveryResult{Status: "BLOCKED", Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: code, Message: projectErrorMessage(code)}}
}

// InspectOrphanRun discovers only the locally recorded prior run on its original
// trusted node. The short-lived candidate permits explicit attach or cancellation.
func (a *App) InspectOrphanRun() OrphanRunRecoveryResult {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	a.orphanRecovery = nil
	if a.current.Status != "OPEN" || a.current.Project == nil || a.startInFlight || a.runtimeUpdateInFlight {
		return orphanRecoveryError("PROJECT_NOT_OPEN")
	}
	record, err := readLocalRunRecord(a.localRunRecordRoot, a.current.Root, a.current.Project.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return orphanRecoveryError("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_INVALID")
	}
	if record == nil || record.State == "TERMINAL" {
		return OrphanRunRecoveryResult{Status: "NONE"}
	}
	if record.State != "RUNNING" || record.RunID == "" {
		return OrphanRunRecoveryResult{Status: "UNKNOWN"}
	}
	if a.installationRuns.knowsRun(record.RunID) {
		return OrphanRunRecoveryResult{Status: "CURRENT", RunID: record.RunID, ProjectRevision: record.ProjectRevision}
	}
	binding, err := a.resolveTrustedExecutionConnectionLocked()
	if err != nil || !sameLocalRunNode(*record, binding.node) {
		return OrphanRunRecoveryResult{Status: "UNAVAILABLE"}
	}
	client, ok := binding.reader.transport.(executionnode.ExecutionClient)
	if !ok {
		return OrphanRunRecoveryResult{Status: "UNAVAILABLE"}
	}
	ctx, cancel := a.operationContext(30 * time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	run, err := client.GetExecution(ctx, binding.node, record.RunID)
	if err != nil || run.ProjectIdentity != record.ProjectID {
		return OrphanRunRecoveryResult{Status: "UNAVAILABLE"}
	}
	if rebindTerminalRun(run.State) && !a.recoveredStopUnconfirmedLocked(record.RunID) {
		record.State, record.TerminalState = "TERMINAL", run.State
		if err := writeLocalRunRecord(a.localRunRecordRoot, *record); err != nil {
			return orphanRecoveryError("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_UNAVAILABLE")
		}
		return OrphanRunRecoveryResult{Status: "RESOLVED", RunID: record.RunID, RunState: run.State}
	}
	if !orphanRunCancellable(run.State) && !a.recoveredStopUnconfirmedLocked(record.RunID) {
		return OrphanRunRecoveryResult{Status: "UNAVAILABLE"}
	}
	var nonce [16]byte
	if _, err := rand.Read(nonce[:]); err != nil {
		return orphanRecoveryError("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	id := hex.EncodeToString(nonce[:])
	a.orphanRecovery = &orphanRunRecovery{id: id, projectRoot: a.current.Root, projectID: record.ProjectID, runID: record.RunID, expires: time.Now().Add(2 * time.Minute)}
	result := OrphanRunRecoveryResult{Status: "FOUND", RecoveryID: id, RunID: record.RunID, RunState: run.State, ProjectRevision: record.ProjectRevision}
	if a.recoveredStopUnconfirmedLocked(record.RunID) {
		result.Error = &ProjectOpenError{Code: "ORPHAN_RUN_CANCEL_UNCONFIRMED", Message: "Остановка не подтверждена. Подключитесь и повторите отмену."}
	}
	return result
}

// AttachOrphanRun restores the existing execution session without a new Start.
func (a *App) AttachOrphanRun(recoveryID string) InstallationRunOperation {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	p := a.orphanRecovery
	a.orphanRecovery = nil
	fail := func(code string) InstallationRunOperation {
		return InstallationRunOperation{Status: "BLOCKED", Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: code, Message: projectErrorMessage(code)}}
	}
	if p == nil || recoveryID == "" || recoveryID != p.id || !time.Now().Before(p.expires) || a.current.Status != "OPEN" || a.current.Root != p.projectRoot || a.current.Project == nil || a.current.Project.ID != p.projectID || a.startInFlight || a.runtimeUpdateInFlight {
		return fail("ORPHAN_RUN_RECOVERY_STALE")
	}
	record, err := readLocalRunRecord(a.localRunRecordRoot, p.projectRoot, p.projectID)
	if err != nil || record == nil || record.State != "RUNNING" || record.RunID != p.runID {
		return fail("ORPHAN_RUN_RECOVERY_STALE")
	}
	binding, err := a.resolveTrustedExecutionConnectionLocked()
	if err != nil || !sameLocalRunNode(*record, binding.node) {
		return fail("ORPHAN_RUN_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED")
	}
	client, ok := binding.reader.transport.(executionnode.ExecutionClient)
	if !ok {
		return fail("EXECUTION_NODE_BINDING_REQUIRED")
	}
	ctx, cancel := a.operationContext(30 * time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	run, err := client.GetExecution(ctx, binding.node, record.RunID)
	if err != nil || run.RunID != record.RunID || run.ProjectIdentity != record.ProjectID || a.revalidateTrustedConnectionLocked(binding) != nil {
		return fail("ORPHAN_RUN_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED")
	}
	if !orphanRunCancellable(run.State) && !rebindTerminalRun(run.State) {
		return fail("ORPHAN_RUN_STATE_UNKNOWN")
	}
	if binding.plans == nil {
		return fail("EXECUTION_NODE_BINDING_REQUIRED")
	}
	reconnected, _, err := binding.plans.Reconnect(ctx, binding.node, record.RunID)
	if err != nil || reconnected.RunID != record.RunID || reconnected.ProjectIdentity != record.ProjectID || a.revalidateTrustedConnectionLocked(binding) != nil {
		return fail("ORPHAN_RUN_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED")
	}
	run = reconnected
	if !orphanRunCancellable(run.State) && !rebindTerminalRun(run.State) {
		return fail("ORPHAN_RUN_STATE_UNKNOWN")
	}
	a.pauseRecoveredObservationLocked()
	a.recoveredRun = record
	a.installationRuns.rememberRun(run.RunID)
	if rebindTerminalRun(run.State) && !a.recoveredStopUnconfirmedLocked(run.RunID) {
		record.State, record.TerminalState = "TERMINAL", run.State
		if err := writeLocalRunRecord(a.localRunRecordRoot, *record); err != nil {
			return fail("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_UNAVAILABLE")
		}
		a.installationRuns.finishMonitor(run.RunID, &run)
	} else {
		captured := installationStartContext{generation: a.installationGeneration, root: a.current.Root, projectID: record.ProjectID, revision: record.ProjectRevision, planID: record.PlanID, nodeID: record.NodeID}
		monitorCtx, started := a.installationRuns.startMonitor(run.RunID)
		if !started {
			return fail("INSTALLATION_OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS")
		}
		go a.monitorInstallationRun(monitorCtx, binding, captured, run.RunID)
	}
	return a.observedInstallationRunLocked(run)
}

func (a *App) recoveredRunActiveLocked() bool {
	return a.recoveredRun != nil && a.recoveredRun.State == "RUNNING"
}

func (a *App) recoveredStopUnconfirmedLocked(runID string) bool {
	return a.recoveredCancelUnconfirmed && a.recoveredRun != nil && a.recoveredRun.RunID == runID
}

func (a *App) canRenewRecoveredConnectionLocked() bool {
	return a.recoveredRunActiveLocked() && !a.startInFlight && !a.secrets.HasAnyRunExecutionIdentityHold()
}

// Credential renewal stops old local observers, never the remote controller.
func (a *App) pauseRecoveredObservationLocked() {
	if a.recoveredRun != nil {
		a.installationRuns.clear()
	}
}

func (a *App) resolveInstallationObservationLocked(runID string) (*executionNodeBinding, error) {
	if a.recoveredRun == nil || a.recoveredRun.RunID != runID {
		return a.resolveSelectedExecutionNodeBindingLocked(sshpassword.Scope{RunID: runID})
	}
	record := a.recoveredRun
	root, err := canonicalRunProjectRoot(a.current.Root)
	if err != nil || a.current.Project == nil || root != record.ProjectRoot || a.current.Project.ID != record.ProjectID {
		return nil, errors.New("ORPHAN_RUN_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED")
	}
	binding, err := a.resolveTrustedExecutionConnectionLocked(sshpassword.Scope{RunID: runID})
	if err != nil || !sameLocalRunNode(*record, binding.node) {
		return nil, errors.New("ORPHAN_RUN_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED")
	}
	return binding, nil
}

func (a *App) observedInstallationRunLocked(run executionnode.ExecutionRun) InstallationRunOperation {
	result := InstallationRunOperation{Status: "READY", Run: ptrInstallationRun(installationRunView(run)), Result: installationResultView(run)}
	// A React reload loses view state while the same Go session still owns
	// the run. Return its saved display plan without creating or approving one.
	if a.current.Status == "OPEN" && a.current.Project != nil && run.ProjectIdentity == a.current.Project.ID {
		if record, err := readLocalRunRecord(a.localRunRecordRoot, a.current.Root, a.current.Project.ID); err == nil && record != nil && record.RunID == run.RunID {
			result.Plan = record.Plan
			result.ProjectRevision = record.ProjectRevision
		}
	}
	if a.recoveredRun != nil && a.recoveredRun.RunID == run.RunID {
		result.Reconnected = true
		result.CancelUnconfirmed = a.recoveredCancelUnconfirmed
		result.ProjectRevision = a.recoveredRun.ProjectRevision
		result.Plan = a.recoveredRun.Plan
		if a.recoveredCancelUnconfirmed {
			result.Result = nil
		}
		if rebindTerminalRun(run.State) && !a.recoveredCancelUnconfirmed {
			a.recoveredRun.State, a.recoveredRun.TerminalState = "TERMINAL", run.State
		}
	}
	return result
}

func orphanRunCancellable(state string) bool {
	switch state {
	case "STARTING", "RUNNING", "CANCELLING":
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

// CancelOrphanRun only uses the run ID kept by Go in the one-use preview. It
// never deletes remote run files and never unlocks on timeout or unknown state.
func (a *App) CancelOrphanRun(recoveryID string) OrphanRunRecoveryResult {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	p := a.orphanRecovery
	a.orphanRecovery = nil
	if p == nil || recoveryID == "" || recoveryID != p.id || time.Now().After(p.expires) || a.current.Status != "OPEN" || a.current.Root != p.projectRoot || a.current.Project == nil || a.current.Project.ID != p.projectID || a.startInFlight || a.runtimeUpdateInFlight || a.installationRuns.knowsRun(p.runID) {
		return orphanRecoveryError("ORPHAN_RUN_RECOVERY_STALE")
	}
	record, err := readLocalRunRecord(a.localRunRecordRoot, p.projectRoot, p.projectID)
	if err != nil || record == nil || record.State != "RUNNING" || record.RunID != p.runID {
		return orphanRecoveryError("ORPHAN_RUN_RECOVERY_STALE")
	}
	binding, err := a.resolveTrustedExecutionConnectionLocked()
	if err != nil || !sameLocalRunNode(*record, binding.node) {
		return orphanRecoveryError("EXECUTION_NODE_BINDING_REQUIRED")
	}
	client, ok := binding.reader.transport.(executionnode.ExecutionClient)
	if !ok {
		return orphanRecoveryError("EXECUTION_NODE_BINDING_REQUIRED")
	}
	ctx, cancel := a.operationContext(90 * time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	run, err := client.GetExecution(ctx, binding.node, record.RunID)
	if err != nil || run.ProjectIdentity != record.ProjectID {
		return orphanRecoveryError("ORPHAN_RUN_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED")
	}
	if !rebindTerminalRun(run.State) || a.recoveredStopUnconfirmedLocked(record.RunID) {
		if !orphanRunCancellable(run.State) {
			return orphanRecoveryError("ORPHAN_RUN_STATE_UNKNOWN")
		}
		if _, err := client.CancelExecution(ctx, binding.node, record.RunID); err != nil {
			return orphanRecoveryError("ORPHAN_RUN_CANCEL_UNCONFIRMED")
		}
		for {
			run, err = client.GetExecution(ctx, binding.node, record.RunID)
			if err != nil || run.ProjectIdentity != record.ProjectID {
				return orphanRecoveryError("ORPHAN_RUN_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED")
			}
			if rebindTerminalRun(run.State) {
				break
			}
			if !orphanRunCancellable(run.State) {
				return orphanRecoveryError("ORPHAN_RUN_STATE_UNKNOWN")
			}
			select {
			case <-ctx.Done():
				return OrphanRunRecoveryResult{Status: "CANCELLING", RunID: record.RunID}
			case <-time.After(time.Second):
			}
		}
	}
	record.State, record.TerminalState = "TERMINAL", run.State
	if err := writeLocalRunRecord(a.localRunRecordRoot, *record); err != nil {
		return orphanRecoveryError("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	if a.recoveredStopUnconfirmedLocked(record.RunID) {
		a.recoveredCancelUnconfirmed = false
		a.recoveredRun.State, a.recoveredRun.TerminalState = "TERMINAL", run.State
	}
	return OrphanRunRecoveryResult{Status: "RESOLVED", RunID: record.RunID, RunState: run.State}
}

package desktop

import (
	"crypto/rand"

// The source path and project root are private to Go. React receives only an
// opaque, short-lived confirmation token and integrity-checked metadata.
type runtimeBundlePreview struct {
	id, source, projectRoot, revision                string
	oldArtifact, oldCatalog, newArtifact, newCatalog string
	expires                                          time.Time
}

type RuntimeBundleUpdateResult struct {
	Status                string            `json:"status"`
	PreviewID             string            `json:"previewId,omitempty"`
	CurrentArtifactDigest string            `json:"currentArtifactDigest,omitempty"`
	CurrentCatalogDigest  string            `json:"currentCatalogDigest,omitempty"`
	NewArtifactDigest     string            `json:"newArtifactDigest,omitempty"`
	NewCatalogDigest      string            `json:"newCatalogDigest,omitempty"`
	BundleVersion         string            `json:"bundleVersion,omitempty"`
	CoreVersion           string            `json:"coreVersion,omitempty"`
	ProjectRevision       string            `json:"projectRevision,omitempty"`
	Error                 *ProjectOpenError `json:"error,omitempty"`
}

func bundleUpdateError(status, code string) RuntimeBundleUpdateResult {
	return RuntimeBundleUpdateResult{Status: status, Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: code, Message: projectErrorMessage(code)}}
}

func (a *App) ChooseRuntimeBundleUpdate() RuntimeBundleUpdateResult {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	a.bundlePreview = nil
	if a.current.Status != "OPEN" || a.current.Classification != projectlifecycle.ClassificationManaged || a.current.Project == nil || a.bundleCacheRoot == "" || a.activeSession != "" || a.startInFlight || a.startOutcomeUnknown || a.runtimeUpdateInFlight {
		return bundleUpdateError("BLOCKED", "RUNTIME_BUNDLE_UPDATE_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	if !a.knownRunsTerminalLocked() {
		return bundleUpdateError("BLOCKED", "INSTALLATION_RUN_ACTIVE")
	}
	root := a.current.Root
	revision, err := installer.ProjectRevision(root)
	if err != nil || a.current.Managed == nil || revision != a.current.Managed.ProjectRevision {
		return bundleUpdateError("BLOCKED", "PROJECT_CHANGED")
	}
	old, err := installer.ReadRuntimeLockSet(root)
	if err != nil {
		return bundleUpdateError("BLOCKED", "RUNTIME_BUNDLE_UPDATE_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	source := filepath.Join(root, "bundle")
	sourceInfo, err := os.Lstat(source)
	if os.IsNotExist(err) {
		return RuntimeBundleUpdateResult{Status: "NOT_FOUND"}
	} else if err != nil || !sourceInfo.IsDir() || sourceInfo.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
		return bundleUpdateError("BLOCKED", "RUNTIME_BUNDLE_INVALID")
	}
	verified, err := executionbundle.ValidateRoot(source)
	if err != nil {
		return bundleUpdateError("BLOCKED", "RUNTIME_BUNDLE_INVALID")
	}
	if verified.Digest == old.ArtifactDigest {
		return RuntimeBundleUpdateResult{Status: "UNCHANGED", CurrentArtifactDigest: old.ArtifactDigest, CurrentCatalogDigest: old.CatalogDigest}
	}
	var token [16]byte
	if _, err := rand.Read(token[:]); err != nil {
		return bundleUpdateError("BLOCKED", "RUNTIME_BUNDLE_UPDATE_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	id := hex.EncodeToString(token[:])
	a.bundlePreview = &runtimeBundlePreview{id: id, source: verified.Root, projectRoot: root, revision: revision, oldArtifact: old.ArtifactDigest, oldCatalog: old.CatalogDigest, newArtifact: verified.Digest, newCatalog: verified.Manifest.CatalogDigest, expires: time.Now().Add(10 * time.Minute)}
	return RuntimeBundleUpdateResult{Status: "PREVIEW", PreviewID: id, CurrentArtifactDigest: old.ArtifactDigest, CurrentCatalogDigest: old.CatalogDigest, NewArtifactDigest: verified.Digest, NewCatalogDigest: verified.Manifest.CatalogDigest, BundleVersion: verified.Manifest.BundleVersion, CoreVersion: verified.Manifest.CoreVersion, ProjectRevision: revision}
}

func (a *App) ConfirmRuntimeBundleUpdate(previewID string) RuntimeBundleUpdateResult {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	p := a.bundlePreview
	a.bundlePreview = nil // one use, including a failed attempt
	if p == nil || previewID == "" || previewID != p.id || time.Now().After(p.expires) || a.current.Status != "OPEN" || a.current.Root != p.projectRoot || a.activeSession != "" || a.startInFlight || a.startOutcomeUnknown || a.runtimeUpdateInFlight || a.bundleCacheRoot == "" {
		return bundleUpdateError("BLOCKED", "RUNTIME_BUNDLE_PREVIEW_STALE")
	}
	if !a.knownRunsTerminalLocked() {
		return bundleUpdateError("BLOCKED", "INSTALLATION_RUN_ACTIVE")
	}
	revision, err := installer.ProjectRevision(p.projectRoot)
	if err != nil || revision != p.revision {
		return bundleUpdateError("BLOCKED", "PROJECT_CHANGED")
	}
	current, err := installer.ReadRuntimeLockSet(p.projectRoot)
	if err != nil || current.ArtifactDigest != p.oldArtifact || current.CatalogDigest != p.oldCatalog {
		return bundleUpdateError("BLOCKED", "PROJECT_CHANGED")
	}
	sourceInfo, err := os.Lstat(p.source)
	if err != nil || !sourceInfo.IsDir() || sourceInfo.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
		return bundleUpdateError("BLOCKED", "RUNTIME_BUNDLE_CHANGED")
	}
	verified, err := executionbundle.ValidateRoot(p.source)
	if err != nil || verified.Digest != p.newArtifact || verified.Manifest.CatalogDigest != p.newCatalog {
		return bundleUpdateError("BLOCKED", "RUNTIME_BUNDLE_CHANGED")
	}
	a.runtimeUpdateInFlight = true
	defer func() { a.runtimeUpdateInFlight = false }()
	publish := a.bundlePublisher
	if publish == nil {
		publish = (executionbundle.Cache{Root: a.bundleCacheRoot}).Publish
	}
	published, publishErr := publish(verified.Root)
	if publishErr != nil {
		// Publish may have renamed a different valid source and pruned the
		// previous cache root before returning an error. Never retain a root
		// that no longer verifies, regardless of the digest now in the cache.
		if a.availableBundleRoot == "" {
			a.switchPublishedBundleLocked("")
		} else if _, err := executionbundle.ValidateRoot(a.availableBundleRoot); err != nil {
			a.switchPublishedBundleLocked("")
		}
		return bundleUpdateError("BLOCKED", "RUNTIME_BUNDLE_PUBLICATION_FAILED")
	}
	// The source can change during copy. Only the exact previewed, verified
	// bytes authorize the project CAS, even if another valid bundle got copied.
	a.switchPublishedBundleLocked(published.Root)
	if published.Digest != p.newArtifact || published.Manifest.CatalogDigest != p.newCatalog {
		return bundleUpdateError("PUBLISHED_NOT_BOUND", "RUNTIME_BUNDLE_CHANGED")
	}
	ctx, cancel := a.operationContext(2 * time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	_, err = installer.NewBackend(nil).UpdateRuntimeLockSet(ctx, installer.RuntimeLockSetUpdateRequest{ProjectRoot: p.projectRoot, ExpectedProjectRevision: p.revision, ExpectedOldArtifactDigest: p.oldArtifact, ExpectedOldCatalogDigest: p.oldCatalog, NewDigest: p.newArtifact, NewBundleRoot: published.Root})
	if err != nil {
		return bundleUpdateError("PUBLISHED_NOT_BOUND", projectErrorCode(err))
	}
	// Never label an uncertain post-commit refresh as rollback. The on-disk
	// locks are authoritative and OpenProject can safely be retried.
	opened, err := a.lifecycle.OpenProject(ctx, p.projectRoot)
	if err != nil || opened.Project == nil || opened.Catalog == nil || opened.Catalog.Status != "READY" || opened.Project.Source.BundleDigest != p.newArtifact || opened.Project.Source.CatalogDigest != p.newCatalog {
		return bundleUpdateError("BOUND_REFRESH_REQUIRED", "RUNTIME_BUNDLE_REOPEN_FAILED")
	}
	managed, err := installer.ReadManagedProjectViewWithCatalog(p.projectRoot, opened.Catalog)
	if err != nil {
		return bundleUpdateError("BOUND_REFRESH_REQUIRED", "RUNTIME_BUNDLE_REOPEN_FAILED")
	}
	a.secrets.Clear()
	a.current = ProjectOpenResult{Status: "OPEN", Root: opened.Root, Classification: opened.Classification, Project: opened.Project, Catalog: opened.Catalog, Managed: managed, Verification: notVerified(), Counts: opened.Counts, Diagnostics: a.managedServerTypeDiagnostics(managed)}
	a.bindExecutionLocked(opened.Root, opened.Project, managedSnapshotHosts(managed))
	return RuntimeBundleUpdateResult{Status: "UPDATED", NewArtifactDigest: p.newArtifact, NewCatalogDigest: p.newCatalog, ProjectRevision: managed.ProjectRevision}
}

func (a *App) switchPublishedBundleLocked(root string) {
	a.invalidateDynamicBindingLocked()
	a.binding = nil // explicit startup release also names the previous bundle
	a.reader = unavailableProjectReader{}
	a.availableBundleRoot = root
	if root == "" {
		a.lifecycle = projectlifecycle.NewService(nil)
	} else {
		a.lifecycle = projectlifecycle.NewService(map[string]string{projectlifecycle.DefaultCompatibilitySourceID: root})
	}
	a.current.Catalog = nil
	a.current.Managed = nil
	a.current.Snapshot = nil
	a.execution.setStatus(executionNodeNotPrepared)
	a.continuation = nil
	a.installationPlanID = ""
	a.installationGeneration++
	a.clearInstallationRunsLocked()
	a.current.Verification = notVerified()
	a.clearRuntimeSecretDescriptorEvidenceLocked()
}

func (a *App) knownRunsTerminalLocked() bool {
	if a.recoveredCancelUnconfirmed && a.recoveredRun != nil {
		return false
	}
	if a.current.Status != "OPEN" || a.current.Project == nil {
		return false
	}
	record, err := readLocalRunRecord(a.localRunRecordRoot, a.current.Root, a.current.Project.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	if record == nil {
		return len(a.installationRuns.runIDs()) == 0
	}
	if record.State == "TERMINAL" {
		return true
	}
	if record.State != "RUNNING" || record.RunID == "" {
		return false
	}
	binding, err := a.resolveTrustedExecutionConnectionLocked()
	if err != nil || !sameLocalRunNode(*record, binding.node) {
		return false
	}
	client, ok := binding.reader.transport.(executionnode.ExecutionClient)
	if !ok {
		return false
	}
	ctx, cancel := a.operationContext(30 * time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	run, err := client.GetExecution(ctx, binding.node, record.RunID)
	if err != nil || run.RunID != record.RunID || run.ProjectIdentity != record.ProjectID || !rebindTerminalRun(run.State) {
		return false
	}
	record.State, record.TerminalState = "TERMINAL", run.State
	if writeLocalRunRecord(a.localRunRecordRoot, *record) != nil {
		return false
	}
	a.installationRuns.finishMonitor(record.RunID, &run)
	a.secrets.ReleaseExecutionIdentityForRun(record.RunID)
	return true
}

func sameLocalRunNode(record localRunRecord, node executionnode.Node) bool {
	return record.NodeID == node.ID && record.NodeAddress == node.Address && record.NodePort == node.Port && record.NodeUser == node.User && record.HostKeyFingerprint == node.HostKey.Fingerprint
}

func rebindTerminalRun(state string) bool {
	switch state {
	case "SUCCEEDED", "FAILED", "CANCELLED", "INTERRUPTED", "CORRUPT_ORPHANED":
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

package desktop

import (

// Only replaces the OS picker result. The bound import method and all its
// descriptor, file-handle, decryption, session and post-read guards still run.
func configureQASecretFileSelection(app *App) error {
	encoded := os.Getenv("PLATFORM_QA_SECRET_FILE_SELECTIONS")
	if encoded == "" {
		return nil
	}
	if len(encoded) > 16*4096 || !utf8.ValidString(encoded) {
		return errors.New("QA_SECRET_FILE_SELECTION_INVALID")
	}
	var paths []string
	if json.Unmarshal([]byte(encoded), &paths) != nil || len(paths) == 0 || len(paths) > 16 {
		return errors.New("QA_SECRET_FILE_SELECTION_INVALID")
	}
	for _, path := range paths {
		if !utf8.ValidString(path) || len(path) == 0 || len(path) > 4096 || !filepath.IsAbs(path) {
			return errors.New("QA_SECRET_FILE_SELECTION_INVALID")
		}
		for _, char := range path {
			if char == 0 || char < 32 {
				return errors.New("QA_SECRET_FILE_SELECTION_INVALID")
			}
		}
	}
	var mu sync.Mutex
	app.chooseSecretFile = func(ctx context.Context, _ DialogOptions) (string, error) {
		mu.Lock()
		defer mu.Unlock()
		if ctx.Err() != nil {
			return "", ctx.Err()
		}
		if len(paths) == 0 {
			return "", errors.New("QA_SECRET_FILE_SELECTION_EXHAUSTED")
		}
		path := paths[0]
		paths[0] = ""
		paths = paths[1:]
		return path, nil
	}
	return nil
}

package desktop

import (
	"bytes"

	"errors"

type SecretOutputDeliveryInput struct {
	PackageID string `json:"packageId"`
}

type SecretOutputDeliveryOperation struct {
	Status      string                             `json:"status"`
	Package     *executionnode.SecretOutputPackage `json:"package,omitempty"`
	Directory   string                             `json:"directory,omitempty"`
	StagingPath string                             `json:"stagingPath,omitempty"`
	Error       *ProjectOpenError                  `json:"error,omitempty"`
}

type secretOutputDeliveryClient interface {
	GetSecretOutputCapabilities(context.Context, executionnode.Node, string, string) (executionnode.SecretOutputCapabilities, error)
	ListPendingSecretOutputs(context.Context, executionnode.Node, string, string, int, *string) (executionnode.SecretOutputList, error)
	FetchSecretOutput(context.Context, executionnode.Node, string, string, string, int) ([]byte, error)
}

// DeliverPendingSecretOutput fetches one freshly listed package, validates the
// confidential frame against that trusted listing, publishes encrypted files
// and a complete local receipt. Remote custody is independent of delivery.
func (a *App) DeliverPendingSecretOutput(input SecretOutputDeliveryInput) SecretOutputDeliveryOperation {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	if a.current.Status != "OPEN" || a.current.Project == nil || a.execution.context.Status != "READY" {
		a.editMu.Unlock()
		return secretOutputDeliveryFailure("SECRET_OUTPUT_PREREQUISITE_REQUIRED", "Выберите локальную папку и убедитесь, что Execution Node готов.")
	}
	binding, err := a.resolveSelectedExecutionNodeBindingLocked()
	if err != nil {
		a.editMu.Unlock()
		return secretOutputDeliveryFailure("SECRET_OUTPUT_UNAVAILABLE", "Защищённая доставка выходных файлов недоступна.")
	}
	client, ok := binding.reader.transport.(secretOutputDeliveryClient)
	if !ok {
		a.editMu.Unlock()
		return secretOutputDeliveryFailure("SECRET_OUTPUT_UNSUPPORTED", "Выбранный Execution Node не поддерживает защищённую доставку файлов.")
	}
	runtime, runtimeOK := installationRuntimeBinding(binding.reader.runtimeRelease)
	credentialBinding, bindingErr := a.credentialBindingLocked()
	if !runtimeOK || bindingErr != nil || !a.secrets.HasOutputEncryptionPassword(credentialBinding) {
		a.editMu.Unlock()
		return secretOutputDeliveryFailure("SECRET_OUTPUT_PASSWORD_REQUIRED", "Введите пароль шифрования выходных файлов.")
	}
	root, projectID, node := a.current.Root, a.current.Project.ID, binding.node
	generation, projectRoot := a.installationGeneration, a.current.Root
	ctx, cancel := a.operationContext(3 * time.Minute)
	a.editMu.Unlock()
	defer cancel()

	if _, err := client.GetSecretOutputCapabilities(ctx, node, runtime.BundleDigest, projectID); err != nil {
		return secretOutputDeliveryFailure("SECRET_OUTPUT_UNAVAILABLE", "Возможности безопасной доставки не подтверждены.")
	}
	var selected *executionnode.SecretOutputPackage
	var receipt installer.SecretOutputFileReceipt
	var cursor *string
	seenCursors := map[string]struct{}{}
	for page := 0; selected == nil && page < 128; page++ {
		listed, err := client.ListPendingSecretOutputs(ctx, node, runtime.BundleDigest, projectID, 32, cursor)
		if err != nil {
			return secretOutputDeliveryFailure("SECRET_OUTPUT_UNAVAILABLE", "Ожидающие выходные файлы получить не удалось.")
		}
		for index := range listed.Packages {
			if listed.Packages[index].PackageID == input.PackageID {
				item := listed.Packages[index]
				selected = &item
				break
			}
		}
		if selected != nil || listed.NextCursor == nil {
			break
		}
		next := *listed.NextCursor
		if next == "" || (cursor != nil && next == *cursor) {
			return secretOutputDeliveryFailure("SECRET_OUTPUT_UNAVAILABLE", "Страница списка выходных файлов некорректна.")
		}
		if _, exists := seenCursors[next]; exists {
			return secretOutputDeliveryFailure("SECRET_OUTPUT_UNAVAILABLE", "Страница списка выходных файлов повторилась.")
		}
		seenCursors[next] = struct{}{}
		cursor = &next
	}
	if selected == nil {
		return secretOutputDeliveryFailure("SECRET_OUTPUT_NOT_FOUND", "Выходной пакет больше не доступен для доставки.")
	}
	if local, encrypted, localErr := installer.ReadSecretOutputFiles(root, projectID, selected.DeploymentID, selected.PackageID, selected.SourceRunID, selected.Generation, selected.RuntimeDigest); localErr == nil {
		defer func() {
			for _, data := range encrypted {
				clear(data)
			}
		}()
		if err := a.secrets.WithOutputEncryptionPassword(credentialBinding, func(password []byte) error {
			for _, entry := range []struct {
				id, purpose string
				bound       int
			}{{"admin-token", secretfiles.PurposeAdminToken, 4096}, {"unseal-shares", secretfiles.PurposeUnsealShares, 32768}} {
				plain, err := secretfiles.Decrypt(password, encrypted[entry.id], entry.bound)
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
				parsed, err := secretfiles.ReadVaultInput(entry.purpose, plain, nil)
				clear(plain)
				clear(parsed.Token)
				for _, share := range parsed.Shares {
					clear(share)
				}
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
			return nil
		}); err != nil {
			return secretOutputDeliveryFailure("SECRET_OUTPUT_LOCAL_RECEIPT_INVALID", "Локальный пакет не подтверждён; удалённая копия сохранена.")
		}
		return SecretOutputDeliveryOperation{Status: "DELIVERED", Package: selected, Directory: local.Directory}
	}
	if receipt.ReceiptID == "" {
		frame, err := client.FetchSecretOutput(ctx, node, runtime.BundleDigest, projectID, selected.PackageID, selected.Generation)
		if err != nil {
			return secretOutputDeliveryFailure("SECRET_OUTPUT_TRANSFER_FAILED", "Передача прервана; локальные файлы не подтверждены.")
		}
		defer clear(frame)
		expected := secretoutputwire.Binding{ProjectID: selected.ProjectID, DeploymentID: selected.DeploymentID, PackageID: selected.PackageID, SourceRunID: selected.SourceRunID, RuntimeDigest: selected.RuntimeDigest, Generation: selected.Generation}
		var localStorageErr error
		transferErr := secretoutputwire.Consume(bytes.NewReader(frame), expected, func(token, shares []byte) error {
			parsedToken, tokenErr := secretfiles.ReadVaultInput(secretfiles.PurposeAdminToken, token, nil)
			if tokenErr != nil {
				return secretfiles.ErrFile
			}
			defer clear(parsedToken.Token)
			parsedShares, sharesErr := secretfiles.ReadVaultInput(secretfiles.PurposeUnsealShares, shares, nil)
			if sharesErr != nil {
				return secretfiles.ErrFile
			}
			for _, value := range parsedShares.Shares {
				defer clear(value)
			}
			credentialBinding, err := a.credentialBindingLockedForOutput(projectRoot, projectID)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			return a.secrets.WithOutputEncryptionPassword(credentialBinding, func(password []byte) error {
				if existing, encrypted, readErr := installer.ReadSecretOutputFiles(root, projectID, selected.DeploymentID, selected.PackageID, selected.SourceRunID, selected.Generation, selected.RuntimeDigest); readErr == nil {
					defer func() {
						for _, data := range encrypted {
							clear(data)
						}
					}()
					admin, adminErr := secretfiles.Decrypt(password, encrypted["admin-token"], 4096)
					sharesPlain, sharesErr := secretfiles.Decrypt(password, encrypted["unseal-shares"], 32768)
					if adminErr != nil || sharesErr != nil || !bytes.Equal(admin, token) || !bytes.Equal(sharesPlain, shares) {
						clear(admin)
						clear(sharesPlain)
						return errors.New("SECRET_OUTPUT_LOCAL_RECEIPT_INVALID")
					}
					clear(admin)
					clear(sharesPlain)
					receipt = existing
					return nil
				}
				adminAge, err := secretfiles.Encrypt(password, token)
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
				defer clear(adminAge)
				sharesAge, err := secretfiles.Encrypt(password, shares)
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
				defer clear(sharesAge)
				adminCheck, err := secretfiles.Decrypt(password, adminAge, 4096)
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
				sharesCheck, err := secretfiles.Decrypt(password, sharesAge, 32768)
				if err != nil {
					clear(adminCheck)
					return err
				}
				if !bytes.Equal(adminCheck, token) || !bytes.Equal(sharesCheck, shares) {
					clear(adminCheck)
					clear(sharesCheck)
					return errors.New("SECRET_OUTPUT_CIPHER_VERIFY_FAILED")
				}
				clear(adminCheck)
				clear(sharesCheck)
				receipt, err = installer.PublishSecretOutputFiles(root, projectID, selected.DeploymentID, selected.PackageID, selected.SourceRunID, selected.Generation, selected.RuntimeDigest, adminAge, sharesAge)
				localStorageErr = err
				return err
			})
		})
		if transferErr != nil {
			var retained *installer.SecretOutputStagingRetainedError
			if errors.As(localStorageErr, &retained) {
				return SecretOutputDeliveryOperation{Status: "STAGING_RETAINED", Package: selected, StagingPath: retained.Path, Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: "EXPORT_STAGING_RETAINED", Message: "Публикация не завершена. Зашифрованный временный каталог сохранён, потому что безопасное удаление не удалось доказать."}}
			}
			return secretOutputDeliveryFailure("SECRET_OUTPUT_TRANSFER_FAILED", "Проверка или безопасное сохранение выходных файлов не завершились; удалённый пакет сохранён.")
		}
	}
	if receipt.ReceiptID == "" || len(receipt.Digests) != 2 {
		return secretOutputDeliveryFailure("SECRET_OUTPUT_RECEIPT_INVALID", "Локальная запись о сохранении не подтверждена; удалённый пакет сохранён.")
	}
	a.editMu.Lock()
	currentBinding, currentErr := a.resolveSelectedExecutionNodeBindingLocked()
	current := currentErr == nil && a.installationGeneration == generation && a.current.Root == projectRoot && a.current.Project != nil && a.current.Project.ID == projectID && currentBinding.node.ID == node.ID
	a.editMu.Unlock()
	if !current {
		return secretOutputDeliveryFailure("PROJECT_CHANGED", "Проект или Execution Node изменился; удалённый пакет не подтверждён.")
	}
	return SecretOutputDeliveryOperation{Status: "DELIVERED", Package: selected, Directory: receipt.Directory}
}

func (a *App) credentialBindingLockedForOutput(root, projectID string) (runtimesecret.Binding, error) {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	if a.current.Status != "OPEN" || a.current.Root != root || a.current.Project == nil || a.current.Project.ID != projectID {
		return runtimesecret.Binding{}, errors.New("PROJECT_CHANGED")
	}
	return runtimesecret.Binding{Root: root, ID: projectID}, nil
}

func secretOutputDeliveryFailure(code, message string) SecretOutputDeliveryOperation {
	return SecretOutputDeliveryOperation{Status: "UNAVAILABLE", Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: code, Message: message}}
}

package desktop

import (
	"crypto/rand"
	"encoding/hex"

type serverInformationProbe struct {
	id, root, projectID, revision, hostID, address, keyType, publicKey, fingerprint string
	port                                                                            uint16
	identity                                                                        runtimesecret.ExecutionIdentity
	expires                                                                         time.Time
	execution                                                                       bool
}

type ServerInformationResult struct {
	Status      string                           `json:"status"`
	HostID      string                           `json:"hostId,omitempty"`
	Information *executionnode.ServerInformation `json:"information,omitempty"`
	Error       *ProjectOpenError                `json:"error,omitempty"`
}

func informationFailure(hostID string) ServerInformationResult {
	return ServerInformationResult{Status: "UNAVAILABLE", HostID: hostID, Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: "SERVER_INFORMATION_UNAVAILABLE", Message: "Не удалось проверить сервер. Проверьте доступность узла, учётные данные SSH-сеанса и подтверждённый SSH-ключ."}}
}

func informationStageFailure(hostID, code string) ServerInformationResult {
	result := informationFailure(hostID)
	result.Error.Code = code
	return result
}

func (a *App) ProbeServerInformation(hostID string) HostKeyProbeResult {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	a.pendingServerInformation = nil
	address, port, revision, err := a.savedTargetServerLocked(hostID)
	if err != nil {
		a.editMu.Unlock()
		return hostKeyProbeFailure(projectErrorCode(err))
	}
	credentialBinding, err := a.credentialBindingLocked()
	if err != nil {
		a.editMu.Unlock()
		return hostKeyProbeFailure("SESSION_CREDENTIAL_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	identity, err := a.secrets.CurrentExecutionIdentity(credentialBinding)
	if err != nil {
		a.editMu.Unlock()
		return hostKeyProbeFailure("SESSION_CREDENTIAL_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	p := &serverInformationProbe{root: a.current.Root, projectID: a.current.Project.ID, revision: revision, hostID: hostID, address: address, port: port, identity: identity, execution: a.execution.context.SelectedHostID == hostID, expires: time.Now().Add(2 * time.Minute)}
	// Reserve this request before network I/O. React StrictMode or another
	// dialog may start a newer probe while the first keyscan is still running.
	a.pendingServerInformation = p
	a.editMu.Unlock()
	var result HostKeyProbeResult
	var keyType, publicKey, fingerprint string
	if p.execution {
		result = a.ProbeExecutionNodeHostKey()
		if result.Status != "APPROVAL_REQUIRED" {
			return result
		}
	} else {
		ctx, cancel := a.operationContext(9 * time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		keyType, publicKey, fingerprint, err = probeExecutionHostKey(ctx, address, port)
		if err != nil {
			return hostKeyProbeFailure("TARGET_HOST_KEY_PROBE_FAILED")
		}
		var token [16]byte
		if _, err = rand.Read(token[:]); err != nil {
			return hostKeyProbeFailure("TARGET_HOST_KEY_PROBE_FAILED")
		}
		result = HostKeyProbeResult{Status: "APPROVAL_REQUIRED", ProbeID: hex.EncodeToString(token[:]), SafeLabel: hostID + " · " + address, KeyType: keyType, Fingerprint: fingerprint}
	}
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	if a.pendingServerInformation != p || !a.serverInformationProbeCurrentLocked(p) {
		return hostKeyProbeFailure("TARGET_HOST_KEY_APPROVAL_STALE")
	}
	p.id = result.ProbeID
	p.keyType, p.publicKey, p.fingerprint = keyType, publicKey, fingerprint
	if p.execution {
		pending := a.pendingHostKey
		if pending == nil || pending.id != p.id || pending.hostID != p.hostID || pending.address != p.address || pending.port != p.port {
			return hostKeyProbeFailure("TARGET_HOST_KEY_APPROVAL_STALE")
		}
		p.keyType, p.publicKey, p.fingerprint = pending.keyType, pending.publicKey, pending.fingerprint
	}
	a.pendingServerInformation = p
	return result
}

func (a *App) serverInformationProbeCurrentLocked(p *serverInformationProbe) bool {
	if a.current.Project == nil || a.current.Root != p.root || a.current.Project.ID != p.projectID {
		return false
	}
	address, port, revision, err := a.savedTargetServerLocked(p.hostID)
	if err != nil || address != p.address || port != p.port || revision != p.revision {
		return false
	}
	identity, err := a.secrets.CurrentExecutionIdentity(runtimesecret.Binding{Root: p.root, ID: p.projectID})
	return err == nil && sameTransportIdentity(identity, p.identity)
}

// CheckServerInformation confirms one pinned key for information and installation.
// Installation still requires its independently reviewed and approved Core plan.
func (a *App) CheckServerInformation(probeID string) ServerInformationResult {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	p := a.pendingServerInformation
	a.pendingServerInformation = nil
	if p == nil || p.id != probeID || !time.Now().Before(p.expires) || !a.serverInformationProbeCurrentLocked(p) {
		a.editMu.Unlock()
		return informationStageFailure("", "SERVER_INFORMATION_APPROVAL_STALE")
	}
	a.editMu.Unlock()
	var transport executionnode.OpenSSHTransport
	var node executionnode.Node
	if p.execution {
		if a.ApproveExecutionNodeHostKey(probeID).Status != "APPROVED" {
			return informationStageFailure(p.hostID, "SERVER_INFORMATION_EXEC_APPROVAL_FAILED")
		}
		a.editMu.Lock()
		binding, err := a.resolveTrustedExecutionConnectionLocked()
		if err != nil {
			a.editMu.Unlock()
			return informationStageFailure(p.hostID, "SERVER_INFORMATION_EXEC_BINDING_FAILED")
		}
		var ok bool
		transport, ok = binding.reader.transport.(executionnode.OpenSSHTransport)
		node = binding.node
		a.editMu.Unlock()
		if !ok {
			return informationFailure(p.hostID)
		}
	} else {
		known, file, directory, directoryInfo, digest, err := createSessionKnownHosts(p.address, p.port, p.keyType, p.publicKey)
		if err != nil {
			return informationStageFailure(p.hostID, "SERVER_INFORMATION_PIN_FAILED")
		}
		defer removeSessionKnownHosts(known, file, directory, directoryInfo)
		if verifyIsolatedHostKeyConfiguration(known, p.address) != nil {
			return informationStageFailure(p.hostID, "SERVER_INFORMATION_SSH_CONFIGURATION_FAILED")
		}
		transport = a.executionTransport(p.identity, runtimesecret.Binding{Root: p.root, ID: p.projectID}, known, file, digest)
		node = executionnode.Node{ID: p.hostID, Address: p.address, Port: p.port, User: p.identity.Username, CredentialRef: "runtime:ssh", HostKey: executionnode.HostKeyPolicy{State: "TRUSTED", KnownHosts: known, Fingerprint: p.fingerprint}}
	}
	ctx, cancel := a.operationContext(20 * time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	info, err := transport.ReadServerInformation(ctx, node)
	if err != nil {
		return informationStageFailure(p.hostID, err.Error())
	}
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	if !a.serverInformationProbeCurrentLocked(p) {
		return informationStageFailure(p.hostID, "SERVER_INFORMATION_BINDING_CHANGED")
	}
	if a.approvedTargetHostKeys == nil {
		a.approvedTargetHostKeys = make(map[string]approvedTargetHostKey)
	}
	a.approvedTargetHostKeys[p.hostID] = approvedTargetHostKey{root: p.root, projectID: p.projectID, revision: p.revision, hostID: p.hostID, address: p.address, port: p.port, keyType: p.keyType, publicKey: p.publicKey, fingerprint: p.fingerprint}
	return ServerInformationResult{Status: "CHECKED", HostID: p.hostID, Information: &info}
}

package desktop

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/rand"
	"encoding/hex"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"sort"
	"time"

	"platform-installer/internal/executionnode"
)

// These approvals exist only in this application session. A saved project
// revision, server endpoint, or project-open lifecycle change makes them stale.
type pendingTargetHostKey struct {
	id, root, projectID, revision, hostID, address string
	port                                           uint16
	keyType, publicKey, fingerprint                string
	expires                                        time.Time
}

type approvedTargetHostKey struct {
	root, projectID, revision, hostID, address string
	port                                       uint16
	keyType, publicKey, fingerprint            string
}

func (a *App) savedTargetServerLocked(hostID string) (string, uint16, string, error) {
	if a.current.Status != "OPEN" || a.current.Project == nil || a.current.Managed == nil || a.activeSession != "" {
		return "", 0, "", errors.New("TARGET_HOST_TRUST_PROJECT_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	server, ok := a.current.Managed.Servers[hostID]
	if !ok || server.HostID != hostID || !validExecutionAddress(server.Address) {
		return "", 0, "", errors.New("TARGET_HOST_TRUST_SERVER_INVALID")
	}
	port := 22
	if server.SSHPort != nil {
		port = *server.SSHPort
	}
	if port < 1 || port > 65535 {
		return "", 0, "", errors.New("TARGET_HOST_TRUST_SERVER_INVALID")
	}
	revision, err := a.projectRevision(a.current.Root)
	if err != nil || revision == "" || revision != a.current.Managed.ProjectRevision {
		return "", 0, "", errors.New("TARGET_HOST_TRUST_PROJECT_STALE")
	}
	return server.Address, uint16(port), revision, nil
}

func (a *App) ProbeTargetHostKey(hostID string) HostKeyProbeResult {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	a.pendingTargetHostKey = nil
	delete(a.approvedTargetHostKeys, hostID)
	address, port, revision, err := a.savedTargetServerLocked(hostID)
	if err != nil {
		return hostKeyProbeFailure(projectErrorCode(err))
	}
	binding, err := a.resolveSelectedExecutionNodeBindingLocked()
	if err != nil || a.execution.context.Status != "READY" {
		return hostKeyProbeFailure("EXECUTION_NODE_READY_REQUIRED")
	}
	prober, ok := binding.reader.transport.(interface {
		ProbeTargetHostKey(context.Context, executionnode.Node, string, uint16) ([]byte, error)
	})
	if !ok {
		return hostKeyProbeFailure("TARGET_HOST_KEY_PROBE_FAILED")
	}
	ctx, cancel := a.operationContext(9 * time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	output, err := prober.ProbeTargetHostKey(ctx, binding.node, address, port)
	if err != nil {
		return hostKeyProbeFailure("TARGET_HOST_KEY_PROBE_FAILED")
	}
	keyType, publicKey, fingerprint, err := parseScannedHostKey(output, address, port)
	if err != nil {
		return hostKeyProbeFailure("TARGET_HOST_KEY_PROBE_FAILED")
	}
	nonce := make([]byte, 16)
	if _, err := rand.Read(nonce); err != nil {
		return hostKeyProbeFailure("TARGET_HOST_KEY_PROBE_FAILED")
	}
	probeID := hex.EncodeToString(nonce)
	a.pendingTargetHostKey = &pendingTargetHostKey{
		id: probeID, root: a.current.Root, projectID: a.current.Project.ID,
		revision: revision, hostID: hostID, address: address, port: port,
		keyType: keyType, publicKey: publicKey, fingerprint: fingerprint,
		expires: time.Now().Add(2 * time.Minute),
	}
	return HostKeyProbeResult{Status: "APPROVAL_REQUIRED", ProbeID: probeID,
		SafeLabel: fmt.Sprintf("%s · %s:%d", hostID, address, port),
		KeyType:   keyType, Fingerprint: fingerprint}
}

func (a *App) DeclineTargetHostKey() HostKeyProbeResult {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	a.pendingTargetHostKey = nil
	return HostKeyProbeResult{Status: "DECLINED"}
}

func (a *App) ApproveTargetHostKey(probeID string) HostKeyProbeResult {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	pending := a.pendingTargetHostKey
	a.pendingTargetHostKey = nil
	if pending == nil || pending.id != probeID || !time.Now().Before(pending.expires) || a.current.Root != pending.root || a.current.Project == nil || a.current.Project.ID != pending.projectID {
		return hostKeyProbeFailure("TARGET_HOST_KEY_APPROVAL_STALE")
	}
	address, port, revision, err := a.savedTargetServerLocked(pending.hostID)
	if err != nil || address != pending.address || port != pending.port || revision != pending.revision {
		return hostKeyProbeFailure("TARGET_HOST_KEY_APPROVAL_STALE")
	}
	a.approvedTargetHostKeys[pending.hostID] = approvedTargetHostKey{
		root: pending.root, projectID: pending.projectID, revision: pending.revision,
		hostID: pending.hostID, address: address, port: port,
		keyType: pending.keyType, publicKey: pending.publicKey, fingerprint: pending.fingerprint,
	}
	return HostKeyProbeResult{Status: "APPROVED", SafeLabel: fmt.Sprintf("%s · %s:%d", pending.hostID, address, port),
		KeyType: pending.keyType, Fingerprint: pending.fingerprint}
}

func (a *App) configureTargetHostTrust() {
	if a.binding == nil || a.binding.plans == nil {
		return
	}
	stager, ok := a.binding.reader.transport.(executionnode.TargetHostTrustStager)
	if !ok {
		return
	}
	a.binding.plans.ConfigureTargetHostTrust(a.approvedTargetKeysForPlan, stager)
}

func (a *App) approvedTargetKeysForPlan(plan executionnode.DeploymentPlan) ([]executionnode.TargetHostKeyApproval, error) {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	targets := map[string]bool{}
	for _, phase := range plan.Phases {
		for _, action := range phase.Actions {
			for _, hostID := range action.Targets {
				targets[hostID] = true
			}
		}
	}
	ids := make([]string, 0, len(targets))
	for hostID := range targets {
		ids = append(ids, hostID)
	}
	sort.Strings(ids)
	return a.approvedTargetKeysForHostsLocked(plan.ProjectIdentity, plan.ProjectRevision, ids)
}

func (a *App) approvedTargetKeysForHostsLocked(projectID, revision string, ids []string) ([]executionnode.TargetHostKeyApproval, error) {
	if a.current.Status != "OPEN" || a.current.Project == nil || a.current.Managed == nil || a.activeSession != "" || a.current.Project.ID != projectID {
		return nil, errors.New("TARGET_HOST_TRUST_REQUIRED")
	}
	currentRevision, err := a.projectRevision(a.current.Root)
	if err != nil || currentRevision != revision || a.current.Managed.ProjectRevision != revision {
		return nil, errors.New("TARGET_HOST_TRUST_STALE")
	}
	if len(ids) == 0 || len(ids) > 256 {
		return nil, errors.New("TARGET_HOST_TRUST_INVALID")
	}
	result := make([]executionnode.TargetHostKeyApproval, 0, len(ids))
	for _, hostID := range ids {
		pin, ok := a.approvedTargetHostKeys[hostID]
		if !ok || pin.root != a.current.Root || pin.projectID != projectID || pin.revision != revision {
			return nil, errors.New("TARGET_HOST_TRUST_REQUIRED")
		}
		address, port, _, err := a.savedTargetServerLocked(hostID)
		if err != nil || address != pin.address || port != pin.port {
			return nil, errors.New("TARGET_HOST_TRUST_STALE")
		}
		result = append(result, executionnode.TargetHostKeyApproval{HostID: hostID, Address: address, Port: int(port), KeyType: pin.keyType, PublicKey: pin.publicKey})
	}
	return result, nil
}

var verifiedPKIIdentityID = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z][a-z0-9._-]*$`)

// VerifiedPKIView is an in-memory, read-only presentation projection of
// revision-bound Core PKI evidence. It is never desired state or Save input.
type VerifiedPKIView struct {
	Status            string                        `json:"status"`
	Identities        []VerifiedCertificateIdentity `json:"identities,omitempty"`
	Findings          []VerificationFinding         `json:"findings,omitempty"`
	FindingsTruncated bool                          `json:"findingsTruncated,omitempty"`

type VerifiedCertificateIdentity struct {
	ID           string                `json:"id"`
	Scope        string                `json:"scope"`
	TLSProfileID string                `json:"tlsProfileId"`
	DNSNames     []string              `json:"dnsNames"`
	IPAddresses  []string              `json:"ipAddresses"`
	Consumers    []VerifiedPKIConsumer `json:"consumers"`
}

type VerifiedPKIConsumer struct {
	DeploymentID string `json:"deploymentId"`
	MemberID     string `json:"memberId"`
	HostID       string `json:"hostId"`
}

// GetVerifiedPKIView exposes only current, attested Core PKI identity/SAN
// evidence. It deliberately cannot initiate verification or contact a node.
func (a *App) GetVerifiedPKIView() VerifiedPKIView {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	a.reconcileEditSessionLocked()
	return a.verifiedPKIViewLocked()
}

func (a *App) verifiedPKIViewLocked() VerifiedPKIView {
	verification := a.current.Verification
	if a.current.Status != "OPEN" || a.current.Project == nil {
		return verifiedPKIUnavailable("PROJECT_NOT_OPEN")
	}
	if a.activeSession != "" {
		return VerifiedPKIView{Status: "STALE"}
	}
	if verification.Status == "INVALID" {
		return VerifiedPKIView{Status: "INVALID", Findings: append([]VerificationFinding(nil), verification.Findings...), FindingsTruncated: verification.FindingsTruncated}
	}
	if verification.Status == "STALE" {
		return VerifiedPKIView{Status: "STALE"}
	}
	if verification.Status != "VERIFIED" {
		if verification.Status == "UNVERIFIED" || verification.Status == "" {
			return VerifiedPKIView{Status: "NOT_VERIFIED"}
		}
		return VerifiedPKIView{Status: "UNAVAILABLE", Error: verification.Error}
	}
	if a.current.Managed == nil || a.current.Snapshot == nil ||
		verification.ProjectIdentity != a.current.Project.ID ||
		verification.ProjectRevision == "" ||
		verification.ProjectRevision != a.current.Managed.ProjectRevision ||
		verification.ProjectRevision != a.current.Snapshot.ProjectRevision ||
		verification.ExecutionNodeID == "" || verification.Runtime == nil {
		return VerifiedPKIView{Status: "STALE"}
	}
	if a.binding == nil || a.binding.node.ID == "" ||
		a.execution.context.SelectionKind != "EXPLICIT_EXTERNAL" ||
		a.execution.external == nil || a.execution.external.hostID != a.binding.node.ID ||
		verification.ExecutionNodeID != a.binding.node.ID ||
		!runtimeEvidenceMatchesExpected(*verification.Runtime, a.binding.reader.runtimeRelease) {
		return VerifiedPKIView{Status: "STALE"}
	}
	if a.current.Snapshot.Status != "PASS" || a.current.Snapshot.Partial {
		return verifiedPKIUnavailable("VERIFIED_PKI_SNAPSHOT_INVALID")
	}
	view, err := buildVerifiedPKIView(a.current.Snapshot)
	if err != nil {
		return verifiedPKIUnavailable("VERIFIED_PKI_VIEW_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	return view
}

func verifiedPKIUnavailable(code string) VerifiedPKIView {
	return VerifiedPKIView{Status: "UNAVAILABLE", Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: code, Message: "Не удалось безопасно подготовить read-only представление PKI."}}
}

func buildVerifiedPKIView(snapshot *coreadapter.Snapshot) (VerifiedPKIView, error) {
	if snapshot == nil || len(snapshot.PKI) == 0 {
		return VerifiedPKIView{}, errVerifiedPKIView
	}
	status, ok := snapshot.PKI["status"].(string)
	identities, okIdentities := snapshot.PKI["certificateIdentities"].([]any)
	if !ok || status != "PASS" || !okIdentities || len(identities) > maxVerifiedPKIIdentities {
		return VerifiedPKIView{}, errVerifiedPKIView
	}
	view := VerifiedPKIView{Status: "CURRENT", Identities: make([]VerifiedCertificateIdentity, 0, len(identities))}
	for _, raw := range identities {
		identity, err := verifiedPKIIdentity(raw)
		if err != nil {
			return VerifiedPKIView{}, errVerifiedPKIView
		}
		view.Identities = append(view.Identities, identity)
	}
	sort.Slice(view.Identities, func(i, j int) bool { return view.Identities[i].ID < view.Identities[j].ID })
	return view, nil
}

func verifiedPKIIdentity(raw any) (VerifiedCertificateIdentity, error) {
	value, ok := object(raw)
	if !ok {
		return VerifiedCertificateIdentity{}, errVerifiedPKIView
	}
	id, validID := requiredString(value, "id", maxEndpointPreviewIdentifierLength)
	tlsProfileID, validProfile := requiredString(value, "tlsProfileId", maxEndpointPreviewIdentifierLength)
	scope, validScope := value["scope"].(string)
	dnsNames, dnsOK := verifiedPKIDNSNames(value["dnsNames"])
	ipAddresses, ipOK := verifiedPKIIPAddresses(value["ipAddresses"])
	consumers, consumersOK := verifiedPKIConsumers(value["consumers"])
	if !validID || !verifiedPKIIdentityID.MatchString(id) || !validProfile || !validPreviewIdentifier(tlsProfileID) || !validScope ||
		(scope != "HOST" && scope != "MEMBER" && scope != "DEPLOYMENT") || !dnsOK || !ipOK || !consumersOK {
		return VerifiedCertificateIdentity{}, errVerifiedPKIView
	}
	return VerifiedCertificateIdentity{ID: id, Scope: scope, TLSProfileID: tlsProfileID, DNSNames: dnsNames, IPAddresses: ipAddresses, Consumers: consumers}, nil
}

func verifiedPKIDNSNames(raw any) ([]string, bool) {
	values, ok := array(raw)
	if !ok || len(values) > maxVerifiedPKISANs {
		return nil, false
	}
	result := make([]string, 0, len(values))
	for _, raw := range values {
		value, ok := raw.(string)
		if !ok || len(value) == 0 || len(value) > maxVerifiedPKIValue || !verifiedPKISafeName.MatchString(value) {
			return nil, false
		}
		result = append(result, value)
	}
	return result, true
}

func verifiedPKIIPAddresses(raw any) ([]string, bool) {
	values, ok := array(raw)
	if !ok || len(values) > maxVerifiedPKISANs {
		return nil, false
	}
	result := make([]string, 0, len(values))
	for _, raw := range values {
		value, ok := raw.(string)
		if !ok || len(value) == 0 || len(value) > maxVerifiedPKIValue || net.ParseIP(value) == nil {
			return nil, false
		}
		result = append(result, value)
	}
	return result, true
}

func verifiedPKIConsumers(raw any) ([]VerifiedPKIConsumer, bool) {
	values, ok := array(raw)
	if !ok || len(values) > maxVerifiedPKIConsumers {
		return nil, false
	}
	result := make([]VerifiedPKIConsumer, 0, len(values))
	for _, raw := range values {
		value, ok := object(raw)
		deploymentID, deploymentOK := requiredString(value, "deploymentId", maxEndpointPreviewIdentifierLength)
		memberID, memberOK := requiredString(value, "memberId", maxEndpointPreviewIdentifierLength)
		hostID, hostOK := requiredString(value, "hostId", maxEndpointPreviewIdentifierLength)
		if !ok || !deploymentOK || !memberOK || !hostOK || !validPreviewIdentifier(deploymentID) || !validPreviewIdentifier(memberID) || !validPreviewIdentifier(hostID) {
			return nil, false
		}
		result = append(result, VerifiedPKIConsumer{DeploymentID: deploymentID, MemberID: memberID, HostID: hostID})
	}
	sort.Slice(result, func(i, j int) bool {
		return strings.Join([]string{result[i].DeploymentID, result[i].MemberID, result[i].HostID}, "\x00") < strings.Join([]string{result[j].DeploymentID, result[j].MemberID, result[j].HostID}, "\x00")
	})
	return result, true
}

var errVerifiedPKIView = errors.New("verified PKI view invalid")

package executionbundle

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
)

// Cache is operational state. It must never point at project desired state.
type Cache struct{ Root string }

func (c Cache) Publish(bundleRoot string) (Verified, error) {
	verified, err := ValidateRoot(bundleRoot)
	if err != nil {
		return Verified{}, err
	}
	root, err := cacheRoot(c.Root)
	if err != nil {
		return Verified{}, err
	}
	if err := os.MkdirAll(root, 0o700); err != nil {
		return Verified{}, fmt.Errorf("create bundle cache: %w", err)
	}
	destination := filepath.Join(root, strings.TrimPrefix(verified.Digest, "sha256:"))
	if existing, statErr := ValidateRoot(destination); statErr == nil {
		if existing.Digest == verified.Digest {
			if err := retainOnly(root, filepath.Base(destination)); err != nil {
				return Verified{}, err
			}
			return existing, nil
		}
		return Verified{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_CACHE_CONFLICT")
	}
	if _, statErr := os.Lstat(destination); statErr == nil {
		return Verified{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_CACHE_CONFLICT")
	}
	staging, err := os.MkdirTemp(root, ".staging-")
	if err != nil {
		return Verified{}, fmt.Errorf("create bundle staging: %w", err)
	}
	defer os.RemoveAll(staging)
	if err := copyVerifiedTree(verified.Root, staging); err != nil {
		return Verified{}, err
	}
	published, err := ValidateRoot(staging)
	if err != nil || published.Digest != verified.Digest {
		return Verified{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_PUBLICATION_VERIFY_FAILED")
	}
	if err := os.Rename(staging, destination); err != nil {
		return Verified{}, fmt.Errorf("publish bundle: %w", err)
	}
	if err := retainOnly(root, filepath.Base(destination)); err != nil {
		return Verified{}, err
	}
	return ValidateRoot(destination)
}

// retainOnly keeps the cache as one verified current bundle. The caller has
// already verified and atomically published keep; previous digest directories
// are operational duplicates, not rollback state.
func retainOnly(root, keep string) error {
	entries, err := os.ReadDir(root)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("read bundle cache: %w", err)
	}
	for _, entry := range entries {
		if entry.Name() == keep || !entry.IsDir() {
			continue
		}
		if entry.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
			return errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_CACHE_CONFLICT")
		}
		if !digestDirectory(entry.Name()) && !strings.HasPrefix(entry.Name(), ".staging-") {
			continue
		}
		target := filepath.Join(root, entry.Name())
		if !contained(root, target) {
			return errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_COMPONENT_PATH_INVALID")
		}
		if err := os.RemoveAll(target); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("prune bundle cache: %w", err)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func digestDirectory(name string) bool {
	if len(name) != 64 {
		return false
	}
	for _, character := range name {
		if !(character >= '0' && character <= '9' || character >= 'a' && character <= 'f') {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func (c Cache) Resolve(override string, platform Platform) (Verified, error) {
	if override != "" {
		verified, err := ValidateRoot(override)
		if err != nil {
			return Verified{}, err
		}
		if supports(verified.Manifest, platform) {
			return verified, nil
		}
		return Verified{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_INCOMPATIBLE")
	}
	root, err := cacheRoot(c.Root)
	if err != nil {
		return Verified{}, err
	}
	entries, err := os.ReadDir(root)
	if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
		return Verified{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_BUNDLE_MISSING")
	}
	if err != nil {
		return Verified{}, fmt.Errorf("read bundle cache: %w", err)
	}
	for _, entry := range entries {
		if !entry.IsDir() || strings.HasPrefix(entry.Name(), ".") {
			continue
		}
		verified, validationErr := ValidateRoot(filepath.Join(root, entry.Name()))
		if validationErr == nil && supports(verified.Manifest, platform) {
			return verified, nil
		}
	}
	return Verified{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_BUNDLE_MISSING")
}

func cacheRoot(root string) (string, error) {
	if root == "" {
		return "", errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_CACHE_INVALID")
	}
	absolute, err := filepath.Abs(root)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return absolute, nil
}

func supports(manifest Manifest, expected Platform) bool {
	for _, actual := range manifest.Platforms {
		if actual.OS == expected.OS && actual.Version == expected.Version && actual.Architecture == expected.Architecture {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func copyVerifiedTree(source, destination string) error {
	return filepath.WalkDir(source, func(path string, entry os.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
		if walkErr != nil {
			return walkErr
		}
		relative, err := filepath.Rel(source, path)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if relative == "." {
			return nil
		}
		target := filepath.Join(destination, relative)
		if !contained(destination, target) {
			return errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_COMPONENT_PATH_INVALID")
		}
		if entry.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
			return errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_COMPONENT_UNSAFE")
		}
		if entry.IsDir() {
			return os.MkdirAll(target, 0o700)
		}
		if !entry.Type().IsRegular() {
			return errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_COMPONENT_UNSAFE")
		}
		input, err := os.Open(path)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		defer input.Close()
		output, err := os.OpenFile(target, os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY, 0o600)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		_, copyErr := output.ReadFrom(input)
		closeErr := output.Close()
		if copyErr != nil {
			return copyErr
		}
		return closeErr
	})
}

package executionbundle

import (

const maxCatalogComponentBytes int64 = 8 * 1024 * 1024

// ReadVerifiedComponent returns bytes read from the same opened regular-file
// object whose size and digest are checked against a freshly verified manifest
// entry. It is intentionally limited to immutable execution-bundle components.
func ReadVerifiedComponent(verified Verified, componentPath string, limit int64) ([]byte, error) {
	if limit <= 0 || !safeRelative(componentPath) || verified.Root == "" || verified.rootIdentity == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_COMPONENT_INVALID")
	}
	var component *Component
	for index := range verified.Manifest.Components {
		candidate := &verified.Manifest.Components[index]
		if candidate.Path != componentPath {
			continue
		}
		if component != nil {
			return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_COMPONENT_INVALID")
		}
		component = candidate
	}
	if component == nil || component.Size > limit {
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_COMPONENT_INVALID")
	}
	content, err := readVerifiedComponent(verified, *component, limit)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if int64(len(content)) != component.Size || !strings.EqualFold(bytesDigest(content), component.SHA256) {
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_COMPONENT_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH")
	}
	return content, nil
}

// ReadVerifiedCatalog is the only catalog-component read surface used by the
// Installer. Keeping the fixed path and limit here prevents callers from
// turning ReadVerifiedComponent into a repository browser.
func ReadVerifiedCatalog(verified Verified) ([]byte, error) {
	return ReadVerifiedComponent(verified, "catalog/service-catalog.yml", maxCatalogComponentBytes)
}

// DeclaresManifestIdentity performs only the narrow, handle-bound manifest
// inspection needed to classify an incompatible exact bundle source. It never
// follows a link/reparse point and does not expose manifest content to callers.
func DeclaresManifestIdentity(root, artifactDigest, catalogDigest string) bool {
	data, err := readBundleManifest(root)
	if err != nil || !strings.EqualFold(bytesDigest(data), artifactDigest) {
		return false
	}
	var manifest struct {
		CatalogDigest string `yaml:"catalogDigest"`
	}
	return yaml.Unmarshal(data, &manifest) == nil && manifest.CatalogDigest == catalogDigest
}

package executionbundle

import (
	"errors"

	"os"

func verifiedRootIdentity(root string) (string, error) {
	var stat unix.Stat_t
	if err := unix.Stat(root, &stat); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if stat.Mode&unix.S_IFMT != unix.S_IFDIR {
		return "", errors.New("not a directory")
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("%d:%d", stat.Dev, stat.Ino), nil
}

func readVerifiedComponent(verified Verified, component Component, limit int64) ([]byte, error) {
	rootFD, err := unix.Open(verified.Root, unix.O_RDONLY|unix.O_DIRECTORY|unix.O_NOFOLLOW|unix.O_CLOEXEC, 0)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_COMPONENT_UNSAFE")
	}
	defer unix.Close(rootFD)
	if !sameUnixIdentity(rootFD, verified.rootIdentity, true) {
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_COMPONENT_UNSAFE")
	}
	parts := strings.Split(component.Path, "/")
	directoryFD := rootFD
	for _, part := range parts[:len(parts)-1] {
		child, openErr := unix.Openat(directoryFD, part, unix.O_RDONLY|unix.O_DIRECTORY|unix.O_NOFOLLOW|unix.O_CLOEXEC, 0)
		if openErr != nil {
			if directoryFD != rootFD {
				_ = unix.Close(directoryFD)
			}
			return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_COMPONENT_UNSAFE")
		}
		if directoryFD != rootFD {
			_ = unix.Close(directoryFD)
		}
		directoryFD = child
		if !sameUnixIdentity(directoryFD, "", true) {
			_ = unix.Close(directoryFD)
			return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_COMPONENT_UNSAFE")
		}
	}
	if directoryFD != rootFD {
		defer unix.Close(directoryFD)
	}
	fileFD, err := unix.Openat(directoryFD, parts[len(parts)-1], unix.O_RDONLY|unix.O_NOFOLLOW|unix.O_CLOEXEC, 0)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_COMPONENT_UNSAFE")
	}
	file := os.NewFile(uintptr(fileFD), component.Path)
	if file == nil {
		_ = unix.Close(fileFD)
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_COMPONENT_UNSAFE")
	}
	defer file.Close()
	var stat unix.Stat_t
	if err := unix.Fstat(fileFD, &stat); err != nil || stat.Mode&unix.S_IFMT != unix.S_IFREG || stat.Size != component.Size || stat.Size > limit {
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_COMPONENT_UNSAFE")
	}
	content, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, component.Size+1))
	if err != nil || int64(len(content)) != component.Size {
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_COMPONENT_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH")
	}
	return content, nil
}

func readBundleManifest(root string) ([]byte, error) {
	rootFD, err := unix.Open(root, unix.O_RDONLY|unix.O_DIRECTORY|unix.O_NOFOLLOW|unix.O_CLOEXEC, 0)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_COMPONENT_UNSAFE")
	}
	defer unix.Close(rootFD)
	fileFD, err := unix.Openat(rootFD, "manifest.yaml", unix.O_RDONLY|unix.O_NOFOLLOW|unix.O_CLOEXEC, 0)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_COMPONENT_UNSAFE")
	}
	file := os.NewFile(uintptr(fileFD), "manifest.yaml")
	if file == nil {
		_ = unix.Close(fileFD)
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_COMPONENT_UNSAFE")
	}
	defer file.Close()
	var stat unix.Stat_t
	if err := unix.Fstat(fileFD, &stat); err != nil || stat.Mode&unix.S_IFMT != unix.S_IFREG || stat.Size > 1024*1024 {
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_COMPONENT_UNSAFE")
	}
	data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, 1024*1024+1))
	if err != nil || int64(len(data)) != stat.Size {
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_COMPONENT_UNSAFE")
	}
	return data, nil
}

func sameUnixIdentity(fd int, expected string, directory bool) bool {
	var stat unix.Stat_t
	if err := unix.Fstat(fd, &stat); err != nil {
		return false
	}
	if directory && stat.Mode&unix.S_IFMT != unix.S_IFDIR {
		return false
	}
	identity := fmt.Sprintf("%d:%d", stat.Dev, stat.Ino)
	return expected == "" || identity == expected
}

	info, err := file.Stat()
	if err != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Size() > 1024*1024 {
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_COMPONENT_UNSAFE")
	}
	data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, 1024*1024+1))
	if err != nil || int64(len(data)) != info.Size() {
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_COMPONENT_UNSAFE")
	}
	return data, nil
}

func openWindowsRoot(path string) (windows.Handle, error) {
	pointer, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(path)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	return windows.CreateFile(pointer, windows.FILE_GENERIC_READ, windows.FILE_SHARE_READ|windows.FILE_SHARE_WRITE|windows.FILE_SHARE_DELETE, nil, windows.OPEN_EXISTING, windows.FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS|windows.FILE_FLAG_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT, 0)
}

func openWindowsRelative(root windows.Handle, name string, directory bool) (windows.Handle, error) {
	objectName, err := windows.NewNTUnicodeString(name)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	attributes := uint32(windows.FILE_SYNCHRONOUS_IO_NONALERT | windows.FILE_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT)
	if directory {
		attributes |= windows.FILE_DIRECTORY_FILE
	} else {
		attributes |= windows.FILE_NON_DIRECTORY_FILE
	}
	object := windows.OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES{Length: uint32(unsafe.Sizeof(windows.OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES{})), RootDirectory: root, ObjectName: objectName, Attributes: windows.OBJ_CASE_INSENSITIVE | windows.OBJ_DONT_REPARSE}
	var handle windows.Handle
	var status windows.IO_STATUS_BLOCK
	if err := windows.NtCreateFile(&handle, windows.FILE_GENERIC_READ, &object, &status, nil, 0, windows.FILE_SHARE_READ|windows.FILE_SHARE_WRITE|windows.FILE_SHARE_DELETE, windows.FILE_OPEN, attributes, 0, 0); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	if _, err := windowsIdentity(handle, directory); err != nil {
		_ = windows.CloseHandle(handle)
		return 0, err
	}
	return handle, nil
}

func windowsIdentity(handle windows.Handle, directory bool) (string, error) {
	var info windows.ByHandleFileInformation
	if err := windows.GetFileInformationByHandle(handle, &info); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if info.FileAttributes&windows.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT != 0 || (info.FileAttributes&windows.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY != 0) != directory {
		return "", errors.New("unsafe file object")
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("%d:%d:%d", info.VolumeSerialNumber, info.FileIndexHigh, info.FileIndexLow), nil
}

package executionbundle

import (
