type IdentityResolver interface {
	IdentityFile(credentialRef string) (string, error)
}

type commandRunner interface {
	Run(context.Context, string, []string, []byte) ([]byte, error)
}

type boundedCommandRunner interface {
	RunBounded(context.Context, string, []string, []byte, int) ([]byte, error)
}

type separatedCommandRunner interface {
	RunSeparatedBounded(context.Context, string, []string, []byte, int, int) ([]byte, []byte, error)
}

type osRunner struct{ password sshpassword.Provider }

func (r osRunner) execute(ctx context.Context, command *exec.Cmd) error {
	if r.password != nil {
		return sshpassword.Run(ctx, command, r.password)
	}
	return command.Run()
}

func (r osRunner) Run(ctx context.Context, name string, args []string, input []byte) ([]byte, error) {
	command := exec.CommandContext(ctx, name, args...)
	commandwindow.Configure(command)
	command.Stdin = bytes.NewReader(input)
	var output bytes.Buffer
	command.Stdout, command.Stderr = &output, &output
	err := r.execute(ctx, command)
	return output.Bytes(), err
}

func (r osRunner) RunBounded(ctx context.Context, name string, args []string, input []byte, limit int) ([]byte, error) {
	command := exec.CommandContext(ctx, name, args...)
	commandwindow.Configure(command)
	command.Stdin = bytes.NewReader(input)
	output := &boundedOutput{limit: limit}
	command.Stdout = output
	command.Stderr = output
	err := r.execute(ctx, command)
	if output.overflow {
		return output.Bytes(), errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_OUTPUT_LIMIT")
	}
	return output.Bytes(), err
}

func (r osRunner) RunSeparatedBounded(ctx context.Context, name string, args []string, input []byte, stdoutLimit, stderrLimit int) ([]byte, []byte, error) {
	command := exec.CommandContext(ctx, name, args...)
	commandwindow.Configure(command)
	command.Stdin = bytes.NewReader(input)
	stdout := &boundedOutput{limit: stdoutLimit}
	stderr := &boundedOutput{limit: stderrLimit}
	command.Stdout, command.Stderr = stdout, stderr
	err := r.execute(ctx, command)
	if stdout.overflow || stderr.overflow {
		return stdout.Bytes(), nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_OUTPUT_LIMIT")
	}
	return stdout.Bytes(), stderr.Bytes(), err
}

type boundedOutput struct {
	bytes.Buffer
	limit    int
	overflow bool
}

func (b *boundedOutput) Write(value []byte) (int, error) {
	original := len(value)
	remaining := b.limit - b.Len()
	if remaining > 0 {
		if remaining < len(value) {
			_, _ = b.Buffer.Write(value[:remaining])
		} else {
			_, _ = b.Buffer.Write(value)
		}
	}
	if original > remaining {
		b.overflow = true
	}
	return original, nil
}

// OpenSSHTransport is the one product transport for the pre-Core boundary.
// It never accepts a caller-defined remote command or destination.
type OpenSSHTransport struct {
	Identity IdentityResolver
	Runner   commandRunner
	// CommandGuard holds the UI-approved identity and host-key files stable
	// across each SSH/SCP child process. Nil preserves the legacy flag path.
	CommandGuard         func() (func(), error)
	ContextCommandGuard  func(context.Context) (func(), error)
	Password             sshpassword.Provider
	SudoPassword         sshpassword.Provider
	IsolatedHostKeyTrust bool
	RepositoryRoot       string
	RuntimeRoot          string
	StageRoot            string
}

func (t OpenSSHTransport) InspectExecutionNode(ctx context.Context, node Node) (Inspection, error) {
	root := t.runtimeRoot()
	script := "set -eu\nroot=$1\ncase \"$root\" in /var/lib/platform-installer/runtime) ;; *) exit 64;; esac\n. /etc/os-release\nruntime=''; bundle=''; digest=''; core=''; protocol=''; ansible='no'; capabilities='no'\nif sudo -n test -r \"$root/state/active\" && sudo -n test -L \"$root/current\"; then\n  runtime='yes'\n  bundle=$(sudo -n awk -F= '$1 == \"BUNDLE_VERSION\" {print $2}' \"$root/state/active\")\n  digest=$(sudo -n awk -F= '$1 == \"BUNDLE_DIGEST\" {print $2}' \"$root/state/active\")\n  core=$(sudo -n awk -F= '$1 == \"CORE_VERSION\" {print $2}' \"$root/state/active\")\n  protocol=$(sudo -n awk -F= '$1 == \"PROTOCOL\" {print $2}' \"$root/state/active\")\n  ansible=$(sudo -n awk -F= '$1 == \"ANSIBLE\" {print $2}' \"$root/state/active\")\n  capabilities=$(sudo -n awk -F= '$1 == \"CAPABILITIES\" {print $2}' \"$root/state/active\")\nfi\nprintf '%s\\n' \"OS=$ID\" \"VERSION=$VERSION_ID\" \"ARCH=$(uname -m)\" \"ELEVATION=$(sudo -n true >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo yes || echo no)\" \"FREE=$(df -Pk /var/tmp | awk 'NR==2 {print $4 * 1024}')\" \"RUNTIME=$runtime\" \"BUNDLE_VERSION=$bundle\" \"BUNDLE_DIGEST=$digest\" \"CORE_VERSION=$core\" \"PROTOCOL=$protocol\" \"ANSIBLE=$ansible\" \"CAPABILITIES=$capabilities\"\n"
	output, err := t.ssh(ctx, node, "sh", []string{"-s", "--", root}, []byte(script))
	if err != nil {
		return Inspection{State: Unreachable}, err
	}
	values := parseFacts(string(output))
	runtime := Runtime{BundleVersion: values["BUNDLE_VERSION"], BundleDigest: values["BUNDLE_DIGEST"], CoreVersion: values["CORE_VERSION"], Protocol: values["PROTOCOL"], Ansible: values["ANSIBLE"] == "yes", Capabilities: values["CAPABILITIES"] == "yes"}
	state := PreparationRequired
	if values["RUNTIME"] == "yes" {
		state = Ready
	}
	return Inspection{State: state, OS: values["OS"], OSVersion: values["VERSION"], Architecture: values["ARCH"], Elevation: values["ELEVATION"] == "yes", FreeBytes: parseInt64(values["FREE"]), Runtime: runtime}, nil
}

// ReconcileWorkspaceOwnership keeps the fixed candidate staging path writable
// by the SSH identity used for this preparation. The shared workspace parent
// remains root-owned and traversable; private, payload and /var/lib runtime
// trees are outside the ownership change.
func (t OpenSSHTransport) ReconcileWorkspaceOwnership(ctx context.Context, node Node) (bool, error) {
	output, err := t.ssh(ctx, node, "sh", []string{"-s"}, []byte(reconcileWorkspaceOwnershipScript))
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	switch parseFacts(string(output))["CHANGED"] {
	case "yes":
		return true, nil
	case "no":
		return false, nil
	default:
		return false, errors.New("EXECUTION_WORKSPACE_RECONCILIATION_INVALID")
	}
}

const reconcileWorkspaceOwnershipScript = `set -eu
base=/var/tmp/platform-installer
workspace=$base/execution-plan
[ -d /var/tmp ] && [ ! -L /var/tmp ] || exit 64
[ "$(stat -c %u /var/tmp)" = 0 ] && [ "$(stat -c %a /var/tmp)" = 1777 ] || exit 64
uid=$(id -u)
gid=$(id -g)
changed=no
if sudo -n test -L "$base"; then exit 64; fi
if ! sudo -n test -e "$base"; then
  sudo -n install -d -o root -g root -m 0711 -- "$base"
  changed=yes
fi
sudo -n test -d "$base" && sudo -n test ! -L "$base" || exit 64
base_owner=$(sudo -n stat -c %u -- "$base")
base_mode=$(sudo -n stat -c %a -- "$base")
if [ "$base_owner" != 0 ] || [ "$base_mode" != 711 ]; then
  sudo -n chown root:root -- "$base"
  sudo -n chmod 0711 -- "$base"
  changed=yes
fi
if sudo -n test -L "$workspace"; then exit 64; fi
if ! sudo -n test -e "$workspace"; then
  sudo -n install -d -o "$uid" -g "$gid" -m 0700 -- "$workspace"
  changed=yes
fi
sudo -n test -d "$workspace" && sudo -n test ! -L "$workspace" || exit 64
unsafe=$(sudo -n find "$workspace" -xdev \( -type l -o \( ! -type d -a ! -type f \) \) -print -quit)
[ -z "$unsafe" ] || exit 65
owner=$(sudo -n stat -c %u -- "$workspace")
if [ "$owner" != "$uid" ]; then
  entries=$(sudo -n find "$workspace" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print -quit)
  [ -z "$entries" ] || exit 65
  sudo -n chown -- "$uid:$gid" -- "$workspace"
  changed=yes
fi
workspace_mode=$(sudo -n stat -c %a -- "$workspace")
if [ "$workspace_mode" != 700 ]; then
  sudo -n chmod 0700 -- "$workspace"
  changed=yes
fi
[ "$(sudo -n stat -c %u -- "$workspace")" = "$uid" ] || exit 66
printf 'CHANGED=%s\n' "$changed"
`

func (t OpenSSHTransport) InspectAcquisitionSource(ctx context.Context, node Node) (AcquisitionEnvironment, error) {
	inspection, err := t.InspectExecutionNode(ctx, node)
	if err != nil {
		return AcquisitionEnvironment{}, err
	}
	if inspection.OS != "redos" {
		return AcquisitionEnvironment{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_ACQUISITION_OS_UNSUPPORTED")
	}
	return AcquisitionEnvironment{OS: inspection.OS, Version: inspection.OSVersion, Architecture: inspection.Architecture, RepositorySource: "configured-dnf", Trusted: true}, nil
}

func (t OpenSSHTransport) AcquireRuntimeClosure(ctx context.Context, node Node, environment AcquisitionEnvironment, destination string) error {
	if environment.OS != "redos" || environment.Architecture != "x86_64" || environment.RepositorySource != "configured-dnf" || destination == "" {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_ACQUISITION_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	absolute, err := filepath.Abs(destination)
	if err != nil {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_ACQUISITION_DESTINATION_INVALID")
	}
	target := filepath.Join(absolute, "packages", environment.OS, environment.Version, environment.Architecture)
	if !containedLocal(absolute, target) {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_ACQUISITION_DESTINATION_INVALID")
	}
	if err := os.MkdirAll(target, 0o700); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	remote, err := createRemoteAcquisitionWorkspace(ctx, t, node)
	if err != nil {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_RUNTIME_CLOSURE_FAILED")
	}
	defer cleanupRemoteAcquisitionWorkspace(t, node, remote)
	script := "set -eu\nroot=$1\n" + `case "$root" in /var/tmp/platform-installer-acquisition-??????????) ;; *) exit 64;; esac` + "\ntest -d \"$root\" && test ! -L \"$root\"\nsudo -n dnf -q download --resolve --alldeps --destdir \"$root\" -- python3 ansible-core openssl ca-certificates tar gzip\nrpm=$(find \"$root\" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.rpm' -print -quit)\ntest -n \"$rpm\"\ncd \"$root\"\nsudo -n tar -cf closure.tar -- *.rpm\nsudo -n chmod 0644 closure.tar\n"
	if _, err := t.ssh(ctx, node, "sh", []string{"-s", "--", remote}, []byte(script)); err != nil {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_RUNTIME_CLOSURE_FAILED")
	}
	identity, err := t.identityFile(node.CredentialRef)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	archive, err := os.CreateTemp(absolute, ".runtime-closure-*.tar")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	archivePath := archive.Name()
	if err := archive.Close(); err != nil {
		_ = os.Remove(archivePath)
		return err
	}
	defer os.Remove(archivePath)
	args := append(t.scpBase(node, identity), "-O", "--", t.destination(node, remote+"/closure.tar"), archivePath)
	if _, err := t.run(ctx, "scp", args, nil); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("EXECUTION_RUNTIME_TRANSFER_FAILED: %w", err)
	}
	if err := extractTar(archivePath, target); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("EXECUTION_RUNTIME_TRANSFER_FAILED: %w", err)
	}
	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(absolute, "python"), 0o700); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(absolute, "python", "runtime-source.txt"), []byte("python3 from configured dnf closure\n"), 0o600)
}

func (t OpenSSHTransport) StageVerifiedBundle(ctx context.Context, node Node, bundle executionbundle.Verified) (string, error) {
	var nonce [16]byte
	if _, err := rand.Read(nonce[:]); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	stage := t.stageRoot() + "-" + hex.EncodeToString(nonce[:])
	if !validBundleStage(stage) {
		return "", errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_STAGE_INVALID")
	}
	if _, err := t.ssh(ctx, node, "sh", []string{"-s", "--", stage}, []byte(prepareBundleStageScript)); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	complete := false
	defer func() {
		if !complete {
			cleanupCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), 30*time.Second)
			defer cancel()
			_ = t.DiscardStagedRuntime(cleanupCtx, node, stage)
		}
	}()
	identity, err := t.identityFile(node.CredentialRef)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	probe, err := t.ssh(ctx, node, "sh", []string{"-s"}, []byte("if command -v tar >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'TAR=1\\n'; else printf 'TAR=0\\n'; fi\n"))
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(string(probe)) == "TAR=0" {
		if err := t.transferBundle(ctx, node, identity, stage, bundle.Root); err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		if _, err := t.ssh(ctx, node, "sh", []string{"-s", "--", stage}, []byte(remoteChecks(bundle))); err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		complete = true
		return stage, nil
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(string(probe)) != "TAR=1" {
		return "", errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_TRANSFER_PREREQUISITE_INVALID")
	}
	archivePath, err := createBundleArchive(bundle)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	defer os.Remove(archivePath)
	archiveRemote := path.Join(stage, "bundle.tar")
	args := append(t.scpBase(node, identity), "-O", "--", archivePath, t.destination(node, archiveRemote))
	if _, err := t.run(ctx, "scp", args, nil); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if _, err := t.ssh(ctx, node, "sh", []string{"-s", "--", stage, archiveRemote}, []byte("set -eu\nstage=$1; archive=$2\ncase \"$stage\" in /var/tmp/platform-installer-bootstrap-*) ;; *) exit 64;; esac\n[ \"$archive\" = \"$stage/bundle.tar\" ] || exit 64\ntar -xf \"$archive\" -C \"$stage\"\nrm -f -- \"$archive\"\nmkdir -p -- \"$stage/runtime/packages\" \"$stage/runtime/python\"\n")); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	script := remoteChecks(bundle)
	if _, err := t.ssh(ctx, node, "sh", []string{"-s", "--", stage}, []byte(script)); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	complete = true
	return stage, nil
}

// Root-owned sticky /var/tmp protects the private stage from other SSH users.
// Exclusive unprivileged mkdir claims only this attempt, without chown or repair.
const prepareBundleStageScript = `set -eu
stage=$1
case "$stage" in /var/tmp/platform-installer-bootstrap-*) ;; *) exit 64;; esac
suffix=${stage#/var/tmp/platform-installer-bootstrap-}
case "$suffix" in ''|*[!0-9a-f]*) exit 64;; esac
[ "${#suffix}" = 32 ] || exit 64
[ -d /var/tmp ] && [ ! -L /var/tmp ] || exit 64
[ "$(stat -c %u /var/tmp)" = 0 ] && [ "$(stat -c %a /var/tmp)" = 1777 ] || exit 64
umask 077
mkdir -m 0700 -- "$stage"
`

func createBundleArchive(bundle executionbundle.Verified) (string, error) {
	file, err := os.CreateTemp("", "platform-execution-bundle-*.tar")
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	name := file.Name()
	cleanup := func(e error) (string, error) {
		_ = file.Close()
		_ = os.Remove(name)
		return "", e
	}
	writer := tar.NewWriter(file)
	paths := append([]string{"manifest.yaml"}, make([]string, 0, len(bundle.Manifest.Components))...)
	for _, component := range bundle.Manifest.Components {
		paths = append(paths, component.Path)
	}
	for _, relative := range paths {
		absolute := filepath.Join(bundle.Root, filepath.FromSlash(relative))
		info, err := os.Stat(absolute)
		if err != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
			return cleanup(errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_COMPONENT_INVALID"))
		}
		header, err := tar.FileInfoHeader(info, "")
		if err != nil {
			return cleanup(err)
		}
		header.Name = relative
		if err := writer.WriteHeader(header); err != nil {
			return cleanup(err)
		}
		input, err := os.Open(absolute)
		if err != nil {
			return cleanup(err)
		}
		_, copyErr := io.Copy(writer, input)
		closeErr := input.Close()
		if copyErr != nil {
			return cleanup(copyErr)
		}
		if closeErr != nil {
			return cleanup(closeErr)
		}
	}
	if err := writer.Close(); err != nil {
		return cleanup(err)
	}
	if err := file.Close(); err != nil {
		_ = os.Remove(name)
		return "", err
	}
	return name, nil
}

func (t OpenSSHTransport) transferBundle(ctx context.Context, node Node, identity, stage, root string) error {
	for _, name := range []string{"ansible-core", "catalog", "contracts", "runtime", "services"} {
		source := filepath.Join(root, name)
		if info, err := os.Stat(source); err != nil || !info.IsDir() {
			return errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_LAYOUT_INVALID")
		}
		args := append(t.scpBase(node, identity), "-O", "-r", "--", source, t.destination(node, stage))
		if _, err := t.run(ctx, "scp", args, nil); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_TRANSFER_FAILED:%s:%w", name, err)
		}
	}
	manifest := filepath.Join(root, "manifest.yaml")
	args := append(t.scpBase(node, identity), "-O", "--", manifest, t.destination(node, path.Join(stage, "manifest.yaml")))
	_, err := t.run(ctx, "scp", args, nil)
	return err
}

func (t OpenSSHTransport) ActivateStagedRuntime(ctx context.Context, node Node, stage string, bundle executionbundle.Verified) (Runtime, error) {
	if !validBundleStage(stage) {
		return Runtime{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_STAGE_INVALID")
	}
	bootstrapScript, activationScript := runtimePreparationScripts(bundle)
	platforms := make([]string, 0, len(bundle.Manifest.Platforms))
	for _, platform := range bundle.Manifest.Platforms {
		platforms = append(platforms, platform.OS+":"+platform.Version+":"+platform.Architecture)
	}
	bootstrap := "0"
	for _, component := range bundle.Manifest.Components {
		if component.Path == runtimeBootstrapComponent {
			bootstrap = "1"
		}
	}
	args := []string{"-n", "sh", "-s", "--", stage, t.runtimeRoot(), bundle.Digest, bundle.Manifest.BundleVersion, bundle.Manifest.CoreVersion, bundle.Manifest.BootstrapProtocol, strings.Join(platforms, " "), bootstrap}
	complete := false
	defer func() {
		if !complete {
			cleanupCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), 30*time.Second)
			defer cancel()
			_, _ = t.ssh(cleanupCtx, node, "sudo", []string{"-n", "sh", "-s", "--", stage}, []byte(runtimeCandidateCleanupScript))
		}
	}()
	if _, err := t.ssh(ctx, node, "sudo", args, []byte(bootstrapScript)); err != nil {
		return Runtime{}, err
	}
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return Runtime{}, err
	}
	if _, err := t.ssh(ctx, node, "sudo", args, []byte(activationScript)); err != nil {
		return Runtime{}, err
	}
	complete = true
	return Runtime{BundleVersion: bundle.Manifest.BundleVersion, BundleDigest: bundle.Digest, CoreVersion: bundle.Manifest.CoreVersion, Protocol: bundle.Manifest.BootstrapProtocol, Ansible: true, Capabilities: true}, nil
}
func (t OpenSSHTransport) DiscardStagedRuntime(ctx context.Context, node Node, stage string) error {
	if !validBundleStage(stage) {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_STAGE_INVALID")
	}
	_, err := t.ssh(ctx, node, "sh", []string{"-s", "--", stage}, []byte("case \"$1\" in /var/tmp/platform-installer-bootstrap-*) rm -rf -- \"$1\";; *) exit 64;; esac\n"))
	return err
}

func validBundleStage(stage string) bool {
	const prefix = "/var/tmp/platform-installer-bootstrap-"
	if !strings.HasPrefix(stage, prefix) || len(stage) != len(prefix)+32 {
		return false
	}
	suffix := strings.TrimPrefix(stage, prefix)
	if strings.ToLower(suffix) != suffix {
		return false
	}
	_, err := hex.DecodeString(suffix)
	return err == nil
}

// ExecuteService is the production service entrypoint. The source projection
// is ephemeral extra-vars; the project remains the operator-authored input and
// Ansible only gates and executes the already selected source.
func (t OpenSSHTransport) ExecuteService(ctx context.Context, request ServiceExecutionRequest, projections map[string]map[string]artifactsource.Result) (bool, error) {
	playbook, serviceCollections, ok := servicePlaybook(request.Service, request.Operation)
	if !ok || request.ProjectRoot == "" || len(projections) == 0 || !validRemoteSecretFiles(request.PKISecretFiles) {
		return false, errors.New("SERVICE_EXECUTION_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	archive, err := createProjectArchive(request.ProjectRoot)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	defer os.Remove(archive)
	identity, err := t.Identity.IdentityFile(request.Target.CredentialRef)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	if request.Target.User == "" || request.Target.HostKey.State != "TRUSTED" || request.Target.HostKey.KnownHosts == "" {
		return false, errors.New("SERVICE_EXECUTION_CONNECTION_POLICY_INVALID")
	}
	knownHosts, err := os.ReadFile(request.Target.HostKey.KnownHosts)
	if err != nil {
		return false, errors.New("SERVICE_EXECUTION_KNOWN_HOSTS_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	remote := serviceWorkspace(request.Target.ID, request.Service)
	vars, err := os.CreateTemp("", "platform-service-vars-*.json")
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	varsPath := vars.Name()
	defer os.Remove(varsPath)
	data, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
		"platform_resolved_artifact_sources_by_target": projections,
		"platform_resolved_artifact_sources":           "{{ platform_resolved_artifact_sources_by_target[inventory_hostname] | default({}) }}",
		"platform_service_catalog_path":                "/var/lib/platform-installer/runtime/current/catalog/service-catalog.yml",
		"platform_project_manifest_path":               remote + "/project.yml",
		"platform_validation_artifact":                 remote + "/validation-result.json",
		"platform_pki_secret_files":                    request.PKISecretFiles,
		"ansible_user":                                 request.Target.User,
		"ansible_private_key_file":                     remote + "/identity",
		"ansible_ssh_common_args":                      "-o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile=" + remote + "/known_hosts",
	})
	if err != nil {
		_ = vars.Close()
		return false, err
	}
	if _, err := vars.Write(data); err != nil {
		_ = vars.Close()
		return false, err
	}
	if err := vars.Close(); err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	cleanup := func() {
		_, _ = t.ssh(context.Background(), request.Target, "sh", []string{"-s", "--", remote}, []byte("case \"$1\" in /var/tmp/platform-installer/service/*) rm -rf -- \"$1\";; *) exit 64;; esac\n"))
	}
	defer cleanup()
	if _, err := t.ssh(ctx, request.Target, "sh", []string{"-s", "--", remote}, []byte("set -eu\ncase \"$1\" in /var/tmp/platform-installer/service/*) ;; *) exit 64;; esac\nrm -rf -- \"$1\"\nmkdir -p -- \"$1\"\n")); err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	knownHostsFile, err := os.CreateTemp("", "platform-known-hosts-*")
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	knownHostsPath := knownHostsFile.Name()
	defer os.Remove(knownHostsPath)
	if err := knownHostsFile.Chmod(0o600); err != nil {
		_ = knownHostsFile.Close()
		return false, err
	}
	if _, err := knownHostsFile.Write(knownHosts); err != nil {
		_ = knownHostsFile.Close()
		return false, err
	}
	if err := knownHostsFile.Close(); err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	for _, pair := range [][2]string{{archive, remote + "/project.tar"}, {varsPath, remote + "/runtime-vars.json"}, {knownHostsPath, remote + "/known_hosts"}, {identity, remote + "/identity"}} {
		args := append(t.scpBase(request.Target, identity), "-O", "--", pair[0], t.destination(request.Target, pair[1]))
		if _, err := t.run(ctx, "scp", args, nil); err != nil {
			return false, err
		}
	}
	script := "set -eu\nroot=/var/lib/platform-installer/runtime/current\nwork=$1\nplaybook=$2\nservice_collections=$3\ncase \"$work\" in /var/tmp/platform-installer/service/*) ;; *) exit 64;; esac\ncase \"$playbook:$service_collections\" in services/kafka/playbooks/apply.yml:services/kafka/ansible_collections|services/kafka/playbooks/verify.yml:services/kafka/ansible_collections|services/keepalived/playbooks/apply.yml:services/keepalived/ansible_collections|services/keepalived/playbooks/verify.yml:services/keepalived/ansible_collections) ;; *) exit 64;; esac\nsudo -n tar -xf \"$work/project.tar\" -C \"$work\"\nsudo -n rm -f -- \"$work/project.tar\"\nsudo -n test -f \"$work/inventory/hosts.yml\"\nsudo -n test -f \"$root/$playbook\"\nsudo -n env ANSIBLE_CONFIG=\"$root/ansible-core/ansible.cfg\" ANSIBLE_COLLECTIONS_PATH=\"$root/ansible-core/collections:$root/$service_collections\" ansible-playbook -i \"$work/inventory/hosts.yml\" \"$root/$playbook\" -e @\"$work/runtime-vars.json\"\nsudo -n rm -f -- \"$work/runtime-vars.json\"\n"
	if _, err := t.ssh(ctx, request.Target, "sh", []string{"-s", "--", remote, playbook, serviceCollections}, []byte(script)); err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	return true, nil
}

func serviceWorkspace(targetID, service string) string {
	hash := sha256.Sum256([]byte(targetID + "\x00" + service))
	return "/var/tmp/platform-installer/service/run-" + hex.EncodeToString(hash[:8])
}

func servicePlaybook(service, operation string) (string, string, bool) {
	if operation == "" {
		operation = "apply"
	}
	switch service + ":" + operation {
	case "kafka:apply":
		return "services/kafka/playbooks/apply.yml", "services/kafka/ansible_collections", true
	case "kafka:verify":
		return "services/kafka/playbooks/verify.yml", "services/kafka/ansible_collections", true
	case "keepalived:apply":
		return "services/keepalived/playbooks/apply.yml", "services/keepalived/ansible_collections", true
	case "keepalived:verify":
		return "services/keepalived/playbooks/verify.yml", "services/keepalived/ansible_collections", true
	default:
		return "", "", false
	}
}

func createProjectArchive(root string) (string, error) {
	absolute, err := filepath.Abs(root)
	if err != nil {
		return "", errors.New("SERVICE_PROJECT_INVALID")
	}
	info, err := os.Lstat(absolute)
	if err != nil || !info.IsDir() || isUnsafeFilesystemLink(info) {
		return "", errors.New("SERVICE_PROJECT_INVALID")
	}
	for _, required := range []string{"inventory"} {
		entry, statErr := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(absolute, required))
		if statErr != nil || !entry.IsDir() || isUnsafeFilesystemLink(entry) {
			return "", errors.New("SERVICE_PROJECT_INVALID")
		}
	}
	file, err := os.CreateTemp("", "platform-service-project-*.tar")
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	name := file.Name()
	writer := tar.NewWriter(file)
	cleanup := func(e error) (string, error) {
		_ = writer.Close()
		_ = file.Close()
		_ = os.Remove(name)
		return "", e
	}
	if err := writeProjectArchive(writer, absolute); err != nil {
		return cleanup(err)
	}
	if err := writer.Close(); err != nil {
		_ = file.Close()
		_ = os.Remove(name)
		return "", err
	}
	if err := file.Close(); err != nil {
		_ = os.Remove(name)
		return "", err
	}
	return name, nil
}

const managedCandidateAnsibleConfig = "# Managed by Platform Installer.\n" +
	"# This is standard Ansible configuration; formatting may be normalized.\n" +
	"[defaults]\n" +
	"inventory = ./inventory/hosts.yml\n" +
	"retry_files_enabled = False\n" +
	"host_key_checking = True\n" +
	"interpreter_python = auto_silent\n" +
	"hash_behaviour = merge\n"

// createCandidateProjectArchive is intentionally narrower than the service
// archive. Only documents frozen by UI-01A cross the Execution Node boundary.
func createCandidateProjectArchive(root string) (string, error) {
	absolute, err := filepath.Abs(root)
	if err != nil {
		return "", errors.New("PROJECT_CANDIDATE_INVALID")
	}
	rootInfo, err := os.Lstat(absolute)
	if err != nil || !rootInfo.IsDir() || isUnsafeFilesystemLink(rootInfo) {
		return "", errors.New("PROJECT_CANDIDATE_INVALID")
	}
	paths := []string{"project.yml", "ansible.cfg", "inventory/hosts.yml"}
	for _, directory := range []string{"inventory/group_vars", "inventory/host_vars", "application-packages", "library-packages"} {
		candidateRoot := filepath.Join(absolute, filepath.FromSlash(directory))
		entry, statErr := os.Lstat(candidateRoot)
		if errors.Is(statErr, os.ErrNotExist) {
			continue
		}
		if statErr != nil || !entry.IsDir() || isUnsafeFilesystemLink(entry) {
			return "", errors.New("PROJECT_CANDIDATE_FILE_UNSAFE")
		}
		if walkErr := filepath.WalkDir(candidateRoot, func(current string, entry os.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
			if walkErr != nil {
				return walkErr
			}
			info, infoErr := entry.Info()
			if infoErr != nil {
				return infoErr
			}
			if isUnsafeFilesystemLink(info) {
				return errors.New("PROJECT_CANDIDATE_FILE_UNSAFE")
			}
			if entry.IsDir() {
				return nil
			}
			if !entry.Type().IsRegular() {
				return errors.New("PROJECT_CANDIDATE_FILE_UNSAFE")
			}
			relative, relErr := filepath.Rel(absolute, current)
			if relErr != nil || !containedLocal(absolute, current) {
				return errors.New("PROJECT_CANDIDATE_PATH_INVALID")
			}
			logical := filepath.ToSlash(relative)
			if candidateArchiveLogicalPathAllowed(logical) {
				paths = append(paths, logical)
			}
			return nil
		}); walkErr != nil {
			return "", walkErr
		}
	}
	slices.Sort(paths)

	file, err := os.CreateTemp("", "platform-candidate-project-*.tar")
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	name := file.Name()
	writer := tar.NewWriter(file)
	cleanup := func(cause error) (string, error) {
		_ = writer.Close()
		_ = file.Close()
		_ = os.Remove(name)
		return "", cause
	}
	limits := projectArchiveLimits{}
	seen := make(map[string]bool, len(paths))
	identities := make([]os.FileInfo, 0, len(paths))
	for _, logical := range paths {
		if !candidateArchiveLogicalPathAllowed(logical) || !utf8.ValidString(logical) || len([]byte(logical)) > 512 {
			return cleanup(errors.New("PROJECT_CANDIDATE_PATH_INVALID"))
		}
		folded := strings.ToLower(logical)
		if seen[folded] {
			return cleanup(errors.New("PROJECT_CANDIDATE_PATH_COLLISION"))
		}
		seen[folded] = true
		content, readErr := readStableCandidateFile(absolute, logical)
		if readErr != nil {
			return cleanup(readErr)
		}
		identity, identityErr := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(absolute, filepath.FromSlash(logical)))
		if identityErr != nil {
			return cleanup(errors.New("PROJECT_CANDIDATE_FILE_REPLACED"))
		}
		for _, previous := range identities {
			if os.SameFile(previous, identity) {
				return cleanup(errors.New("PROJECT_CANDIDATE_HARDLINK_UNSAFE"))
			}
		}
		identities = append(identities, identity)
		if logical == "ansible.cfg" && string(content) != managedCandidateAnsibleConfig {
			return cleanup(errors.New("PROJECT_CANDIDATE_ANSIBLE_CONFIG_INVALID"))
		}
		limits.files++
		limits.bytes += int64(len(content))
		if limits.files > 4096 || limits.bytes > 64*1024*1024 {
			return cleanup(errors.New("PROJECT_CANDIDATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED"))
		}
		header := &tar.Header{Name: logical, Mode: 0o600, Size: int64(len(content)), Typeflag: tar.TypeReg, Format: tar.FormatPAX}
		if err := writer.WriteHeader(header); err != nil {
			return cleanup(err)
		}
		if _, err := writer.Write(content); err != nil {
			return cleanup(err)
		}
	}
	if err := writer.Close(); err != nil {
		_ = file.Close()
		_ = os.Remove(name)
		return "", err
	}
	if err := file.Close(); err != nil {
		_ = os.Remove(name)
		return "", err
	}
	if info, statErr := os.Stat(name); statErr != nil || info.Size() > 32*1024*1024 {
		_ = os.Remove(name)
		return "", errors.New("PROJECT_CANDIDATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED")
	}
	return name, nil
}

func candidateArchiveLogicalPathAllowed(logical string) bool {
	if installer.ApplicationPackagePathAllowed(logical) {
		return true
	}
	if logical == "project.yml" || logical == "ansible.cfg" || logical == "inventory/hosts.yml" {
		return true
	}
	if strings.Contains(logical, "\\") || strings.Contains(logical, ":") || path.Clean(logical) != logical || strings.HasPrefix(logical, "/") {
		return false
	}
	extension := strings.ToLower(path.Ext(logical))
	if extension != ".yml" && extension != ".yaml" && extension != ".json" {
		return false
	}
	return strings.HasPrefix(logical, "inventory/group_vars/") || strings.HasPrefix(logical, "inventory/host_vars/")
}

func readStableCandidateFile(root, logical string) ([]byte, error) {
	absolute := filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(logical))
	if !containedLocal(root, absolute) {
		return nil, errors.New("PROJECT_CANDIDATE_PATH_INVALID")
	}
	before, err := os.Lstat(absolute)
	if err != nil || !before.Mode().IsRegular() || isUnsafeFilesystemLink(before) {
		return nil, errors.New("PROJECT_CANDIDATE_FILE_UNSAFE")
	}
	fileLimit := int64(4 * 1024 * 1024)
	if installer.ApplicationPackagePathAllowed(logical) {
		fileLimit = 64 * 1024 * 1024
	}
	if before.Size() > fileLimit {
		return nil, errors.New("PROJECT_CANDIDATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED")
	}
	input, err := os.Open(absolute)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, errors.New("PROJECT_CANDIDATE_FILE_UNSAFE")
	}
	defer input.Close()
	opened, err := input.Stat()
	if err != nil || !opened.Mode().IsRegular() || !os.SameFile(before, opened) {
		return nil, errors.New("PROJECT_CANDIDATE_FILE_REPLACED")
	}
	system := reflect.ValueOf(opened.Sys())
	if system.IsValid() && system.Kind() == reflect.Ptr && !system.IsNil() {
		links := system.Elem().FieldByName("Nlink")
		if links.IsValid() && links.CanUint() && links.Uint() > 1 {
			return nil, errors.New("PROJECT_CANDIDATE_FILE_UNSAFE")
		}
	}
	if runtime.GOOS == "windows" {
		output, linkErr := exec.Command("fsutil", "hardlink", "list", absolute).CombinedOutput()
		if linkErr != nil {
			// Error 50 means the filesystem itself does not support hardlinks.
			// Other failures cannot prove that the candidate file is single-link.
			if !bytes.Contains(output, []byte("Error 50:")) {
				return nil, errors.New("PROJECT_CANDIDATE_FILE_UNSAFE")
			}
		} else {
			lines := strings.Split(strings.TrimSpace(strings.ReplaceAll(string(output), "\r\n", "\n")), "\n")
			if len(lines) != 1 || strings.TrimSpace(lines[0]) == "" {
				return nil, errors.New("PROJECT_CANDIDATE_FILE_UNSAFE")
			}
		}
	}
	content, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(input, fileLimit+1))
	if err != nil || int64(len(content)) > fileLimit {
		return nil, errors.New("PROJECT_CANDIDATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED")
	}
	after, err := input.Stat()
	pathAfter, pathErr := os.Lstat(absolute)
	if err != nil || pathErr != nil || !os.SameFile(opened, after) || !os.SameFile(after, pathAfter) || opened.Size() != after.Size() || !opened.ModTime().Equal(after.ModTime()) {
		return nil, errors.New("PROJECT_CANDIDATE_FILE_REPLACED")
	}
	return content, nil
}

type projectArchiveLimits struct{ files, bytes int64 }

func appendTarPath(writer *tar.Writer, root, source string) error {
	return filepath.WalkDir(source, func(current string, entry os.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
		if walkErr != nil {
			return walkErr
		}
		relative, err := filepath.Rel(root, current)
		if err != nil || !containedLocal(root, current) {
			return errors.New("SERVICE_PROJECT_PATH_INVALID")
		}
		if relative == "." {
			return nil
		}
		info, err := entry.Info()
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if isUnsafeFilesystemLink(info) {
			return errors.New("SERVICE_PROJECT_SYMLINK_UNSAFE")
		}
		header, err := tar.FileInfoHeader(info, "")
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		header.Name = filepath.ToSlash(relative)
		if err := writer.WriteHeader(header); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if entry.IsDir() {
			return nil
		}
		if !entry.Type().IsRegular() {
			return errors.New("SERVICE_PROJECT_FILE_UNSAFE")
		}
		input, err := os.Open(current)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		_, copyErr := io.Copy(writer, input)
		closeErr := input.Close()
		if copyErr != nil {
			return copyErr
		}
		return closeErr
	})
}

func (t OpenSSHTransport) stageRoot() string {
	if t.StageRoot != "" {
		return t.StageRoot
	}
	return "/var/tmp/platform-installer-bootstrap"
}
func (t OpenSSHTransport) runtimeRoot() string {
	if t.RuntimeRoot != "" {
		return t.RuntimeRoot
	}
	return "/var/lib/platform-installer/runtime"
}
func (t OpenSSHTransport) ssh(ctx context.Context, node Node, program string, args []string, input []byte) ([]byte, error) {
	identity, err := t.identityFile(node.CredentialRef)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return t.withSudoInput(ctx, program, args, input, func(program string, args []string, input []byte) ([]byte, error) {
		full := append(t.base(node, identity), node.User+"@"+node.Address, program)
		full = append(full, args...)
		return t.run(ctx, "ssh", full, input)
	})
}

func (t OpenSSHTransport) sshBounded(ctx context.Context, node Node, program string, args []string, input []byte, limit int) ([]byte, error) {
	identity, err := t.identityFile(node.CredentialRef)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return t.withSudoInput(ctx, program, args, input, func(program string, args []string, input []byte) ([]byte, error) {
		full := append(t.base(node, identity), node.User+"@"+node.Address, program)
		full = append(full, args...)
		return t.runBounded(ctx, "ssh", full, input, limit)
	})
}

func (t OpenSSHTransport) sshSeparatedBounded(ctx context.Context, node Node, program string, args []string, input []byte, stdoutLimit, stderrLimit int) ([]byte, error) {
	identity, err := t.identityFile(node.CredentialRef)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_TRANSPORT_FAILED")
	}
	return t.withSudoInput(ctx, program, args, input, func(program string, args []string, input []byte) ([]byte, error) {
		full := append(t.base(node, identity), node.User+"@"+node.Address, program)
		full = append(full, args...)
		return t.runSeparatedBounded(ctx, "ssh", full, input, stdoutLimit, stderrLimit)
	})
}

// ProbeTargetHostKey is read-only target host-key discovery from the trusted
// Execution Node. It never accepts a key or alters trust on either machine.
func (t OpenSSHTransport) ProbeTargetHostKey(ctx context.Context, node Node, address string, port uint16) ([]byte, error) {
	if port == 0 || address == "" || len(address) > 253 || strings.ContainsAny(address, " \t\r\n'\";|&$`(){}[]*?!\\") {
		return nil, errors.New("TARGET_HOST_KEY_PROBE_FAILED")
	}
	return t.sshSeparatedBounded(ctx, node, "ssh-keyscan", []string{"-T", "5", "-p", strconv.Itoa(int(port)), "-t", "ed25519,ecdsa,rsa", address}, nil, 16384, 1024)
}
func (t OpenSSHTransport) identityFile(reference string) (string, error) {
	if t.Password != nil {
		return "", nil
	}
	if t.Identity == nil {
		return "", errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_NOT_CONFIGURED")
	}
	return t.Identity.IdentityFile(reference)
}
func (t OpenSSHTransport) base(node Node, identity string) []string {
	args := []string{}
	if t.IsolatedHostKeyTrust {
		args = append(args, "-F", "none", "-o", "GlobalKnownHostsFile=none", "-o", "KnownHostsCommand=none", "-o", "UpdateHostKeys=no")
	}
	args = append(args, "-o", "IdentitiesOnly=yes", "-o", "StrictHostKeyChecking=yes", "-o", "UserKnownHostsFile="+node.HostKey.KnownHosts)
	if t.Password != nil {
		args = append(args, "-o", "BatchMode=no", "-o", "PreferredAuthentications=password", "-o", "PubkeyAuthentication=no", "-o", "KbdInteractiveAuthentication=no", "-o", "NumberOfPasswordPrompts=1")
	} else {
		args = append(args, "-o", "BatchMode=yes", "-i", identity)
	}
	return append(args, "-p", fmt.Sprint(node.Port))
}
func (t OpenSSHTransport) scpBase(node Node, identity string) []string {
	args := t.base(node, identity)
	for i := range args {
		if args[i] == "-p" {
			args[i] = "-P"
		}
	}
	return args
}
func (t OpenSSHTransport) destination(node Node, value string) string {
	return node.User + "@" + node.Address + ":" + value
}
func (t OpenSSHTransport) run(ctx context.Context, name string, args []string, input []byte) ([]byte, error) {
	release, err := t.acquireCommandGuard(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer release()
	runner := t.Runner
	if runner == nil {
		runner = osRunner{password: t.Password}
	}
	out, err := runner.Run(ctx, name, args, input)
	if err != nil {
		detail := strings.TrimSpace(string(out))
		if len(detail) > 512 {
			detail = detail[:512]
		}
		if detail != "" && t.Password == nil && t.SudoPassword == nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("EXECUTION_NODE_TRANSPORT_FAILED:%s:%s", name, detail)
		}
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("EXECUTION_NODE_TRANSPORT_FAILED:%s", name)
	}
	return out, nil
}

func (t OpenSSHTransport) runBounded(ctx context.Context, name string, args []string, input []byte, limit int) ([]byte, error) {
	release, guardErr := t.acquireCommandGuard(ctx)
	if guardErr != nil {
		return nil, guardErr
	}
	defer release()
	runner := t.Runner
	if runner == nil {
		runner = osRunner{password: t.Password}
	}
	var out []byte
	var err error
	if bounded, ok := runner.(boundedCommandRunner); ok {
		out, err = bounded.RunBounded(ctx, name, args, input, limit)
	} else {
		out, err = runner.Run(ctx, name, args, input)
		if len(out) > limit {
			out = out[:limit]
			err = errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_OUTPUT_LIMIT")
		}
	}
	if err != nil {
		return out, fmt.Errorf("EXECUTION_NODE_TRANSPORT_FAILED:%s", name)
	}
	return out, nil
}

func (t OpenSSHTransport) runSeparatedBounded(ctx context.Context, name string, args []string, input []byte, stdoutLimit, stderrLimit int) ([]byte, error) {
	release, guardErr := t.acquireCommandGuard(ctx)
	if guardErr != nil {
		return nil, guardErr
	}
	defer release()
	runner := t.Runner
	if runner == nil {
		runner = osRunner{password: t.Password}
	}
	separated, ok := runner.(separatedCommandRunner)
	if !ok {
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_TRANSPORT_FAILED")
	}
	stdout, _, err := separated.RunSeparatedBounded(ctx, name, args, input, stdoutLimit, stderrLimit)
	if err != nil {
		// Keep bounded stdout for closed protocol error decoding only. Stderr
		// and the process error never become diagnostics or secret content.
		return stdout, errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_TRANSPORT_FAILED")
	}
	return stdout, nil
}

func (t OpenSSHTransport) acquireCommandGuard(ctx context.Context) (func(), error) {
	if t.ContextCommandGuard != nil {
		release, err := t.ContextCommandGuard(ctx)
		if err != nil || release == nil {
			return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_BINDING_INVALID")
		}
		return release, nil
	}
	if t.CommandGuard == nil {
		return func() {}, nil
	}
	release, err := t.CommandGuard()
	if err != nil || release == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_BINDING_INVALID")
	}
	return release, nil
}
func remoteChecks(bundle executionbundle.Verified) string {
	var b strings.Builder
	b.WriteString("set -eu\ncd -- \"$1\"\n")
	for _, c := range bundle.Manifest.Components {
		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "test -f %q\n[ \"$(wc -c < %q)\" = %d ]\nprintf '%%s  %%s\\n' %q %q | sha256sum -c -\n", c.Path, c.Path, c.Size, strings.TrimPrefix(c.SHA256, "sha256:"), c.Path)
	}
	return b.String()
}
func parseFacts(raw string) map[string]string {
	values := map[string]string{}
	for _, line := range strings.Split(raw, "\n") {
		parts := strings.SplitN(line, "=", 2)
		if len(parts) == 2 {
			values[parts[0]] = parts[1]
		}
	}
	return values
}
func parseInt64(value string) int64 { var result int64; fmt.Sscan(value, &result); return result }

func containedLocal(root, candidate string) bool {
	relative, err := filepath.Rel(root, candidate)
	return err == nil && relative != ".." && !strings.HasPrefix(relative, ".."+string(filepath.Separator))
}

// Hash precisely the service archive inputs, including unowned inventory and
// package assets. ProjectRevision alone deliberately excludes generated state.
// A cache hit needs no temporary archive and sends no project bytes over SSH.
func projectTransferIdentity(root string) (string, string, error) {
	absolute, err := filepath.Abs(root)
	if err != nil {
		return "", "", err
	}
	hash := sha256.New()
	writer := tar.NewWriter(hash)
	if err := writeProjectArchive(writer, absolute); err != nil {
		return "", "", err
	}
	if err := writer.Close(); err != nil {
		return "", "", err
	}
	slot := sha256.Sum256([]byte(absolute))
	return hex.EncodeToString(slot[:]), "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil)), nil
}

// One replaceable archive per local project on this node, root-private. The
// lock protects lookup/extraction and publication; Core's request directories
// remain independent and retain their existing ownership/cleanup protocol.
const projectArchiveCacheScript = `set -eu
command -v flock >/dev/null || { printf 'MISS'; exit 0; }
slot=$1; expected=$2; action=$3; run_id=$4; purpose=$5; source=${6-}
base=/var/lib/platform-installer/execution/project-archives
install -d -m 0700 "$base" "$base/$slot"
exec 9>"$base/$slot/lock"
flock -x 9
archive=$base/$slot/project.tar
if [ "$action" = publish ]; then
  [ "sha256:$(sha256sum "$source" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$expected" ]
  install -m 0600 "$source" "$base/$slot/pending.tar"
  mv -f "$base/$slot/pending.tar" "$archive"
  exit 0
fi
[ -f "$archive" ] || { printf 'MISS'; exit 0; }
[ "sha256:$(sha256sum "$archive" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$expected" ] || { printf 'MISS'; exit 0; }
install -d -m 0700 /var/lib/platform-installer/execution/runs
run=/var/lib/platform-installer/execution/runs/$run_id
mkdir -m 0700 "$run"
mkdir -m 0700 "$run/project"
printf '%s\n' "$expected" > "$run/project-archive.digest"
tar -xf "$archive" -C "$run/project"
if [ "$purpose" = snapshot ]; then
  printf '{"kind":"readonly","runId":"%s"}\n' "$run_id" > "$run/.snapshot-owner.json"
fi
printf 'HIT'
`

func (t OpenSSHTransport) projectArchiveCache(ctx context.Context, node Node, slot, digest, action, runID, purpose, source string) (bool, error) {
	if len(slot) != 64 || !validSHA256(digest) || !validRuntimeToken(runID) || (purpose != "plan" && purpose != "snapshot") {
		return false, errors.New("PROJECT_TRANSFER_FAILED")
	}
	if _, err := hex.DecodeString(slot); err != nil {
		return false, errors.New("PROJECT_TRANSFER_FAILED")
	}
	output, err := t.ssh(ctx, node, "sudo", []string{"-n", "sh", "-s", "--", slot, digest, action, runID, purpose, source}, []byte(projectArchiveCacheScript))
	return strings.TrimSpace(string(output)) == "HIT", err
}

func writeProjectArchive(writer *tar.Writer, absolute string) error {
	info, err := os.Lstat(absolute)
	if err != nil || !info.IsDir() || isUnsafeFilesystemLink(info) {
		return errors.New("SERVICE_PROJECT_INVALID")
	}
	for _, entry := range []string{"inventory", "project.yml", "ansible.cfg", "application-packages", "library-packages"} {
		candidate := filepath.Join(absolute, entry)
		if _, err := os.Lstat(candidate); err != nil {
			if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) && entry != "inventory" {
				continue
			}
			return errors.New("SERVICE_PROJECT_INVALID")
		}
		if err := appendTarPath(writer, absolute, candidate); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// BuildOnExecutionNode runs the existing Python bundle builder on the trusted
// Linux execution node. The workstation never needs Python or Ansible.
func (t OpenSSHTransport) BuildOnExecutionNode(ctx context.Context, node Node, runtimeInput, bundleVersion, coreVersion string) (string, error) {

		return "", errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_REMOTE_BUILD_INPUT_INVALID")

func createSourceArchive(repositoryRoot, runtimeInput, output string) error {
	file, err := os.Create(output)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	archive := tar.NewWriter(file)
	closeArchive := func() error {
		if err := archive.Close(); err != nil {
			_ = file.Close()
			return err
		}
		return file.Close()
	}
	for _, source := range []struct{ name, path string }{
		{"ansible-core", filepath.Join(repositoryRoot, "ansible-core")},
		{"services", filepath.Join(repositoryRoot, "services")},
		{"examples", filepath.Join(repositoryRoot, "examples")},
		{"contracts", filepath.Join(repositoryRoot, "contracts")},
		{"runtime-input", runtimeInput},
	} {
		if err := addTreeToTar(archive, source.path, source.name); err != nil {
			_ = file.Close()
			return err
		}
	}
	return closeArchive()
}

func addTreeToTar(archive *tar.Writer, source, prefix string) error {
	return filepath.WalkDir(source, func(path string, entry os.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
		if walkErr != nil {
			return walkErr
		}
		relative, err := filepath.Rel(source, path)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		name := filepath.ToSlash(prefix)
		if relative != "." {
			name += "/" + filepath.ToSlash(relative)
		}
		if entry.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || !entry.IsDir() && !entry.Type().IsRegular() {
			return errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_SOURCE_UNSAFE")
		}
		info, err := entry.Info()
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		header, err := tar.FileInfoHeader(info, "")
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		header.Name = name
		if err := archive.WriteHeader(header); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if entry.IsDir() {
			return nil
		}
		input, err := os.Open(path)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		_, copyErr := io.Copy(archive, input)
		_ = input.Close()
		return copyErr
	})
}

func extractTar(source, destination string) error {
	file, err := os.Open(source)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer file.Close()
	archive := tar.NewReader(file)
	for {
		header, err := archive.Next()
		if errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
			return nil
		}
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		name := header.Name
		if header.FileInfo().IsDir() {
			name = strings.TrimSuffix(name, "/")
		}
		if name == "" || filepath.IsAbs(name) || filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(name)) != name || strings.HasPrefix(name, "../") || strings.Contains(name, "/../") || header.Typeflag == tar.TypeSymlink || header.Typeflag == tar.TypeLink {
			return errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_REMOTE_ARCHIVE_UNSAFE")
		}
		target := filepath.Join(destination, filepath.FromSlash(name))
		if !containedLocal(destination, target) {
			return errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_REMOTE_ARCHIVE_PATH_INVALID")
		}
		if header.FileInfo().IsDir() {
			if err := os.MkdirAll(target, 0o700); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			continue
		}
		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(target), 0o700); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		output, err := os.OpenFile(target, os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY, 0o600)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		_, copyErr := io.Copy(output, archive)
		closeErr := output.Close()
		if copyErr != nil {
			return copyErr
		}
		if closeErr != nil {
			return closeErr
		}
	}
}

package executionnode

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"regexp"
	"strings"

	"platform-installer/internal/artifactsource"
)

var packageIdentity = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.+:-]{0,127}$`)

// ProbeRepository performs a read-only query against the target node's
// configured DNF repositories. It does not install, refresh or modify repos.
func (t OpenSSHTransport) ProbeRepository(ctx context.Context, node Node, requirement artifactsource.Requirement) (artifactsource.RepositoryProbeResult, error) {
	result := artifactsource.RepositoryProbeResult{TargetNode: node.ID, Requirement: requirement}
	if !packageIdentity.MatchString(requirement.Name) || requirement.OS == "" || requirement.Architecture == "" {
		result.Status = artifactsource.ProbeFailed
		result.Reason = "REQUIREMENT_INVALID"
		return result, errors.New("REPOSITORY_PROBE_REQUIREMENT_INVALID")
	}
	const probeScript = "set -eu\ncase \"$1\" in *[!A-Za-z0-9_.+:-]*) exit 64;; esac\nsudo -n dnf -q repoquery --available --qf '%{NAME}|%{VERSION}|%{ARCH}' -- \"$1\"\n"
	output, err := t.ssh(ctx, node, "sh", []string{"-s", "--", requirement.Name}, []byte(probeScript))
	if err != nil {
		result.Status = artifactsource.RepositoryUnavailable
		result.Reason = "REPOSITORY_UNAVAILABLE"
		return result, nil
	}
	for _, line := range strings.Split(strings.TrimSpace(string(output)), "\n") {
		parts := strings.Split(line, "|")
		if len(parts) != 3 || !packageIdentity.MatchString(parts[0]) || !packageIdentity.MatchString(parts[1]) || !packageIdentity.MatchString(parts[2]) {
			continue
		}
		result.Candidates = append(result.Candidates, artifactsource.Candidate{Name: parts[0], Version: parts[1], OS: requirement.OS, Architecture: parts[2], ID: parts[0] + "-" + parts[1] + "." + parts[2]})
	}
	if len(result.Candidates) == 0 {
		result.Status = artifactsource.NotFound
		result.Reason = "REPOSITORY_NOT_FOUND"
		return result, nil
	}
	for _, candidate := range result.Candidates {
		if candidate.Name == requirement.Name && candidate.Architecture == requirement.Architecture && versionMatches(requirement.Version, candidate.Version) {
			result.Status = artifactsource.AvailableCompatible
			result.Reason = "REPOSITORY_COMPATIBLE"
			return result, nil
		}
	}
	result.Status = artifactsource.AvailableIncompatible
	result.Reason = "REPOSITORY_INCOMPATIBLE"
	return result, nil
}

func versionMatches(required, actual string) bool {
	if required == "" {
		return true
	}
	requiredParts, actualParts := strings.Split(required, "."), strings.Split(actual, ".")
	if len(requiredParts) != len(actualParts) {
		return false
	}
	for i, part := range requiredParts {
		if part != "x" && part != "X" && part != actualParts[i] {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

type repositoryProbeProvider struct {
	result artifactsource.RepositoryProbeResult
}

func (p repositoryProbeProvider) FindCompatible(requirement artifactsource.Requirement) (artifactsource.Candidate, bool, error) {
	if p.result.Status == artifactsource.RepositoryUnavailable || p.result.Status == artifactsource.ProbeFailed {
		return artifactsource.Candidate{}, false, errors.New(p.result.Reason)
	}
	for _, candidate := range p.result.Candidates {
		if candidate.Name == requirement.Name && candidate.OS == requirement.OS && candidate.Architecture == requirement.Architecture && versionMatches(requirement.Version, candidate.Version) {
			return candidate, true, nil
		}
	}
	return artifactsource.Candidate{}, false, nil
}

// ResolveWithTargetProbe keeps repository probing target-scoped while the
// existing artifactsource.Resolve remains the only source-selection authority.
func ResolveWithTargetProbe(ctx context.Context, targetNode Node, requirement artifactsource.Requirement, probe artifactsource.RepositoryProbe, bundle artifactsource.Provider) (artifactsource.Result, artifactsource.RepositoryProbeResult, error) {
	probeResult, err := probe.ProbeRepository(ctx, requirement)
	if err != nil {
		return artifactsource.Result{}, probeResult, err
	}
	result, err := artifactsource.ResolveForNode(targetNode.ID, requirement, repositoryProbeProvider{result: probeResult}, bundle)
	return result, probeResult, err
}

// ResolveRequirementsWithTargetProbe performs one read-only probe per
// requirement and returns the target-filtered projection consumed by the
// Ansible service gate. Source selection remains exclusively in the existing
// artifactsource resolver.
func ResolveRequirementsWithTargetProbe(ctx context.Context, targetNode Node, requirements []artifactsource.Requirement, probe artifactsource.RepositoryProbe, bundle artifactsource.Provider) (map[string]artifactsource.Result, []artifactsource.RepositoryProbeResult, error) {
	results := make([]artifactsource.Result, 0, len(requirements))
	probes := make([]artifactsource.RepositoryProbeResult, 0, len(requirements))
	for _, requirement := range requirements {
		result, probeResult, err := ResolveWithTargetProbe(ctx, targetNode, requirement, probe, bundle)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, probes, err
		}
		results = append(results, result)
		probes = append(probes, probeResult)
	}
	return artifactsource.RuntimeProjection(targetNode.ID, results), probes, nil
}

	ObserverTransportFailure = "EXECUTION_OBSERVER_TRANSPORT_FAILURE"
	ObserverMirrorFailure    = "EXECUTION_OBSERVER_MIRROR_FAILURE"

type ObserverError struct{ Code string }

func (e *ObserverError) Error() string { return e.Code }

type ObserverSubscription struct {
	NodeID       string
	RunID        string
	MirrorPath   string
	Events       <-chan ExecutionEvent
	Errors       <-chan error
	events       chan ExecutionEvent
	errors       chan error
	done         chan struct{}
	closeRequest sync.Once
	finishOnce   sync.Once
	remove       func()
	checkpoint   int
}

func (s *ObserverSubscription) Close() {
	if s != nil {
		s.closeRequest.Do(s.remove)
	}
}

func (s *ObserverSubscription) finish(err error) {
	s.finishOnce.Do(func() {
		if err != nil {
			for {
				select {
				case s.errors <- err:
					goto delivered
				default:
				}
				select {
				case <-s.errors:
				default:
					goto delivered
				}
			}
		}
	delivered:
		close(s.events)
		close(s.errors)
		close(s.done)
	})
}

type observedRun struct {
	stateMu          sync.Mutex
	key              observerRunKey
	node             Node
	runID            string
	ctx              context.Context
	cancel           context.CancelFunc
	mirror           *EventMirror
	last             int
	seen             map[int][]byte
	subs             map[uint64]*ObserverSubscription
	nextSub          uint64
	mirrorErr        error
	mirrorCheckpoint int
	mirrorVerified   bool
	earliestSequence int
	historyTruncated bool
}

type RunObserver struct {
	client       ExecutionClient
	runtimeRoot  string
	pollInterval time.Duration
	minBackoff   time.Duration
	maxBackoff   time.Duration
	mu           sync.Mutex
	runs         map[observerRunKey]*observedRun
}

type observerRunKey struct {
	nodeID        string
	address       string
	user          string
	port          uint16
	credentialRef string
	runID         string
}

func NewRunObserver(client ExecutionClient, runtimeRoot string) (*RunObserver, error) {
	if client == nil || runtimeRoot == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_OBSERVER_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	absolute, err := filepath.Abs(runtimeRoot)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_OBSERVER_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	return &RunObserver{client: client, runtimeRoot: absolute, pollInterval: 500 * time.Millisecond, minBackoff: 250 * time.Millisecond, maxBackoff: 5 * time.Second, runs: map[observerRunKey]*observedRun{}}, nil
}

func (o *RunObserver) Observe(ctx context.Context, node Node, runID string) (*ObserverSubscription, error) {
	return o.SubscribeAfter(ctx, node, runID, 0, 256)
}

func (o *RunObserver) Subscribe(ctx context.Context, node Node, runID string, capacity int) (*ObserverSubscription, error) {
	return o.SubscribeAfter(ctx, node, runID, 0, capacity)
}

func (o *RunObserver) SubscribeAfter(ctx context.Context, node Node, runID string, after, capacity int) (*ObserverSubscription, error) {
	if ctx == nil || !validRuntimeToken(runID) || after < 0 || capacity < 1 || capacity > maxSubscriberBufferSlots {
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_OBSERVER_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	key := observerKey(node, runID)
	o.mu.Lock()
	current := o.runs[key]
	startPoller := false
	if current == nil {
		if len(o.runs) >= maxObservedRuns {
			o.mu.Unlock()
			return nil, &ObserverError{Code: ObserverCapacityExceeded}
		}
		mirror, mirrorErr := OpenEventMirror(o.runtimeRoot, runID, nodeMirrorFingerprint(node))
		runContext, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
		current = &observedRun{key: key, node: node, runID: runID, ctx: runContext, cancel: cancel, mirror: mirror, seen: map[int][]byte{}, subs: map[uint64]*ObserverSubscription{}, mirrorErr: mirrorErr, mirrorVerified: true}
		if mirror != nil {
			current.last = mirror.LastSequence()
			current.seen = mirror.knownEvents()
			current.mirrorCheckpoint = current.last
			current.mirrorVerified = current.last == 0
		}
		o.runs[key] = current
		startPoller = true
	}
	if len(current.subs) >= maxSubscribersPerRun {
		o.mu.Unlock()
		return nil, &ObserverError{Code: ObserverCapacityExceeded}
	}
	current.stateMu.Lock()
	replayCount := 0
	for sequence := range current.seen {
		if sequence > after {
			replayCount++
		}
	}
	requestedSlots := replayCount + capacity
	if requestedSlots > maxObservedExecutionEvents+maxSubscriberBufferSlots {
		current.stateMu.Unlock()
		o.mu.Unlock()
		if startPoller {
			o.finish(current, nil)
		}
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_OBSERVER_REPLAY_LIMIT")
	}
	if o.aggregateSubscriberSlotsLocked()+requestedSlots > maxAggregateSubscriberSlots {
		current.stateMu.Unlock()
		o.mu.Unlock()
		if startPoller {
			o.finish(current, nil)
		}
		return nil, &ObserverError{Code: ObserverCapacityExceeded}
	}
	events := make(chan ExecutionEvent, replayCount+capacity)
	errorsChannel := make(chan error, 4)
	mirrorPath := ""
	if current.mirrorErr == nil {
		mirrorPath, _ = EventMirrorPath(o.runtimeRoot, runID)
	}
	sub := &ObserverSubscription{NodeID: node.ID, RunID: runID, MirrorPath: mirrorPath, Events: events, Errors: errorsChannel, events: events, errors: errorsChannel, done: make(chan struct{}), checkpoint: after}
	id := current.nextSub
	current.nextSub++
	sub.remove = func() { o.removeSubscriber(key, current, id, sub) }
	if current.mirrorErr != nil {
		sub.errors <- &ObserverError{Code: ObserverMirrorFailure}
	}
	if current.historyTruncated && after < current.earliestSequence-1 {
		sub.errors <- &ObserverError{Code: ObserverHistoryTruncated}
	}
	if current.mirrorVerified {
		for _, sequence := range orderedSequences(current.seen, after, current.last) {
			encoded, ok := current.seen[sequence]
			if !ok {
				continue
			}
			var event ExecutionEvent
			if decodeCanonicalEvent(encoded, &event) {
				sub.events <- event
				sub.checkpoint = sequence
			}
		}
	}
	current.stateMu.Unlock()
	current.subs[id] = sub
	o.mu.Unlock()
	if startPoller {
		go o.poll(current)
	}
	go func() {
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			sub.Close()
		case <-sub.done:
		}
	}()
	return sub, nil
}

func (o *RunObserver) aggregateSubscriberSlotsLocked() int {
	total := 0
	for _, current := range o.runs {
		for _, sub := range current.subs {
			total += cap(sub.events)
		}
	}
	return total
}

func nodeMirrorFingerprint(node Node) string {
	value := strings.Join([]string{node.ID, node.Address, node.User, strconv.Itoa(int(node.Port)), node.HostKey.Fingerprint}, "\x00")
	digest := sha256.Sum256([]byte(value))
	return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
}

func (o *RunObserver) Replay(ctx context.Context, node Node, runID string, after int) ([]ExecutionEvent, error) {
	if ctx == nil || !validRuntimeToken(runID) || after < 0 {
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_OBSERVER_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	result := []ExecutionEvent{}
	last := after
	seen := map[int][]byte{}
	historyTruncated := false
	for {
		page, err := o.client.GetEvents(ctx, node, runID, last, ExecutionEventPageLimit)
		if err != nil {
			if errors.Is(err, errExecutionEventsResponseInvalid) || errors.Is(err, errExecutionEventResponseInvalid) {
				return nil, &ObserverError{Code: ObserverIntegrityFailure}
			}
			return nil, err
		}
		accepted, next, err := validateObserverPage(page, runID, last, seen)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		result = append(result, accepted...)
		historyTruncated = historyTruncated || page.HistoryTruncated
		last = next
		if !page.HasMore {
			if historyTruncated {
				return result, &ObserverError{Code: ObserverHistoryTruncated}
			}
			return result, nil
		}
	}
}

func (o *RunObserver) Stop(node Node, runID string) {
	key := observerKey(node, runID)
	o.mu.Lock()
	if current := o.runs[key]; current != nil {
		current.cancel()
	}
	o.mu.Unlock()
}

func (o *RunObserver) removeSubscriber(key observerRunKey, current *observedRun, id uint64, sub *ObserverSubscription) {
	o.mu.Lock()
	if o.runs[key] == current {
		delete(current.subs, id)
		if len(current.subs) == 0 {
			current.cancel()
		}
	}
	o.mu.Unlock()
	sub.finish(nil)
}

func (o *RunObserver) poll(current *observedRun) {
	backoff := o.minBackoff
	for {
		current.stateMu.Lock()
		after := current.last
		if !current.mirrorVerified && current.mirrorCheckpoint > 0 {
			after = current.mirrorCheckpoint - 1
		}
		current.stateMu.Unlock()
		page, err := o.client.GetEvents(current.ctx, current.node, current.runID, after, ExecutionEventPageLimit)
		if err != nil {
			if current.ctx.Err() != nil {
				o.finish(current, nil)
				return
			}
			if errors.Is(err, errExecutionEventsResponseInvalid) || errors.Is(err, errExecutionEventResponseInvalid) {
				o.finish(current, &ObserverError{Code: ObserverIntegrityFailure})
				return
			}
			o.notify(current, &ObserverError{Code: ObserverTransportFailure})
			if !waitObserver(current.ctx, backoff) {
				o.finish(current, nil)
				return
			}
			backoff *= 2
			if backoff > o.maxBackoff {
				backoff = o.maxBackoff
			}
			continue
		}
		backoff = o.minBackoff
		current.stateMu.Lock()
		accepted, next, validationErr := validateObserverPage(page, current.runID, current.last, current.seen)
		if page.HistoryTruncated {
			current.historyTruncated = true
			current.earliestSequence = page.EarliestSequence
		}
		mirrorMismatch := false
		verifiedMirror := false
		if !current.mirrorVerified && current.mirrorCheckpoint > 0 {
			checkpoint := current.mirrorCheckpoint
			remoteCheckpointMatches := len(page.Events) > 0 && page.Events[0].Sequence == checkpoint
			if remoteCheckpointMatches {
				encoded, encodeErr := canonicalEvent(page.Events[0])
				remoteCheckpointMatches = encodeErr == nil && bytes.Equal(current.seen[checkpoint], encoded)
			}
			if validationErr != nil || !remoteCheckpointMatches {
				mirrorMismatch = true
			} else {
				current.mirrorVerified = true
				verifiedMirror = true
			}
		}
		current.stateMu.Unlock()
		if mirrorMismatch {
			o.resetUnverifiedMirror(current)
			continue
		}
		if verifiedMirror {
			o.publishMirroredHistory(current, current.mirrorCheckpoint)
		}
		if validationErr != nil {
			o.finish(current, validationErr)
			return
		}
		if page.HistoryTruncated {
			o.notify(current, &ObserverError{Code: ObserverHistoryTruncated})
		}
		for _, event := range accepted {
			if current.mirror != nil {
				if _, mirrorErr := current.mirror.Append(event); mirrorErr != nil {
					_ = current.mirror.Close()
					current.mirror = nil
					current.stateMu.Lock()
					current.mirrorErr = mirrorErr
					current.stateMu.Unlock()
					o.notify(current, &ObserverError{Code: ObserverMirrorFailure})
				}
			}
			current.stateMu.Lock()
			current.last = event.Sequence
			encoded, _ := canonicalEvent(event)
			current.seen[event.Sequence] = encoded
			current.stateMu.Unlock()
			o.publish(current, event)
		}
		current.stateMu.Lock()
		current.last = next
		current.stateMu.Unlock()
		if page.HasMore {
			continue
		}
		run, runErr := o.client.GetExecution(current.ctx, current.node, current.runID)
		if runErr != nil {
			o.notify(current, &ObserverError{Code: ObserverTransportFailure})
			if !waitObserver(current.ctx, backoff) {
				o.finish(current, nil)
				return
			}
			backoff *= 2
			if backoff > o.maxBackoff {
				backoff = o.maxBackoff
			}
			continue
		}
		backoff = o.minBackoff
		current.stateMu.Lock()
		last := current.last
		current.stateMu.Unlock()
		if run.RunID != "" && run.RunID != current.runID || run.Sequence < last {
			o.finish(current, &ObserverError{Code: ObserverIntegrityFailure})
			return
		}
		if terminalExecutionState(run.State) {
			if run.Sequence > last {
				continue
			}
			o.finish(current, nil)
			return
		}
		if !waitObserver(current.ctx, o.pollInterval) {
			o.finish(current, nil)
			return
		}
	}
}

func validateObserverPage(page ExecutionEventPage, runID string, last int, seen map[int][]byte) ([]ExecutionEvent, int, error) {
	accepted := make([]ExecutionEvent, 0, len(page.Events))
	next := last
	if page.HistoryTruncated {
		if page.EarliestSequence <= last+1 {
			return nil, last, &ObserverError{Code: ObserverIntegrityFailure}
		}
		next = page.EarliestSequence - 1
	}
	for _, event := range page.Events {
		if validateExecutionEvent(event, runID) != nil {
			return nil, last, &ObserverError{Code: ObserverIntegrityFailure}
		}
		encoded, _ := canonicalEvent(event)
		if event.Sequence <= next {
			if prior, ok := seen[event.Sequence]; ok && bytes.Equal(prior, encoded) {
				continue
			}
			return nil, last, &ObserverError{Code: ObserverIntegrityFailure}
		}
		if event.Sequence != next+1 {
			return nil, last, &ObserverError{Code: ObserverIntegrityFailure}
		}
		if len(seen) >= maxObservedExecutionEvents {
			return nil, last, &ObserverError{Code: ObserverIntegrityFailure}
		}
		accepted = append(accepted, event)
		seen[event.Sequence] = encoded
		next = event.Sequence
	}
	if page.NextSequence != next || page.HasMore && len(page.Events) == 0 {
		return nil, last, &ObserverError{Code: ObserverIntegrityFailure}
	}
	return accepted, next, nil
}

func (o *RunObserver) publish(current *observedRun, event ExecutionEvent) {
	o.mu.Lock()
	overflow := []*ObserverSubscription{}
	if o.runs[current.key] == current {
		for id, sub := range current.subs {
			if event.Sequence <= sub.checkpoint {
				continue
			}
			select {
			case sub.events <- event:
				sub.checkpoint = event.Sequence
			default:
				delete(current.subs, id)
				overflow = append(overflow, sub)
			}
		}
		if len(current.subs) == 0 {
			current.cancel()
		}
	}
	o.mu.Unlock()
	for _, sub := range overflow {
		sub.finish(&ObserverError{Code: ObserverSubscriberSlow})
	}
}

func (o *RunObserver) publishMirroredHistory(current *observedRun, through int) {
	current.stateMu.Lock()
	history := make(map[int][]byte, len(current.seen))
	for sequence, encoded := range current.seen {
		if sequence <= through {
			history[sequence] = append([]byte(nil), encoded...)
		}
	}
	current.stateMu.Unlock()
	for _, sequence := range orderedSequences(history, 0, through) {
		encoded, ok := history[sequence]
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		var event ExecutionEvent
		if decodeCanonicalEvent(encoded, &event) {
			o.publish(current, event)
		}
	}
}

func orderedSequences(events map[int][]byte, after, through int) []int {
	result := make([]int, 0, len(events))
	for sequence := range events {
		if sequence > after && sequence <= through {
			result = append(result, sequence)
		}
	}
	sort.Ints(result)
	return result
}

func (o *RunObserver) resetUnverifiedMirror(current *observedRun) {
	current.stateMu.Lock()
	if current.mirror != nil {
		if err := current.mirror.Reset(); err != nil {
			_ = current.mirror.Close()
			current.mirror = nil
		}
	}
	current.last = 0
	current.seen = map[int][]byte{}
	current.mirrorCheckpoint = 0
	current.mirrorVerified = true
	current.earliestSequence = 0
	current.historyTruncated = false
	current.stateMu.Unlock()
	o.notify(current, &ObserverError{Code: ObserverMirrorFailure})
}

func decodeCanonicalEvent(encoded []byte, event *ExecutionEvent) bool {
	return json.Unmarshal(encoded, event) == nil
}

func (o *RunObserver) notify(current *observedRun, err error) {
	o.mu.Lock()
	if o.runs[current.key] == current {
		for _, sub := range current.subs {
			select {
			case sub.errors <- err:
			default:
			}
		}
	}
	o.mu.Unlock()
}

func (o *RunObserver) finish(current *observedRun, err error) {
	o.mu.Lock()
	if o.runs[current.key] == current {
		delete(o.runs, current.key)
	}
	subs := make([]*ObserverSubscription, 0, len(current.subs))
	for id, sub := range current.subs {
		delete(current.subs, id)
		subs = append(subs, sub)
	}
	o.mu.Unlock()
	current.cancel()
	if current.mirror != nil {
		_ = current.mirror.Close()
	}
	for _, sub := range subs {
		sub.finish(err)
	}
}

func observerKey(node Node, runID string) observerRunKey {
	return observerRunKey{nodeID: node.ID, address: node.Address, user: node.User, port: node.Port, credentialRef: node.CredentialRef, runID: runID}
}

func terminalExecutionState(state string) bool {
	switch state {
	case "SUCCEEDED", "FAILED", "CANCELLED", "INTERRUPTED", "CORRUPT_ORPHANED":
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func waitObserver(ctx context.Context, duration time.Duration) bool {
	timer := time.NewTimer(duration)
	defer timer.Stop()
	select {
	case <-ctx.Done():
		return false
	case <-timer.C:
		return true
	}
}

func shellLiteral(value string) string { return "'" + strings.ReplaceAll(value, "'", "'\"'\"'") + "'" }

// Both phases recheck immutable bytes under root ownership. Bootstrap has no
// activation side effects: cancelling its SSH call cannot later switch current.
func runtimePreparationScripts(bundle executionbundle.Verified) (string, string) {
	var checks strings.Builder
	fmt.Fprintf(&checks, "[ \"$actual_files\" = %d ]\n", len(bundle.Manifest.Components)+1)
	fmt.Fprintf(&checks, "printf '%%s  %%s\\n' %s manifest.yaml | sha256sum -c - >/dev/null\n", shellLiteral(strings.TrimPrefix(bundle.Digest, "sha256:")))
	for _, component := range bundle.Manifest.Components {
		file := shellLiteral(component.Path)
		fmt.Fprintf(&checks, "[ -f %s ] && [ ! -L %s ] && [ \"$(stat -c %%u -- %s)\" = 0 ]\n", file, file, file)
		fmt.Fprintf(&checks, "[ \"$(wc -c < %s)\" = %d ]\nprintf '%%s  %%s\\n' %s %s | sha256sum -c - >/dev/null\n", file, component.Size, shellLiteral(strings.TrimPrefix(component.SHA256, "sha256:")), file)
	}
	common := strings.Replace(runtimePreparationCommon, "__COMPONENT_CHECKS__", checks.String(), 1)
	return common + runtimeBootstrapPhase, common + runtimeActivationPhase
}

stage=$1; root=$2; bundle_digest=$3; bundle_version=$4; core_version=$5; protocol=$6; platforms=$7; bootstrap=$8

nonce=${stage##*-}
id=${bundle_digest#sha256:}
case "$nonce:$id" in *[!0-9a-f:]*|:*) fail EXECUTION_BUNDLE_DIGEST_INVALID ;; esac
[ "${#nonce}" = 32 ] && [ "${#id}" = 64 ] && [ "$bundle_digest" = "sha256:$id" ] || fail EXECUTION_BUNDLE_DIGEST_INVALID
candidate=$root/releases/.prepare-$nonce
release=$root/releases/$id
[ "$(id -u)" = 0 ] || fail EXECUTION_BOOTSTRAP_NOT_ROOT
for directory in /var/lib/platform-installer "$root" "$root/releases" "$root/state"; do
    [ ! -L "$directory" ] || fail EXECUTION_RUNTIME_DIRECTORY_UNSAFE
    if [ -e "$directory" ]; then
        [ -d "$directory" ] && [ "$(stat -c %u "$directory")" = 0 ] || fail EXECUTION_RUNTIME_DIRECTORY_UNSAFE
        mode=$(stat -c %a "$directory")
        [ "$((0$mode & 022))" = 0 ] || fail EXECUTION_RUNTIME_DIRECTORY_UNSAFE
    else
        install -d -m 0750 "$directory"
    fi
done

[ ! -L "$root/state/prepare.lock" ] || fail EXECUTION_RUNTIME_LOCK_UNSAFE

    [ -f "$root/state/prepare.lock" ] && [ "$(stat -c %u "$root/state/prepare.lock")" = 0 ] && [ "$(stat -c %h "$root/state/prepare.lock")" = 1 ] || fail EXECUTION_RUNTIME_LOCK_UNSAFE
    mode=$(stat -c %a "$root/state/prepare.lock")
    [ "$((0$mode & 022))" = 0 ] || fail EXECUTION_RUNTIME_LOCK_UNSAFE
fi
umask 077
exec 9>"$root/state/prepare.lock"
flock -n 9 || fail EXECUTION_RUNTIME_PREPARATION_BUSY
verify_bundle() (
    directory=$1
    allow_cache=${2-0}
    [ -d "$directory" ] && [ ! -L "$directory" ] && [ "$(stat -c %u "$directory")" = 0 ] || exit 78
    cd -- "$directory"
    [ -z "$(find . -type l -o \( ! -type f -a ! -type d \) -print -quit)" ] || exit 78
    [ -z "$(find . -perm /022 -print -quit)" ] || exit 78

    if [ "$allow_cache" = 1 ]; then

        actual_files=$(find . -type f -printf . | wc -c)

`

const runtimeBootstrapPhase = `
[ -d "$stage" ] && [ ! -L "$stage" ] || fail EXECUTION_BUNDLE_STAGE_INVALID
[ ! -e "$candidate" ] && [ ! -L "$candidate" ] || fail EXECUTION_RUNTIME_CANDIDATE_EXISTS

const runtimeActivationPhase = `

    mv -- "$candidate" "$release"

func (t OpenSSHTransport) StageRuntimeProjection(ctx context.Context, node Node, runID, projectIdentity, planFingerprint, requirementsFingerprint string, projections map[string]map[string]artifactsource.Result, pkiSecretFiles map[string]string) error {
	if !validRuntimeToken(runID) || projectIdentity == "" || planFingerprint == "" || requirementsFingerprint == "" || !validRemoteSecretFiles(pkiSecretFiles) {
		return errors.New("RUNTIME_PROJECTION_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	payload := map[string]any{
		"apiVersion":                                   "platform.installer/runtime-projection/v1alpha1",
		"platform_execution_run_id":                    runID,
		"platform_execution_project_identity":          projectIdentity,
		"platform_execution_plan_fingerprint":          planFingerprint,
		"platform_execution_requirements_fingerprint":  requirementsFingerprint,
		"platform_project_id":                          projectIdentity,
		"platform_service_catalog_path":                "/var/lib/platform-installer/runtime/current/catalog/service-catalog.yml",
		"platform_resolved_artifact_sources_by_target": projections,
		"platform_resolved_artifact_sources":           "{{ platform_resolved_artifact_sources_by_target[inventory_hostname] | default({}) }}",
		"platform_pki_secret_files":                    pkiSecretFiles,
	}
	data, err := json.Marshal(payload)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	local, err := os.CreateTemp("", "platform-runtime-projection-*.json")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	localPath := local.Name()
	defer os.Remove(localPath)
	if _, err := local.Write(data); err != nil {
		_ = local.Close()
		return err
	}
	if err := local.Close(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	identity, err := t.Identity.IdentityFile(node.CredentialRef)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	remote := "/var/tmp/platform-installer/execution-projection/" + runID + ".json"
	if _, err := t.ssh(ctx, node, "sh", []string{"-s", "--", remote}, []byte("set -eu\ncase \"$1\" in /var/tmp/platform-installer/execution-projection/installer-*.json) ;; *) exit 64;; esac\nmkdir -p -- /var/tmp/platform-installer/execution-projection\nrm -f -- \"$1\"\n")); err != nil {
		return &ExecutionError{Code: ExecutionNodeUnavailable}
	}
	args := append(t.scpBase(node, identity), "-O", "--", localPath, t.destination(node, remote))
	if _, err := t.run(ctx, "scp", args, nil); err != nil {
		return &ExecutionError{Code: ExecutionNodeUnavailable}
	}
	script := "set -eu\nremote=$1\nrun=$2\ncase \"$remote:$run\" in /var/tmp/platform-installer/execution-projection/installer-*.json:installer-*) ;; *) exit 64;; esac\nsudo -n install -d -m 0700 /var/lib/platform-installer/execution/runs/$run\nsudo -n install -m 0600 \"$remote\" /var/lib/platform-installer/execution/runs/$run/runtime-projection.json\nrm -f -- \"$remote\"\n"
	if _, err := t.ssh(ctx, node, "sh", []string{"-s", "--", remote, runID}, []byte(script)); err != nil {
		return &ExecutionError{Code: ExecutionNodeUnavailable}
	}
	return nil
}

func validRemoteSecretFiles(values map[string]string) bool {
	for reference, secretPath := range values {
		if !strings.HasPrefix(reference, "runtime:") || len(reference) == len("runtime:") || !strings.HasPrefix(secretPath, "/") || path.Clean(secretPath) != secretPath || strings.ContainsAny(reference+secretPath, "\r\n\x00") {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func validRuntimeToken(value string) bool {
	const prefix = "installer-"
	if len(value) <= len(prefix) || len(value) > 128 || !strings.HasPrefix(value, prefix) {
		return false
	}
	for _, r := range value[len(prefix):] {
		// Legacy workstation-created IDs are decimal, while v1alpha2 Start
		// returns the Execution Node's lowercase hexadecimal identifier.
		if !(r >= '0' && r <= '9') && !(r >= 'a' && r <= 'f') {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

var candidateOwnedPathPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^(ansible\.cfg|inventory/hosts\.yml|inventory/group_vars/all/platform-installer\.yml|inventory/host_vars/[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,62}/platform-installer\.yml)$`)

func validLowerHex(value string, size int) bool {
	if len(value) != size {
		return false
	}
	for _, item := range value {
		if (item < '0' || item > '9') && (item < 'a' || item > 'f') {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}
func validSHA256(value string) bool {
	return strings.HasPrefix(value, "sha256:") && validLowerHex(strings.TrimPrefix(value, "sha256:"), 64)
}
