// desiredStateIdentifierPattern is deliberately separate from the shorter
// Installer command ID grammar. PKI references are desired-state fields and
// must use the grammar published by project/v2alpha1.
var desiredStateIdentifierPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:[-_.][a-z0-9]+)*$`)

func pkiOperation(operation string) bool {
	switch operation {
	case "CreateCertificateAuthority", "UpdateCertificateAuthority", "DeleteCertificateAuthority", "CreateCertificateProfile", "UpdateCertificateProfile", "DeleteCertificateProfile", "CreateTLSProfile", "UpdateTLSProfile", "DeleteTLSProfile", "CreateCertificateScope", "UpdateCertificateScope", "DeleteCertificateScope":
		return true
	}
	return false
}

func pkiMap(state map[string]any, key string) map[string]any {
	value := asMap(state[key])
	if value == nil {
		value = map[string]any{}
		state[key] = value
	}
	return value
}

func reducePKICommand(state map[string]any, command EditCommand, mutations topologyMutationSet) error {
	var values map[string]any
	var deleted map[string]bool
	switch command.Operation {
	case "CreateCertificateAuthority", "UpdateCertificateAuthority", "DeleteCertificateAuthority":
		values, deleted = pkiMap(state, "certificateAuthorities"), mutations.deletedAuthorities
	case "CreateCertificateProfile", "UpdateCertificateProfile", "DeleteCertificateProfile":
		values, deleted = pkiMap(state, "certificateProfiles"), mutations.deletedProfiles
	case "CreateTLSProfile", "UpdateTLSProfile", "DeleteTLSProfile":
		values, deleted = pkiMap(state, "tlsProfiles"), mutations.deletedTLSProfiles
	case "CreateCertificateScope", "UpdateCertificateScope", "DeleteCertificateScope":
		values = pkiMap(state, "certificateScopes")
	}
	if values == nil {
		return blocked("INVALID_EDIT_COMMAND", "PKI operation is unsupported", "command.operation")
	}
	if command.APIVersion != EditCommandAPIVersionV7 && command.APIVersion != EditCommandAPIVersionV8 && command.APIVersion != EditCommandAPIVersionV9 && command.APIVersion != EditCommandAPIVersionV10 {
		return blocked("EDIT_OPERATION_UNAVAILABLE", "PKI editing requires v1alpha7 or a compatible later contract", "command.apiVersion")
	}
	if command.Operation[:6] == "Create" {
		if values[command.EntityID] != nil {
			return blocked("INVALID_EDIT_COMMAND", "PKI entity already exists", "command.entityId")
		}
		if err := validPKIEntity(command.Operation, command.Entity); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		values[command.EntityID] = deepCopy(command.Entity)
		return nil
	}
	if command.Operation[:6] == "Update" {
		if values[command.EntityID] == nil {
			return blocked("INVALID_EDIT_COMMAND", "PKI entity does not exist", "command.entityId")
		}
		if err := validPKIEntity(command.Operation, command.Entity); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		next := deepCopy(command.Entity).(map[string]any)
		for key, value := range asMap(values[command.EntityID]) {
			if _, supplied := next[key]; extensionKeyPattern.MatchString(key) && !supplied {
				next[key] = deepCopy(value)
			}
		}
		values[command.EntityID] = next
		return nil
	}
	if values[command.EntityID] == nil {
		return blocked("INVALID_EDIT_COMMAND", "PKI entity does not exist", "command.entityId")
	}
	delete(values, command.EntityID)
	if deleted != nil {
		deleted[command.EntityID] = true
	}
	return nil
}

func validPKIEntity(operation string, value map[string]any) error {
	if value == nil {
		return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "PKI entity is required", "command.entity")
	}
	if operation == "CreateCertificateAuthority" || operation == "UpdateCertificateAuthority" {
		if err := validPKIObjectKeys(value, []string{"mode", "displayName", "commonName", "validityDays"}, "command.entity"); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if value["mode"] != "MANAGED" {
			return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "Only MANAGED certificate authorities are supported", "command.entity.mode")
		}
		if name, ok := value["commonName"].(string); !ok || name == "" || len(name) > 128 {
			return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "Certificate authority common name is invalid", "command.entity.commonName")
		}
		if err := validOptionalString(value, "displayName", 1, 0); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return validOptionalInteger(value, "validityDays", 1, "command.entity.validityDays")
	}
	if operation == "CreateCertificateProfile" || operation == "UpdateCertificateProfile" {
		if err := validPKIObjectKeys(value, []string{"displayName", "authorityRef", "keyAlgorithm", "keySize", "validityDays", "usages", "sanPolicy", "subject"}, "command.entity"); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if ref, ok := value["authorityRef"].(string); !ok || !validDesiredStateIdentifier(ref) || asMap(value["sanPolicy"]) == nil {
			return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "Certificate profile is invalid", "command.entity")
		}
		if err := validOptionalString(value, "displayName", 1, 0); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := validOptionalInteger(value, "keySize", 2048, "command.entity.keySize"); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := validOptionalInteger(value, "validityDays", 1, "command.entity.validityDays"); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if algorithm, present := value["keyAlgorithm"]; present && algorithm != "RSA" && algorithm != "EC" {
			return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "Certificate profile key algorithm is invalid", "command.entity.keyAlgorithm")
		}
		if raw, present := value["usages"]; present {
			if err := validPKIEnumList(raw, "command.entity.usages", []string{"serverAuth", "clientAuth"}, maxManagedEntities); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		if err := validClosedBoolMap(asMap(value["sanPolicy"]), []string{"includeHostDns", "includeHostIp", "includeEndpointFqdns", "includeEndpointWildcard", "includeEndpointVip"}, "command.entity.sanPolicy"); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if raw, present := value["subject"]; present {
			subject := asMap(raw)
			if subject == nil {
				return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "Certificate subject is invalid", "command.entity.subject")
			}
			return validSubjectDN(subject)
		}
		return nil
	}
	if operation == "CreateTLSProfile" || operation == "UpdateTLSProfile" {
		if err := validPKIObjectKeys(value, []string{"certificateProfileRef", "scope", "storePasswordSecretRef"}, "command.entity"); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if ref, ok := value["certificateProfileRef"].(string); !ok || !validDesiredStateIdentifier(ref) {
			return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "TLS profile certificate reference is invalid", "command.entity.certificateProfileRef")
		}
		if ref, ok := value["storePasswordSecretRef"].(string); !ok || !runtimeRefPattern.MatchString(ref) {
			return blocked("SECRET_REFERENCE_INVALID", "TLS profile requires an opaque runtime secret reference", "command.entity.storePasswordSecretRef")
		}
		if err := validOptionalScope(value, "scope", "command.entity.scope"); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return nil
	}
	if operation != "CreateCertificateScope" && operation != "UpdateCertificateScope" {
		return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "PKI operation is unsupported", "command.operation")
	}
	if err := validPKIObjectKeys(value, []string{"displayName", "profile", "scope", "sources"}, "command.entity"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if ref, ok := value["profile"].(string); !ok || !validDesiredStateIdentifier(ref) || asMap(value["sources"]) == nil {
		return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "Certificate scope is invalid", "command.entity")
	}
	if err := validOptionalString(value, "displayName", 1, 0); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := validOptionalScope(value, "scope", "command.entity.scope"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return validScopeSources(asMap(value["sources"]))
}

func validPKIObjectKeys(value map[string]any, keys []string, field string) error {
	allowed := map[string]bool{}
	for _, key := range keys {
		allowed[key] = true
	}
	for key := range value {
		if !allowed[key] && !extensionKeyPattern.MatchString(key) {
			return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "PKI entity contains an unknown field", field)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func validOptionalString(value map[string]any, key string, min, max int) error {
	raw, present := value[key]
	if !present {
		return nil
	}
	text, ok := raw.(string)
	if !ok || (min > 0 && len(text) < min) || (max > 0 && len(text) > max) {
		return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "PKI string field is invalid", "command.entity."+key)
	}
	return nil
}

func validOptionalInteger(value map[string]any, key string, min int, field string) error {
	raw, present := value[key]
	if !present {
		return nil
	}
	number, ok := pkiInteger(raw)
	if !ok || number < min {
		return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "PKI integer field is invalid", field)
	}
	return nil
}

func pkiInteger(value any) (int, bool) {
	if number, ok := yamlInteger(value); ok {
		return number, true
	}
	var number float64
	switch typed := value.(type) {
	case float64:
		number = typed
	case json.Number:
		parsed, err := strconv.ParseFloat(string(typed), 64)
		if err != nil {
			return 0, false
		}
		number = parsed
	default:
		return 0, false
	}
	// A decoded float64 has at most 53 exact integer bits. Do not round a JSON
	// number or convert an out-of-range value to the platform int type.
	if math.IsNaN(number) || math.IsInf(number, 0) || math.Trunc(number) != number || number < float64(-maxIntValue()) || number > float64(maxIntValue()) || number > 1<<53 || number < -(1<<53) {
		return 0, false
	}
	return int(number), true
}

func maxIntValue() int {
	return int(^uint(0) >> 1)
}

func validDesiredStateIdentifier(value string) bool {
	return len(value) >= 1 && len(value) <= 128 && desiredStateIdentifierPattern.MatchString(value)
}

func validOptionalScope(value map[string]any, key, field string) error {
	raw, present := value[key]
	if !present {
		return nil
	}
	if raw != "HOST" && raw != "MEMBER" && raw != "DEPLOYMENT" {
		return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "PKI scope is invalid", field)
	}
	return nil
}

func validClosedBoolMap(value map[string]any, keys []string, field string) error {
	if value == nil {
		return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "PKI object is invalid", field)
	}
	allowed := map[string]bool{}
	for _, key := range keys {
		allowed[key] = true
	}
	for key, raw := range value {
		if !allowed[key] {
			return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "PKI object contains an unknown field", field)
		}
		if _, ok := raw.(bool); !ok {
			return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "PKI policy value is invalid", field)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func validSubjectDN(value map[string]any) error {
	if value == nil {
		return nil
	}
	limits := map[string]int{"C": 2, "ST": 128, "L": 128, "O": 128, "OU": 128}
	for key, raw := range value {
		limit, allowed := limits[key]
		text, ok := raw.(string)
		if !allowed || !ok || len(text) > limit {
			return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "Certificate subject is invalid", "command.entity.subject")
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func validPKIEnumList(value any, field string, allowedValues []string, limit int) error {
	values := asSlice(value)
	if values == nil || len(values) > limit {
		return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "PKI list is invalid", field)
	}
	allowed := map[string]bool{}
	for _, item := range allowedValues {
		allowed[item] = true
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, raw := range values {
		item, ok := raw.(string)
		if !ok || !allowed[item] || seen[item] {
			return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "PKI list item is invalid", field)
		}
		seen[item] = true
	}
	return nil
}

func validScopeSources(value map[string]any) error {
	if err := validPKIObjectKeys(value, []string{"serviceDeployments", "hosts", "members", "explicitDnsNames", "explicitIpAddresses"}, "command.entity.sources"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if raw, present := value["serviceDeployments"]; present {
		if err := validIdentifierList(raw, "command.entity.sources.serviceDeployments", maxManagedEntities); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if raw, present := value["hosts"]; present {
		if err := validIdentifierList(raw, "command.entity.sources.hosts", maxManagedEntities); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if raw, present := value["members"]; present {
		if err := validMemberReferenceList(raw); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if raw, present := value["explicitDnsNames"]; present {
		if err := validStringList(raw, "command.entity.sources.explicitDnsNames", false); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if raw, present := value["explicitIpAddresses"]; present {
		return validStringList(raw, "command.entity.sources.explicitIpAddresses", true)
	}
	return nil
}

func validIdentifierList(value any, field string, limit int) error {
	values := asSlice(value)
	if values == nil || len(values) > limit {
		return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "PKI identifier list is invalid", field)
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, raw := range values {
		item, ok := raw.(string)
		if !ok || !validDesiredStateIdentifier(item) || seen[item] {
			return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "PKI identifier list item is invalid", field)
		}
		seen[item] = true
	}
	return nil
}

func validMemberReferenceList(value any) error {
	values := asSlice(value)
	if values == nil || len(values) > maxManagedPlacements {
		return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "PKI member list is invalid", "command.entity.sources.members")
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, raw := range values {
		member := asMap(raw)
		deploymentID, deploymentOK := member["deploymentId"].(string)
		memberID, memberOK := member["memberId"].(string)
		key := deploymentID + "\x00" + memberID
		if len(member) != 2 || !deploymentOK || !memberOK || !validDesiredStateIdentifier(deploymentID) || !validDesiredStateIdentifier(memberID) || seen[key] {
			return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "PKI member reference is invalid", "command.entity.sources.members")
		}
		seen[key] = true
	}
	return nil
}

func validStringList(value any, field string, requireIP bool) error {
	values := asSlice(value)
	if values == nil || len(values) > maxManagedEntities {
		return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "PKI string list is invalid", field)
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, raw := range values {
		text, ok := raw.(string)
		if !ok || text == "" || seen[text] {
			return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "PKI string list item is invalid", field)
		}
		if requireIP {
			if _, err := netip.ParseAddr(text); err != nil {
				return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "Explicit IP address is invalid", field)
			}
		}
		seen[text] = true
	}
	return nil
}

package installer

import (
	"crypto/rand"
	"encoding/hex"
	"sync"
	"time"
)

type storedDocument struct {
	LogicalPath string
	Before      []byte
	After       []byte
	Existed     bool
}

type storedPlan struct {
	Created     time.Time
	ProjectRoot string
	Public      EditPlan
	LocalOnly   bool
	Documents   []storedDocument
}

type PlanStore interface {
	Put(plan storedPlan) (string, error)
	Get(id string) (storedPlan, bool)
	Discard(id string) bool
}

type MemoryPlanStore struct {
	mu    sync.Mutex
	ttl   time.Duration
	now   func() time.Time
	plans map[string]storedPlan
}

func NewMemoryPlanStore(ttl time.Duration) *MemoryPlanStore {
	return &MemoryPlanStore{ttl: ttl, now: time.Now, plans: make(map[string]storedPlan)}
}

func cloneStoredPlan(plan storedPlan) storedPlan {
	copyPlan := plan
	copyPlan.Public.AffectedDocuments = append([]DocumentChange(nil), plan.Public.AffectedDocuments...)
	copyPlan.Public.SemanticChanges = append([]SemanticChange(nil), plan.Public.SemanticChanges...)
	copyPlan.Documents = make([]storedDocument, len(plan.Documents))
	for index, document := range plan.Documents {
		copyPlan.Documents[index] = document
		copyPlan.Documents[index].Before = append([]byte(nil), document.Before...)
		copyPlan.Documents[index].After = append([]byte(nil), document.After...)
	}
	return copyPlan
}

func (s *MemoryPlanStore) Put(plan storedPlan) (string, error) {
	identifier := make([]byte, 16)
	if _, err := rand.Read(identifier); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	id := hex.EncodeToString(identifier)
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	s.plans[id] = cloneStoredPlan(plan)
	return id, nil
}

func (s *MemoryPlanStore) Get(id string) (storedPlan, bool) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	plan, found := s.plans[id]
	if !found {
		return storedPlan{}, false
	}
	if s.ttl > 0 && s.now().Sub(plan.Created) > s.ttl {
		delete(s.plans, id)
		return storedPlan{}, false
	}
	return cloneStoredPlan(plan), true
}

func (s *MemoryPlanStore) Discard(id string) bool {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	_, found := s.plans[id]
	delete(s.plans, id)
	return found
}

func tryProcessFileLock(file *os.File) (func() error, bool, error) {
	err := unix.Flock(int(file.Fd()), unix.LOCK_EX|unix.LOCK_NB)
	if errors.Is(err, unix.EWOULDBLOCK) {
		return nil, false, nil
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, false, err
	}
	return func() error { return unix.Flock(int(file.Fd()), unix.LOCK_UN) }, true, nil
}

import (
	"errors"
	"os"

func tryProcessFileLock(file *os.File) (func() error, bool, error) {
	overlapped := &windows.Overlapped{}
	err := windows.LockFileEx(windows.Handle(file.Fd()), windows.LOCKFILE_EXCLUSIVE_LOCK|windows.LOCKFILE_FAIL_IMMEDIATELY, 0, 1, 0, overlapped)
	if errors.Is(err, windows.ERROR_LOCK_VIOLATION) {
		return nil, false, nil
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, false, err
	}
	return func() error { return windows.UnlockFileEx(windows.Handle(file.Fd()), 0, 1, 0, overlapped) }, true, nil

// ProjectExport retains the two opened filesystem authorities for one preview
// and exactly one commit attempt. It must be closed when the App invalidates
// the preview or shuts down.
type ProjectExport struct {
	source           *exportDirectory
	destination      *exportDirectory
	sourceIdentity   exportIdentity
	destIdentity     exportIdentity
	sourceDisplay    string
	destDisplay      string
	directoryName    string
	plan             ProjectExportPlan
	manifest         exportObservation
	writeObservation func(*exportDirectory, exportObservation) error
	closed           bool

func PlanProjectExport(sourceRoot, destinationParent, directoryName string) (*ProjectExport, ProjectExportPlan, error) {
	name, err := ValidateExportDirectoryName(directoryName)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, ProjectExportPlan{}, err
	}
	sourceDisplay, err := absoluteExportDisplayPath(sourceRoot)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, ProjectExportPlan{}, errors.New("EXPORT_SOURCE_UNSAFE")
	}
	destDisplay, err := absoluteExportDisplayPath(destinationParent)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, ProjectExportPlan{}, errors.New("EXPORT_DESTINATION_INVALID")
	}
	if rootsOverlap(sourceDisplay, filepath.Join(destDisplay, name)) {
		return nil, ProjectExportPlan{}, errors.New("EXPORT_DESTINATION_INVALID")
	}
	source, err := openExportSourceDirectory(sourceDisplay)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, ProjectExportPlan{}, errors.New("EXPORT_SOURCE_UNSAFE")
	}
	destination, err := openExportDestinationDirectory(destDisplay)
	if err != nil {
		source.close()
		return nil, ProjectExportPlan{}, errors.New("EXPORT_DESTINATION_UNSAFE")
	}
	capability := &ProjectExport{source: source, destination: destination, sourceIdentity: source.identity(), destIdentity: destination.identity(), sourceDisplay: sourceDisplay, destDisplay: destDisplay, directoryName: name}
	observation, err := stableExportObservation(source)
	if err != nil {
		capability.Close()
		return nil, ProjectExportPlan{}, errors.New(exportErrorCode(err, "EXPORT_SOURCE_UNSAFE"))
	}
	if exists, existErr := destination.exists(name); existErr != nil || exists {
		capability.Close()
		if existErr != nil {
			return nil, ProjectExportPlan{}, errors.New("EXPORT_DESTINATION_UNSAFE")
		}
		return nil, ProjectExportPlan{}, errors.New("EXPORT_DESTINATION_EXISTS")
	}
	output, err := namedExportObservation(observation, name)
	if err != nil {
		capability.Close()
		return nil, ProjectExportPlan{}, err
	}
	plan := projectExportPlan(sourceDisplay, destDisplay, name, capability.sourceIdentity, capability.destIdentity, output, observation.revision)
	// The capability retains only integrity metadata between preview and
	// commit. Exact bytes are re-read through the held source authority during
	// Commit, after the source has been proven unchanged.
	capability.plan, capability.manifest = plan, exportObservationMetadata(observation)
	return capability, cloneProjectExportPlan(plan), nil
}

func (export *ProjectExport) Plan() ProjectExportPlan { return cloneProjectExportPlan(export.plan) }

func (export *ProjectExport) Close() {
	if export == nil || export.closed {
		return
	}
	export.closed = true
	if export.source != nil {
		export.source.close()
	}
	if export.destination != nil {
		export.destination.close()
	}
}

func (export *ProjectExport) Commit(planDigest string) (result ProjectExportResult) {
	result = ProjectExportResult{APIVersion: projectExportAPIVersion, Kind: "ProjectExportResult", Status: "FAILED", ErrorCode: "EXPORT_PLAN_STALE"}
	if export == nil || export.closed || planDigest == "" || planDigest != export.plan.PlanDigest {
		return result
	}
	defer export.Close()
	if export.source.identity() != export.sourceIdentity || export.destination.identity() != export.destIdentity {
		result.ErrorCode = "PROJECT_CHANGED"
		return result
	}
	observation, err := stableExportObservation(export.source)
	if err != nil {
		result.ErrorCode = exportErrorCode(err, "PROJECT_CHANGED")
		return result
	}
	if !sameExportObservation(observation, export.manifest) {
		result.ErrorCode = "EXPORT_PLAN_STALE"
		return result
	}
	output, err := namedExportObservation(observation, export.directoryName)
	if err != nil {
		result.ErrorCode = exportErrorCode(err, "EXPORT_SOURCE_UNSAFE")
		return result
	}
	if exists, existErr := export.destination.exists(export.directoryName); existErr != nil || exists {
		if existErr != nil {
			result.ErrorCode = "EXPORT_DESTINATION_UNSAFE"
		} else {
			result.ErrorCode = "EXPORT_DESTINATION_EXISTS"
		}
		return result
	}
	staging, stagingName, err := export.destination.createStaging(export.directoryName)
	if err != nil {
		result.ErrorCode = "EXPORT_WRITE_FAILED"
		return result
	}
	published := false
	defer func() {
		if !published {
			if cleanupErr := export.destination.removeOwnedTree(staging, stagingName); cleanupErr != nil {
				result.ErrorCode = exportErrorCode(cleanupErr, "EXPORT_STAGING_RETAINED")
			}
		}
		staging.close()
	}()
	write := writeExportObservation
	if export.writeObservation != nil {
		write = export.writeObservation
	}
	if err := write(staging, output); err != nil {
		result.ErrorCode = exportErrorCode(err, "EXPORT_WRITE_FAILED")
		return result
	}
	if err := verifyExportObservation(staging, output); err != nil {
		result.ErrorCode = "EXPORT_WRITE_FAILED"
		return result
	}
	finalObservation, err := stableExportObservation(export.source)
	if err != nil || !sameExportObservation(finalObservation, export.manifest) || export.source.identity() != export.sourceIdentity {
		result.ErrorCode = "PROJECT_CHANGED"
		return result
	}
	if exists, existErr := export.destination.exists(export.directoryName); existErr != nil || exists {
		if existErr != nil {
			result.ErrorCode = "EXPORT_DESTINATION_UNSAFE"
		} else {
			result.ErrorCode = "EXPORT_DESTINATION_EXISTS"
		}
		return result
	}
	if err := export.destination.publish(staging, stagingName, export.directoryName); err != nil {
		result.ErrorCode = "EXPORT_PUBLISH_FAILED"
		return result
	}
	published = true
	return ProjectExportResult{APIVersion: projectExportAPIVersion, Kind: "ProjectExportResult", Status: "EXPORTED", DestinationRoot: filepath.Join(export.destDisplay, export.directoryName), SourceProjectRevision: observation.revision, DocumentCount: len(output.documents), AggregateSize: output.total}
}

type exportRecord struct {
	ProjectExportDocument
	identity exportFileIdentity
	content  []byte
}

type exportObservation struct {
	documents []exportRecord
	revision  string
	total     int64
}

func exportObservationMetadata(observation exportObservation) exportObservation {
	metadata := exportObservation{
		documents: make([]exportRecord, len(observation.documents)),
		revision:  observation.revision,
		total:     observation.total,
	}
	for index, record := range observation.documents {
		metadata.documents[index] = exportRecord{
			ProjectExportDocument: record.ProjectExportDocument,
			identity:              record.identity,
		}
	}
	return metadata
}

func stableExportObservation(root *exportDirectory) (exportObservation, error) {
	first, err := observeExportProject(root)
	if err != nil {
		return exportObservation{}, err
	}
	second, err := observeExportProject(root)
	if err != nil {
		return exportObservation{}, err
	}
	if !sameExportObservation(first, second) {
		return exportObservation{}, errors.New("PROJECT_CHANGED")
	}
	return second, nil
}

func observeExportProject(root *exportDirectory) (exportObservation, error) {
	if root == nil || root.identity().empty() {
		return exportObservation{}, errors.New("EXPORT_SOURCE_UNSAFE")
	}
	result := exportObservation{}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	caseFolded := map[string]bool{}
	for _, logical := range []string{"project.yml", "ansible.cfg", "inventory/hosts.yml"} {
		if err := addExportDocument(root, logical, &result, seen, caseFolded); err != nil {
			if isExportNotExist(err) {
				continue
			}
			return exportObservation{}, err
		}
	}
	for _, logical := range []string{"inventory/group_vars", "inventory/host_vars", "application-packages", "library-packages"} {
		directory, err := root.openDirectory(strings.Split(logical, "/"))
		if isExportNotExist(err) {
			continue
		}
		if err != nil {
			return exportObservation{}, errors.New("EXPORT_SOURCE_UNSAFE")
		}
		err = collectExportDirectory(directory, logical, &result, seen, caseFolded)
		directory.close()
		if err != nil {
			return exportObservation{}, err
		}
	}
	if err := validateExportPackages(result.documents); err != nil {
		return exportObservation{}, err
	}
	sort.Slice(result.documents, func(left, right int) bool {
		return result.documents[left].LogicalPath < result.documents[right].LogicalPath
	})
	result.revision = exportContentRevision(result.documents)
	return result, nil
}

func exportContentRevision(documents []exportRecord) string {
	var revisionInput []byte
	for _, document := range documents {
		if document.LogicalPath == generatedDocument {
			continue
		}
		revisionInput = append(revisionInput, []byte(document.LogicalPath)...)
		revisionInput = append(revisionInput, 0)
		revisionInput = append(revisionInput, []byte(document.Digest)...)
		revisionInput = append(revisionInput, 0)
	}
	return digestBytes(revisionInput)
}

func collectExportDirectory(directory *exportDirectory, prefix string, result *exportObservation, seen, caseFolded map[string]bool) error {
	entries, err := directory.entries()
	if err != nil {
		return errors.New("EXPORT_SOURCE_UNSAFE")
	}
	for _, entry := range entries {
		logical := prefix + "/" + entry.name
		if !safeExportLogicalPath(logical) {
			return errors.New("EXPORT_SOURCE_UNSAFE")
		}
		switch entry.kind {
		case exportEntryDirectory:
			child, openErr := directory.openDirectory([]string{entry.name})
			if openErr != nil {
				return errors.New("EXPORT_SOURCE_UNSAFE")
			}
			recurseErr := collectExportDirectory(child, logical, result, seen, caseFolded)
			child.close()
			if recurseErr != nil {
				return recurseErr
			}
		case exportEntryRegular:
			if logical == generatedDocument {
				continue
			}
			extension := strings.ToLower(path.Ext(entry.name))
			if strings.HasPrefix(logical, "application-packages/") || strings.HasPrefix(logical, "library-packages/") || extension == ".yml" || extension == ".yaml" || extension == ".json" {
				if strings.HasPrefix(logical, "application-packages/") || strings.HasPrefix(logical, "library-packages/") {
					if !safeApplicationPackagePath(logical) {
						return errors.New("APPLICATION_PACKAGE_PATH_INVALID")
					}
				}
				if err := addExportDocument(directory, entry.name, result, seen, caseFolded, logical); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
		default:
			return errors.New("EXPORT_SOURCE_UNSAFE")
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func addExportDocument(root *exportDirectory, logical string, result *exportObservation, seen, caseFolded map[string]bool, explicit ...string) error {
	parts := strings.Split(logical, "/")
	storedLogical := logical
	if len(explicit) == 1 {
		storedLogical = explicit[0]
	}
	if !safeExportLogicalPath(storedLogical) {
		return errors.New("EXPORT_SOURCE_UNSAFE")
	}
	if seen[storedLogical] || caseFolded[strings.ToLower(storedLogical)] {
		return errors.New("EXPORT_SOURCE_UNSAFE")
	}
	limit := maxExportFileBytes
	if safeApplicationPackagePath(storedLogical) {
		limit = maxApplicationPackageFileBytes
	}
	content, identity, err := root.readFile(parts, limit)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if len(result.documents) >= maxExportFiles || result.total > maxExportTotalBytes-int64(len(content)) {
		return errors.New("EXPORT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED")
	}
	seen[storedLogical], caseFolded[strings.ToLower(storedLogical)] = true, true
	record := exportRecord{ProjectExportDocument: ProjectExportDocument{LogicalPath: storedLogical, Size: int64(len(content)), Digest: digestBytes(content)}, identity: identity, content: content}
	result.documents = append(result.documents, record)
	result.total += int64(len(content))
	return nil
}

func safeExportLogicalPath(logical string) bool {
	if logical == "" || len([]byte(logical)) > maxExportLogicalBytes || strings.Contains(logical, "\\") || path.Clean(logical) != logical || strings.HasPrefix(logical, "/") {
		return false
	}
	for _, part := range strings.Split(logical, "/") {
		if part == "" || part == "." || part == ".." {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func sameExportObservation(left, right exportObservation) bool {
	if left.revision != right.revision || left.total != right.total || len(left.documents) != len(right.documents) {
		return false
	}
	for index := range left.documents {
		leftDocument, rightDocument := left.documents[index], right.documents[index]
		if leftDocument.LogicalPath != rightDocument.LogicalPath || leftDocument.Size != rightDocument.Size || leftDocument.Digest != rightDocument.Digest || leftDocument.identity != rightDocument.identity {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func sameExportContentObservation(left, right exportObservation) bool {
	if left.revision != right.revision || left.total != right.total || len(left.documents) != len(right.documents) {
		return false
	}
	for index := range left.documents {
		leftDocument, rightDocument := left.documents[index], right.documents[index]
		if leftDocument.LogicalPath != rightDocument.LogicalPath || leftDocument.Size != rightDocument.Size || leftDocument.Digest != rightDocument.Digest {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func projectExportPlan(sourceRoot, destinationParent, name string, sourceIdentity, destinationIdentity exportIdentity, observation exportObservation, sourceRevision string) ProjectExportPlan {
	documents := make([]ProjectExportDocument, len(observation.documents))
	for index, document := range observation.documents {
		documents[index] = document.ProjectExportDocument
	}
	plan := ProjectExportPlan{APIVersion: projectExportAPIVersion, Kind: "ProjectExportPlan", SourceProjectRoot: sourceRoot, SourceProjectRevision: sourceRevision, DestinationParent: destinationParent, DirectoryName: name, DestinationRoot: filepath.Join(destinationParent, name), Documents: documents, AggregateSize: observation.total, ExcludedCategories: []string{"DRAFT", "RUNTIME_CREDENTIALS", "GENERATED_STATE", "RUNTIME_STATE", "PLANS", "FACTS", "LOGS", "RESULTS", "VERIFICATION_EVIDENCE"}}
	input := []byte(plan.APIVersion + "\x00" + sourceIdentity.String() + "\x00" + destinationIdentity.String() + "\x00" + plan.SourceProjectRevision + "\x00" + plan.DestinationRoot + "\x00")
	for _, document := range documents {
		input = append(input, []byte(document.LogicalPath)...)
		input = append(input, 0)
		input = append(input, []byte(document.Digest)...)
		input = append(input, 0)
		input = append(input, []byte(strconv.FormatInt(document.Size, 10))...)
		input = append(input, 0)
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256(input)
	plan.PlanDigest = "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
	return plan
}

func cloneProjectExportPlan(plan ProjectExportPlan) ProjectExportPlan {
	plan.Documents = append([]ProjectExportDocument(nil), plan.Documents...)
	plan.ExcludedCategories = append([]string(nil), plan.ExcludedCategories...)
	return plan
}

func absoluteExportDisplayPath(value string) (string, error) {
	if value == "" {
		return "", errors.New("invalid path")
	}
	absolute, err := filepath.Abs(value)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return filepath.Clean(absolute), nil
}

func rootsOverlap(left, right string) bool {
	leftToRight, leftErr := filepath.Rel(left, right)
	rightToLeft, rightErr := filepath.Rel(right, left)
	leftContainsRight := leftErr == nil && (leftToRight == "." || (leftToRight != ".." && !strings.HasPrefix(leftToRight, ".."+string(filepath.Separator))))
	rightContainsLeft := rightErr == nil && (rightToLeft == "." || (rightToLeft != ".." && !strings.HasPrefix(rightToLeft, ".."+string(filepath.Separator))))
	return leftContainsRight || rightContainsLeft
}

func writeExportObservation(staging *exportDirectory, observation exportObservation) error {
	created := map[string]*exportDirectory{"": staging}
	defer func() {
		for logical, directory := range created {
			if logical != "" {
				directory.close()
			}
		}
	}()
	for _, document := range observation.documents {
		parent := path.Dir(document.LogicalPath)
		directory, err := ensureExportDirectory(staging, parent, created)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := directory.writeFile(path.Base(document.LogicalPath), document.content); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func ensureExportDirectory(root *exportDirectory, logical string, created map[string]*exportDirectory) (*exportDirectory, error) {
	if logical == "." || logical == "" {
		return root, nil
	}
	current, currentLogical := root, ""
	for _, part := range strings.Split(logical, "/") {
		if currentLogical == "" {
			currentLogical = part
		} else {
			currentLogical += "/" + part
		}
		if known, ok := created[currentLogical]; ok {
			current = known
			continue
		}
		next, err := current.createDirectory(part)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		created[currentLogical], current = next, next
	}
	return current, nil
}

func verifyExportObservation(staging *exportDirectory, expected exportObservation) error {
	actual, err := observeExportProject(staging)
	if err != nil || !sameExportContentObservation(actual, expected) {
		return errors.New("EXPORT_WRITE_FAILED")
	}
	return nil
}

func exportErrorCode(err error, fallback string) string {
	if err == nil {
		return fallback
	}
	for _, code := range []string{"PROJECT_CHANGED", "EXPORT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED", "EXPORT_SOURCE_UNSAFE", "EXPORT_DESTINATION_UNSAFE", "EXPORT_WRITE_FAILED", "EXPORT_STAGING_RETAINED"} {
		if err.Error() == code {
			return code
		}
	}
	return fallback
}

package installer

import (
	"crypto/rand"
	"encoding/hex"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
	"strings"

	"golang.org/x/sys/unix"
)

type exportIdentity struct {
	device uint64
	inode  uint64
}

func (identity exportIdentity) empty() bool { return identity.device == 0 && identity.inode == 0 }
func (identity exportIdentity) String() string {
	return hex.EncodeToString([]byte{byte(identity.device), byte(identity.device >> 8), byte(identity.device >> 16), byte(identity.device >> 24), byte(identity.device >> 32), byte(identity.device >> 40), byte(identity.device >> 48), byte(identity.device >> 56), byte(identity.inode), byte(identity.inode >> 8), byte(identity.inode >> 16), byte(identity.inode >> 24), byte(identity.inode >> 32), byte(identity.inode >> 40), byte(identity.inode >> 48), byte(identity.inode >> 56)})
}

type exportFileIdentity struct {
	exportIdentity
	links uint64
}

type exportDirectory struct{ fd int }

type exportEntryKind uint8

const (
	exportEntryDirectory exportEntryKind = iota + 1
	exportEntryRegular
)

type exportEntry struct {
	name string
	kind exportEntryKind
}

func openExportSourceDirectory(root string) (*exportDirectory, error) {
	return openExportUnixRoot(root)
}
func openExportDestinationDirectory(root string) (*exportDirectory, error) {
	return openExportUnixRoot(root)
}

func openExportUnixRoot(root string) (*exportDirectory, error) {
	if !filepath.IsAbs(root) {
		return nil, errors.New("unsafe export root")
	}
	fd, err := unix.Open("/", unix.O_RDONLY|unix.O_DIRECTORY|unix.O_NOFOLLOW|unix.O_CLOEXEC, 0)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	directory := &exportDirectory{fd: fd}
	if err := directory.verify(); err != nil {
		directory.close()
		return nil, err
	}
	relative := strings.TrimPrefix(filepath.Clean(root), string(filepath.Separator))
	if relative == "" {
		directory.close()
		return nil, errors.New("unsafe export root")
	}
	opened, err := directory.openDirectory(strings.Split(relative, string(filepath.Separator)))
	directory.close()
	return opened, err
}

func (directory *exportDirectory) close() {
	if directory != nil && directory.fd >= 0 {
		_ = unix.Close(directory.fd)
		directory.fd = -1
	}
}

func (directory *exportDirectory) verify() error {
	var stat unix.Stat_t
	if directory == nil || directory.fd < 0 || unix.Fstat(directory.fd, &stat) != nil || stat.Mode&unix.S_IFMT != unix.S_IFDIR {
		return errors.New("unsafe export directory")
	}
	return nil
}

func (directory *exportDirectory) identity() exportIdentity {
	var stat unix.Stat_t
	if directory == nil || directory.fd < 0 || unix.Fstat(directory.fd, &stat) != nil {
		return exportIdentity{}
	}
	return exportIdentity{device: uint64(stat.Dev), inode: stat.Ino}
}

func (directory *exportDirectory) openDirectory(parts []string) (*exportDirectory, error) {
	if directory == nil || directory.fd < 0 {
		return nil, errors.New("unsafe export directory")
	}
	current, owned := directory.fd, false
	for _, part := range parts {
		next, err := unix.Openat(current, part, unix.O_RDONLY|unix.O_DIRECTORY|unix.O_NOFOLLOW|unix.O_CLOEXEC, 0)
		if err != nil {
			if owned {
				_ = unix.Close(current)
			}
			return nil, exportUnixNotExist(err)
		}
		if owned {
			_ = unix.Close(current)
		}
		current, owned = next, true
	}
	if !owned {
		return nil, errors.New("unsafe export directory")
	}
	child := &exportDirectory{fd: current}
	if err := child.verify(); err != nil {
		child.close()
		return nil, err
	}
	return child, nil
}

func (directory *exportDirectory) entries() ([]exportEntry, error) {
	duplicate, err := unix.Dup(directory.fd)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	file := os.NewFile(uintptr(duplicate), "export-directory")
	if file == nil {
		_ = unix.Close(duplicate)
		return nil, errors.New("unsafe export directory")
	}
	entries, err := file.ReadDir(maxExportDirectoryEntries + 1)
	closeErr := file.Close()
	if (err != nil && !errors.Is(err, io.EOF)) || closeErr != nil || len(entries) > maxExportDirectoryEntries {
		return nil, errors.New("unsafe export directory")
	}
	result := make([]exportEntry, 0, len(entries))
	for _, entry := range entries {
		name := entry.Name()
		if name == "" || name == "." || name == ".." {
			return nil, errors.New("unsafe export directory")
		}
		child, directoryErr := directory.openDirectory([]string{name})
		if directoryErr == nil {
			child.close()
			result = append(result, exportEntry{name: name, kind: exportEntryDirectory})
			continue
		}
		fd, fileErr := unix.Openat(directory.fd, name, unix.O_RDONLY|unix.O_NOFOLLOW|unix.O_CLOEXEC, 0)
		if fileErr != nil {
			return nil, errors.New("unsafe export directory")
		}
		var stat unix.Stat_t
		valid := unix.Fstat(fd, &stat) == nil && stat.Mode&unix.S_IFMT == unix.S_IFREG
		_ = unix.Close(fd)
		if !valid {
			return nil, errors.New("unsafe export directory")
		}
		result = append(result, exportEntry{name: name, kind: exportEntryRegular})
	}
	sort.Slice(result, func(left, right int) bool { return result[left].name < result[right].name })
	return result, nil
}

func (directory *exportDirectory) readFile(parts []string, limit int64) ([]byte, exportFileIdentity, error) {
	if len(parts) == 0 {
		return nil, exportFileIdentity{}, errors.New("unsafe export file")
	}
	parent := directory
	var owned *exportDirectory
	if len(parts) > 1 {
		var err error
		owned, err = directory.openDirectory(parts[:len(parts)-1])
		if err != nil {
			return nil, exportFileIdentity{}, err
		}
		defer owned.close()
		parent = owned
	}
	fd, err := unix.Openat(parent.fd, parts[len(parts)-1], unix.O_RDONLY|unix.O_NOFOLLOW|unix.O_CLOEXEC, 0)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, exportFileIdentity{}, exportUnixNotExist(err)
	}
	file := os.NewFile(uintptr(fd), parts[len(parts)-1])
	if file == nil {
		_ = unix.Close(fd)
		return nil, exportFileIdentity{}, errors.New("unsafe export file")
	}
	defer file.Close()
	identity, size, err := exportUnixFileIdentity(fd)
	if err != nil || identity.links != 1 {
		return nil, exportFileIdentity{}, errors.New("unsafe export file")
	}
	if size > limit {
		return nil, exportFileIdentity{}, errors.New("EXPORT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED")
	}
	data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, limit+1))
	if err != nil || int64(len(data)) != size {
		return nil, exportFileIdentity{}, errors.New("unsafe export file")
	}
	after, afterSize, afterErr := exportUnixFileIdentity(fd)
	if afterErr != nil || after != identity || afterSize != size {
		return nil, exportFileIdentity{}, errors.New("PROJECT_CHANGED")
	}
	return data, identity, nil
}

func (directory *exportDirectory) exists(name string) (bool, error) {
	child, directoryErr := directory.openDirectory([]string{name})
	if directoryErr == nil {
		child.close()
		return true, nil
	}
	fd, fileErr := unix.Openat(directory.fd, name, unix.O_RDONLY|unix.O_NOFOLLOW|unix.O_CLOEXEC, 0)
	if fileErr == nil {
		_ = unix.Close(fd)
		return true, nil
	}
	if isExportNotExist(exportUnixNotExist(directoryErr)) && isExportNotExist(exportUnixNotExist(fileErr)) {
		return false, nil
	}
	return false, errors.New("unsafe export destination")
}

func (directory *exportDirectory) createStaging(_ string) (*exportDirectory, string, error) {
	for attempt := 0; attempt < 16; attempt++ {
		value := make([]byte, 12)
		if _, err := rand.Read(value); err != nil {
			return nil, "", err
		}
		name := ".platform-export-" + hex.EncodeToString(value)
		if err := unix.Mkdirat(directory.fd, name, 0o700); err == nil {
			staging, openErr := directory.openDirectory([]string{name})
			if openErr != nil {
				return nil, "", openErr
			}
			return staging, name, nil
		} else if !errors.Is(err, unix.EEXIST) {
			return nil, "", err
		}
	}
	return nil, "", errors.New("staging name collision")
}

func (directory *exportDirectory) createDirectory(name string) (*exportDirectory, error) {
	if err := unix.Mkdirat(directory.fd, name, 0o700); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return directory.openDirectory([]string{name})
}

func (directory *exportDirectory) writeFile(name string, content []byte) error {
	fd, err := unix.Openat(directory.fd, name, unix.O_WRONLY|unix.O_CREAT|unix.O_EXCL|unix.O_NOFOLLOW|unix.O_CLOEXEC, 0o600)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	file := os.NewFile(uintptr(fd), name)
	if file == nil {
		_ = unix.Close(fd)
		return errors.New("unsafe export file")
	}
	if _, err := file.Write(content); err != nil {
		_ = file.Close()
		return err
	}
	if err := file.Sync(); err != nil {
		_ = file.Close()
		return err
	}
	return file.Close()
}

func (directory *exportDirectory) publish(_ *exportDirectory, stagingName, destination string) error {
	return unix.Renameat2(directory.fd, stagingName, directory.fd, destination, unix.RENAME_NOREPLACE)
}

func (directory *exportDirectory) removeOwnedTree(staging *exportDirectory, stagingName string) error {
	linked, err := directory.openDirectory([]string{stagingName})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	linkedIdentity, stagingIdentity := linked.identity(), staging.identity()
	linked.close()
	if linkedIdentity != stagingIdentity {
		return errors.New("EXPORT_STAGING_RETAINED")
	}
	// Linux has no unlink-by-open-directory-handle primitive. A pathname-based
	// recursive cleanup could delete a sibling swapped in after the identity
	// check above, so fail closed and leave staging for operator cleanup.
	return errors.New("EXPORT_STAGING_RETAINED")
}

func exportUnixFileIdentity(fd int) (exportFileIdentity, int64, error) {
	var stat unix.Stat_t
	if err := unix.Fstat(fd, &stat); err != nil || stat.Mode&unix.S_IFMT != unix.S_IFREG {
		return exportFileIdentity{}, 0, errors.New("unsafe export file")
	}
	return exportFileIdentity{exportIdentity: exportIdentity{device: uint64(stat.Dev), inode: stat.Ino}, links: uint64(stat.Nlink)}, stat.Size, nil
}

func exportUnixNotExist(err error) error {
	if errors.Is(err, unix.ENOENT) || errors.Is(err, unix.ENOTDIR) {
		return os.ErrNotExist
	}
	return err
}

func isExportNotExist(err error) bool { return errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) }

func openExportWindowsRoot(root string, access uint32) (*exportDirectory, error) {
	volume := filepath.VolumeName(root)
	if volume == "" || strings.HasPrefix(volume, `\\`) {
		return nil, errors.New("unsafe export root")
	}
	logicalAnchor := volume + "\\"
	anchor := `\\?\` + logicalAnchor
	pointer, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(anchor)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	// A drive root is the trusted, non-replaceable traversal anchor. It is not a
	// reparse point itself, so avoid OPEN_REPARSE_POINT here; every untrusted
	// component below it is opened with the no-follow relative helper.
	handle, err := windows.CreateFile(pointer, windows.FILE_GENERIC_READ, windows.FILE_SHARE_READ|windows.FILE_SHARE_WRITE|windows.FILE_SHARE_DELETE, nil, windows.OPEN_EXISTING, windows.FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS, 0)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	directory := &exportDirectory{handle: handle}
	if err := directory.verify(); err != nil {
		directory.close()
		return nil, err
	}
	relative, err := filepath.Rel(logicalAnchor, root)
	if err != nil || relative == "." || relative == ".." || strings.HasPrefix(relative, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)) {
		directory.close()
		return nil, errors.New("unsafe export root")
	}
	components := strings.Split(relative, string(filepath.Separator))
	opened, err := directory.openDirectoryWithAccess(components, access)
	directory.close()
	return opened, err
}

func (directory *exportDirectory) close() {
	if directory != nil && directory.handle != 0 {
		_ = windows.CloseHandle(directory.handle)
		directory.handle = 0
	}
}

func (directory *exportDirectory) verify() error {
	var info windows.ByHandleFileInformation
	if directory == nil || directory.handle == 0 || windows.GetFileInformationByHandle(directory.handle, &info) != nil || info.FileAttributes&windows.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT != 0 || info.FileAttributes&windows.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY == 0 {
		return errors.New("unsafe export directory")
	}
	return nil
}

func (directory *exportDirectory) identity() exportIdentity {
	var info windows.ByHandleFileInformation
	if directory == nil || directory.handle == 0 || windows.GetFileInformationByHandle(directory.handle, &info) != nil {
		return exportIdentity{}
	}
	return exportIdentity{volume: info.VolumeSerialNumber, index: uint64(info.FileIndexHigh)<<32 | uint64(info.FileIndexLow)}
}

func (directory *exportDirectory) openDirectoryWithAccess(parts []string, access uint32) (*exportDirectory, error) {
	if directory == nil || directory.handle == 0 {
		return nil, errors.New("unsafe export directory")
	}
	current := directory.handle
	owned := false
	for index, part := range parts {
		partAccess := uint32(windows.FILE_GENERIC_READ)
		if index == len(parts)-1 {
			partAccess = access
		}
		next, err := openExportWindowsRelative(current, part, true, partAccess, windows.FILE_OPEN)
		if err != nil {
			if owned {
				_ = windows.CloseHandle(current)
			}
			return nil, exportWindowsNotExist(err)
		}
		if owned {
			_ = windows.CloseHandle(current)
		}
		current, owned = next, true
	}
	if !owned {
		return nil, errors.New("unsafe export directory")
	}
	return &exportDirectory{handle: current}, nil
}

	if err != nil {
		return nil, err

		_ = windows.CloseHandle(duplicate)
		return nil, errors.New("unsafe export directory")
	}
	entries, err := file.ReadDir(maxExportDirectoryEntries + 1)
	closeErr := file.Close()
	if (err != nil && !errors.Is(err, io.EOF)) || closeErr != nil || len(entries) > maxExportDirectoryEntries {
		return nil, errors.New("unsafe export directory")
	}
	result := make([]exportEntry, 0, len(entries))
	for _, entry := range entries {
		name := entry.Name()
		if name == "" || name == "." || name == ".." {
			return nil, errors.New("unsafe export directory")
		}
		child, directoryErr := openExportWindowsRelative(directory.handle, name, true, windows.FILE_GENERIC_READ, windows.FILE_OPEN)
		if directoryErr == nil {
			_ = windows.CloseHandle(child)
			result = append(result, exportEntry{name: name, kind: exportEntryDirectory})
			continue
		}
		child, fileErr := openExportWindowsRelative(directory.handle, name, false, windows.FILE_GENERIC_READ, windows.FILE_OPEN)
		if fileErr != nil {
			return nil, errors.New("unsafe export directory")
		}
		_ = windows.CloseHandle(child)
		result = append(result, exportEntry{name: name, kind: exportEntryRegular})
	}
	sort.Slice(result, func(left, right int) bool { return result[left].name < result[right].name })
	return result, nil

func (directory *exportDirectory) publish(staging *exportDirectory, _ string, destination string) error {
	name, err := windows.UTF16FromString(destination)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	type renameHeader struct {
		ReplaceIfExists byte
		_               [7]byte
		RootDirectory   windows.Handle
		FileNameLength  uint32
		FileName        uint16
	}
	headerSize := int(unsafe.Offsetof(renameHeader{}.FileName))
	buffer := make([]byte, headerSize+len(name)*2)
	header := (*renameHeader)(unsafe.Pointer(&buffer[0]))
	header.RootDirectory = directory.handle
	header.FileNameLength = uint32((len(name) - 1) * 2)
	copy(buffer[headerSize:], unsafe.Slice((*byte)(unsafe.Pointer(&name[0])), len(name)*2))
	var status windows.IO_STATUS_BLOCK
	// SetFileInformationByHandle(FileRenameInfo) rejects a non-nil
	// RootDirectory on current Windows despite the documented relative-name
	// shape. NtSetInformationFile's FileRenameInformation class preserves the
	// retained parent-handle authority required by UI-01I.
	return windows.NtSetInformationFile(staging.handle, &status, &buffer[0], uint32(len(buffer)), 10)
}

func (directory *exportDirectory) removeOwnedTree(staging *exportDirectory, _ string) error {
	if staging == nil || staging.identity().empty() {
		return nil
	}
	if err := removeExportWindowsDirectory(staging); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return markExportWindowsDelete(staging.handle)
}

func removeExportWindowsDirectory(directory *exportDirectory) error {
	entries, err := directory.entries()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, entry := range entries {
		if entry.kind == exportEntryDirectory {
			child, openErr := directory.openDirectory([]string{entry.name})
			if openErr != nil {
				return openErr
			}
			err = removeExportWindowsDirectory(child)
			if err == nil {
				err = markExportWindowsDelete(child.handle)
			}
			child.close()
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			continue
		}
		handle, openErr := openExportWindowsRelative(directory.handle, entry.name, false, windows.DELETE, windows.FILE_OPEN)
		if openErr != nil {
			return openErr
		}
		err = markExportWindowsDelete(handle)
		_ = windows.CloseHandle(handle)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func markExportWindowsDelete(handle windows.Handle) error {
	buffer := []byte{1}
	return windows.SetFileInformationByHandle(handle, windows.FileDispositionInfo, &buffer[0], uint32(len(buffer)))
}

func openExportWindowsRelative(root windows.Handle, name string, directory bool, access, disposition uint32) (windows.Handle, error) {
	nameValue, err := windows.NewNTUnicodeString(name)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	options := uint32(windows.FILE_SYNCHRONOUS_IO_NONALERT | windows.FILE_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT)
	if directory {
		options |= windows.FILE_DIRECTORY_FILE
	} else {
		options |= windows.FILE_NON_DIRECTORY_FILE
	}
	object := windows.OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES{Length: uint32(unsafe.Sizeof(windows.OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES{})), RootDirectory: root, ObjectName: nameValue, Attributes: windows.OBJ_CASE_INSENSITIVE | windows.OBJ_DONT_REPARSE}
	var handle windows.Handle
	var status windows.IO_STATUS_BLOCK
	if err := windows.NtCreateFile(&handle, access, &object, &status, nil, 0, windows.FILE_SHARE_READ|windows.FILE_SHARE_WRITE|windows.FILE_SHARE_DELETE, disposition, options, 0, 0); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	if err := verifyExportWindowsHandle(handle, directory); err != nil {
		_ = windows.CloseHandle(handle)
		return 0, err
	}
	return handle, nil
}

func verifyExportWindowsHandle(handle windows.Handle, directory bool) error {
	var info windows.ByHandleFileInformation
	if err := windows.GetFileInformationByHandle(handle, &info); err != nil || info.FileAttributes&windows.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT != 0 || (info.FileAttributes&windows.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY != 0) != directory {
		return errors.New("unsafe export object")
	}
	return nil
}

func exportWindowsFileIdentity(handle windows.Handle) (exportFileIdentity, int64, error) {
	var info windows.ByHandleFileInformation
	if err := windows.GetFileInformationByHandle(handle, &info); err != nil || info.FileAttributes&windows.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT != 0 || info.FileAttributes&windows.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY != 0 {
		return exportFileIdentity{}, 0, errors.New("unsafe export file")
	}
	identity := exportFileIdentity{exportIdentity: exportIdentity{volume: info.VolumeSerialNumber, index: uint64(info.FileIndexHigh)<<32 | uint64(info.FileIndexLow)}, links: info.NumberOfLinks}
	return identity, int64(uint64(info.FileSizeHigh)<<32 | uint64(info.FileSizeLow)), nil
}

func duplicateExportWindowsHandle(handle windows.Handle) (windows.Handle, error) {
	var duplicate windows.Handle
	err := windows.DuplicateHandle(windows.CurrentProcess(), handle, windows.CurrentProcess(), &duplicate, 0, false, windows.DUPLICATE_SAME_ACCESS)
	return duplicate, err
}

func exportWindowsNotExist(err error) error {
	if err == windows.ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND || err == windows.ERROR_PATH_NOT_FOUND || err == windows.STATUS_OBJECT_NAME_NOT_FOUND || err == windows.STATUS_OBJECT_PATH_NOT_FOUND || errors.Is(err, windows.ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND) || errors.Is(err, windows.ERROR_PATH_NOT_FOUND) || errors.Is(err, windows.STATUS_OBJECT_NAME_NOT_FOUND) || errors.Is(err, windows.STATUS_OBJECT_PATH_NOT_FOUND) {
		return os.ErrNotExist
	}
	return err
}

func isExportNotExist(err error) bool { return errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) }

func digestBytes(content []byte) string {
	sum := sha256.Sum256(content)
	return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])

func cleanRoot(root string) (string, error) {
	absolute, err := filepath.Abs(root)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	absolute = filepath.Clean(absolute)
	if err := assertSafeExistingAncestors(absolute); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	info, err := os.Lstat(absolute)
	if err != nil || !info.IsDir() || pathEntryUnsafe(info) {
		return "", blocked("PROJECT_PATH_INVALID", "Project root is not a directory", "projectRoot")
	}
	return absolute, nil
}

func assertSafeExistingAncestors(path string) error {
	for current := filepath.Clean(path); ; current = filepath.Dir(current) {
		info, err := os.Lstat(current)
		if err != nil {
			return blocked("PROJECT_PATH_INVALID", "Project path cannot be inspected", "projectRoot")
		}
		if pathEntryUnsafe(info) {
			return blocked("PATH_UNSAFE", "Project path contains a symlink or reparse point", "projectRoot")
		}
		parent := filepath.Dir(current)
		if parent == current {
			return nil
		}
	}
}

func logicalPath(path string) string { return filepath.ToSlash(path) }

func safeProjectPath(root, logical string, allowMissing bool) (string, error) {
	if logical == "" || filepath.IsAbs(logical) || filepath.VolumeName(logical) != "" {
		return "", blocked("PATH_UNSAFE", "Managed document path is unsafe", "document.logicalPath")
	}
	clean := filepath.Clean(filepath.FromSlash(logical))
	if clean == "." || clean == ".." || strings.HasPrefix(clean, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)) {
		return "", blocked("PATH_UNSAFE", "Managed document path escapes the project", "document.logicalPath")
	}
	path := filepath.Join(root, clean)
	relative, err := filepath.Rel(root, path)
	if err != nil || relative == ".." || strings.HasPrefix(relative, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)) {
		return "", blocked("PATH_UNSAFE", "Managed document path escapes the project", "document.logicalPath")
	}
	current := root
	parts := strings.Split(filepath.ToSlash(clean), "/")
	for index, part := range parts {
		current = filepath.Join(current, part)
		info, statErr := os.Lstat(current)
		if statErr != nil {
			if os.IsNotExist(statErr) && allowMissing {
				break
			}
			return "", blocked("WRITE_OWNERSHIP_REQUIRED", "Installer-owned document does not exist", "document")
		}
		if pathEntryUnsafe(info) {
			return "", blocked("PATH_UNSAFE", "Managed document path contains a symlink or reparse point", "document.logicalPath")
		}
		if index < len(parts)-1 && !info.IsDir() {
			return "", blocked("PATH_UNSAFE", "Managed document parent is not a directory", "document.logicalPath")
		}
	}
	return path, nil
}

func collectProjectDocuments(root string) ([]projectDocument, string, error) {
	candidates := []string{"project.yml", "ansible.cfg", "inventory/hosts.yml"}
	packageDocuments, err := applicationPackageDocuments(root)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, "", err
	}
	packageContents := map[string][]byte{}
	for _, record := range packageDocuments {
		candidates = append(candidates, record.LogicalPath)
		packageContents[record.LogicalPath] = record.content
	}
	for _, directory := range []string{"inventory/group_vars", "inventory/host_vars"} {
		base := filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(directory))
		if _, err := os.Stat(base); os.IsNotExist(err) {
			continue
		}
		err := filepath.WalkDir(base, func(path string, entry os.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
			if walkErr != nil {
				return walkErr
			}
			if entry.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
				return blocked("PATH_UNSAFE", "Canonical project documents must not contain symlinks", "project")
			}
			if entry.IsDir() {
				return nil
			}
			extension := strings.ToLower(filepath.Ext(entry.Name()))
			if extension != ".yml" && extension != ".yaml" && extension != ".json" {
				return nil
			}
			relative, err := filepath.Rel(root, path)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			candidates = append(candidates, logicalPath(relative))
			return nil
		})
		if err != nil {
			return nil, "", err
		}
	}
	sort.Strings(candidates)
	seen := make(map[string]bool)
	documents := make([]projectDocument, 0, len(candidates))
	var revisionInput []byte
	for _, logical := range candidates {
		if seen[logical] {
			continue
		}
		seen[logical] = true
		path, err := safeProjectPath(root, logical, true)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, "", err
		}
		content, packageFile := packageContents[logical]
		if !packageFile {
			content, err = os.ReadFile(path)
		} else {
			err = nil
		}
		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
			continue
		}
		if err != nil {
			return nil, "", err
		}
		digest := digestBytes(content)
		documents = append(documents, projectDocument{LogicalPath: logical, Digest: digest})
		if logical != generatedDocument {
			revisionInput = append(revisionInput, []byte(logical)...)
			revisionInput = append(revisionInput, 0)
			revisionInput = append(revisionInput, []byte(digest)...)
			revisionInput = append(revisionInput, 0)
		}
	}
	return documents, digestBytes(revisionInput), nil
}

// ProjectRevision returns the canonical raw-byte revision used to bind an edit
// session. It does not parse or mutate project content.
func ProjectRevision(root string) (string, error) {
	clean, err := cleanRoot(root)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	_, revision, err := collectProjectDocuments(clean)
	return revision, err
}

func managedHostDocument(hostID string) string {
	return "inventory/host_vars/" + hostID + "/platform-installer.yml"
}

func discoverOwnedPaths(root string) ([]string, error) {
	paths := []string{"ansible.cfg", "inventory/hosts.yml", desiredDocument}
	hostRoot := filepath.Join(root, "inventory", "host_vars")
	entries, err := os.ReadDir(hostRoot)
	if err != nil && !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		return nil, err
	}
	for _, entry := range entries {
		if entry.IsDir() {
			paths = append(paths, managedHostDocument(entry.Name()))
		}
	}
	owned := make([]string, 0, len(paths))
	for _, logical := range paths {
		path, err := safeProjectPath(root, logical, true)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		content, err := os.ReadFile(path)
		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
			continue
		}
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		ownedHeader := managedHeader
		if logical == "ansible.cfg" {
			ownedHeader = managedConfigHeader
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(string(content), string(ownedHeader)) {
			owned = append(owned, logical)
		}
	}
	sort.Strings(owned)
	return owned, nil
}

func copyProject(source string) (string, func(), error) {
	parent, err := os.MkdirTemp("", "platform-installer-stage-")
	if err != nil {
		return "", nil, err
	}
	cleanup := func() { _ = os.RemoveAll(parent) }
	destination := filepath.Join(parent, "project")
	err = filepath.WalkDir(source, func(path string, entry os.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
		if walkErr != nil {
			return walkErr
		}
		relative, err := filepath.Rel(source, path)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if relative == "secrets" {
			if entry.IsDir() {
				return filepath.SkipDir
			}
			return nil
		}
		if relative == ".git" || relative == ".runtime" {
			return filepath.SkipDir
		}
		info, infoErr := entry.Info()
		if infoErr != nil {
			return infoErr
		}
		if pathEntryUnsafe(info) {
			return blocked("PATH_UNSAFE", "Staged projects must not contain symlinks", "project")
		}
		target := filepath.Join(destination, relative)
		if entry.IsDir() {
			return os.MkdirAll(target, 0o755)
		}
		input, err := os.Open(path)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		defer input.Close()
		output, err := os.OpenFile(target, os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY, info.Mode().Perm())
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		_, copyErr := io.Copy(output, input)
		closeErr := output.Close()
		if copyErr != nil {
			return copyErr
		}
		return closeErr
	})
	if err != nil {
		cleanup()
		return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("stage project: %w", err)
	}
	return destination, cleanup, nil
}

package installer

import (
	"os"
	"syscall"
	"unsafe"
)

type replaceFunc func(source, destination string) error

var moveFileEx = syscall.NewLazyDLL("kernel32.dll").NewProc("MoveFileExW")

const moveFileReplaceExisting = 0x1
const moveFileWriteThrough = 0x8

func atomicReplace(source, destination string) error {
	from, err := syscall.UTF16PtrFromString(source)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	to, err := syscall.UTF16PtrFromString(destination)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	result, _, callErr := moveFileEx.Call(uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(from)), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(to)),
		moveFileReplaceExisting|moveFileWriteThrough)
	if result == 0 {
		if callErr != nil && callErr != syscall.Errno(0) {
			return callErr
		}
		return os.ErrInvalid
	}
	return nil
}

func syncDirectory(path string) error { return nil }

// PublishSecretOutputFiles writes only the two encrypted, fixed-name output
// entries and their completion receipt. It uses the existing platform-safe
// directory-handle writer, never overwrites a package, and publishes by one
// no-replace directory rename. On failure it does not guess that pathname
// cleanup is identity-safe.
func PublishSecretOutputFiles(parent, projectID, deploymentID, packageID, sourceRunID string, generation int, runtimeDigest string, adminTokenAge, unsealSharesAge []byte) (SecretOutputFileReceipt, error) {
	return publishSecretOutputFiles(parent, projectID, deploymentID, packageID, sourceRunID, generation, runtimeDigest, adminTokenAge, unsealSharesAge, nil)
}

// Fault injection stays local to this publication operation; production has
// no global hooks or alternate writer.
func publishSecretOutputFiles(parent, projectID, deploymentID, packageID, sourceRunID string, generation int, runtimeDigest string, adminTokenAge, unsealSharesAge []byte, before func(string) error) (SecretOutputFileReceipt, error) {
	check := func(stage string) error {
		if before != nil {
			return before(stage)
		}
		return nil
	}
	if parent == "" || !secretOutputProjectID.MatchString(projectID) || !secretOutputDeploymentID.MatchString(deploymentID) || !secretOutputPackageID.MatchString(packageID) || !secretOutputRunID.MatchString(sourceRunID) || generation < 1 || !secretOutputDigest.MatchString(runtimeDigest) || len(adminTokenAge) == 0 || len(adminTokenAge) > 131072 || len(unsealSharesAge) == 0 || len(unsealSharesAge) > 131072 {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	var random [16]byte
	if _, err := rand.Read(random[:]); err != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	receiptID := hex.EncodeToString(random[:])
	digests := map[string]string{"admin-token": ciphertextDigest(adminTokenAge), "unseal-shares": ciphertextDigest(unsealSharesAge)}
	name := packageID
	receipt := secretOutputLocalReceipt{SchemaVersion: 1, ProjectID: projectID, DeploymentID: deploymentID, PackageID: packageID, SourceRunID: sourceRunID, Generation: generation, RuntimeDigest: runtimeDigest, ReceiptID: receiptID, Entries: []string{"admin-token", "unseal-shares"}, Digests: digests}
	encodedReceipt, err := json.Marshal(receipt)
	if err != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	root, err := openExportDestinationDirectory(parent)
	if err != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	defer root.close()
	projectRoot := root
	secrets, err := root.createDirectory("secrets")
	if err != nil {
		secrets, err = openSecretOutputDirectory(root, []string{"secrets"})
	}
	if err != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	defer secrets.close()
	if check("project-flush") != nil || syncSecretOutputDirectory(projectRoot) != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	deployment, err := secrets.createDirectory(deploymentID)
	if err != nil {
		deployment, err = openSecretOutputDirectory(secrets, []string{deploymentID})
	}
	if err != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	defer deployment.close()
	if syncSecretOutputDirectory(secrets) != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	root = deployment
	parent = filepath.Join(parent, "secrets", deploymentID)
	staging, stagingName, err := root.createStaging(name)
	if err != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	defer staging.close()
	retained := func() error {
		path := filepath.Join(parent, stagingName)
		if len(path) > 4096 {
			path = ""
		}
		return &SecretOutputStagingRetainedError{Path: path}
	}
	entries := []struct {
		name string
		data []byte
	}{{"admin-token.age", adminTokenAge}, {"unseal-shares.age", unsealSharesAge}}
	for _, entry := range entries {
		if err := staging.writeFile(entry.name, entry.data); err != nil {
			return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, retained()
		}
		readBack, _, err := staging.readFile([]string{entry.name}, 131072)
		if err != nil || len(readBack) != len(entry.data) || ciphertextDigest(readBack) != ciphertextDigest(entry.data) {
			return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, retained()
		}
	}
	if err := staging.writeFile("complete", encodedReceipt); err != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, retained()
	}
	readBack, _, err := staging.readFile([]string{"complete"}, 8192)
	if err != nil || string(readBack) != string(encodedReceipt) {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, retained()
	}
	if check("staging-flush") != nil || syncSecretOutputDirectory(staging) != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, retained()
	}
	if check("publish") != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, retained()
	}
	if err := root.publish(staging, stagingName, name); err != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, retained()
	}
	if check("published-flush") != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	published, err := root.openDirectory([]string{name})
	if err != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	defer published.close()
	if published.identity() != staging.identity() || syncSecretOutputDirectory(staging) != nil || syncSecretOutputDirectory(root) != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	for _, entry := range append(entries, struct {
		name string
		data []byte
	}{"complete", encodedReceipt}) {
		data, _, readErr := published.readFile([]string{entry.name}, 131072)
		if readErr != nil || !bytes.Equal(data, entry.data) {
			return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, ErrSecretOutputFiles
		}
	}
	if check("binding-readback") != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}

		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, ErrSecretOutputFiles

	if err != nil {

	}
	defer currentDeployment.close()
	if currentRoot.identity() != projectRoot.identity() || currentSecrets.identity() != secrets.identity() || currentDeployment.identity() != root.identity() {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}

}

// ReadSecretOutputFiles verifies a previously published package through the
// same safe opened-directory primitives. It returns only encrypted bytes and
// never follows a substituted package/file path.
func ReadSecretOutputFiles(parent, projectID, deploymentID, packageID, sourceRunID string, generation int, runtimeDigest string) (SecretOutputFileReceipt, map[string][]byte, error) {
	if parent == "" || !secretOutputProjectID.MatchString(projectID) || !secretOutputDeploymentID.MatchString(deploymentID) || !secretOutputPackageID.MatchString(packageID) || !secretOutputRunID.MatchString(sourceRunID) || generation < 1 || !secretOutputDigest.MatchString(runtimeDigest) {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, nil, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	root, err := openExportDestinationDirectory(parent)
	if err != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, nil, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	defer root.close()
	name := packageID
	projectRoot := root
	secrets, err := openSecretOutputDirectory(root, []string{"secrets"})
	if err != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, nil, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	defer secrets.close()
	root = secrets
	parent = filepath.Join(parent, "secrets")
	deployment, err := openSecretOutputDirectory(root, []string{deploymentID})
	if err != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, nil, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	defer deployment.close()
	directory, err := openSecretOutputDirectory(deployment, []string{name})
	if err != nil {
		if !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
			return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, nil, ErrSecretOutputFiles
		}
		// Files published before package-specific directories remain readable
		// only when their complete receipt matches the requested package.
		directory = deployment
		name = ""
	} else {
		defer directory.close()
	}
	encoded, _, err := directory.readFile([]string{"complete"}, 8192)
	var receipt secretOutputLocalReceipt
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(encoded))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err != nil || decoder.Decode(&receipt) != nil || receipt.SchemaVersion != 1 || receipt.ProjectID != projectID || receipt.DeploymentID != deploymentID || receipt.PackageID != packageID || receipt.SourceRunID != sourceRunID || receipt.Generation != generation || receipt.RuntimeDigest != runtimeDigest || !secretOutputPackageID.MatchString(receipt.ReceiptID) || len(receipt.Entries) != 2 || receipt.Entries[0] != "admin-token" || receipt.Entries[1] != "unseal-shares" || len(receipt.Digests) != 2 {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, nil, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	var trailing any
	if decoder.Decode(&trailing) != io.EOF {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, nil, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	ciphertexts := make(map[string][]byte, 2)
	for _, entry := range []struct{ id, file string }{{"admin-token", "admin-token.age"}, {"unseal-shares", "unseal-shares.age"}} {
		data, _, readErr := directory.readFile([]string{entry.file}, 131072)
		if readErr != nil || !secretOutputDigest.MatchString(receipt.Digests[entry.id]) || ciphertextDigest(data) != receipt.Digests[entry.id] {
			for _, value := range ciphertexts {
				clear(value)
			}
			clear(data)
			return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, nil, ErrSecretOutputFiles
		}
		ciphertexts[entry.id] = data
	}
	if syncSecretOutputDirectory(directory) != nil || syncSecretOutputDirectory(deployment) != nil || syncSecretOutputDirectory(root) != nil || syncSecretOutputDirectory(projectRoot) != nil {
		for _, data := range ciphertexts {
			clear(data)
		}
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, nil, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	return SecretOutputFileReceipt{ReceiptID: receipt.ReceiptID, Directory: filepath.Join(parent, deploymentID, name), Digests: receipt.Digests, ProjectID: projectID, DeploymentID: deploymentID, PackageID: packageID, SourceRunID: sourceRunID, Generation: generation, RuntimeDigest: runtimeDigest}, ciphertexts, nil
}

func ciphertextDigest(data []byte) string {
	digest := sha256.Sum256(data)
	return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
}

// ReadSecretOutputReceipt discovers binding only at one canonical deployment
// path supplied by the managed projection, never by directory scanning.
func ReadSecretOutputReceipt(rootPath, projectID, deploymentID, runtimeDigest string) (SecretOutputFileReceipt, map[string][]byte, error) {
	if !secretOutputDeploymentID.MatchString(deploymentID) {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, nil, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	root, err := openExportSourceDirectory(rootPath)
	if err != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, nil, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	defer root.close()
	dir, err := root.openDirectory([]string{"secrets", deploymentID})
	if err != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, nil, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	defer dir.close()
	data, _, err := dir.readFile([]string{"complete"}, 8192)
	var receipt secretOutputLocalReceipt
	if err != nil || json.Unmarshal(data, &receipt) != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, nil, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	return ReadSecretOutputFiles(rootPath, projectID, deploymentID, receipt.PackageID, receipt.SourceRunID, receipt.Generation, runtimeDigest)
}

package installer

import (
	"unsafe"

	"golang.org/x/sys/windows"
)

var secretOutputFlush = windows.NewLazySystemDLL("ntdll.dll").NewProc("NtFlushBuffersFileEx")

// Fail closed if the filesystem cannot durably flush the held directory.
func syncSecretOutputDirectory(directory *exportDirectory) error {
	if err := secretOutputFlush.Find(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var status windows.IO_STATUS_BLOCK
	result, _, _ := secretOutputFlush.Call(uintptr(directory.handle), 0, 0, 0, uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&status)))
	if int32(result) < 0 {
		return windows.NTStatus(result)
	}
	return nil
}

func openSecretOutputDirectory(parent *exportDirectory, parts []string) (*exportDirectory, error) {
	return parent.openDirectoryWithAccess(parts, windows.FILE_GENERIC_READ|windows.FILE_GENERIC_WRITE|windows.DELETE)
}
