// Binding prevents a lease for one open project being observed by another.
type Binding struct {
	Root string
	ID   string
}

type Input struct {
	Username          string `json:"username"`
	SSHMode           string `json:"sshMode"`
	SSHPassword       string `json:"sshPassword"`
	PrivateKeyPath    string `json:"privateKeyPath"`
	ElevationMode     string `json:"elevationMode"`
	ElevationPassword string `json:"elevationPassword"`
}

// Status intentionally includes safe metadata only.
type Status struct {
	Status                 string `json:"status"`
	Username               string `json:"username,omitempty"`
	SSHMode                string `json:"sshMode,omitempty"`
	SudoPasswordStatus     string `json:"sudoPasswordStatus"`
	PKIStorePasswordStatus string `json:"pkiStorePasswordStatus"`
	ExpiresAt              string `json:"expiresAt,omitempty"`
}

// TargetCredential is a short-lived copy supplied only to a synchronous
// execution transport callback. It is intentionally not JSON serializable and
// has no persistence or Wails-facing representation.
type TargetCredential struct {
	Username            string
	SSHMode             string
	SSHSecret           []byte
	SudoSecret          []byte
	PKIStorePassword    []byte
	RuntimeSecretValues map[string][]byte
	RuntimeSecretInputs []RuntimeSecretInput
}

// RuntimeSecretInput is a typed, short-lived payload for the private v1alpha4
// lease. Values are borrowed by one synchronous execution callback and cleared
// immediately afterwards.
type RuntimeSecretInput struct {
	RequirementRef, Purpose, ServiceDeployment string
	Operations                                 []string
	Value                                      []byte
	Shares                                     [][]byte
}

type lease struct {
	binding             Binding
	reference           []byte
	username            string
	sshMode             string
	sshSecret           []byte
	privateKeyPath      string
	privateKeyInfo      os.FileInfo
	sudoSecret          []byte
	pkiStorePassword    []byte
	runtimeSecretValues map[string][]byte
	runtimeSecretInputs []RuntimeSecretInput
	expiresAt           time.Time
	generation          uint64
}

// runExecutionIdentityHold retains the approved identity during one Start/run.
// PEM bytes are never copied; the original file stays verified. Password mode
// retains a private, wiped-on-release copy for that exact operation only.
type runExecutionIdentityHold struct {
	state        string
	planID       string
	runID        string
	binding      Binding
	identity     ExecutionIdentity
	password     []byte
	sudoPassword []byte
}

// pendingRuntimeSecrets holds service-password values entered before a target
// credential is available.  It is project-bound, short-lived and deliberately
// separate from a transport credential: it cannot be used for SSH or exposed
// through Status.
type pendingRuntimeSecrets struct {
	binding    Binding
	values     map[string][]byte
	typed      map[string]RuntimeSecretInput
	expiresAt  time.Time
	generation uint64
}

// SetPendingServiceSecretInput stores a locally catalog-authorized typed
// secret without requiring a target credential or Execution Node readiness.
// Core later supplies the opaque exact requirementRef and allowed operations.
func (b *Broker) SetPendingServiceSecretInput(binding Binding, deployment, purpose string, value []byte, shares [][]byte) error {
	if binding.Root == "" || binding.ID == "" || deployment == "" || len(deployment) > 128 {
		return errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	input := RuntimeSecretInput{Purpose: purpose, ServiceDeployment: deployment}
	switch purpose {
	case "SERVICE_ADMIN_TOKEN", "SERVICE_PASSWORD":
		if len(value) == 0 || len(value) > 4096 || len(shares) != 0 || !utf8.Valid(value) {
			return errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_INPUT_INVALID")
		}
		input.Value = append([]byte(nil), value...)
	case "SERVICE_UNSEAL_SHARES":
		if len(shares) == 0 || len(shares) > 255 || len(value) != 0 {
			return errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_INPUT_INVALID")
		}
		seen := map[string]bool{}
		total := 0
		for _, share := range shares {
			if len(share) == 0 || len(share) > 128 || !utf8.Valid(share) || seen[string(share)] {
				return errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_INPUT_INVALID")
			}
			seen[string(share)] = true
			total += len(share)
		}
		if total > 32768 {
			return errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_INPUT_INVALID")
		}
		input.Shares = cloneSecretSlices(shares)
	default:
		return errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	key := typedSecretKey(deployment, purpose)
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	if b.pending == nil || b.pending.binding != binding || !b.now().Before(b.pending.expiresAt) {
		if b.pending != nil && !b.now().Before(b.pending.expiresAt) {
			b.clearPendingLocked()
		}
		b.nextGen++
		b.pending = &pendingRuntimeSecrets{binding: binding, values: map[string][]byte{}, typed: map[string]RuntimeSecretInput{}, expiresAt: b.now().Add(b.ttl), generation: b.nextGen}
		b.armPendingExpiryLocked(b.pending.generation, b.pending.expiresAt)
	}
	if b.pending.typed == nil {
		b.pending.typed = map[string]RuntimeSecretInput{}
	}
	if previous, ok := b.pending.typed[key]; ok {
		zeroRuntimeSecretInput(previous)
	}
	b.pending.typed[key] = input
	return nil
}

// BindPendingServiceSecretInputs maps local deployment/purpose values onto
// the exact current Core descriptors before target credential serialization.
func (b *Broker) BindPendingServiceSecretInputs(binding Binding, descriptors []RuntimeSecretInput, applicationTokens ...RuntimeSecretInput) error {
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	if b.pending == nil || b.pending.binding != binding || !b.now().Before(b.pending.expiresAt) || b.lease == nil || b.lease.binding != binding || !b.now().Before(b.lease.expiresAt) {
		return nil
	}
	allowed := make(map[string]RuntimeSecretInput, len(descriptors))
	for _, descriptor := range descriptors {
		if !validTypedDescriptor(descriptor) {
			return errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_DESCRIPTORS_STALE")
		}
		key := typedSecretKey(descriptor.ServiceDeployment, descriptor.Purpose)
		if _, exists := allowed[key]; exists {
			return errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_DESCRIPTORS_STALE")
		}
		allowed[key] = descriptor
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, token := range applicationTokens {
		if token.Purpose != "APPLICATION_VAULT_ADMIN_TOKEN" || !runtimeSecretID(token.RequirementRef) || token.ServiceDeployment == "" || len(token.ServiceDeployment) > 128 || seen[token.RequirementRef] {
			return errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_DESCRIPTORS_STALE")
		}
		seen[token.RequirementRef] = true
	}
	attached := make([]RuntimeSecretInput, 0, len(b.pending.typed))
	passwords := cloneSecretMap(b.lease.runtimeSecretValues)
	defer func() { zeroSecretMap(passwords) }()
	for key, pending := range b.pending.typed {
		descriptor, ok := allowed[key]
		if !ok {
			return errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_DESCRIPTORS_STALE")
		}
		if descriptor.Purpose == "SERVICE_PASSWORD" {
			zero(passwords[descriptor.RequirementRef])
			passwords[descriptor.RequirementRef] = append([]byte(nil), pending.Value...)
			continue
		}
		descriptor.Value = append([]byte(nil), pending.Value...)
		descriptor.Shares = cloneSecretSlices(pending.Shares)
		attached = append(attached, descriptor)
	}
	// Core binds each application requirement to the infrastructure deployment.
	// Reuse its existing typed admin input without returning a token to callers.
	for _, token := range applicationTokens {
		if pending, ok := b.pending.typed[typedSecretKey(token.ServiceDeployment, "SERVICE_ADMIN_TOKEN")]; ok {
			zero(passwords[token.RequirementRef])
			passwords[token.RequirementRef] = append([]byte(nil), pending.Value...)
		}
	}
	sort.Slice(attached, func(i, j int) bool { return attached[i].RequirementRef < attached[j].RequirementRef })
	for _, old := range b.lease.runtimeSecretInputs {
		zeroRuntimeSecretInput(old)
	}
	b.lease.runtimeSecretInputs = attached
	zeroSecretMap(b.lease.runtimeSecretValues)
	b.lease.runtimeSecretValues = passwords
	passwords = nil
	return nil
}

func validTypedDescriptor(value RuntimeSecretInput) bool {
	if !runtimeSecretID(value.RequirementRef) || value.ServiceDeployment == "" || len(value.ServiceDeployment) > 128 {
		return false
	}
	switch value.Purpose {
	case "SERVICE_ADMIN_TOKEN", "SERVICE_PASSWORD":
		return len(value.Operations) == 2 && value.Operations[0] == "SERVICE_APPLY" && value.Operations[1] == "SERVICE_VERIFY"
	case "SERVICE_UNSEAL_SHARES":
		return len(value.Operations) == 1 && value.Operations[0] == "SERVICE_APPLY"
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func typedSecretKey(deployment, purpose string) string { return deployment + "\x00" + purpose }

func zeroRuntimeSecretInput(value RuntimeSecretInput) {
	zero(value.Value)
	zeroByteSlices(value.Shares)
}

func zeroTypedSecretMap(values map[string]RuntimeSecretInput) {
	for _, value := range values {
		zeroRuntimeSecretInput(value)
	}
}

func zeroByteSlices(values [][]byte) {
	for _, value := range values {
		zero(value)
	}
}

// SetPKIStorePassword updates only the optional in-memory PKI password on the
// current project-bound lease. It neither extends its TTL nor contacts a node.
func (b *Broker) SetPKIStorePassword(binding Binding, value string) (Status, error) {
	if !utf8.ValidString(value) || len([]byte(value)) < 1 || len([]byte(value)) > maxPKIStorePasswordBytes {
		return Status{}, errors.New("PKI_STORE_PASSWORD_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	if b.lease == nil || b.lease.binding != binding || !b.now().Before(b.lease.expiresAt) {
		if b.lease != nil && !b.now().Before(b.lease.expiresAt) {
			b.expireLocked(b.lease.generation)
		}
		return Status{}, errors.New("SESSION_CREDENTIAL_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	next := append([]byte(nil), value...)
	zero(b.lease.pkiStorePassword)
	b.lease.pkiStorePassword = next
	return statusFromLease(b.lease), nil
}

// SetRuntimeSecretValues replaces the session-only service-secret set.  The
// caller supplies only safe requirement IDs; values never enter Status or a
// serializable DTO.
func (b *Broker) SetRuntimeSecretValues(binding Binding, values map[string]string) error {
	if len(values) == 0 {
		return errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	next, total := make(map[string][]byte, len(values)), 0
	for reference, value := range values {
		if !runtimeSecretID(reference) || !utf8.ValidString(value) || len([]byte(value)) < 1 || len([]byte(value)) > 4096 {
			zeroSecretMap(next)
			return errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_INPUT_INVALID")
		}
		total += len([]byte(value))
		if total > 65536 {
			zeroSecretMap(next)
			return errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_INPUT_INVALID")
		}
		next[reference] = []byte(value)
	}
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	if b.lease == nil || b.lease.binding != binding || !b.now().Before(b.lease.expiresAt) {
		zeroSecretMap(next)
		return errors.New("SESSION_CREDENTIAL_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	zeroSecretMap(b.lease.runtimeSecretValues)
	b.lease.runtimeSecretValues = next
	return nil
}

// SetRuntimeSecretValuesForRequirements replaces only one descriptor-bound
// subset. Other acknowledged service values remain in the same short-lived
// lease, so separate service dialogs cannot erase each other.
func (b *Broker) SetRuntimeSecretValuesForRequirements(binding Binding, requirements []string, values map[string]string) error {
	if !sameRuntimeSecretRequirements(requirements, values) {
		return errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	if b.lease == nil || b.lease.binding != binding || !b.now().Before(b.lease.expiresAt) {
		return errors.New("SESSION_CREDENTIAL_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	next := cloneSecretMap(b.lease.runtimeSecretValues)
	for _, reference := range requirements {
		zero(next[reference])
		delete(next, reference)
	}
	for reference, value := range values {
		next[reference] = []byte(value)
	}
	if !validRuntimeSecretMap(next) {
		zeroSecretMap(next)
		return errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	zeroSecretMap(b.lease.runtimeSecretValues)
	b.lease.runtimeSecretValues = next
	return nil
}

// SetPendingRuntimeSecretValuesForRequirements accepts a locally
// catalog-authorized service-secret subset before a READY Execution Node or a
// target credential exists. Values are kept only in Broker memory and expire
// on the same bounded TTL as session credentials.
func (b *Broker) SetPendingRuntimeSecretValuesForRequirements(binding Binding, requirements []string, values map[string]string) error {
	if binding.Root == "" || binding.ID == "" || !sameRuntimeSecretRequirements(requirements, values) {
		return errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	next := make(map[string][]byte, len(values))
	for reference, value := range values {
		next[reference] = []byte(value)
	}
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	if b.pending != nil && b.pending.binding == binding && b.now().Before(b.pending.expiresAt) {
		merged := cloneSecretMap(b.pending.values)
		typed := cloneTypedSecretMap(b.pending.typed)
		for _, reference := range requirements {
			zero(merged[reference])
			delete(merged, reference)
		}
		for reference, value := range next {
			merged[reference] = value
		}
		next = merged
		if !validRuntimeSecretMap(next) {
			zeroSecretMap(next)
			zeroTypedSecretMap(typed)
			return errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_INPUT_INVALID")
		}
		b.clearPendingLocked()
		b.pending = &pendingRuntimeSecrets{binding: binding, values: next, typed: typed, expiresAt: b.now().Add(b.ttl)}
		b.nextGen++
		b.pending.generation = b.nextGen
		b.armPendingExpiryLocked(b.pending.generation, b.pending.expiresAt)
		return nil
	}
	if !validRuntimeSecretMap(next) {
		zeroSecretMap(next)
		return errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	b.clearPendingLocked()
	b.nextGen++
	b.pending = &pendingRuntimeSecrets{binding: binding, values: next, expiresAt: b.now().Add(b.ttl), generation: b.nextGen}
	b.armPendingExpiryLocked(b.pending.generation, b.pending.expiresAt)
	return nil
}

// PromotePendingRuntimeSecretValues moves values into the target credential
// only after Core has produced the current descriptor set. Every pending key
// must be in that set; stale or superseded local requirements fail closed.
func (b *Broker) PromotePendingRuntimeSecretValues(binding Binding, requirements []string) error {
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	if b.pending == nil || b.pending.binding != binding {
		return nil
	}
	if !b.now().Before(b.pending.expiresAt) {
		b.clearPendingLocked()
		return errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_INPUT_EXPIRED")
	}
	if b.lease == nil || b.lease.binding != binding || !b.now().Before(b.lease.expiresAt) {
		return nil
	}
	allowed := make(map[string]struct{}, len(requirements))
	for _, reference := range requirements {
		if !runtimeSecretID(reference) {
			return errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_DESCRIPTORS_STALE")
		}
		allowed[reference] = struct{}{}
	}
	for reference := range b.pending.values {
		if _, ok := allowed[reference]; !ok {
			return errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_DESCRIPTORS_STALE")
		}
	}
	// Typed inputs share this pending bucket but are authorized and bound by
	// BindPendingServiceSecretInputs, not by password-map promotion.
	if len(b.pending.values) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	next := cloneSecretMap(b.lease.runtimeSecretValues)
	for reference, value := range b.pending.values {
		zero(next[reference])
		next[reference] = append([]byte(nil), value...)
	}
	if !validRuntimeSecretMap(next) {
		zeroSecretMap(next)
		return errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	zeroSecretMap(b.lease.runtimeSecretValues)
	b.lease.runtimeSecretValues = next
	zeroSecretMap(b.pending.values)
	b.pending.values = nil
	if len(b.pending.typed) == 0 {
		b.clearPendingLocked()
	}
	return nil
}

// ClearRuntimeSecretValues leaves the target credential and optional PKI
// password intact while invalidating descriptor-bound service values.
func (b *Broker) ClearRuntimeSecretValues(binding Binding) {
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	if b.lease != nil && b.lease.binding == binding {
		zeroSecretMap(b.lease.runtimeSecretValues)
		b.lease.runtimeSecretValues = nil
		zeroTypedSecretSlice(b.lease.runtimeSecretInputs)
		b.lease.runtimeSecretInputs = nil
	}
	if b.pending != nil && b.pending.binding == binding {
		b.clearPendingLocked()
	}
}

// ClearAttachedRuntimeSecretValues removes only values already attached to a
// target credential. Pending locally entered values remain available for the
// immediately following Core-attested promotion step.
func (b *Broker) ClearAttachedRuntimeSecretValues(binding Binding) {
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	if b.lease != nil && b.lease.binding == binding {
		zeroSecretMap(b.lease.runtimeSecretValues)
		b.lease.runtimeSecretValues = nil
		zeroTypedSecretSlice(b.lease.runtimeSecretInputs)
		b.lease.runtimeSecretInputs = nil
	}
}

type expiredMarker struct {
	binding    Binding
	expiresAt  time.Time
	generation uint64
}

type Broker struct {
	mu              sync.Mutex
	ttl             time.Duration
	now             func() time.Time
	lease           *lease
	runHold         *runExecutionIdentityHold
	pending         *pendingRuntimeSecrets
	outputPassword  []byte
	outputBinding   Binding
	outputExpiresAt time.Time
	expired         *expiredMarker
	timer           *time.Timer
	nextGen         uint64
}

// SetOutputEncryptionPassword keeps the workstation-only age password in the
// same bounded in-memory broker as other session secrets. It is never part of
// TargetCredential or any transport payload.
func (b *Broker) SetOutputEncryptionPassword(binding Binding, password []byte) error {
	if binding.Root == "" || binding.ID == "" || len(password) == 0 || len(password) > maxPKIStorePasswordBytes || !utf8.Valid(password) {
		return errors.New("SECRET_OUTPUT_PASSWORD_INVALID")
	}
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	if b.outputBinding != binding {
		zero(b.outputPassword)
	}
	b.outputPassword = append(b.outputPassword[:0], password...)
	b.outputBinding = binding
	b.outputExpiresAt = b.now().Add(b.ttl)
	return nil
}

// WithOutputEncryptionPassword lends a short-lived copy synchronously and
// zeroes it after callback completion. It is not exposed in status or DTOs.
func (b *Broker) WithOutputEncryptionPassword(binding Binding, use func([]byte) error) error {
	if use == nil {
		return errors.New("SECRET_OUTPUT_PASSWORD_MISSING")
	}
	b.mu.Lock()
	if b.outputBinding != binding || len(b.outputPassword) == 0 || !b.now().Before(b.outputExpiresAt) {
		if len(b.outputPassword) > 0 && !b.now().Before(b.outputExpiresAt) {
			zero(b.outputPassword)
			b.outputPassword = nil
		}
		b.mu.Unlock()
		return errors.New("SECRET_OUTPUT_PASSWORD_MISSING")
	}
	copyValue := append([]byte(nil), b.outputPassword...)
	b.mu.Unlock()
	defer zero(copyValue)
	return use(copyValue)
}

func (b *Broker) ClearOutputEncryptionPassword(binding Binding) {
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	if b.outputBinding == binding {
		zero(b.outputPassword)
		b.outputPassword = nil
		b.outputBinding = Binding{}
		b.outputExpiresAt = time.Time{}
	}
}

func (b *Broker) HasOutputEncryptionPassword(binding Binding) bool {
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	if b.outputBinding != binding || len(b.outputPassword) == 0 {
		return false
	}
	if !b.now().Before(b.outputExpiresAt) {
		zero(b.outputPassword)
		b.outputPassword = nil
		b.outputBinding = Binding{}
		b.outputExpiresAt = time.Time{}
		return false
	}
	return true
}

type Option func(*Broker)

func WithTTL(ttl time.Duration) Option      { return func(b *Broker) { b.ttl = ttl } }
func WithClock(now func() time.Time) Option { return func(b *Broker) { b.now = now } }

func NewBroker(options ...Option) *Broker {
	b := &Broker{ttl: 4 * time.Hour, now: time.Now}
	for _, option := range options {
		option(b)
	}
	return b
}

// Set atomically replaces the lease after constructing and validating all
// input. A failed replacement leaves the prior lease untouched.
func (b *Broker) Set(binding Binding, input Input) (Status, error) {
	if binding.Root == "" || binding.ID == "" {
		return Status{}, errors.New("SESSION_CREDENTIAL_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	candidate, err := b.buildLease(binding, input)
	if err != nil {
		return Status{}, err
	}
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	if b.runHold != nil {
		zero(candidate.sshSecret)
		zero(candidate.sudoSecret)
		zero(candidate.pkiStorePassword)
		zeroSecretMap(candidate.runtimeSecretValues)
		zeroTypedSecretSlice(candidate.runtimeSecretInputs)
		return Status{}, errors.New("INSTALLATION_RUN_ACTIVE")
	}
	if b.outputBinding != binding {
		zero(b.outputPassword)
		b.outputPassword = nil
		b.outputBinding = Binding{}
		b.outputExpiresAt = time.Time{}
	}
	b.clearLeaseLocked(false)
	if b.pending != nil && b.pending.binding != binding {
		b.clearPendingLocked()
	}
	b.expired = nil
	b.nextGen++
	candidate.generation = b.nextGen
	candidate.expiresAt = b.now().Add(b.ttl)
	b.lease = candidate
	b.armExpiryLocked(candidate.generation, candidate.expiresAt)
	return statusFromLease(candidate), nil
}

func (b *Broker) Status(binding Binding) Status {
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	if b.lease != nil && b.lease.binding == binding {
		if !b.now().Before(b.lease.expiresAt) {
			b.expireLocked(b.lease.generation)
		} else {
			return statusFromLease(b.lease)
		}
	}
	if b.expired != nil && b.expired.binding == binding {
		return Status{Status: StatusExpired, SudoPasswordStatus: SudoNotProvided, PKIStorePasswordStatus: PKIStorePasswordMissing}
	}
	return missingStatus()
}

func (b *Broker) Clear() {
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	b.clearLeaseLocked(true)
	b.clearPendingLocked()
	b.clearRunHoldsLocked()
	zero(b.outputPassword)
	b.outputPassword = nil
	b.outputBinding = Binding{}
	b.outputExpiresAt = time.Time{}
}

func (b *Broker) Close() { b.Clear() }

// WithTargetCredential exposes one in-memory credential to a synchronous
// caller while the broker lease remains valid. The callback must not retain
// the slices; they are zeroed immediately after it returns.
// MissingRequiredSecrets reports only public requirement IDs. It never copies
// secret values out of the broker and does not extend their lifetime.
func (b *Broker) MissingRequiredSecrets(binding Binding, passwords []string, requirePKI, includePending bool) []string {
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	result := make([]string, 0, len(passwords)+1)
	valid := b.lease != nil && b.lease.binding == binding && b.now().Before(b.lease.expiresAt)
	pendingValid := includePending && b.pending != nil && b.pending.binding == binding && b.now().Before(b.pending.expiresAt)
	if requirePKI && (!valid || len(b.lease.pkiStorePassword) == 0) {
		result = append(result, "pki-store-password")
	}
	for _, reference := range passwords {
		if (!valid || len(b.lease.runtimeSecretValues[reference]) == 0) && (!pendingValid || len(b.pending.values[reference]) == 0) {
			result = append(result, reference)
		}
	}
	return result
}

// ServiceSecretsPresent reports presence only, without copying values or extending expiry.
func (b *Broker) ServiceSecretsPresent(binding Binding, requirements []RuntimeSecretInput) bool {
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	valid := b.lease != nil && b.lease.binding == binding && b.now().Before(b.lease.expiresAt)
	pendingValid := b.pending != nil && b.pending.binding == binding && b.now().Before(b.pending.expiresAt)
	if len(requirements) == 0 {
		return false
	}
	for _, requirement := range requirements {
		present := false
		if requirement.Purpose == "SERVICE_PASSWORD" {
			present = (valid && len(b.lease.runtimeSecretValues[requirement.RequirementRef]) > 0) ||
				(pendingValid && len(b.pending.values[requirement.RequirementRef]) > 0)
			if pendingValid {
				present = present || len(b.pending.typed[typedSecretKey(requirement.ServiceDeployment, requirement.Purpose)].Value) > 0
			}
		} else {
			if pendingValid {
				input := b.pending.typed[typedSecretKey(requirement.ServiceDeployment, requirement.Purpose)]
				present = len(input.Value) > 0 || len(input.Shares) > 0
			}
			if valid {
				for _, input := range b.lease.runtimeSecretInputs {
					if input.ServiceDeployment == requirement.ServiceDeployment && input.Purpose == requirement.Purpose {
						present = present || len(input.Value) > 0 || len(input.Shares) > 0
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if !present {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func (b *Broker) WithTargetCredential(binding Binding, use func(TargetCredential) error) error {
	if use == nil {
		return errors.New("SESSION_CREDENTIAL_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	b.mu.Lock()
	if b.lease == nil || b.lease.binding != binding || !b.now().Before(b.lease.expiresAt) {
		if b.lease != nil && !b.now().Before(b.lease.expiresAt) {
			b.expireLocked(b.lease.generation)
		}
		b.mu.Unlock()
		return errors.New("SESSION_CREDENTIAL_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	value := TargetCredential{Username: b.lease.username, SSHMode: b.lease.sshMode, SSHSecret: append([]byte(nil), b.lease.sshSecret...), SudoSecret: append([]byte(nil), b.lease.sudoSecret...), PKIStorePassword: append([]byte(nil), b.lease.pkiStorePassword...), RuntimeSecretValues: cloneSecretMap(b.lease.runtimeSecretValues), RuntimeSecretInputs: cloneTypedSecretSlice(b.lease.runtimeSecretInputs)}
	b.mu.Unlock()
	defer zero(value.SSHSecret)
	defer zero(value.SudoSecret)
	defer zero(value.PKIStorePassword)
	defer zeroSecretMap(value.RuntimeSecretValues)
	defer zeroTypedSecretSlice(value.RuntimeSecretInputs)
	return use(value)
}

func (b *Broker) buildLease(binding Binding, input Input) (*lease, error) {
	username := stringTrimSpace(input.Username)
	if username == "" || !utf8.ValidString(username) || len(username) > maxUsernameBytes {
		return nil, errors.New("SESSION_CREDENTIAL_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	if input.ElevationMode == "" {
		input.ElevationMode = ElevationNone
	}
	var sshSecret []byte
	var keyInfo os.FileInfo
	switch input.SSHMode {
	case SSHPassword:
		if len(input.SSHPassword) > maxPasswordBytes {
			return nil, errors.New("SESSION_CREDENTIAL_TOO_LARGE")
		}
		if strings.ContainsAny(input.SSHPassword, "\r\n\x00") {
			return nil, errors.New("SESSION_CREDENTIAL_PASSWORD_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED")
		}
		if input.PrivateKeyPath != "" || input.SSHPassword == "" {
			return nil, errors.New("SESSION_CREDENTIAL_MODE_INVALID")
		}
		sshSecret = []byte(input.SSHPassword)
	case SSHPrivateKey:
		if input.SSHPassword != "" || input.PrivateKeyPath == "" || !filepath.IsAbs(input.PrivateKeyPath) {
			return nil, errors.New("SESSION_CREDENTIAL_MODE_INVALID")
		}
		key, info, err := readPrivateKeyWithInfo(input.PrivateKeyPath)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		sshSecret = key
		keyInfo = info
	default:
		return nil, errors.New("SESSION_CREDENTIAL_MODE_INVALID")
	}
	var sudoSecret []byte
	switch input.ElevationMode {
	case ElevationNone:
		if input.ElevationPassword != "" {
			zero(sshSecret)
			return nil, errors.New("SESSION_CREDENTIAL_MODE_INVALID")
		}
	case ElevationSudo:
		if strings.ContainsAny(input.ElevationPassword, "\r\n\x00") {
			zero(sshSecret)
			return nil, errors.New("SESSION_CREDENTIAL_PASSWORD_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED")
		}
		if len(input.ElevationPassword) > maxPasswordBytes {
			zero(sshSecret)
			return nil, errors.New("SESSION_CREDENTIAL_TOO_LARGE")
		}
		if input.ElevationPassword == "" {
			zero(sshSecret)
			return nil, errors.New("SESSION_CREDENTIAL_MODE_INVALID")
		}
		sudoSecret = []byte(input.ElevationPassword)
	default:
		zero(sshSecret)
		return nil, errors.New("SESSION_CREDENTIAL_MODE_INVALID")
	}
	reference := make([]byte, 16)
	if _, err := rand.Read(reference); err != nil {
		zero(sshSecret)
		zero(sudoSecret)
		return nil, errors.New("SESSION_CREDENTIAL_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	keyPath := ""
	if input.SSHMode == SSHPrivateKey {
		keyPath = filepath.Clean(input.PrivateKeyPath)
	}
	return &lease{binding: binding, reference: reference, username: username, sshMode: input.SSHMode, sshSecret: sshSecret, privateKeyPath: keyPath, privateKeyInfo: keyInfo, sudoSecret: sudoSecret}, nil
}

// ExecutionIdentity is private application transport metadata. It must never
// cross Wails, logs or the portable project boundary.
type ExecutionIdentity struct {
	Mode       string
	Path       string
	Username   string
	Digest     [sha256.Size]byte
	Generation uint64
	FileInfo   os.FileInfo
}

func (b *Broker) CurrentExecutionIdentity(binding Binding) (ExecutionIdentity, error) {
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	if b.lease != nil && b.lease.binding == binding && b.now().Before(b.lease.expiresAt) {
		return executionIdentityFromLease(b.lease)
	}
	if b.lease != nil && !b.now().Before(b.lease.expiresAt) {
		b.expireLocked(b.lease.generation)
	}
	if identity, ok := b.heldExecutionIdentityLocked(binding); ok && identity.Mode != SSHPassword {
		return identity, nil
	}
	return ExecutionIdentity{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_PEM_REQUIRED")
}

// ReserveExecutionIdentityForStart retains only approved identity metadata
// before dispatch. The reservation is idempotent for a retry of the same plan.
func (b *Broker) ReserveExecutionIdentityForStart(binding Binding, planID string, identity ExecutionIdentity) error {
	if binding.Root == "" || binding.ID == "" || planID == "" || len(planID) > 128 ||
		identity.Username == "" || identity.Generation == 0 ||
		(identity.Mode != SSHPassword && (identity.Path == "" || identity.FileInfo == nil || identity.Digest == [sha256.Size]byte{})) {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_RUN_IDENTITY_INVALID")
	}
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	if hold := b.runHold; hold != nil {
		if hold.state == "STARTING" && hold.binding == binding && hold.planID == planID && sameExecutionIdentity(hold.identity, identity) {
			return nil
		}
		return errors.New("INSTALLATION_RUN_ACTIVE")
	}
	if b.lease != nil && b.lease.binding == binding && b.lease.generation == identity.Generation {
		if !b.now().Before(b.lease.expiresAt) {
			b.expireLocked(b.lease.generation)
		}
	}
	if b.lease != nil && b.lease.binding == binding && b.now().Before(b.lease.expiresAt) {
		current, err := executionIdentityFromLease(b.lease)
		if err != nil || !sameExecutionIdentity(current, identity) {
			return errors.New("EXECUTION_RUN_IDENTITY_STALE")
		}
	} else if b.expired == nil || b.expired.binding != binding || b.expired.generation != identity.Generation {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_RUN_IDENTITY_STALE")
	}
	if identity.Mode == SSHPassword && (b.lease == nil || !b.now().Before(b.lease.expiresAt)) {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_RUN_IDENTITY_STALE")
	}
	b.runHold = &runExecutionIdentityHold{state: "STARTING", planID: planID, binding: binding, identity: identity}
	if identity.Mode == SSHPassword {
		b.runHold.password = append([]byte(nil), b.lease.sshSecret...)
	}
	if b.lease != nil && b.now().Before(b.lease.expiresAt) {
		b.runHold.sudoPassword = append([]byte(nil), b.lease.sudoSecret...)
	}
	return nil
}

// ConfirmExecutionIdentityRun binds the reserved slot to the authoritative
// run ID returned by Start. It remains usable after ordinary lease expiry.
func (b *Broker) ConfirmExecutionIdentityRun(binding Binding, planID, runID string) error {
	if runID == "" || len(runID) > 128 {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_RUN_IDENTITY_INVALID")
	}
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	hold := b.runHold
	if hold == nil || hold.state != "STARTING" || hold.binding != binding || hold.planID != planID {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_RUN_IDENTITY_STALE")
	}
	hold.state, hold.runID = "RUNNING", runID
	return nil
}

// ReleaseStartingExecutionIdentity releases only a reservation whose Start
// was authoritatively not dispatched.
func (b *Broker) ReleaseStartingExecutionIdentity(binding Binding, planID string) {
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	if hold := b.runHold; hold != nil && hold.state == "STARTING" && hold.binding == binding && hold.planID == planID {
		zero(hold.password)
		zero(hold.sudoPassword)
		clearExecutionIdentity(&hold.identity)
		b.runHold = nil
	}
}

// ReleaseExecutionIdentityForRun releases one run's retained metadata after
// its authoritative terminal state has been observed.
func (b *Broker) ReleaseExecutionIdentityForRun(runID string) {
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	if hold := b.runHold; hold != nil && hold.state == "RUNNING" && hold.runID == runID {
		zero(hold.password)
		zero(hold.sudoPassword)
		clearExecutionIdentity(&hold.identity)
		b.runHold = nil
	}
}

// ClearRunExecutionIdentityHolds is used when the owning project or trusted
// Execution Node context is replaced. It does not alter any ordinary lease.
func (b *Broker) ClearRunExecutionIdentityHolds() {
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	b.clearRunHoldsLocked()
}

func (b *Broker) HasRunExecutionIdentityHold(binding Binding) bool {
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	return b.hasRunHoldLocked(binding)
}

func (b *Broker) HasAnyRunExecutionIdentityHold() bool {
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	return b.runHold != nil
}

func (b *Broker) HasStartingExecutionIdentity(binding Binding, planID string) bool {
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	return b.runHold != nil && b.runHold.state == "STARTING" && b.runHold.binding == binding && b.runHold.planID == planID
}

func executionIdentityFromLease(value *lease) (ExecutionIdentity, error) {
	if value != nil && value.sshMode == SSHPassword && len(value.sshSecret) > 0 {
		return ExecutionIdentity{Mode: SSHPassword, Username: value.username, Generation: value.generation}, nil
	}
	if value == nil || value.sshMode != SSHPrivateKey || value.privateKeyPath == "" {
		return ExecutionIdentity{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_PEM_REQUIRED")
	}
	return ExecutionIdentity{Mode: SSHPrivateKey, Path: value.privateKeyPath, Username: value.username, Digest: sha256.Sum256(value.sshSecret), Generation: value.generation, FileInfo: value.privateKeyInfo}, nil
}

func sameExecutionIdentity(left, right ExecutionIdentity) bool {
	if left.Mode == SSHPassword || right.Mode == SSHPassword {
		return left.Mode == right.Mode && left.Username == right.Username && left.Generation == right.Generation && left.Generation != 0
	}
	return left.Path == right.Path && left.Username == right.Username && left.Digest == right.Digest && left.Generation == right.Generation && left.FileInfo != nil && right.FileInfo != nil && os.SameFile(left.FileInfo, right.FileInfo)
}

func (b *Broker) heldExecutionIdentityLocked(binding Binding) (ExecutionIdentity, bool) {
	hold := b.runHold
	if hold == nil || hold.binding != binding || hold.identity.Username == "" || hold.identity.Generation == 0 || (hold.identity.Mode != SSHPassword && (hold.identity.Path == "" || hold.identity.FileInfo == nil)) {
		return ExecutionIdentity{}, false
	}
	return hold.identity, true
}

func (b *Broker) hasRunHoldLocked(binding Binding) bool {
	return b.runHold != nil && b.runHold.binding == binding
}

func (b *Broker) clearRunHoldsLocked() {
	if b.runHold != nil {
		zero(b.runHold.password)
		zero(b.runHold.sudoPassword)
		clearExecutionIdentity(&b.runHold.identity)
		b.runHold = nil
	}
}

func clearExecutionIdentity(identity *ExecutionIdentity) {
	if identity == nil {
		return
	}
	identity.Path = ""
	identity.Mode = ""
	identity.Username = ""
	identity.Digest = [sha256.Size]byte{}
	identity.Generation = 0
	identity.FileInfo = nil
}

func readPrivateKey(path string) ([]byte, error) {
	value, _, err := readPrivateKeyWithInfo(path)
	return value, err
}

func readPrivateKeyWithInfo(path string) ([]byte, os.FileInfo, error) {
	info, err := os.Lstat(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, errors.New("SESSION_PRIVATE_KEY_UNREADABLE")
	}
	if !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
		return nil, nil, errors.New("SESSION_PRIVATE_KEY_NOT_REGULAR")
	}
	file, err := openPrivateKey(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, errors.New("SESSION_PRIVATE_KEY_UNREADABLE")
	}
	defer file.Close()
	opened, err := file.Stat()
	if err != nil || !opened.Mode().IsRegular() || opened.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || !os.SameFile(info, opened) {
		return nil, nil, errors.New("SESSION_PRIVATE_KEY_NOT_REGULAR")
	}
	contents, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, maxKeyBytes+1))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, errors.New("SESSION_PRIVATE_KEY_UNREADABLE")
	}
	if len(contents) > maxKeyBytes {
		zero(contents)
		return nil, nil, errors.New("SESSION_CREDENTIAL_TOO_LARGE")
	}
	if err := validatePrivateKey(contents); err != nil {
		zero(contents)
		if errors.Is(err, errEncryptedPrivateKey) {
			return nil, nil, errors.New("SESSION_PRIVATE_KEY_ENCRYPTED_UNSUPPORTED")
		}
		return nil, nil, errors.New("SESSION_PRIVATE_KEY_INVALID")
	}
	return contents, opened, nil
}

var errEncryptedPrivateKey = errors.New("encrypted private key")

// validatePrivateKey accepts the portable unencrypted PEM key forms supported
// by Go's standard library. It intentionally does not invoke an external
// parser or leave parser diagnostics available to callers.
func validatePrivateKey(contents []byte) error {
	block, rest := pem.Decode(contents)
	if block == nil || len(strings.TrimSpace(string(rest))) != 0 {
		return errors.New("invalid private key")
	}
	if x509.IsEncryptedPEMBlock(block) || strings.Contains(block.Type, "ENCRYPTED") {
		return errEncryptedPrivateKey
	}
	if key, err := x509.ParsePKCS8PrivateKey(block.Bytes); err == nil {
		switch key.(type) {
		case *rsa.PrivateKey, *ecdsa.PrivateKey:
			return nil
		default:
			return errors.New("unsupported private key")
		}
	}
	if _, err := x509.ParsePKCS1PrivateKey(block.Bytes); err == nil {
		return nil
	}
	if _, err := x509.ParseECPrivateKey(block.Bytes); err == nil {
		return nil
	}
	return errors.New("invalid private key")
}

func (b *Broker) armExpiryLocked(generation uint64, expiresAt time.Time) {
	if b.timer != nil {
		b.timer.Stop()
	}
	b.timer = time.AfterFunc(b.ttl, func() {
		b.mu.Lock()
		defer b.mu.Unlock()
		b.expireLocked(generation)
	})
}

func (b *Broker) armPendingExpiryLocked(generation uint64, expiresAt time.Time) {
	time.AfterFunc(time.Until(expiresAt), func() {
		b.mu.Lock()
		defer b.mu.Unlock()
		if b.pending != nil && b.pending.generation == generation && !b.now().Before(b.pending.expiresAt) {
			b.clearPendingLocked()
		}
	})
}

func (b *Broker) expireLocked(generation uint64) {
	if b.lease == nil || b.lease.generation != generation {
		return
	}
	binding, expiresAt := b.lease.binding, b.lease.expiresAt
	b.clearLeaseLocked(false)
	b.expired = &expiredMarker{binding: binding, expiresAt: expiresAt, generation: generation}
}

func (b *Broker) clearLeaseLocked(clearExpired bool) {
	if b.timer != nil {
		b.timer.Stop()
		b.timer = nil
	}
	if b.lease != nil {
		zero(b.lease.reference)
		zero(b.lease.sshSecret)
		zero(b.lease.sudoSecret)
		zero(b.lease.pkiStorePassword)
		zeroSecretMap(b.lease.runtimeSecretValues)
		zeroTypedSecretSlice(b.lease.runtimeSecretInputs)
		zeroTypedSecretSlice(b.lease.runtimeSecretInputs)
		b.lease = nil
	}
	if clearExpired {
		b.expired = nil
	}
}

func (b *Broker) clearPendingLocked() {
	if b.pending == nil {
		return
	}
	zeroSecretMap(b.pending.values)
	zeroTypedSecretMap(b.pending.typed)
	b.pending = nil
}

func statusFromLease(value *lease) Status {
	sudo := SudoNotProvided
	if len(value.sudoSecret) != 0 {
		sudo = SudoPresent
	}
	pki := PKIStorePasswordMissing
	if len(value.pkiStorePassword) != 0 {
		pki = PKIStorePasswordPresent
	}
	return Status{Status: StatusPresent, Username: value.username, SSHMode: value.sshMode, SudoPasswordStatus: sudo, PKIStorePasswordStatus: pki, ExpiresAt: value.expiresAt.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)}
}

func missingStatus() Status {
	return Status{Status: StatusMissing, SudoPasswordStatus: SudoNotProvided, PKIStorePasswordStatus: PKIStorePasswordMissing}
}
func zero(value []byte) {
	for i := range value {
		value[i] = 0
	}
}

var runtimeSecretRequirementPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$`)

func runtimeSecretID(value string) bool { return runtimeSecretRequirementPattern.MatchString(value) }

func sameRuntimeSecretRequirements(requirements []string, values map[string]string) bool {
	if len(requirements) == 0 || len(requirements) != len(values) {
		return false
	}
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(requirements))
	for _, reference := range requirements {
		if !runtimeSecretID(reference) {
			return false
		}
		if _, duplicate := seen[reference]; duplicate {
			return false
		}
		seen[reference] = struct{}{}
		if _, present := values[reference]; !present {
			return false
		}
	}
	return validRuntimeSecretMapFromStrings(values)
}

func validRuntimeSecretMap(values map[string][]byte) bool {
	if len(values) == 0 {
		return false
	}
	total := 0
	for reference, value := range values {
		if !runtimeSecretID(reference) || !utf8.Valid(value) || len(value) < 1 || len(value) > 4096 {
			return false
		}
		total += len(value)
		if total > 65536 {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func validRuntimeSecretMapFromStrings(values map[string]string) bool {
	if len(values) == 0 {
		return false
	}
	total := 0
	for reference, value := range values {
		if !runtimeSecretID(reference) || !utf8.ValidString(value) || len([]byte(value)) < 1 || len([]byte(value)) > 4096 {
			return false
		}

package runtimesecret

import "errors"

// HasExecutionSudoPassword returns only live credential metadata.
func (b *Broker) HasExecutionSudoPassword(binding Binding, identity ExecutionIdentity) bool {
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	if b.lease == nil || b.lease.binding != binding || !b.now().Before(b.lease.expiresAt) {
		return false
	}
	current, err := executionIdentityFromLease(b.lease)
	return err == nil && sameExecutionIdentity(current, identity) && len(b.lease.sudoSecret) != 0
}

// WithExecutionSudoPassword shares the existing exact-operation hold and wipe rules.
func (b *Broker) WithExecutionSudoPassword(binding Binding, identity ExecutionIdentity, planID, runID string, use func([]byte) error) error {
	if use == nil {
		return errors.New("SESSION_CREDENTIAL_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	b.mu.Lock()
	var password []byte
	if b.lease != nil && b.lease.binding == binding && b.now().Before(b.lease.expiresAt) {
		current, err := executionIdentityFromLease(b.lease)
		if err == nil && sameExecutionIdentity(current, identity) {
			password = append([]byte(nil), b.lease.sudoSecret...)
		}
	} else if b.operationHoldLocked(binding, planID, runID) && sameExecutionIdentity(b.runHold.identity, identity) {
		password = append([]byte(nil), b.runHold.sudoPassword...)
	}
	b.mu.Unlock()
	if len(password) == 0 {
		return errors.New("SESSION_CREDENTIAL_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	defer zero(password)
	return use(password)
}

// CurrentExecutionIdentityForOperation permits an expired password only for
// the exact already-reserved Start or confirmed run. Empty scope is live-only.
func (b *Broker) CurrentExecutionIdentityForOperation(binding Binding, planID, runID string) (ExecutionIdentity, error) {
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	if b.lease != nil && b.lease.binding == binding && b.now().Before(b.lease.expiresAt) {
		return executionIdentityFromLease(b.lease)
	}
	if b.operationHoldLocked(binding, planID, runID) {
		return b.runHold.identity, nil
	}
	return ExecutionIdentity{}, errors.New("SESSION_CREDENTIAL_UNAVAILABLE")
}

func (b *Broker) operationHoldLocked(binding Binding, planID, runID string) bool {
	h := b.runHold
	if h == nil || h.binding != binding {
		return false
	}
	return (h.state == "STARTING" && planID != "" && runID == "" && h.planID == planID) || (h.state == "RUNNING" && runID != "" && planID == "" && h.runID == runID)
}

// WithExecutionPassword never exposes other secrets or a password for another
// generation. The synchronous caller cannot retain the cleared byte slice.
func (b *Broker) WithExecutionPassword(binding Binding, identity ExecutionIdentity, planID, runID string, use func([]byte) error) error {
	if use == nil || identity.Mode != SSHPassword {
		return errors.New("SESSION_CREDENTIAL_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	b.mu.Lock()
	var password []byte
	if b.lease != nil && b.lease.binding == binding && b.now().Before(b.lease.expiresAt) {
		current, err := executionIdentityFromLease(b.lease)
		if err == nil && sameExecutionIdentity(current, identity) {
			password = append([]byte(nil), b.lease.sshSecret...)
		}
	} else if b.operationHoldLocked(binding, planID, runID) && sameExecutionIdentity(b.runHold.identity, identity) {
		password = append([]byte(nil), b.runHold.password...)
	}
	b.mu.Unlock()
	if len(password) == 0 {
		return errors.New("SESSION_CREDENTIAL_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	defer zero(password)
	return use(password)
}

// Package secretfiles provides bounded age password encryption for local
// runtime-secret files. It deliberately knows no service or project semantics.
package secretfiles

import (
	"bytes"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"filippo.io/age"
)

const (
	MaxEncryptedBytes = 131072
	MaxPasswordBytes  = 4096
	ScryptWorkFactor  = 18
)

var ErrFile = errors.New("SECRET_FILE_INVALID")

// Encrypt emits the standard binary age format with only the approved
// password/Scrypt recipient. Plaintext is never written to a file or exposed
// in an error. The caller owns and should clear its plaintext/password buffers.
func Encrypt(password, plaintext []byte) ([]byte, error) {
	if !validPassword(password) || len(plaintext) == 0 || len(plaintext) > MaxEncryptedBytes {
		return nil, ErrFile
	}
	recipient, err := age.NewScryptRecipient(string(password))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, ErrFile
	}
	recipient.SetWorkFactor(ScryptWorkFactor)
	var ciphertext bytes.Buffer
	writer, err := age.Encrypt(&ciphertext, recipient)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, ErrFile
	}
	if _, err = writer.Write(plaintext); err != nil {
		_ = writer.Close()
		return nil, ErrFile
	}
	if err = writer.Close(); err != nil || ciphertext.Len() > MaxEncryptedBytes {
		return nil, ErrFile
	}
	return ciphertext.Bytes(), nil
}

// Decrypt accepts only age-encrypted bytes and rejects oversized ciphertext,
// unsupported Scrypt work factors, invalid UTF-8 passwords and plaintext
// exceeding maxPlaintextBytes. It never attempts plaintext fallback.
func Decrypt(password, ciphertext []byte, maxPlaintextBytes int) ([]byte, error) {
	if !validPassword(password) || len(ciphertext) == 0 || len(ciphertext) > MaxEncryptedBytes || maxPlaintextBytes < 1 || maxPlaintextBytes > MaxEncryptedBytes {
		return nil, ErrFile
	}
	identity, err := age.NewScryptIdentity(string(password))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, ErrFile
	}
	identity.SetMaxWorkFactor(ScryptWorkFactor)
	reader, err := age.Decrypt(bytes.NewReader(ciphertext), identity)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, ErrFile
	}
	plaintext, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(reader, int64(maxPlaintextBytes)+1))
	if err != nil || len(plaintext) == 0 || len(plaintext) > maxPlaintextBytes || !utf8.Valid(plaintext) {
		clear(plaintext)
		return nil, ErrFile
	}
	return plaintext, nil
}

func validPassword(password []byte) bool {
	return len(password) > 0 && len(password) <= MaxPasswordBytes && utf8.Valid(password)
}

@@PORTABLE {"path":"internal/secretfiles/vault_input.go","mode":420,"size":8056,"sha256":"34dc88302f765e0cc252632d14e1af10f5b1417a255fbea9bd95ecdadd831a26","index":0,"count":1,"encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":8056}
package secretfiles

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"unicode/utf8"

const (
	PurposeAdminToken   = "SERVICE_ADMIN_TOKEN"
	PurposeUnsealShares = "SERVICE_UNSEAL_SHARES"
	MaxTokenBytes       = 4096
	MaxSharesJSONBytes  = 65536
	MaxShareBytes       = 128
	MaxShares           = 255
)

// VaultInput contains exactly one of Token or Shares. Byte slices remain
// caller-owned and must be cleared when the value is no longer needed.
type VaultInput struct {
	Purpose string
	Token   []byte
	Shares  [][]byte
}

// ReadVaultInput decodes one of the explicitly approved Vault input file
// forms. The function does not access the filesystem and never returns the
// surrounding initialization JSON. Encrypted input requires a password; a
// recognized age prefix is never retried as plaintext.
func ReadVaultInput(purpose string, fileBytes, inputPassword []byte) (VaultInput, error) {
	if len(fileBytes) == 0 || len(fileBytes) > MaxEncryptedBytes {
		return VaultInput{}, ErrFile
	}
	plain := fileBytes
	ownedPlain := false
	if bytes.HasPrefix(fileBytes, []byte("age-encryption.org/")) {
		if !bytes.HasPrefix(fileBytes, []byte("age-encryption.org/v1\n")) || len(inputPassword) == 0 {
			return VaultInput{}, ErrFile
		}
		limit := MaxTokenBytes
		if purpose == PurposeUnsealShares {
			limit = MaxSharesJSONBytes
		}
		var err error
		plain, err = Decrypt(inputPassword, fileBytes, limit)
		if err != nil {
			return VaultInput{}, ErrFile
		}
		ownedPlain = true
	}
	if ownedPlain {
		defer clear(plain)
	}
	if !utf8.Valid(plain) {
		return VaultInput{}, ErrFile
	}
	switch purpose {
	case PurposeAdminToken:
		return readAdminToken(plain)
	case PurposeUnsealShares:
		return readUnsealShares(plain)
	default:
		return VaultInput{}, ErrFile
	}
}

func readAdminToken(data []byte) (VaultInput, error) {
	if len(data) == 0 || len(data) > MaxTokenBytes {
		return VaultInput{}, ErrFile
	}
	value := data
	trimmed := bytes.TrimSpace(data)
	if len(trimmed) > 0 && trimmed[0] == '{' {
		fields, err := uniqueObject(data)
		if err != nil {
			return VaultInput{}, ErrFile
		}
		raw, ok := fields["root_token"]
		var token string
		if !ok || json.Unmarshal(raw, &token) != nil || !utf8.ValidString(token) {
			return VaultInput{}, ErrFile
		}
		value = []byte(token)
	}
	if len(value) == 0 || len(value) > MaxTokenBytes || bytes.ContainsAny(value, "\r\n") {
		return VaultInput{}, ErrFile
	}
	return VaultInput{Purpose: PurposeAdminToken, Token: append([]byte(nil), value...)}, nil
}

func readUnsealShares(data []byte) (VaultInput, error) {
	if len(data) == 0 || len(data) > MaxSharesJSONBytes {
		return VaultInput{}, ErrFile
	}
	fields, err := uniqueObject(data)
	if err != nil {
		return VaultInput{}, ErrFile
	}
	selected := ""
	for _, key := range []string{"keys", "keys_base64", "unseal_keys_hex", "unseal_keys_b64"} {
		if _, ok := fields[key]; ok {
			if selected != "" && !(selected == "unseal_keys_hex" && key == "unseal_keys_b64") && !(selected == "unseal_keys_b64" && key == "unseal_keys_hex") {
				return VaultInput{}, ErrFile
			}
			if key == "unseal_keys_hex" || key == "unseal_keys_b64" {
				if selected != "" && selected != "unseal_keys_hex" && selected != "unseal_keys_b64" {
					return VaultInput{}, ErrFile
				}
			}
			selected = key
		}
	}
	if selected == "" {
		return VaultInput{}, ErrFile
	}
	selectedRaw, ok := fields[selected]
	if !ok {
		return VaultInput{}, ErrFile
	}
	values, err := decodeStringArray(selectedRaw)
	if err != nil {
		return VaultInput{}, ErrFile
	}
	if _, err := validateShares(values); err != nil {
		return VaultInput{}, ErrFile
	}
	selectedBytes, err := decodeRepresentation(selected, values)
	if err != nil {
		return VaultInput{}, ErrFile
	}
	if selected == "unseal_keys_hex" || selected == "unseal_keys_b64" {
		for _, key := range []string{"unseal_keys_hex", "unseal_keys_b64"} {
			other, exists := fields[key]
			if !exists || key == selected {
				continue
			}
			otherValues, decodeErr := decodeStringArray(other)
			if decodeErr != nil {
				return VaultInput{}, ErrFile
			}
			decoded, decodeErr := decodeRepresentation(key, otherValues)
			if decodeErr != nil || !sameByteSet(selectedBytes, decoded) {
				return VaultInput{}, ErrFile
			}
		}
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(values)
	if err != nil || len(encoded) > 32768 {
		return VaultInput{}, ErrFile
	}
	return VaultInput{Purpose: PurposeUnsealShares, Shares: cloneByteSlices(values)}, nil
}

func decodeStringArray(raw json.RawMessage) ([][]byte, error) {
	var values []string
	if len(raw) == 0 || json.Unmarshal(raw, &values) != nil || len(values) == 0 || len(values) > MaxShares {
		return nil, ErrFile
	}
	result := make([][]byte, len(values))
	for i, value := range values {
		if !utf8.ValidString(value) || len([]byte(value)) == 0 || len([]byte(value)) > MaxShareBytes {
			return nil, ErrFile
		}
		result[i] = []byte(value)
	}
	return result, nil
}

func validateShares(values [][]byte) ([][]byte, error) {
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
	for _, value := range values {
		if len(value) == 0 || len(value) > MaxShareBytes || !utf8.Valid(value) {
			return nil, ErrFile
		}
		if _, ok := seen[string(value)]; ok {
			return nil, ErrFile
		}
		seen[string(value)] = struct{}{}
	}
	return cloneByteSlices(values), nil
}

func decodeRepresentation(key string, values [][]byte) ([][]byte, error) {
	result := make([][]byte, len(values))
	for i, value := range values {
		var decoded []byte
		var err error
		switch key {
		case "unseal_keys_hex":
			decoded, err = hex.DecodeString(string(value))
		case "unseal_keys_b64", "keys_base64":
			decoded, err = base64.StdEncoding.Strict().DecodeString(string(value))
			if err != nil {
				decoded, err = base64.RawStdEncoding.Strict().DecodeString(string(value))
			}
		default:
			decoded = append([]byte(nil), value...)
		}
		if err != nil || len(decoded) == 0 || len(decoded) > MaxShareBytes {
			return nil, ErrFile
		}
		result[i] = decoded
	}
	if _, err := validateShares(result); err != nil {
		return nil, ErrFile
	}
	return result, nil
}

func sameByteSet(left, right [][]byte) bool {
	if len(left) != len(right) {
		return false
	}
	set := make(map[string]int, len(left))
	for _, item := range left {
		set[string(item)]++
	}
	for _, item := range right {
		set[string(item)]--
		if set[string(item)] < 0 {
			return false
		}
	}
	for _, count := range set {
		if count != 0 {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func cloneByteSlices(values [][]byte) [][]byte {
	result := make([][]byte, len(values))
	for i, value := range values {
		result[i] = append([]byte(nil), value...)
	}
	return result
}

func uniqueObject(data []byte) (map[string]json.RawMessage, error) {
	if len(data) == 0 || !utf8.Valid(data) {
		return nil, ErrFile
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
	if err := scanJSONValue(decoder); err != nil {
		return nil, ErrFile
	}
	if _, err := decoder.Token(); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return nil, ErrFile
	}
	var fields map[string]json.RawMessage
	if json.Unmarshal(data, &fields) != nil || fields == nil {
		return nil, ErrFile
	}
	return fields, nil
}

func scanJSONValue(decoder *json.Decoder) error {
	token, err := decoder.Token()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	delim, isDelim := token.(json.Delim)
	if !isDelim {
		return nil
	}
	switch delim {
	case '{':
		seen := map[string]struct{}{}
		for decoder.More() {
			keyToken, err := decoder.Token()
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			key, ok := keyToken.(string)
			if !ok {
				return ErrFile
			}
			if _, duplicate := seen[key]; duplicate {
				return ErrFile
			}
			seen[key] = struct{}{}
			if err := scanJSONValue(decoder); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		end, err := decoder.Token()
		if err != nil || end != json.Delim('}') {
			return ErrFile
		}
	case '[':
		for decoder.More() {
			if err := scanJSONValue(decoder); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		end, err := decoder.Token()
		if err != nil || end != json.Delim(']') {
			return ErrFile
		}
	default:
		return ErrFile
	}
	return nil
}

)

const MaxFrameBytes = 65536

var ErrTransfer = errors.New("OUTPUT_TRANSFER_FAILED")

var (
	opaque     = regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9a-f]{32}$`)
	project    = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,127}$`)
	deployment = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:[-_.][a-z0-9]+)*$`)
	run        = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}$`)
	digest     = regexp.MustCompile(`^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$`)
)

// Binding is the expected identity from trusted local runtime context, never
// an identity inferred from the received frame itself.
type Binding struct {
	ProjectID, DeploymentID, PackageID, SourceRunID, RuntimeDigest string
	Generation                                                     int
}

type metadata struct {
	Protocol      string   `json:"protocol"`
	PackageID     string   `json:"packageId"`
	ProjectID     string   `json:"projectId"`
	DeploymentID  string   `json:"deploymentId"`
	SourceRunID   string   `json:"sourceRunId"`
	RuntimeDigest string   `json:"runtimeDigest"`
	Generation    int      `json:"generation"`
	State         string   `json:"state"`
	Entries       []string `json:"entries"`
}

// Consume validates the complete frame before invoking use. Token/shares are
// borrowed byte slices cleared on return, including callback failure. Callers
// must also establish a successful remote process exit before calling Consume.
// Transport and parse errors deliberately never include stream/error content.
func Consume(source io.Reader, expected Binding, use func(token, shares []byte) error) error {
	if source == nil || use == nil || !validBinding(expected) {
		return ErrTransfer
	}
	data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(source, MaxFrameBytes+1))
	defer clear(data)
	if err != nil || len(data) < 16 || len(data) > MaxFrameBytes || string(data[:4]) != "SOD1" {
		return ErrTransfer
	}
	m := uint64(binary.BigEndian.Uint32(data[4:8]))
	t := uint64(binary.BigEndian.Uint32(data[8:12]))
	s := uint64(binary.BigEndian.Uint32(data[12:16]))
	if m < 1 || m > 8192 || t < 1 || t > 4096 || s < 1 || s > 32768 || 16+m+t+s != uint64(len(data)) {
		return ErrTransfer
	}
	header := data[16 : 16+m]
	if !utf8.Valid(header) || !uniqueFlatObject(header) || !exactMetadataKeys(header) {
		return ErrTransfer
	}
	var meta metadata
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(header))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if decoder.Decode(&meta) != nil || meta.Protocol != "SecretOutputDelivery/v1alpha1" || meta.State != "READY" ||
		len(meta.Entries) != 2 || meta.Entries[0] != "admin-token" || meta.Entries[1] != "unseal-shares" ||
		meta.ProjectID != expected.ProjectID || meta.DeploymentID != expected.DeploymentID ||
		meta.PackageID != expected.PackageID || meta.SourceRunID != expected.SourceRunID || meta.RuntimeDigest != expected.RuntimeDigest || meta.Generation != expected.Generation {
		return ErrTransfer
	}
	token, shares := data[16+m:16+m+t], data[16+m+t:]
	if !utf8.Valid(token) || !utf8.Valid(shares) || !json.Valid(shares) {
		return ErrTransfer
	}
	// Semantic shares validation belongs to the approved Vault input adapter.
	if use(token, shares) != nil {
		// The callback owns plaintext too: its error may contain that content.
		// Never propagate or wrap it across this confidential boundary.
		return ErrTransfer
	}
	return nil
}

func validBinding(b Binding) bool {
	return project.MatchString(b.ProjectID) && len(b.DeploymentID) <= 128 && deployment.MatchString(b.DeploymentID) &&
		opaque.MatchString(b.PackageID) && run.MatchString(b.SourceRunID) && digest.MatchString(b.RuntimeDigest) && b.Generation >= 1 && b.Generation <= 2147483647
}

// The metadata schema has a flat object with primitive values and one array.
// Checking duplicate keys here prevents JSON last-value-wins identity parsing.
func uniqueFlatObject(data []byte) bool {
	d := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
	token, err := d.Token()
	if err != nil || token != json.Delim('{') {
		return false
	}
	seen := make(map[string]bool, 11)
	for d.More() {
		token, err = d.Token()
		key, ok := token.(string)
		if err != nil || !ok || seen[key] {
			return false
		}
		seen[key] = true
		var value json.RawMessage
		if d.Decode(&value) != nil {
			return false
		}
	}
	if _, err = d.Token(); err != nil {
		return false
	}
	_, err = d.Token()
	return err == io.EOF
}

func exactMetadataKeys(data []byte) bool {
	var fields map[string]json.RawMessage
	if json.Unmarshal(data, &fields) != nil || len(fields) != 9 {
		return false
	}
	for key := range fields {
		switch key {
		case "protocol", "packageId", "projectId", "deploymentId", "sourceRunId", "runtimeDigest", "generation", "state", "entries":
		default:
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

package secretoutputwire

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"unicode/utf8"
)

const Protocol = "SecretOutputDelivery/v1alpha1"
const MaxRequestBytes = 8192

var ErrRequest = errors.New("OUTPUT_REQUEST_INVALID")

// Request contains only non-secret protocol control fields. It is not a
// credential payload, a filesystem location or an authorization decision.
type Request struct {
	Protocol           string            `json:"protocol"`
	Operation          string            `json:"operation"`
	ProjectID          string            `json:"projectId"`
	Limit              int               `json:"limit,omitempty"`
	Cursor             string            `json:"cursor,omitempty"`
	PackageID          string            `json:"packageId,omitempty"`
	ExpectedGeneration int               `json:"expectedGeneration,omitempty"`
	ReceiptID          string            `json:"receiptId,omitempty"`
	CiphertextDigests  map[string]string `json:"ciphertextDigests,omitempty"`
}

// DecodeRequest admits exactly the closed request contract. Field presence is
// checked separately so omitted, zero and null cannot silently collapse.
func DecodeRequest(data []byte) (Request, error) {
	var r Request
	if len(data) == 0 || len(data) > MaxRequestBytes || !utf8.Valid(data) || !uniqueFlatObject(data) {
		return r, ErrRequest
	}
	var fields map[string]json.RawMessage
	if json.Unmarshal(data, &fields) != nil {
		return r, ErrRequest
	}
	d := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
	d.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if d.Decode(&r) != nil || r.Protocol != Protocol || !project.MatchString(r.ProjectID) {
		return Request{}, ErrRequest
	}
	required := []string{"protocol", "operation", "projectId"}
	optional := []string{}
	switch r.Operation {
	case "GetCapabilities":
	case "ListPending":
		required = append(required, "limit")
		optional = append(optional, "cursor")
		if r.Limit < 1 || r.Limit > 32 {
			return Request{}, ErrRequest
		}
		if _, exists := fields["cursor"]; exists && !opaque.MatchString(r.Cursor) {
			return Request{}, ErrRequest
		}
	case "Fetch", "Acknowledge":
		required = append(required, "packageId", "expectedGeneration")
		if !opaque.MatchString(r.PackageID) || r.ExpectedGeneration < 1 || r.ExpectedGeneration > 2147483647 {
			return Request{}, ErrRequest
		}
		if r.Operation == "Acknowledge" {
			required = append(required, "receiptId", "ciphertextDigests")
			if !opaque.MatchString(r.ReceiptID) || !uniqueFlatObject(fields["ciphertextDigests"]) || len(r.CiphertextDigests) != 2 ||
				!digest.MatchString(r.CiphertextDigests["admin-token"]) || !digest.MatchString(r.CiphertextDigests["unseal-shares"]) {
				return Request{}, ErrRequest
			}
		}
	default:
		return Request{}, ErrRequest
	}
	allowed := make(map[string]bool, len(required)+len(optional))
	for _, key := range required {
		value, exists := fields[key]
		if !exists || bytes.Equal(bytes.TrimSpace(value), []byte("null")) {
			return Request{}, ErrRequest
		}
		allowed[key] = true
	}
	for _, key := range optional {
		allowed[key] = true
	}
	for key := range fields {
		if !allowed[key] {
			return Request{}, ErrRequest
		}
	}
	return r, nil
}

@@PORTABLE {"path":"internal/sshpassword/askpass.go","mode":420,"size":4565,"sha256":"2b54fb5b24d140366228bff2368989ba4978547de0c097ee2913a0e304330d53","index":0,"count":1,"encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":4565}
// Package sshpassword supplies command-scoped OpenSSH ASKPASS without storing
// passwords in files, command arguments or process environment.
package sshpassword

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/rand"
	"crypto/subtle"
	"encoding/hex"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

const prefix = "PLATFORM_INSTALLER_SSH_"
const maxPassword = 32768

type Provider func(context.Context, func([]byte) error) error
type scopeKey struct{}
type Scope struct{ PlanID, RunID string }

func WithScope(ctx context.Context, scope Scope) context.Context {
	return context.WithValue(ctx, scopeKey{}, scope)
}
func OperationScope(ctx context.Context) Scope {
	value, _ := ctx.Value(scopeKey{}).(Scope)
	return value
}

func validPassword(value []byte) bool {
	if len(value) == 0 || len(value) > maxPassword {
		return false
	}
	for _, b := range value {
		if b == 0 || b == '\r' || b == '\n' {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

// Run owns listener, connections and the helper capability until the child
// finishes. The provider wipes the password when this synchronous call returns.
func Run(ctx context.Context, command *exec.Cmd, provider Provider) error {
	return provider(ctx, func(password []byte) error {
		if !validPassword(password) {
			return errors.New("SSH_PASSWORD_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED")
		}
		executable, err := os.Executable()
		if err != nil {
			return errors.New("SSH_PASSWORD_HELPER_UNAVAILABLE")
		}
		listener, err := net.Listen("tcp4", "127.0.0.1:0")
		if err != nil {
			return errors.New("SSH_PASSWORD_HELPER_UNAVAILABLE")
		}
		defer listener.Close()
		var random [32]byte
		if _, err = rand.Read(random[:]); err != nil {
			return errors.New("SSH_PASSWORD_HELPER_UNAVAILABLE")
		}
		token := hex.EncodeToString(random[:])
		done := make(chan struct{})
		go func() {
			defer close(done)
			defer listener.Close()
			for attempt := 0; attempt < 4; attempt++ {
				connection, err := listener.Accept()
				if err != nil {
					return
				}
				_ = connection.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(2 * time.Second))
				var supplied [64]byte
				_, err = io.ReadFull(connection, supplied[:])
				if err == nil && subtle.ConstantTimeCompare(supplied[:], []byte(token)) == 1 {
					_, _ = connection.Write(password)
					_, _ = connection.Write([]byte{'\n'})
					_ = connection.Close()
					return
				}
				_ = connection.Close()
			}
		}()
		// Remove inherited helper capabilities and SSH overrides before setting the
		// capability for this one child. Its value is never the SSH password.
		environment := command.Env
		if environment == nil {
			environment = os.Environ()
		}
		command.Env = nil
		for _, entry := range environment {
			name, _, _ := strings.Cut(entry, "=")
			name = strings.ToUpper(name)
			if !strings.HasPrefix(name, prefix) && name != "SSH_ASKPASS" && name != "SSH_ASKPASS_REQUIRE" {
				command.Env = append(command.Env, entry)
			}
		}
		command.Env = append(command.Env, "SSH_ASKPASS="+executable, "SSH_ASKPASS_REQUIRE=force", prefix+"ASKPASS=1", prefix+"ENDPOINT="+listener.Addr().String(), prefix+"TOKEN="+token)
		err = command.Run()
		_ = listener.Close()
		<-done
		return err
	})
}

// Dispatch runs before flags or UI initialization. A helper invocation has no
// application bindings and prints only the one authenticated ASKPASS response.
func Dispatch() bool {
	if os.Getenv(prefix+"ASKPASS") != "1" {
		return false
	}
	response, err := helperResponse(os.Getenv(prefix+"ENDPOINT"), os.Getenv(prefix+"TOKEN"))
	if err == nil {
		_, err = os.Stdout.Write(response)
	}
	for i := range response {
		response[i] = 0
	}
	if err != nil {
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	os.Exit(0)
	return true
}

func helperResponse(endpoint, token string) ([]byte, error) {
	fail := errors.New("SSH_PASSWORD_HELPER_UNAVAILABLE")
	host, port, err := net.SplitHostPort(endpoint)
	if err != nil || host != "127.0.0.1" || port == "" || len(token) != 64 {
		return nil, fail
	}
	if decoded, err := hex.DecodeString(token); err != nil || len(decoded) != 32 {
		return nil, fail
	}
	connection, err := net.DialTimeout("tcp4", endpoint, 2*time.Second)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fail
	}
	defer connection.Close()
	_ = connection.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(2 * time.Second))
	if _, err = io.WriteString(connection, token); err != nil {
		return nil, fail
	}
	response, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(connection, maxPassword+2))
	if err != nil || len(response) < 2 || response[len(response)-1] != '\n' || !validPassword(response[:len(response)-1]) {
		for i := range response {
			response[i] = 0
		}
		return nil, fail
	}
	return response, nil
}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Pack/restore application and Core sources in text parts of at most 5,000,000 bytes."""
import argparse
import base64
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

FORMAT = "platform-installer-portable-source-v2"
LIMIT = 5_000_000
BLOCK = 48_000
HEADER = b"@@PORTABLE "
FOOTER = b"\n@@END\n"
SCRIPT = "scripts/portable_source.py"
RESOURCES = ["build/appicon.png", "build/windows/icon.ico", "build/windows/info.json",
             "build/windows/wails.exe.manifest", "build/linux/build.sh",
             "build/linux/platform-installer-ui.desktop", "build/linux/icon.png"]
WAILS_SOURCE = "third_party/wails"
WAILS_VERSION = "v2.15.0"
# CLI templates are compile-time go:embed resources, including their README files.
WAILS_EMBED_TREES = ("pkg/templates/templates/", "pkg/templates/ides/",

                 ".pytest_cache", "dist", "cache", "bundle", "runs", "secrets",
