def digest(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def safe_path(name):
    require(isinstance(name, str) and bool(name), "Missing path")
    for part in name.split("/"):
        require(part not in {"", ".", ".."} and
                not re.search(r'[\\<>:"|?*\x00-\x1f]', part) and
                not part.endswith((".", " ")) and
                not re.match(r"^(con|prn|aux|nul|com[1-9]|lpt[1-9])(?:\.|$)", part, re.I),
                "Unsafe path: " + name)
    return name


def included(name):
    if name.startswith(WAILS_SOURCE + "/"):
        relative = name[len(WAILS_SOURCE) + 1:]
        if "/" not in relative and relative not in {"go.mod", "go.sum", "wails.go", "LICENSE", "SOURCE.json"}:
            return False
        if relative.startswith(WAILS_EMBED_TREES):
            return True
        # Vendored CLI dependencies already omit tests; preserve compile-time resources.
        if relative.startswith("vendor/"):
            return not relative.endswith("_test.go")
        if relative.split("/")[0] in {"test", "tests", "tools"}:
            return False
        if relative.endswith(".exe") and relative != "internal/webview2runtime/MicrosoftEdgeWebview2Setup.exe":
            return False
        if relative == "internal/webview2runtime/MicrosoftEdgeWebview2Setup.exe":
            return True
    parts = name.lower().split("/")
    leaf = parts[-1]
    if set(parts) & EXCLUDED_DIRS:
        return False
    if leaf in {"agents.md", "current_state.md"} or re.match(r"readme(?:\.|$)", leaf):
        return False
    # Licence/notice files are required for dependency redistribution.
    if re.search(r"\.(md|rst|adoc|docx?|pdf)$", leaf) and not re.match(r"(license|licence|copying|notice)", leaf):
        return False
    if re.search(r"(_test\.go|\.(test|spec)\.[^.]+)$", leaf) or leaf.startswith("test_"):
        return False
    if re.match(r"(vitest|playwright|eslint|prettier)\.config\.", leaf) or leaf == "test-setup.ts":
        return False
    if parts[0] == "scripts" and (leaf.startswith("qa-") or leaf in {"source_text.py", "portable-source.cjs"}):
        return False
    if leaf.startswith((".env", ".coverage")) or re.search(r"\.(key|pem|p12|pfx|vault-password|private-key|log|pyc|pyo|tmp|syso)$", leaf):
        return False
    if re.search(r"\.(rpm|deb|whl|bin|zip|tar|gz|xz|bz2|7z|iso)$", leaf):
        return False
    # Wails vendor has executable/DLL assets embedded in Go at compile time.
    if parts[0] != "vendor" and re.search(r"\.(exe|dll|so|a|lib)$", leaf):
        return False
    return True


def git(root, *args):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(root), *args])


def source_files(root):
    modes = {}
    for entry in git(root, "ls-files", "--stage", "-z").split(b"\0"):
        if not entry:
            continue
        metadata, name = entry.split(b"\t", 1)
        mode, _, stage = metadata.split(b" ")
        require(stage == b"0", "Unmerged source file")
        decoded = name.decode("utf-8")
        if included(decoded):
            require(mode in {b"100644", b"100755"}, "Unsupported Git entry: " + decoded)
            modes[decoded] = 0o755 if mode == b"100755" else 0o644
    for name in [SCRIPT, *RESOURCES]:
        modes[name] = 0o755 if name.endswith(".sh") else 0o644
    wails_root = root / WAILS_SOURCE
    require((wails_root / "vendor/modules.txt").is_file(), "Missing vendored Wails CLI sources")
    for directory, directories, filenames in os.walk(str(wails_root), followlinks=False):
        directories[:] = [name for name in directories if name not in {".git", "node_modules", "__pycache__"}]
        for filename in filenames:
            target = Path(directory) / filename
            name = target.relative_to(root).as_posix()
            if included(name):
                modes.setdefault(name, 0o755 if name.endswith(".sh") else 0o644)
    files = []
    seen = set()
    for name in sorted(modes):
        safe_path(name)
        require(name.casefold() not in seen, "Case-colliding source path: " + name)
        seen.add(name.casefold())
        target = root.joinpath(*name.split("/"))
        require(target.is_file() and not target.is_symlink(), "Missing/nonregular source: " + name)
        files.append((name, modes[name], target))
    return files


def pack(root, output):
    require(not output.exists(), "Output already exists: " + str(output))
    files = source_files(root)
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    staging = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=".portable-pack-", dir=str(output.parent)))
    manifest = {"format": FORMAT, "maxPartBytes": LIMIT,
                "sourceRevision": git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD").decode().strip(),
                "files": len(files), "sourceBytes": 0, "textFiles": 0, "binaryFiles": 0, "parts": []}
    lines = []
    length = 0

    def flush():
        nonlocal lines, length
        if not length:
            return
        data = b"".join(lines)
        name = "source-{:04d}.txt".format(len(manifest["parts"]) + 1)
        (staging / name).write_bytes(data)
        manifest["parts"].append({"name": name, "bytes": len(data), "sha256": digest(data)})
        lines, length = [], 0

    try:
        for name, mode, target in files:
            data = target.read_bytes()
            manifest["sourceBytes"] += len(data)
            checksum = digest(data)
            try:
                text = data.decode("utf-8")
                require("\0" not in text, "Binary NUL")
            except (UnicodeDecodeError, ValueError):
                encoding = "base64"
                chunks = [base64.b64encode(data[start:start + BLOCK])
                          for start in range(0, len(data), BLOCK)] or [b""]
                manifest["binaryFiles"] += 1
            else:
                encoding = "utf-8"
                chunks = [text[start:start + BLOCK].encode("utf-8")
                          for start in range(0, len(text), BLOCK)] or [b""]
                manifest["textFiles"] += 1
            count = len(chunks)
            for index, payload in enumerate(chunks):
                record = {"path": name, "mode": mode, "size": len(data), "sha256": checksum,
                          "index": index, "count": count,
                          "encoding": encoding, "payloadBytes": len(payload)}
                line = HEADER + json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode("ascii") + b"\n" + payload + FOOTER
                require(len(line) <= LIMIT, "Record exceeds part limit")
                if length + len(line) > LIMIT:
                    flush()
                lines.append(line)
                length += len(line)
        flush()
        manifest_data = (json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
        require(len(manifest_data) <= LIMIT, "Manifest exceeds part limit")
        (staging / "manifest.json").write_bytes(manifest_data)
        shutil.copyfile(Path(__file__), staging / "portable_source.py")
        require(not output.exists(), "Output appeared during pack")
        staging.rename(output)
    except Exception:
        shutil.rmtree(staging)
        raise
    print(json.dumps({"files": manifest["files"], "sourceBytes": manifest["sourceBytes"],
                      "parts": len(manifest["parts"]),
                      "textFiles": manifest["textFiles"], "binaryFiles": manifest["binaryFiles"],
                      "maxPartBytes": max(part["bytes"] for part in manifest["parts"]),
                      "output": str(output)}))


def read_package(source):
    manifest = json.loads((source / "manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    require(manifest.get("format") == FORMAT and manifest.get("maxPartBytes") == LIMIT and
            type(manifest.get("files")) is int and manifest["files"] > 0 and
            isinstance(manifest.get("parts"), list) and bool(manifest["parts"]), "Invalid manifest")
    files, seen, blocks = [], set(), []
    current, next_index, total = None, 0, 0
    encodings = {"utf-8": 0, "base64": 0}
    for part_index, part in enumerate(manifest["parts"], 1):
        require(part["name"] == "source-{:04d}.txt".format(part_index), "Invalid part order")
        data = (source / part["name"]).read_bytes()
        require(len(data) <= LIMIT and len(data) == part["bytes"] and digest(data) == part["sha256"],
                "Part checksum/size mismatch: " + part["name"])
        stream = io.BytesIO(data)
        while stream.tell() < len(data):
            header = stream.readline(16385)
            require(len(header) <= 16384 and header.startswith(HEADER) and header.endswith(b"\n"), "Invalid record header")
            record = json.loads(header[len(HEADER):].decode("ascii"))
            safe_path(record["path"])
            require(type(record.get("size")) is int and record["size"] >= 0 and
                    type(record.get("count")) is int and record["count"] > 0 and
                    type(record.get("index")) is int and isinstance(record.get("sha256"), str) and
                    re.fullmatch(r"[a-f0-9]{64}", record["sha256"]) and record.get("mode") in {0o644, 0o755} and
                    record.get("encoding") in {"utf-8", "base64"} and
                    type(record.get("payloadBytes")) is int and 0 <= record["payloadBytes"] <= BLOCK * 4,
                    "Invalid file metadata")
            if record["index"] == 0:
                require(current is None and record["path"].casefold() not in seen,
                        "Duplicate/incomplete file: " + record["path"])
                seen.add(record["path"].casefold())
                current, blocks, next_index = record, [], 0
            require(current is not None and record["index"] == next_index and
                    record["index"] < record["count"] and
                    all(record[key] == current[key] for key in ("path", "mode", "size", "sha256", "count", "encoding")),
                    "Invalid block order/metadata")
            payload = stream.read(record["payloadBytes"])
            require(len(payload) == record["payloadBytes"] and stream.read(len(FOOTER)) == FOOTER,
                    "Incomplete payload or invalid footer")
            if record["encoding"] == "utf-8":
                decoded = payload.decode("utf-8").encode("utf-8")
                require(b"\0" not in decoded, "Binary NUL in text")
            else:
                decoded = base64.b64decode(payload, validate=True)
                require(base64.b64encode(decoded) == payload and len(decoded) <= BLOCK, "Invalid Base64")
            blocks.append(decoded)
            next_index += 1
            if next_index == current["count"]:
                content = b"".join(blocks)
                require(len(content) == current["size"] and digest(content) == current["sha256"],
                        "File checksum mismatch: " + current["path"])
                files.append((current, content))
                encodings[current["encoding"]] += 1
                total += len(content)
                current, blocks = None, []
    require(current is None and len(files) == manifest["files"] and total == manifest["sourceBytes"],
            "Incomplete package")
    require(manifest.get("textFiles") == encodings["utf-8"] and manifest.get("binaryFiles") == encodings["base64"],
            "Encoding counts mismatch")
    return manifest, files


def unpack(source, destination):
    require(not destination.exists(), "Destination already exists: " + str(destination))
    _, files = read_package(source)  # Validate every part before writing.
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    staging = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=".portable-restore-", dir=str(destination.parent)))
    try:
        for record, content in files:
            target = staging.joinpath(*record["path"].split("/"))
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            with target.open("xb") as handle:
                handle.write(content)
            target.chmod(record["mode"])
        require(not destination.exists(), "Destination appeared during restoration")
        staging.rename(destination)
    except Exception:
        shutil.rmtree(staging)
        raise
    print("Restored {} files to {}".format(len(files), destination))


def verify(source, root=None):
    manifest, files = read_package(source)
    if root is not None:
        for record, _ in files:
            target = root.joinpath(*record["path"].split("/"))
            require(not target.is_symlink() and digest(target.read_bytes()) == record["sha256"],
                    "Source mismatch: " + record["path"])
    print("PASS: {} files, {} parts; SHA-256 {}".format(len(files), len(manifest["parts"]),
          "matches source tree" if root else "verified"))


def linux_build_tags(webkit):
    require(shutil.which("pkg-config") and shutil.which("cc"),
            "Linux build requires a C compiler and pkg-config")
    def available(package):
        return subprocess.run(["pkg-config", "--exists", package],
                              stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL).returncode == 0
    require(available("gtk+-3.0"), "Linux build requires GTK3 development libraries")
    abi = webkit
    if abi == "auto":
        abi = "4.1" if available("webkit2gtk-4.1") else "4.0"
    require(available("webkit2gtk-" + abi), "Linux build requires WebKit2GTK " + abi + " development libraries")
    return ["-tags", "webkit2_41"] if abi == "4.1" else []


def build_wails(root):
    source = root / WAILS_SOURCE
    require((source / "go.mod").is_file() and (source / "vendor/modules.txt").is_file(),
            "Missing Wails v2.15.0 sources/vendor")
    require((source / "cmd/wails/internal/version.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip() == WAILS_VERSION,
            "Unexpected Wails source version")
    require(shutil.which("go"), "Building Wails requires Go")
    output = root / ".runtime/tools" / ("wails.exe" if os.name == "nt" else "wails")
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    environment = dict(os.environ, GOFLAGS="-mod=vendor", GOPROXY="off", GOSUMDB="off", GOWORK="off", GOTOOLCHAIN="local")
    command = ["go", "build", "-mod=vendor", "-trimpath", "-o", str(output), "./cmd/wails"]
    print("+ " + " ".join(command), flush=True)
    subprocess.run(command, cwd=str(source), env=environment, check=True)
    subprocess.run([str(output), "version"], cwd=str(root), env=environment, check=True)
    return output


def build(root, webkit="auto"):
    require((root / "vendor/modules.txt").is_file(), "Missing Go vendor")
    npm = shutil.which("npm.cmd" if os.name == "nt" else "npm")
    require(npm and shutil.which("go"), "Build requires Node/npm and Go")
    tags = linux_build_tags(webkit) if sys.platform.startswith("linux") else []
    wails = str(build_wails(root))
    environment = dict(os.environ, GOFLAGS="-mod=vendor", GOPROXY="off", GOSUMDB="off", GOWORK="off", GOTOOLCHAIN="local")
    for command, cwd in [([npm, "ci"], root / "frontend"),
                         ([npm, "run", "build"], root / "frontend"),
                         ([wails, "build", "-nopackage", "-clean", "-m", "-nosyncgomod", "-skipbindings", "-s", *tags], root)]:
        print("+ " + " ".join(command), flush=True)
        subprocess.run(command, cwd=str(cwd), env=environment, check=True)
    if sys.platform.startswith("linux"):
        resources = root / "build/bin/linux-resources"
        resources.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copyfile(root / "build/linux/platform-installer-ui.desktop",
                        resources / "platform-installer-ui.desktop")
        shutil.copyfile(root / "build/linux/icon.png", resources / "platform-installer-ui.png")
    print("Build complete: " + str(root / "build/bin"))


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    for name, first, second in [("pack", "root", "output"), ("unpack", "source", "destination"),
                                ("verify", "source", "root"), ("build", "root", None), ("build-wails", "root", None)]:
        command = commands.add_parser(name)
        command.add_argument(first, type=Path)
        if name == "build":
            command.add_argument("--webkit", choices=["auto", "4.0", "4.1"], default="auto",
                                 help="Linux WebKit2GTK ABI; auto prefers 4.1")
        if second:
            command.add_argument(second, type=Path, nargs="?" if name == "verify" else None)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    try:
        if args.command == "pack":
            pack(args.root.resolve(), args.output.resolve())
        elif args.command == "unpack":
            unpack(args.source.resolve(), args.destination.resolve())
        elif args.command == "verify":
            verify(args.source.resolve(), args.root.resolve() if args.root else None)
        elif args.command == "build-wails":
            build_wails(args.root.resolve())
        else:
            build(args.root.resolve(), args.webkit)
        return 0
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, subprocess.CalledProcessError) as error:
        print("portable-source: " + str(error), file=sys.stderr)
        return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Regenerate only portable-source artifacts; validate before replacing files."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

import portable_source


def generated(name):
    return name in {"manifest.json", "portable_source.py"} or bool(
        re.fullmatch(r"source-[0-9]+\.txt", name)
    )


def update(root):
    output = root / "portable-source"
    if output.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError("portable-source must not be a symlink")
    revision = portable_source.git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD").decode().strip()
    manifest_path = output / "manifest.json"
    if manifest_path.is_file():
        manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        previous = manifest.get("sourceRevision")
        already_current = previous == revision
        if not already_current:
            parent = subprocess.run(
                ["git", "-C", str(root), "rev-parse", "HEAD^"],
                capture_output=True, text=True,
            )
            if parent.returncode == 0 and previous == parent.stdout.strip():
                changed = portable_source.git(root, "diff", "--name-only", "-z", "HEAD^", "HEAD")
                already_current = all(
                    path.decode().startswith("portable-source/")
                    and generated(path.decode().removeprefix("portable-source/"))
                    for path in changed.split(b"\0") if path
                )
        if already_current:
            try:
                portable_source.verify(output, root)
            except (ValueError, OSError):
                already_current = False
        if already_current:
            expected = {name for name, _, _ in portable_source.source_files(root)}
            _, records = portable_source.read_package(output)
            expected_outputs = {"manifest.json", "portable_source.py"} | {
                part["name"] for part in manifest["parts"]
            }
            actual_outputs = {path.name for path in output.iterdir() if generated(path.name)}
            if (expected == {record["path"] for record, _ in records}
                    and actual_outputs == expected_outputs
                    and (output / "portable_source.py").read_bytes()
                    == Path(portable_source.__file__).read_bytes()):
                print("Portable snapshot already represents this source revision")
                return

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="portable-source-update-") as workspace:
        candidate = Path(workspace) / "snapshot"
        portable_source.pack(root, candidate)
        portable_source.verify(candidate, root)
        restored = Path(workspace) / "restored"
        portable_source.unpack(candidate, restored)
        portable_source.verify(candidate, restored)
        output.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        new_names = {path.name for path in candidate.iterdir()}
        for path in candidate.iterdir():
            target = output / path.name
            if not generated(path.name) or target.is_symlink():
                raise ValueError("Unsafe generated output: " + str(target))
            shutil.copyfile(path, target)
        for path in output.iterdir():
            if generated(path.name) and path.name not in new_names:
                if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
                    raise ValueError("Unsafe stale output: " + str(path))
                path.unlink()
        portable_source.verify(output, root)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    update(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent)

    fail_msg: BIND_DNS_A_RECORD_UPDATE_INPUT_INVALID

- name: Инициализация результатов проверки зоны BIND без изменений
  ansible.builtin.set_fact:
    _platform_bind_zone_observations: []

- name: Проверка и чтение записей каждого выбранного владельца перед изменением DNS
  ansible.builtin.include_tasks: prepare_a_record.yml
  vars:
    platform_bind_a_record: "{{ _platform_bind_record }}"
  loop: "{{ platform_bind_a_records | sort(attribute='owner') }}"

    loop_var: _platform_bind_record

- name: Создание одного обновления зоны с проверками наличия записей и исходных RDATA
  ansible.builtin.set_fact:
    _platform_bind_zone_update: |-
      zone {{ platform_bind_a_records[0].zone }}.
      {% for observation in _platform_bind_zone_observations %}
      {% if observation.absentOwner %}
      prereq nxdomain {{ observation.record.owner }}
      {% else %}
      prereq nxrrset {{ observation.record.owner }} CNAME
      {% if observation.currentAddresses | length > 0 %}
      {% for address in observation.currentAddresses %}
      prereq yxrrset {{ observation.record.owner }} A {{ address }}
      {% endfor %}
      {% else %}
      prereq nxrrset {{ observation.record.owner }} A
      {% endif %}
      {% endif %}
      {% endfor %}
      {% for observation in _platform_bind_zone_observations | selectattr('changed') %}
      update delete {{ observation.record.owner }} A
      {% for address in observation.record.addresses | sort %}
      update add {{ observation.record.owner }} {{ observation.record.ttl }} A {{ address }}
      {% endfor %}
      {% endfor %}
      send

  ansible.builtin.assert:

"""Render table SQL through the existing Ansible template lookup in one action."""
import json
from ansible.plugins.action import ActionBase
from ansible.errors import AnsibleError


class ActionModule(ActionBase):
    TRANSFERS_FILES = False

    def run(self, tmp=None, task_vars=None):
        values = task_vars or {}
        try:
            job = self._task.args['job']
            if self._task.args['phase'] == 'accounts':
                return dict(changed=False, tables=[])
            if not any(database.get('tables') for database in job['databases']):
                return dict(changed=False, tables=[])
            variables = dict(values, platform_clickhouse_application_job=job,
                             table_template_path=self._task.args['template_path'])
            templar = self._templar.copy_with_new_env(available_variables=variables)
            rendered = templar.template("{{ lookup('ansible.builtin.template', table_template_path, template_vars={'platform_clickhouse_application_job': platform_clickhouse_application_job}) }}")
            # Depending on the Ansible native templating version, JSON may
            # already have been converted into its list representation.
            tables = json.loads(rendered) if isinstance(rendered, str) else rendered
            expected = [(database['name'], table) for database in job['databases']
                        for table in database.get('tables', [])]
            if (not isinstance(tables, list) or len(tables) != len(expected) or
                    any(not isinstance(row, dict) or row.get('database') != database or
                        row.get('definition') != definition or not isinstance(row.get('sql'), str) or
                        not row['sql'].strip() for row, (database, definition) in zip(tables, expected))):
                raise ValueError()
            return dict(changed=False, tables=tables)
        except (AnsibleError, KeyError, TypeError, ValueError):
            return dict(changed=False, failed=True, msg='CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_TABLE_TEMPLATE_INVALID')

"""Private native-client execution for library and logical instance scopes."""
import contextlib
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import stat
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
from xml.sax.saxutils import escape


class ProviderFailure(ValueError):
    pass


def identifier(value):
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not re.fullmatch(r'[a-z_][a-z0-9_-]{0,62}', value) or value in {'default', 'system', 'information_schema', 'INFORMATION_SCHEMA'}:
        raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_IDENTIFIER_INVALID')
    return '`' + value + '`'


def literal(value):
    return "'" + value.replace('\\', '\\\\').replace("'", "\\'") + "'"


def table_matches(client, database, table):
    """Read only declared schema; ClickHouse normalizes expressions, not a SQL parser here."""
    where = 'database = %s AND name = %s' % (literal(database), literal(table['name']))
    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in client.query(
        'SELECT engine, partition_key, primary_key, sorting_key, sampling_key, create_table_query '
        'FROM system.tables WHERE ' + where + ' FORMAT JSONEachRow;').splitlines() if line.strip()]
    if not rows:
        return False
    actual = rows[0]
    if actual['engine'] != table['engine']:
        raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_TABLE_ENGINE_DRIFT')
    columns = [json.loads(line) for line in client.query(
        'SELECT name, type, compression_codec FROM system.columns WHERE database = %s AND table = %s '
        'ORDER BY position FORMAT JSONEachRow;' % (literal(database), literal(table['name']))).splitlines() if line.strip()]
    if [(c['name'], c['type']) for c in columns] != [(c['name'], c['type']) for c in table['columns']]:
        raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_TABLE_COLUMNS_DRIFT')
    pairs = [('CODEC(' + c['codec'] + ')', a['compression_codec']) for c, a in zip(table['columns'], columns) if c.get('codec')]
    for desired, observed in [('partition_by', 'partition_key'), ('primary_key', 'primary_key'),
                              ('order_by', 'sorting_key'), ('sample_by', 'sampling_key')]:
        expected = table.get(desired, table['order_by'] if desired == 'primary_key' else '')
        value = actual[observed]
        if bool(expected) != bool(value):
            raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_TABLE_KEYS_DRIFT')
        if expected:
            pairs.append((expected, '(' + value + ')' if expected.lstrip().startswith('(') else value))
    indexes = [json.loads(line) for line in client.query(
        'SELECT name, expr, type_full, granularity FROM system.data_skipping_indices WHERE database = %s AND table = %s '
        'ORDER BY name FORMAT JSONEachRow;' % (literal(database), literal(table['name']))).splitlines() if line.strip()]
    expected_indexes = sorted(table.get('indexes', []), key=lambda i: i['name'])
    if [(i['name'], i['type_full'], i['granularity']) for i in indexes] != [(i['name'], i['type'], i['granularity']) for i in expected_indexes]:
        raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_TABLE_INDEX_DRIFT')
    pairs.extend((e['expression'], a['expr']) for e, a in zip(expected_indexes, indexes))
    expressions = ','.join(literal('SELECT ' + value) for pair in pairs for value in pair)
    normalized = json.loads(client.query('SELECT arrayMap(x -> formatQuerySingleLine(x), [' + expressions + ']) AS expressions FORMAT JSONEachRow;'))['expressions']
    if any(normalized[i] != normalized[i + 1] for i in range(0, len(normalized), 2)):
        raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_TABLE_EXPRESSION_DRIFT')
    for key, value in table.get('settings', {}).items():
        integral = isinstance(value, (int, float)) and float(value).is_integer()
        value = literal(value) if isinstance(value, str) else str(int(value) if isinstance(value, bool) or float(value).is_integer() else value)
        pattern = re.escape(value) + (r'(?:\.0*)?' if integral else '')
        if not re.search(r'\b' + re.escape(key) + r'\s*=\s*' + pattern + r'\s*(?:,|$)', actual['create_table_query']):
            raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_TABLE_SETTINGS_DRIFT')
    if table['engine'].startswith('Replicated'):
        replicas = [json.loads(line) for line in client.query(
            'SELECT zookeeper_path, replica_name, getMacro(\'shard\') AS shard, getMacro(\'replica\') AS replica '
            'FROM system.replicas WHERE database = %s AND table = %s FORMAT JSONEachRow;' % (literal(database), literal(table['name']))).splitlines() if line.strip()]
        if len(replicas) != 1 or replicas[0]['zookeeper_path'] != table['replicationPath'].replace('{shard}', replicas[0]['shard']) or replicas[0]['replica_name'] != replicas[0]['replica']:
            raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_TABLE_REPLICATION_DRIFT')
    return True


class NativeClient:
    def __init__(self, target, directory, password, username='default', timeout=60):
        descriptor, self.path = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.application-client-', suffix='.xml', dir=directory)
        self.timeout = timeout
        try:
            pki = directory + '/pki/'
            content = '<clickhouse><host>%s</host><port>%s</port><secure>true</secure><user>%s</user><password>%s</password><openSSL><client><caConfig>%s</caConfig><certificateFile>%s</certificateFile><privateKeyFile>%s</privateKeyFile><loadDefaultCAFile>false</loadDefaultCAFile><verificationMode>strict</verificationMode><extendedVerification>true</extendedVerification><invalidCertificateHandler><name>RejectCertificateHandler</name></invalidCertificateHandler></client></openSSL></clickhouse>' % (
                escape(target['address']), int(target['port']), escape(username), escape(password),
                escape(pki + 'ca-chain.pem'), escape(pki + 'certificate.pem'), escape(pki + 'private-key.pem'))
            with os.fdopen(descriptor, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
                stream.write(content)
        except Exception:
            os.unlink(self.path)
            raise

    def close(self):
        os.unlink(self.path)

    def query(self, sql):
        result = subprocess.run(['clickhouse-client', '--config-file', self.path, '--multiquery'], input=sql,
                                text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=self.timeout)
        if result.returncode:
            code = re.search(r'\bCode:\s*(\d{1,6})\b', result.stderr)
            raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_QUERY_FAILED' + ('_' + code.group(1) if code else ''))
        if len(result.stdout) > 1048576:
            raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_RESPONSE_INVALID')
        return result.stdout


def private_file(descriptor):
    info = os.fstat(descriptor)
    if not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or info.st_uid != os.getuid() or info.st_mode & 0o077 or info.st_nlink != 1 or info.st_size > 1048576:
        raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_PATH_UNSAFE')


@contextlib.contextmanager
def custody(directory, timeout):
    info = os.lstat(directory)
    if os.path.realpath(directory) != os.path.abspath(directory) or not stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) or info.st_uid != os.getuid() or info.st_mode & 0o077:
        raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_PATH_UNSAFE')
    descriptor = os.open(directory + '/.application-objects.lock', os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
    try:
        private_file(descriptor)
        deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
        while True:
            try:
                fcntl.flock(descriptor, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
                break
            except BlockingIOError:
                if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                    raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_LOCK_TIMEOUT')
                time.sleep(0.05)
        path = directory + '/application-objects.json'
        try:
            witness_descriptor = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            witness = {}
        else:
            with os.fdopen(witness_descriptor, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
                private_file(stream.fileno())
                witness = json.load(stream)
        if not isinstance(witness, dict):
            raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_WITNESS_INVALID')
        yield witness
    finally:
        os.close(descriptor)


def publish(directory, witness):
    descriptor, path = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.application-objects-', dir=directory)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(descriptor, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
            json.dump(witness, stream, sort_keys=True)
            stream.flush()
            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        os.replace(path, directory + '/application-objects.json')
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(path):
            os.unlink(path)


def state(client, databases, accounts):
    sql = ''
    if databases:
        sql += "SELECT 'database' AS kind, name, toString(uuid) AS id FROM system.databases WHERE name IN (%s) FORMAT JSONEachRow;\n" % ','.join(literal(item['name']) for item in databases)
    if accounts:
        names = ','.join(literal(item['name']) for item in accounts)
        sql += "SELECT 'user' AS kind, name, toString(id) AS id FROM system.users WHERE name IN (%s) FORMAT JSONEachRow;\n" % names
        sql += "SELECT 'grant' AS kind, user_name AS name, access_type AS privilege, database, table, column, is_partial_revoke, grant_option FROM system.grants WHERE user_name IN (%s) FORMAT JSONEachRow;\n" % names
        sql += "SELECT 'role' AS kind, user_name AS name FROM system.role_grants WHERE user_name IN (%s) FORMAT JSONEachRow;\n" % names
        tables = {(database, table) for account in accounts for database, table, _ in required_grants(account) if table != '*'}
        if tables:
            pairs = ','.join('(%s,%s)' % (literal(database), literal(table)) for database, table in sorted(tables))
            sql += "SELECT 'table' AS kind, database, name FROM system.tables WHERE (database, name) IN (%s) FORMAT JSONEachRow;\n" % pairs
    return [json.loads(line) for line in client.query(sql).splitlines() if line.strip()] if sql else []


def required_grants(account):
    values = set()
    for grant in account.get('grants', []):
        identifier(grant['database'])
        if grant['table'] != '*':
            identifier(grant['table'])
        if not set(grant['privileges']) <= {'SELECT', 'INSERT', 'CREATE TABLE'}:
            raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_GRANTS_INVALID')
        values.update((grant['database'], grant['table'], privilege) for privilege in grant['privileges'])
    return values


def managed_grant_delta(account, rows, databases):
    """Reconcile direct SELECT/INSERT/CREATE TABLE on this account's witnessed library DBs.

    Custody and UUID/marker checks remain the caller's prerequisite. Anything
    outside that limited authority remains a conflict, not a cleanup candidate.
    """
    grants = [row for row in rows if row['kind'] == 'grant' and row['name'] == account['name']]
    if (any(row['column'] or row['is_partial_revoke'] or row['grant_option'] for row in grants)
            or any(row['kind'] == 'role' and row['name'] == account['name'] for row in rows)):
        raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_GRANTS_DRIFT')
    prefix = account['marker'].split(':account:', 1)[0] + ':clickhouse.database:'
    owned = {db['name'] for db in databases if db['mode'] == 'managed' and db['marker'].startswith(prefix)}
    current = {(row['database'], row['table'] or '*', row['privilege']) for row in grants}
    expected = required_grants(account)
    removed = current - expected
    for database, table, privilege in removed:
        if database not in owned or privilege not in {'SELECT', 'INSERT', 'CREATE TABLE'}:
            raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_GRANTS_DRIFT')
        if table != '*':
            identifier(table)
    return expected - current, removed


def user_batch(account, password, missing, create, clustered, revoked=(), password_update=False):
    name = identifier(account['name'])
    cluster = ' ON CLUSTER default' if clustered else ''
    statements = []
    if create:
        verifier = hashlib.sha256(password.encode()).hexdigest()
        statements.append("CREATE USER %s%s IDENTIFIED WITH sha256_hash BY '%s' DEFAULT ROLE NONE;" % (name, cluster, verifier))
    elif password_update:
        verifier = hashlib.sha256(password.encode()).hexdigest()
        statements.append("ALTER USER %s%s IDENTIFIED WITH sha256_hash BY '%s';" % (name, cluster, verifier))
    for database, table, privilege in sorted(revoked):
        if privilege not in {'SELECT', 'INSERT', 'CREATE TABLE'}:
            raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_GRANTS_INVALID')
        scope = identifier(database) + '.' + ('*' if table == '*' else identifier(table))
        statements.append('REVOKE%s %s ON %s FROM %s;' % (cluster, privilege, scope, name))
    for database, table, privilege in sorted(missing):
        if privilege not in {'SELECT', 'INSERT', 'CREATE TABLE'}:
            raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_GRANTS_INVALID')
        scope = identifier(database) + '.' + ('*' if table == '*' else identifier(table))
        statements.append('GRANT%s %s ON %s TO %s;' % (cluster, privilege, scope, name))
    return '\n'.join(statements)


def verify_login(client, account, preflight=False):
    expected = required_grants(account)
    sql = 'SELECT 1;\n'
    if not preflight:
        for database, table, privilege in sorted(expected):
            sql += 'CHECK GRANT %s ON %s.%s;\n' % (privilege, identifier(database), '*' if table == '*' else identifier(table))
    if client.query(sql).split() != ['1'] * (1 if preflight else len(expected) + 1):
        raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_LOGIN_OR_GRANTS_FAILED')

"""Service-owned ClickHouse host-local allocation; no target discovery."""
import hashlib


def project_members(instances, deployment, settings):
    result, ordinals = [], {}
    for slot, source in enumerate(sorted(instances, key=lambda item: item['id'])):
        ordinal = ordinals.get(source['host'], 0)
        ordinals[source['host']] = ordinal + 1
        member = dict(source, slot=slot + 1, host_ordinal=ordinal)
        for name, base in [('https_port', 'port'), ('native_port', 'native_port'),
                           ('interserver_port', 'interserver_port'),
                           ('keeper_client_port', 'keeper_client_port'),
                           ('keeper_raft_port', 'keeper_raft_port')]:
            if base not in settings:
                continue
            port = int(source['port']) if name == 'https_port' and 'port' in source else int(settings[base]) + ordinal
            if not 1 <= port <= 65535:
                raise ValueError('CLICKHOUSE_LISTENER_PORT_INVALID')
            member[name] = port
        unit_id = hashlib.sha256((deployment + '\n' + source['id']).encode()).hexdigest()
        member['unit_id'] = unit_id
        for kind in ('server', 'keeper'):
            member[kind + '_unit_name'] = 'platform-clickhouse-' + kind + '@' + deployment + '-' + source['id'].rsplit('-', 1)[-1] + '.service'
            member['legacy_' + kind + '_unit_name'] = 'platform-clickhouse-' + kind + '-' + unit_id[:16] + '.service'
        for kind in ('config', 'data', 'log'):
            if kind + '_root' in settings:
                member[kind + '_directory'] = settings[kind + '_root'] + '/' + deployment + '/' + source['id']
        result.append(member)
    return result

def identity(rows, kind, name):
    values = [row['id'] for row in rows if row['kind'] == kind and row['name'] == name]
    if len(values) > 1:
        raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_IDENTITY_INVALID')
    return values[0] if values else None


def check_owner(witness, key, marker, actual, mode, phase):
    record = witness.get(key)
    if record is not None and (not isinstance(record, dict) or set(record) != {'marker', 'ids'}
                               or not isinstance(record['ids'], dict)):
        raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_WITNESS_INVALID')
    existing = {member: value for member, value in actual.items() if value is not None}
    if mode == 'managed':
        if existing and (not isinstance(record, dict) or record.get('marker') != marker or record.get('ids') != existing):
            raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_OWNERSHIP_UNKNOWN')
        if record and (record.get('marker') != marker or record.get('ids') != existing):
            raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_OWNERSHIP_DRIFT')
    if (mode == 'existing' or phase == 'verify') and len(existing) != len(actual):
        raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_OBJECT_MISSING')
    return existing


def main():
    module = AnsibleModule(argument_spec={
        'job': {'type': 'dict', 'required': True}, 'directory': {'type': 'path', 'required': True},
        'admin_password': {'type': 'str', 'required': True, 'no_log': True},
        'passwords': {'type': 'dict', 'default': {}, 'no_log': True},
        'tables': {'type': 'list', 'elements': 'dict', 'default': []},
        'phase': {'choices': ['preflight', 'resources', 'accounts', 'verify'], 'required': True},
        'lock_timeout': {'type': 'int', 'default': 15}, 'query_timeout': {'type': 'int', 'default': 60}})
    args, clients, changed, active_table = module.params, [], False, {}
    try:
        job, phase, directory = args['job'], args['phase'], args['directory']
        if not 1 <= args['lock_timeout'] <= 120 or not 1 <= args['query_timeout'] <= 120:
            raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_INPUT_INVALID')
        if any(not isinstance(password, str) or not 1 <= len(password) <= 4096
               for password in [args['admin_password']] + list(args['passwords'].values())):
            raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_INPUT_INVALID')
        if job['serviceType'] != 'clickhouse' or job['mode'] not in {'standalone', 'raft-ha'}:
            raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_INPUT_INVALID')
        targets = sorted(job['candidates'], key=lambda target: (target['hostId'], target['memberId']))
        if len(targets) != (3 if job['mode'] == 'raft-ha' else 1) or len({item['memberId'] for item in targets}) != len(targets):
            raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_MEMBERS_INVALID')
        databases, accounts = job['databases'], job['accounts']
        if len(databases) > 128 or len(accounts) > 128 or (phase == 'resources' and accounts):
            raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_INPUT_INVALID')
        for value in databases + accounts:
            identifier(value['name'])
            if value['mode'] not in {'managed', 'existing'} or not isinstance(value['marker'], str) or not value['marker'].startswith('platform.application/v1:'):
                raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_INPUT_INVALID')
        with custody(directory, args['lock_timeout']) as witness:
            original_witness = dict(witness)
            for target in targets:
                clients.append(NativeClient(target, directory, args['admin_password'], timeout=args['query_timeout']))
            if job['mode'] == 'raft-ha':
                topology = clients[0].query("SELECT host_name AS address, port FROM system.clusters WHERE cluster = 'default' FORMAT JSONEachRow;")
                resolved = {(item['address'], int(item['port'])) for item in map(json.loads, topology.splitlines())}
                if resolved != {(target['address'], int(target['port'])) for target in targets}:
                    raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_CLUSTER_INVALID')
            observed = {target['memberId']: state(client, databases, accounts) for target, client in zip(targets, clients)}
            resource_sql = {target['memberId']: [] for target in targets}
            missing_tables = []
            if phase != 'accounts':
                for active_table in args['tables']:
                    present = [table_matches(client, active_table['database'], active_table['definition']) for client in clients]
                    if not all(present):
                        if phase == 'verify':
                            raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_TABLE_MISSING')
                        missing_tables.append(active_table)
            for database in databases:
                actual = {member: identity(rows, 'database', database['name']) for member, rows in observed.items()}
                check_owner(witness, 'database/' + database['name'], database['marker'], actual, database['mode'], phase)
                if phase == 'accounts' and any(value is None for value in actual.values()):
                    raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_DATABASE_MISSING')
                for target in targets:
                    if actual[target['memberId']] is None and phase == 'resources' and database['mode'] == 'managed':
                        resource_sql[target['memberId']].append('CREATE DATABASE ' + identifier(database['name']) + ';')
            for target, client in zip(targets, clients):
                statements = resource_sql[target['memberId']]
                if statements:
                    client.query('\n'.join(statements))
                    changed = True
            account_sql = []
            # Persist newly created database ownership before a table error can
            # interrupt the scope; retry must not treat our database as foreign.
            if phase == 'resources' and changed:
                for database in databases:
                    ids = {target['memberId']: identity(state(client, [database], []), 'database', database['name'])
                           for target, client in zip(targets, clients)}
                    if any(value is None for value in ids.values()):
                        raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_OBJECT_MISSING')
                    if any(identity(observed[member], 'database', database['name']) not in (None, value) for member, value in ids.items()):
                        raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_OWNERSHIP_DRIFT')
                    if database['mode'] == 'managed':
                        witness['database/' + database['name']] = dict(marker=database['marker'], ids=ids)
                publish(directory, witness)
                original_witness = dict(witness)
            if phase == 'resources':
                for active_table in missing_tables:
                    clients[0].query('SET distributed_ddl_task_timeout = 30;\n' + active_table['sql'])
                    changed = True
                    deadline = time.monotonic() + args['query_timeout']
                    while not all(table_matches(client, active_table['database'], active_table['definition']) for client in clients):
                        if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                            raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_TABLE_NOT_READY')
                        time.sleep(1)
            for account in accounts:
                actual = {member: identity(rows, 'user', account['name']) for member, rows in observed.items()}
                existing = check_owner(witness, 'user/' + account['name'], account['marker'], actual, account['mode'], phase)
                if existing and len(existing) != len(targets):
                    raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_PARTIAL_ACCOUNT')
                expected = required_grants(account)
                missing_union, removed_union = set(), set()
                password_update = False
                for target, client in zip(targets, clients):
                    rows = observed[target['memberId']]
                    grants = [row for row in rows if row['kind'] == 'grant' and row['name'] == account['name']]
                    current = {(row['database'], row['table'] or '*', row['privilege']) for row in grants}
                    missing = expected - current
                    if account['mode'] == 'managed':
                        missing, removed = managed_grant_delta(account, rows, databases)
                        if phase == 'verify' and removed:
                            raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_GRANTS_DRIFT')
                        removed_union.update(removed)
                    if phase == 'verify' and missing and account['mode'] == 'managed':
                        raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_GRANTS_MISSING')
                    missing_union.update(missing)
                    # Specific table grants require application migrations first.
                    for database, table, _ in expected:
                        if table != '*':
                            if (database, table) not in {(row['database'], row['name']) for row in rows if row['kind'] == 'table'}:
                                raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_MIGRATION_REQUIRED')
                    if existing:
                        user_client = NativeClient(target, directory, args['passwords'][account['passwordRef']], account['name'], args['query_timeout'])
                        try:
                            verify_login(user_client, account, account['mode'] == 'managed' and
                                         (phase == 'preflight' or (phase == 'accounts' and bool(missing))))
                        except ProviderFailure as error:
                            if (str(error) != 'CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_QUERY_FAILED_516' or
                                    account['mode'] != 'managed' or phase not in {'preflight', 'resources', 'accounts'}):
                                raise
                            password_update = True
                        finally:
                            user_client.close()
                if phase == 'accounts' and account['mode'] == 'managed':
                    account_sql.append(user_batch(account, args['passwords'][account['passwordRef']], missing_union, not existing, job['mode'] == 'raft-ha', removed_union, password_update))
            if any(account_sql):
                clients[0].query('SET distributed_ddl_task_timeout = 30;\n' + '\n'.join(account_sql))
                changed = True
            # Observed identities/grants and authenticated probes already prove
            # an unchanged scope. Reread only after an actual native mutation.
            if phase in {'resources', 'accounts'} and changed:
                final = {target['memberId']: state(client, databases, accounts) for target, client in zip(targets, clients)}
                for value, kind in [(value, 'database') for value in databases] + [(value, 'user') for value in accounts]:
                    ids = {member: identity(rows, kind, value['name']) for member, rows in final.items()}
                    if any(value is None for value in ids.values()):
                        raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_OBJECT_MISSING')
                    original = {member: identity(rows, kind, value['name']) for member, rows in observed.items()}
                    if any(identifier is not None and ids[member] != identifier for member, identifier in original.items()):
                        raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_OWNERSHIP_DRIFT')
                    if value['mode'] == 'managed':
                        witness[kind + '/' + value['name']] = {'marker': value['marker'], 'ids': ids}
                for account in accounts:
                    if account['mode'] == 'managed':
                        for rows in final.values():
                            missing, removed = managed_grant_delta(account, rows, databases)
                            if missing or removed:
                                raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_GRANTS_DRIFT')
                    for target in targets:
                        user_client = NativeClient(target, directory, args['passwords'][account['passwordRef']], account['name'], args['query_timeout'])
                        try:
                            verify_login(user_client, account)
                        finally:
                            user_client.close()
                if witness != original_witness:
                    publish(directory, witness)
        module.exit_json(changed=changed)
    except ProviderFailure as error:
        module.fail_json(msg=str(error), database=active_table.get('database', ''), table=active_table.get('definition', {}).get('name', ''))
    except (ValueError, OSError, TypeError, KeyError, SubprocessError):
        module.fail_json(msg='CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_SCOPE_FAILED')
    finally:
        for client in clients:
            client.close()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

@@END

      (platform_clickhouse_mode == 'raft-ha' and _platform_clickhouse_keeper_status.stdout == 'active') or
      (platform_clickhouse_mode == 'standalone' and _platform_clickhouse_keeper_status.stdout != 'active')
    fail_msg: CLICKHOUSE_KEEPER_MODE_MISMATCH

    method: GET
    url_username: default
    url_password: "{{ _platform_clickhouse_default_password }}"
    force_basic_auth: true
    validate_certs: true
    ca_path: "{{ clickhouse_member.config_directory }}/pki/ca-chain.pem"
    return_content: true
    status_code: 200
  register: _platform_clickhouse_https_query
  changed_when: false
  failed_when: false
  until: _platform_clickhouse_https_query.status | default(-1) | int == 200
  retries: 15
  delay: 2
  no_log: true

- name: Вывод только статуса HTTPS при ошибке аутентификации или TLS

    msg: "CLICKHOUSE_HTTPS_STATUS={{ _platform_clickhouse_https_query.status | default(-1) }}"
  when: _platform_clickhouse_https_query.status | default(-1) | int != 200

- name: Проверка успешности HTTPS-запроса ClickHouse с аутентификацией

      - _platform_clickhouse_https_query.content | default('') | trim == '1'
    fail_msg: "CLICKHOUSE_AUTHENTICATED_HTTPS_VERIFY_FAILED status={{ _platform_clickhouse_https_query.status | default(-1) }}"
  no_log: true

    port: "{{ clickhouse_member.keeper_client_port }}"
    state: started
    timeout: 30
  when: platform_clickhouse_mode == 'raft-ha'
  changed_when: false

- name: Проверка владения установленным помощником RootlessKit LXC
  ansible.builtin.stat:
    path: /usr/libexec/lxc/lxc-user-nic
    follow: false
    get_mime: false
    get_attributes: false
    get_checksum: false
  register: _platform_docker_lxc_helper

- name: Проверка доверенного исполняемого файла помощника LXC
  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that:
      - _platform_docker_lxc_helper.stat.isreg
      - not _platform_docker_lxc_helper.stat.islnk
      - _platform_docker_lxc_helper.stat.pw_name == 'root'
      - _platform_docker_lxc_helper.stat.mode in ['4755', '4750']
    fail_msg: DOCKER_LXC_HELPER_UNSAFE

- name: Проверка необходимых исполняемых файлов Docker без прав root
  ansible.builtin.stat:
    path: "{{ item }}"
    follow: false
    get_mime: false
    get_attributes: false
    get_checksum: false
  loop: [/usr/bin/dockerd-rootless.sh, /usr/bin/rootlesskit, /usr/bin/newuidmap, /usr/bin/newgidmap, /usr/libexec/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose]
  register: _platform_docker_binaries

- name: Проверка наличия всех исполняемых файлов Docker без прав root и Compose
  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that: _platform_docker_binaries.results | rejectattr('stat.isreg', 'equalto', true) | list | length == 0
    fail_msg: DOCKER_RUNTIME_PACKAGE_INCOMPLETE

- name: Чтение выделенных пользователю диапазонов subordinate UID и GID
  ansible.builtin.slurp:
    src: "{{ item }}"
  loop: [/etc/subuid, /etc/subgid]
  register: _platform_docker_subid_files

- name: Проверка диапазонов subordinate UID и GID, выделенных пользователю
  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that:
      - >-
        (_platform_docker_subid_files.results[0].content | b64decode)
        is search('(?m)^' ~ platform_docker_account_name ~ ':[0-9]+:[0-9]+$')
      - >-
        (_platform_docker_subid_files.results[1].content | b64decode)
        is search('(?m)^' ~ platform_docker_account_name ~ ':[0-9]+:[0-9]+$')
      - >-
        (((_platform_docker_subid_files.results[0].content | b64decode).splitlines()
          | select('match', '^' ~ platform_docker_account_name ~ ':') | first).split(':')[2] | int) >= 65536
      - >-
        (((_platform_docker_subid_files.results[1].content | b64decode).splitlines()
          | select('match', '^' ~ platform_docker_account_name ~ ':') | first).split(':')[2] | int) >= 65536
    fail_msg: DOCKER_SUBID_ALLOCATION_REQUIRED

- name: Проверка общего адресата пользовательской сети LXC перед изменением

  changed_when: false
  failed_when: _platform_docker_existing_usernet.rc not in [0, 1, 2]

    owner: root

    line: "{{ platform_docker_account_name }} veth {{ platform_docker_lxc_bridge }} {{ platform_docker_lxc_veth_limit }}"

    follow: false
    get_mime: false
    get_attributes: false
    get_checksum: false
  register: _platform_docker_lxc_dnsmasq_file

  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that:
      - not (_platform_docker_lxc_dnsmasq_file.stat.islnk | default(false))
      - not _platform_docker_lxc_dnsmasq_file.stat.exists or (_platform_docker_lxc_dnsmasq_file.stat.isreg | default(false))
      - not _platform_docker_lxc_dnsmasq_file.stat.exists or _platform_docker_lxc_dnsmasq_file.stat.pw_name == 'root'
    fail_msg: DOCKER_LXC_DNSMASQ_CONFIG_NOT_OWNED

  ansible.builtin.slurp:

    fail_msg: DOCKER_LXC_DNSMASQ_CONFIG_NOT_OWNED

      - not _platform_docker_lxc_dns_server.startswith('127.')

    fail_msg: DOCKER_LXC_DNS_SERVER_UNAVAILABLE

- name: Выбор плана Core PKI для потребителя при его наличии
  ansible.builtin.include_role:
    name: platform.core.pki_materialize
    tasks_from: select_consumer_plan.yml
  vars:
    platform_pki_consumer_tls_profile_id: "{{ platform_docker_tls_profile }}"
  when: >-
    platform_pki_materialization_plans | default(hostvars['localhost'].platform_pki_materialization_plans | default([]), true)
    | selectattr('hostId', 'equalto', inventory_hostname)
    | selectattr('tlsProfileId', 'equalto', platform_docker_tls_profile)
    | list | length > 0

- name: Определение утвержденного каталога Docker TLS
  ansible.builtin.set_fact:
    _platform_docker_tls_source: >-
      {{ platform_pki_selected_consumer_plan.targetDirectory
         if platform_pki_selected_consumer_plan is defined
         else platform_docker_tls_directory }}
  changed_when: false

- name: Отклонение отсутствующего или небезопасного каталога PKI
  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that:
      - _platform_docker_tls_source is match('^/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]{1,240}$')
      - "'..' not in _platform_docker_tls_source.split('/')"
    fail_msg: DOCKER_PKI_MATERIALIZATION_REQUIRED

- name: Проверка TLS-файлов Docker
  ansible.builtin.stat:
    path: "{{ _platform_docker_tls_source }}/{{ item }}"
    follow: false
    get_mime: false
    get_attributes: false
    get_checksum: false
  loop: [ca-chain.pem, certificate.pem, private-key.pem]
  register: _platform_docker_tls_files
  no_log: true

- name: Проверка обычного типа TLS-файлов и отсутствия символических ссылок
  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that:
      - _platform_docker_tls_files.results | rejectattr('stat.isreg', 'equalto', true) | list | length == 0
      - _platform_docker_tls_files.results | selectattr('stat.islnk', 'equalto', true) | list | length == 0
    fail_msg: DOCKER_PKI_MATERIALIZATION_REQUIRED
  no_log: true

- name: Проверка назначений serverAuth и clientAuth в выбранном запросе PKI для Docker
  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that:
      - _platform_docker_selected_requests | length == 1
      - "'serverAuth' in (_platform_docker_selected_requests[0].usages | default([]))"
      - "'clientAuth' in (_platform_docker_selected_requests[0].usages | default([]))"
    fail_msg: DOCKER_PKI_USAGES_INVALID
  vars:
    _platform_docker_selected_requests: >-
      {{ _platform_pki_consumer_requests
         | selectattr('id', 'equalto', platform_pki_selected_consumer_plan.requestId)
         | list }}
  when: platform_pki_selected_consumer_plan is defined

- name: "Чтение расширенных назначений ключа сертификата — EKU"
  ansible.builtin.command:
    argv: [openssl, x509, -in, "{{ _platform_docker_tls_source }}/certificate.pem", -noout, -ext, extendedKeyUsage]
  register: _platform_docker_certificate_eku
  changed_when: false
  failed_when: false
  no_log: true

- name: Отклонение отсутствующего или неполного явного сертификата Docker EKU
  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that:
      - _platform_docker_certificate_eku.rc == 0
      - _platform_docker_certificate_eku.stdout is search('X509v3 Extended Key Usage:')
      - _platform_docker_certificate_eku.stdout is search('(?m)(?:^|[,\n])\s*TLS Web Server Authentication\s*(?:,|$)')
      - _platform_docker_certificate_eku.stdout is search('(?m)(?:^|[,\n])\s*TLS Web Client Authentication\s*(?:,|$)')
    fail_msg: DOCKER_PKI_USAGES_INVALID

- name: Проверка сертификата Docker API SAN

@@PORTABLE {"path":"services/haproxy/ansible_collections/platform/haproxy/plugins/module_utils/managed_graph.py","mode":420,"size":12428,"sha256":"98a42fc102033d0baccbd4aa104295cb73b5c4e4ee81cd3329da09d74a1315f2","index":0,"count":1,"encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":12428}
import os
import re
import stat
import uuid
import hashlib

NAME = re.compile(r"30-backend-[a-z][a-z0-9._-]*\.cfg\Z")
MAX_FILE = 8 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_FILES = 256
MAX_TOTAL = 32 * 1024 * 1024
OPEN_DIR = os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW


class ArchiveError(Exception):
    pass


def require(ok, code):
    if not ok:
        raise ArchiveError(code)


def secure_directory(fd):
    info = os.fstat(fd)
    require(stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) and info.st_uid == 0, "HAPROXY_ARCHIVE_DIRECTORY_UNSAFE")
    # A root-owned sticky ancestor such as /var/tmp cannot rename a root-owned
    # child; every actual HAProxy/archival directory remains non-writable.
    require(not (info.st_mode & 0o022) or bool(info.st_mode & stat.S_ISVTX),
            "HAPROXY_ARCHIVE_DIRECTORY_UNSAFE")
    return info


def open_directory_path(path):
    require(isinstance(path, str) and path.startswith("/") and
            not any(part in (".", "..") for part in path.split("/")),
            "HAPROXY_ARCHIVE_PATH_INVALID")
    current = os.open("/", OPEN_DIR)
    try:
        secure_directory(current)
        for part in (value for value in path.split("/") if value):
            next_fd = os.open(part, OPEN_DIR, dir_fd=current)
            secure_directory(next_fd)
            os.close(current)
            current = next_fd
        return current
    except BaseException:
        os.close(current)
        raise


def child_directory(parent, name, create=False):
    if create:
        try:
            os.mkdir(name, 0o700, dir_fd=parent)
        except FileExistsError:
            pass
    fd = os.open(name, OPEN_DIR, dir_fd=parent)
    info = secure_directory(fd)
    require(not (info.st_mode & 0o077), "HAPROXY_ARCHIVE_DIRECTORY_UNSAFE")
    require(info.st_dev == os.fstat(parent).st_dev, "HAPROXY_ARCHIVE_MOUNT_UNSAFE")
    return fd


def read_regular(parent, name):
    fd = os.open(name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK, dir_fd=parent)
    try:
        before = os.fstat(fd)
        require(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and before.st_uid == 0 and
                not (before.st_mode & 0o022) and before.st_nlink == 1 and
                before.st_size <= MAX_FILE and before.st_dev == os.fstat(parent).st_dev,
                "HAPROXY_ARCHIVE_FILE_UNSAFE")
        data = bytearray()
        while len(data) <= MAX_FILE:
            block = os.read(fd, min(65536, MAX_FILE + 1 - len(data)))
            if not block:
                break
            data.extend(block)
        after = os.fstat(fd)
        require(len(data) <= MAX_FILE and len(data) == before.st_size and
                (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) ==
                (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns),
                "HAPROXY_ARCHIVE_FILE_CHANGED")
        return bytes(data), before
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def write_snapshot(parent, name, data, source):
    fd = os.open(name, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW,
                 0o600, dir_fd=parent)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "wb", closefd=False) as output:
            output.write(data)
            output.flush()
        os.fchown(fd, source.st_uid, source.st_gid)
        os.fchmod(fd, stat.S_IMODE(source.st_mode))
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def capture_prior_candidate(config_directory, name_prefix=''):
    """Prove old active backends against the retained complete candidate graph."""
    try:
        config_fd = open_directory_path(config_directory)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return []  # A fresh installation has no active backend inventory.
    try:
        try:
            active_fd = os.open("conf.d", OPEN_DIR, dir_fd=config_fd)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            return []
        try:
            secure_directory(active_fd)
            active_names = sorted(os.listdir(active_fd))
            backend_names = [name for name in active_names if name.startswith("30-backend-")]
            if not backend_names:
                return []
            require(len(active_names) <= MAX_FILES and
                    all(isinstance(name, str) and "/" not in name for name in active_names),
                    "HAPROXY_PRIOR_GRAPH_INVALID")
            # Old releases retained their validated .platform-candidate. If it
            # is missing or differs, no old file is automatically owned.
            candidate_fd = os.open("." + (name_prefix + "-" if name_prefix else "") + "candidate", OPEN_DIR, dir_fd=config_fd)
            try:
                secure_directory(candidate_fd)
                require(os.fstat(candidate_fd).st_dev == os.fstat(config_fd).st_dev,
                        "HAPROXY_PRIOR_GRAPH_INVALID")
                candidate_conf_fd = os.open("conf.d", OPEN_DIR, dir_fd=candidate_fd)
                try:
                    secure_directory(candidate_conf_fd)
                    require(os.fstat(candidate_conf_fd).st_dev == os.fstat(active_fd).st_dev and
                            sorted(os.listdir(candidate_conf_fd)) == active_names,
                            "HAPROXY_PRIOR_GRAPH_INVALID")
                    active_main, _ = read_regular(config_fd, "haproxy.cfg")
                    candidate_main, _ = read_regular(candidate_fd, "haproxy.cfg")
                    require(active_main == candidate_main, "HAPROXY_PRIOR_GRAPH_MISMATCH")
                    total = len(active_main)
                    inventory = []
                    for name in active_names:
                        active, _ = read_regular(active_fd, name)
                        candidate, _ = read_regular(candidate_conf_fd, name)
                        total += len(active)
                        require(total <= MAX_TOTAL and active == candidate,
                                "HAPROXY_PRIOR_GRAPH_MISMATCH")
                        if name in backend_names:
                            require(NAME.fullmatch(name), "HAPROXY_BACKEND_OWNERSHIP_UNPROVEN")
                            inventory.append({"name": name, "sha256": hashlib.sha256(active).hexdigest()})
                    return inventory
                finally:
                    os.close(candidate_conf_fd)
            finally:
                os.close(candidate_fd)
        finally:
            os.close(active_fd)
    finally:
        os.close(config_fd)


def archive(config_directory, candidate_files, activation_required, previous_inventory=None, name_prefix=''):
    if previous_inventory is None:
        previous_inventory = []
    require(isinstance(candidate_files, list) and len(candidate_files) <= MAX_FILES and
            len(set(candidate_files)) == len(candidate_files) and
            all(isinstance(name, str) and NAME.fullmatch(name) for name in candidate_files),
            "HAPROXY_ARCHIVE_CANDIDATE_INVALID")
    require(isinstance(previous_inventory, list) and len(previous_inventory) <= MAX_FILES and
            all(isinstance(item, dict) and set(item) == {"name", "sha256"} and
                isinstance(item["name"], str) and NAME.fullmatch(item["name"]) and
                isinstance(item["sha256"], str) and
                re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", item["sha256"])
                for item in previous_inventory), "HAPROXY_PRIOR_INVENTORY_INVALID")
    proof = {item["name"]: item["sha256"] for item in previous_inventory}
    require(len(proof) == len(previous_inventory), "HAPROXY_PRIOR_INVENTORY_INVALID")
    config_fd = open_directory_path(config_directory)
    try:
        conf_fd = os.open("conf.d", OPEN_DIR, dir_fd=config_fd)
        try:
            conf_info = secure_directory(conf_fd)
            require(conf_info.st_dev == os.fstat(config_fd).st_dev,
                    "HAPROXY_ARCHIVE_MOUNT_UNSAFE")
            names = sorted(os.listdir(conf_fd))
            backend_names = [name for name in names if name.startswith("30-backend-")]
            owned_names = sorted(set(backend_names).union(
                ("10-public.cfg", "20-local-stats.cfg", "90-stats-backends.cfg")).intersection(names))
            require(len(owned_names) <= MAX_FILES, "HAPROXY_ARCHIVE_FILE_LIMIT")
            previous = {}
            total = 0
            require(set(proof) == set(backend_names), "HAPROXY_BACKEND_OWNERSHIP_UNPROVEN")
            for name in owned_names:
                data, metadata = read_regular(conf_fd, name)
                total += len(data)
                require(total <= MAX_TOTAL, "HAPROXY_ARCHIVE_SIZE_LIMIT")
                previous[name] = (data, metadata)
                if name in backend_names:
                    require(NAME.fullmatch(name) and
                            hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == proof[name],
                            "HAPROXY_BACKEND_OWNERSHIP_UNPROVEN")
            stale = sorted(set(backend_names).difference(candidate_files))
            if not activation_required:
                require(not stale, "HAPROXY_BACKEND_STALE_WITHOUT_ACTIVATION")
                return {"changed": False, "archived": [], "archivePath": None}
            try:
                main = read_regular(config_fd, "haproxy.cfg")
            except FileNotFoundError:
                require(not previous, "HAPROXY_ARCHIVE_MAIN_MISSING")
                main = None
            if main is None:
                return {"changed": False, "archived": [], "archivePath": None}
            archive_name = "." + (name_prefix + "-" if name_prefix else "") + "backend-archive"
            archive_fd = child_directory(config_fd, archive_name, create=True)
            try:
                token = "activation-" + uuid.uuid4().hex
                session_fd = child_directory(archive_fd, token, create=True)
                try:
                    previous_fd = child_directory(session_fd, "previous", create=True)
                    stale_fd = child_directory(session_fd, "stale", create=True)
                    try:
                        previous_conf_fd = child_directory(previous_fd, "conf.d", create=True)
                        try:
                            write_snapshot(previous_fd, "haproxy.cfg", *main)
                            for name, (data, metadata) in previous.items():
                                write_snapshot(previous_conf_fd, name, data, metadata)
                            os.fsync(previous_conf_fd)
                            os.fsync(previous_fd)
                            moved = []
                            try:
                                for name in stale:
                                    original = previous[name][1]
                                    current = os.stat(name, dir_fd=conf_fd, follow_symlinks=False)
                                    require((current.st_dev, current.st_ino, current.st_mtime_ns) ==
                                            (original.st_dev, original.st_ino, original.st_mtime_ns),
                                            "HAPROXY_ARCHIVE_FILE_CHANGED")
                                    os.rename(name, name, src_dir_fd=conf_fd, dst_dir_fd=stale_fd)
                                    moved.append(name)
                                    archived = os.stat(name, dir_fd=stale_fd, follow_symlinks=False)
                                    require(archived.st_ino == original.st_ino and archived.st_dev == original.st_dev,
                                            "HAPROXY_ARCHIVE_IDENTITY_MISMATCH")
                                os.fsync(stale_fd)
                                os.fsync(conf_fd)
                            except BaseException:
                                for name in reversed(moved):
                                    if name not in os.listdir(conf_fd):
                                        os.rename(name, name, src_dir_fd=stale_fd, dst_dir_fd=conf_fd)
                                raise
                        finally:
                            os.close(previous_conf_fd)
                    finally:
                        os.close(previous_fd)
                        os.close(stale_fd)
                    os.fsync(session_fd)
                finally:
                    os.close(session_fd)
            finally:
                os.close(archive_fd)
            return {"changed": True, "archived": stale,
                    "archivePath": os.path.join(config_directory, archive_name, token)}
        finally:
            os.close(conf_fd)
    finally:
        os.close(config_fd)

#!/usr/bin/python
"""Preflight and archive only proven Platform-owned HAProxy backend fragments.

This intentionally handles one fixed HAProxy layout, not arbitrary filesystem
cleanup. The retained, exact prior Platform candidate proves the old inventory.
"""

from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function

__metaclass__ = type

import os
import re
import stat
import uuid
import hashlib

from ansible.module_utils.basic import AnsibleModule


DOCUMENTATION = r'''
---
module: archive_managed_backends
short_description: Guard and archive exact owned HAProxy backend fragments
description:
  - Rejects unowned reserved backend files and archives proven stale fragments before publication.
options:
  config_directory:
    type: path
    required: true
    description: Fixed HAProxy configuration root.

    required: true

    elements: dict

        "candidate_files": {"type": "list", "elements": "str", "default": []},
        "activation_required": {"type": "bool", "default": False},
        "operation": {"type": "str", "choices": ["capture", "archive"], "default": "archive"},
        "previous_inventory": {"type": "list", "elements": "dict", "default": []},
        "name_prefix": {"type": "str", "default": ""},
    }, supports_check_mode=False)
    try:
        if module.params["name_prefix"] and not re.fullmatch(r"[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,23}", module.params["name_prefix"]):
            raise ValueError("HAPROXY_RESOURCE_PREFIX_INVALID")
        if module.params["operation"] == "capture":
            result = {"changed": False, "previousInventory": capture_prior_candidate(
                module.params["config_directory"], module.params["name_prefix"])}
        else:
            result = archive(module.params["config_directory"], module.params["candidate_files"],

                             module.params["previous_inventory"], module.params["name_prefix"])
        module.exit_json(**result)
    except (ArchiveError, OSError, ValueError) as error:
        # The archive path and file contents are intentionally not included.
        module.fail_json(msg=error.args[0] if isinstance(error, ArchiveError)
                         else "HAPROXY_RESOURCE_PREFIX_INVALID" if isinstance(error, ValueError)
                         else "HAPROXY_ARCHIVE_IO_FAILURE")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
